import { setCorsHeaders } from './_lib/auth.js';
import { generateCodeFirstOpenApiSpec } from './_lib/openapiRegistry.js';

export default function handler(req, res) {
  // Support returning raw OpenAPI 3.1 JSON
  if (req.query?.format === 'json' || req.url?.includes('openapi.json')) {
    setCorsHeaders(res, req);
    if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
      return res.status(204).end();
    }
    try {
      const spec = generateCodeFirstOpenApiSpec();
      res.setHeader('Content-Type', 'application/json; charset=utf-8');
      return res.status(200).json(spec);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('[OpenAPI Generator Error]:', err);
      return res.status(500).json({
        success: false,
        error: 'OPENAPI_GENERATION_FAILED',
        message: err.message
      });
    }
  }

  res.setHeader('Content-Type', 'text/html; charset=utf-8');

  const html = `<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <title>Wholesale RMA Portal | Interactive REST API Documentation</title>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
    <link rel="icon" type="image/svg+xml" href="data:image/svg+xml,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 24 24' fill='none' stroke='%231d6fce' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'><path d='M3 7V5a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h2'/><path d='M17 3h2a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v2'/><path d='M21 17v2a2 2 0 0 1-2 2h-2'/><path d='M7 21H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2v-2'/><rect width='10' height='8' x='7' y='8' rx='1'/></svg>" />
    <style>
      body {
        margin: 0;
        background-color: #0b0f19;
        font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif;
      }
    </style>
  </head>
  <body>
    <!-- Scalar Modern Interactive API Reference -->
    <script
      id="api-reference"
      data-url="/api/openapi.json"
      data-configuration='{"theme":"purple","layout":"modern","showSidebar":true,"searchHotKey":"k"}'
      src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@scalar/api-reference"></script>
  </body>
</html>`;

  return res.status(200).send(html);
}

--- START FILE: api/send-email.js ---
import nodemailer from 'nodemailer';

function getDiagnosticHelp(errMsg, user, pass) {
  const str = String(errMsg || '');
  if (str.includes('535') || str.includes('BadCredentials') || str.includes('Username and Password not accepted')) {
    return `Google SMTP rejected login for "${user}". Your App Password has ${pass.length} characters (Google App Passwords are 16 letters). If you see 535 Bad Credentials, please verify: (1) Ensure 2-Step Verification is enabled in your Google Account for ${user}, (2) Ensure the App Password was generated under ${user} (Google Account > Security > 2-Step Verification > App passwords), and (3) In Vercel Environment Variables, check GMAIL_APP_PASSWORD and make sure all 16 characters were pasted accurately.`;
  }
  return null;
}

export default async function handler(req, res) {
  // CORS configuration
  res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Credentials', 'true');
  res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', '*');
  res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Methods', 'GET,OPTIONS,PATCH,DELETE,POST,PUT');
  res.setHeader(
    'Access-Control-Allow-Headers',
    'X-CSRF-Token, X-Requested-With, Accept, Accept-Version, Content-Length, Content-MD5, Content-Type, Date, X-Api-Version'
  );

  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
    return res.status(200).end();
  }

  try {
    let payload = req.body;
    if (typeof payload === 'string') {
      try {
        payload = JSON.parse(payload);
      } catch (e) {
        // use as-is
      }
    }

    const smtpUser = String(process.env.SMTP_USER || process.env.GMAIL_USER || 'finance2@keysysincorporated.com').trim();
    const rawPass = process.env.SMTP_PASS || process.env.GMAIL_APP_PASSWORD || process.env.SMTP_PASSWORD || '';
    
    // CRITICAL: Google displays app passwords with spaces like "abcd efgh ijkl mnop".
    // We strip all spaces/whitespace to ensure pure 16-character authentication with Google SMTP.
    const cleanPass = String(rawPass).replace(/\s+/g, '').trim();

    if (!cleanPass) {
      console.warn('SMTP credentials (GMAIL_APP_PASSWORD) not configured in Vercel environment variables yet.');
      return res.status(200).json({
        success: false,
        notConfigured: true,
        user: smtpUser,
        message: 'SMTP credentials (GMAIL_APP_PASSWORD) not configured in Vercel environment variables. Email notifications will be logged in console.'
      });
    }

    const isGmail = !process.env.SMTP_HOST || process.env.SMTP_HOST.includes('gmail.com');
    const transporter = nodemailer.createTransport(
      isGmail
        ? {
            service: 'gmail',
            auth: {
              user: smtpUser,
              pass: cleanPass
            }
          }
        : {
            host: process.env.SMTP_HOST,
            port: Number(process.env.SMTP_PORT || 465),
            secure: Number(process.env.SMTP_PORT || 465) === 465,
            auth: {
              user: smtpUser,
              pass: cleanPass
            }
          }
    );

    // Diagnostic/Testing Connection Ping
    if (req.method === 'GET' || payload?.action === 'test-connection') {
      try {
        console.log(`[SMTP Diagnostic Ping] Testing credentials for user: ${smtpUser} (password length: ${cleanPass.length}, had spaces originally: ${rawPass.includes(' ')})`);
        await transporter.verify();
        return res.status(200).json({
          success: true,
          verified: true,
          user: smtpUser,
          passLength: cleanPass.length,
          hadSpaces: rawPass.includes(' '),
          message: `Google SMTP connection & authentication successfully verified for ${smtpUser}!`
        });
      } catch (verifyErr) {
        console.error('SMTP Verify failed:', verifyErr);
        return res.status(200).json({
          success: false,
          verified: false,
          user: smtpUser,
          passLength: cleanPass.length,
          hadSpaces: rawPass.includes(' '),
          error: verifyErr.message,
          diagnostic: getDiagnosticHelp(verifyErr.message, smtpUser, cleanPass)
        });
      }
    }

    const {
      from,
      fromName,
      to = 'azgodev@gmail.com',
      cc = [],
      subject,
      html,
      text,
      isTestMode = false,
      attachments = []
    } = payload || {};

    const senderEmail = from || smtpUser;
    const formattedFrom = fromName ? `"${fromName}" <${senderEmail}>` : senderEmail;

    // Filter valid CC addresses
    const validCc = Array.isArray(cc)
      ? cc.filter(e => typeof e === 'string' && e.includes('@') && e.trim() !== '' && !e.endsWith('.test'))
      : (cc && typeof cc === 'string' && cc.includes('@') && !cc.endsWith('.test') ? [cc] : []);

    let finalTo = to;
    let finalCc = validCc;
    let finalSubject = subject || 'New RMA Return Submission Notification';
    let finalHtml = html || text || '';
    let finalText = text || '';

    // If Test Mode is active:
    // DO NOT send to actual recipients or customer AE!
    // Instead, reroute the delivery to finance2@keysysincorporated.com so Danilo sees the sent and received email in Gmail without disturbing anyone!
    if (isTestMode) {
      const originalTo = to;
      const originalCc = validCc.join(', ');

      finalTo = smtpUser; // 'finance2@keysysincorporated.com'
      finalCc = []; // empty to prevent other recipients from receiving anything
      finalSubject = finalSubject.toLowerCase().startsWith('test') || finalSubject.startsWith('[TEST')
        ? finalSubject
        : `[TEST MODE] ${finalSubject}`;

      const testBanner = `
        <div style="background-color: #fef3c7; border: 2px dashed #f59e0b; color: #92400e; padding: 14px 18px; border-radius: 12px; margin-bottom: 20px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 13px;">
          <div style="font-weight: 800; font-size: 14px; margin-bottom: 6px;">🧪 TEST MODE ACTIVE (Safe Sandbox Delivery)</div>
          <div>This test email was safely sent exclusively to <strong>${finalTo}</strong> so you can verify the layout, calculations, and photo attachments in your Gmail.</div>
          <div style="margin-top: 8px; padding-top: 8px; border-top: 1px solid #fde68a; font-size: 11px; color: #78350f;">
            <strong>Live Production Recipients (Bypassed in Test Mode):</strong><br/>
            • <strong>Target TO:</strong> ${originalTo}<br/>
            • <strong>Target CC:</strong> ${originalCc || 'None'}
          </div>
        </div>
      `;

      finalHtml = testBanner + finalHtml;
      finalText = `[TEST MODE ACTIVE - Safe Sandbox Delivery]\nTarget TO: ${originalTo}\nTarget CC: ${originalCc}\n\n${finalText}`;
      console.log(`🧪 [TEST MODE] Dispatched safely via SMTP to ${finalTo} (Original TO: ${originalTo}, CC: ${originalCc})`);
    }

    const mailOptions = {
      from: formattedFrom,
      to: finalTo,
      cc: finalCc,
      subject: finalSubject,
      text: finalText,
      html: finalHtml,
      attachments: Array.isArray(attachments) ? attachments : []
    };

    let info;
    try {
      info = await transporter.sendMail(mailOptions);
    } catch (sendErr) {
      if (mailOptions.attachments && mailOptions.attachments.length > 0) {
        console.warn('sendMail with attachments failed, retrying without attachments:', sendErr.message);
        mailOptions.attachments = [];
        info = await transporter.sendMail(mailOptions);
      } else {
        throw sendErr;
      }
    }

    console.log('Email dispatched successfully via Gmail SMTP:', info.messageId, 'TestMode:', isTestMode);

    return res.status(200).json({
      success: true,
      messageId: info.messageId,
      testMode: isTestMode,
      deliveredTo: finalTo
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error in send-email API handler:', error);
    const smtpUser = String(process.env.SMTP_USER || process.env.GMAIL_USER || 'finance2@keysysincorporated.com').trim();
    const rawPass = process.env.SMTP_PASS || process.env.GMAIL_APP_PASSWORD || process.env.SMTP_PASSWORD || '';
    const cleanPass = String(rawPass).replace(/\s+/g, '').trim();

    return res.status(200).json({
      success: false,
      error: error.message,
      diagnostic: getDiagnosticHelp(error.message, smtpUser, cleanPass),
      user: smtpUser,
      passLength: cleanPass.length
    });
  }
}

--- START FILE: api/upload-photo.js ---
import crypto from 'crypto';
import { setCorsHeaders } from './_lib/auth.js';
import { inspectPaperworkWithGemini } from './_lib/geminiInspector.js';

/**
 * Cache access token across warm lambda invocations
 */
let cachedToken = null;
let tokenExpiresAt = 0;
const folderCache = new Map();

/**
 * Extracts Google Service Account credentials from environment variables
 */
function getGoogleCredentials() {
  let clientEmail = null;
  let privateKey = null;
  let folderId = process.env.GOOGLE_DRIVE_FOLDER_ID || null;
  let impersonateUser = process.env.GOOGLE_DRIVE_IMPERSONATE_USER || process.env.GOOGLE_WORKSPACE_USER || null;

  // Option 1: Direct JSON string in GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY or GOOGLE_DRIVE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON
  const jsonStr = process.env.GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY || process.env.GOOGLE_DRIVE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON;
  if (jsonStr) {
    try {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(jsonStr);
      if (parsed.client_email && parsed.private_key) {
        clientEmail = parsed.client_email;
        privateKey = parsed.private_key.replace(/\\n/g, '\n');
        if (!folderId) folderId = parsed.folder_id || null;
        if (!impersonateUser) impersonateUser = parsed.impersonate_user || null;
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('[Google Drive Auth] Failed to parse service account JSON:', e.message);
    }
  }

  // Option 2: Individual env vars
  if (!clientEmail || !privateKey) {
    clientEmail = process.env.GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_EMAIL || process.env.GOOGLE_DRIVE_CLIENT_EMAIL;
    privateKey = process.env.GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_PRIVATE_KEY || process.env.GOOGLE_DRIVE_PRIVATE_KEY;
  }

  if (clientEmail && privateKey) {
    privateKey = privateKey.replace(/\\n/g, '\n');
    return { clientEmail, privateKey, folderId, impersonateUser };
  }

  return null;
}

/**
 * Generates an OAuth2 JWT assertion for Google APIs (RS256)
 * Supports optional user impersonation (domain-wide delegation) if configured.
 */
function createGoogleJwtAssertion(clientEmail, privateKey, impersonateUser = null) {
  const header = {
    alg: 'RS256',
    typ: 'JWT',
  };

  const now = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
  const claimSet = {
    iss: clientEmail,
    scope: 'https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive.file',
    aud: 'https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token',
    exp: now + 3600,
    iat: now,
  };

  // If user delegation configured, set sub
  if (impersonateUser) {
    claimSet.sub = impersonateUser;
  }

  const encodeBase64Url = (obj) =>
    Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(obj))
      .toString('base64')
      .replace(/=/g, '')
      .replace(/\+/g, '-')
      .replace(/\//g, '_');

  const unsignedToken = `${encodeBase64Url(header)}.${encodeBase64Url(claimSet)}`;

  const sign = crypto.createSign('RSA-SHA256');
  sign.update(unsignedToken);
  sign.end();
  const signature = sign
    .sign(privateKey, 'base64')
    .replace(/=/g, '')
    .replace(/\+/g, '-')
    .replace(/\//g, '_');

  return `${unsignedToken}.${signature}`;
}

/**
 * Obtains an OAuth2 Access Token using JWT bearer grant
 */
async function getGoogleAccessToken(creds, signal) {
  const now = Date.now();
  if (cachedToken && tokenExpiresAt > now + 60000) {
    return cachedToken;
  }

  // Try with impersonateUser first if set, fallback to direct service account if unauthorized
  let assertion = createGoogleJwtAssertion(creds.clientEmail, creds.privateKey, creds.impersonateUser);
  let body = new URLSearchParams({
    grant_type: 'urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:jwt-bearer',
    assertion,
  });

  let res = await fetch('https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' },
    body: body.toString(),
    signal,
  });

  if (!res.ok && creds.impersonateUser) {
    // If impersonation failed (e.g. domain delegation not configured in admin.google.com), retry as pure service account
    console.warn('[Google Drive Auth] Impersonation failed, retrying without sub claim...');
    assertion = createGoogleJwtAssertion(creds.clientEmail, creds.privateKey, null);
    body = new URLSearchParams({
      grant_type: 'urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:jwt-bearer',
      assertion,
    });
    res = await fetch('https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' },
      body: body.toString(),
      signal,
    });
  }

  if (!res.ok) {
    const errText = await res.text();
    throw new Error(`Google OAuth Token Error (${res.status}): ${errText}`);
  }

  const data = await res.json();
  cachedToken = data.access_token;
  tokenExpiresAt = now + (data.expires_in || 3600) * 1000;
  return cachedToken;
}

/**
 * Finds or creates a Google Drive folder by name inside a parent folder
 * Passing supportsAllDrives=true and includeItemsFromAllDrives=true for Shared Drives.
 */
async function findOrCreateFolder(folderName, parentFolderId, accessToken, signal) {
  if (!parentFolderId) return null;

  let query = `mimeType = 'application/vnd.google-apps.folder' and name = '${folderName}' and '${parentFolderId}' in parents and trashed = false`;

  const searchRes = await fetch(
    `https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3/files?q=${encodeURIComponent(query)}&fields=files(id,name)&pageSize=1&supportsAllDrives=true&includeItemsFromAllDrives=true&corpora=allDrives`,
    {
      headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${accessToken}` },
      signal,
    }
  );

  if (searchRes.ok) {
    const data = await searchRes.json();
    if (data.files && data.files.length > 0) {
      return data.files[0].id;
    }
  }

  // Create subfolder inside parent
  const meta = {
    name: folderName,
    mimeType: 'application/vnd.google-apps.folder',
    parents: [parentFolderId],
  };

  const createRes = await fetch('https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3/files?fields=id&supportsAllDrives=true', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {
      Authorization: `Bearer ${accessToken}`,
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    },
    body: JSON.stringify(meta),
    signal,
  });

  if (!createRes.ok) {
    const errText = await createRes.text();
    console.warn(`[Google Drive] Subfolder creation notice: ${errText}`);
    return parentFolderId;
  }

  const created = await createRes.json();
  return created.id || parentFolderId;
}

/**
 * Cached version of findOrCreateFolder to avoid redundant API queries
 */
async function findOrCreateFolderCached(folderName, parentFolderId, accessToken, signal) {
  if (!parentFolderId) return null;
  const cacheKey = `${parentFolderId}::${folderName}`;
  if (folderCache.has(cacheKey)) {
    return folderCache.get(cacheKey);
  }
  const folderId = await findOrCreateFolder(folderName, parentFolderId, accessToken, signal);
  if (folderId) {
    folderCache.set(cacheKey, folderId);
  }
  return folderId;
}

/**
 * Resolves structured folder hierarchy:
 * Wholesale RMA Records
 *   └── [YYYY-MM]
 *       └── [RMA_NUMBER]
 *           ├── 01_Damaged_Items/
 *           └── 02_Official_Paperwork/
 */
async function resolveRmaHierarchy({ rootFolderId, rmaNumber, category, accessToken, signal }) {
  const now = new Date();
  const yearMonth = `${now.getFullYear()}-${String(now.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}`;

  let currentParentId = rootFolderId;

  // 1. Root folder: "Wholesale RMA Records"
  if (!currentParentId) {
    try {
      const searchRes = await fetch(
        `https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3/files?q=${encodeURIComponent("mimeType = 'application/vnd.google-apps.folder' and name = 'Wholesale RMA Records' and trashed = false")}&fields=files(id,name)&pageSize=1&supportsAllDrives=true&includeItemsFromAllDrives=true&corpora=allDrives`,
        { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${accessToken}` }, signal }
      );
      if (searchRes.ok) {
        const sData = await searchRes.json();
        if (sData.files && sData.files.length > 0) {
          currentParentId = sData.files[0].id;
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('[Google Drive] Root search notice:', e.message);
    }
  }

  if (currentParentId) {
    try {
      const infoRes = await fetch(
        `https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3/files/${currentParentId}?fields=id,name&supportsAllDrives=true`,
        { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${accessToken}` }, signal }
      );
      if (infoRes.ok) {
        const info = await infoRes.json();
        if (info.name !== 'Wholesale RMA Records') {
          const subRoot = await findOrCreateFolderCached('Wholesale RMA Records', currentParentId, accessToken, signal);
          if (subRoot) currentParentId = subRoot;
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('[Google Drive] Root verification notice:', e.message);
    }
  }

  // 2. Monthly: [YYYY-MM]
  const monthFolderId = await findOrCreateFolderCached(yearMonth, currentParentId, accessToken, signal);
  if (monthFolderId) {
    currentParentId = monthFolderId;
  }

  // 3. RMA Number: [RMA_NUMBER]
  const cleanRma = (rmaNumber && rmaNumber !== 'GENERAL') ? String(rmaNumber).trim() : 'General_Intake';
  const rmaFolderId = await findOrCreateFolderCached(cleanRma, currentParentId, accessToken, signal);
  if (rmaFolderId) {
    currentParentId = rmaFolderId;
  }

  // 4. Subfolder: 01_Damaged_Items or 02_Official_Paperwork
  const isPaperwork = category === 'official_paperwork' || category === 'paperwork';
  const subFolderName = isPaperwork ? '02_Official_Paperwork' : '01_Damaged_Items';
  const targetSubfolderId = await findOrCreateFolderCached(subFolderName, currentParentId, accessToken, signal);

  const rmaFolderUrl = rmaFolderId
    ? `https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/${rmaFolderId}`
    : (currentParentId ? `https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/${currentParentId}` : null);

  return {
    targetFolderId: targetSubfolderId || currentParentId,
    rmaFolderId: rmaFolderId || currentParentId,
    rmaFolderUrl
  };
}

/**
 * Serverless Upload Handler:
 * Uploads compressed WebP proof photo directly to Google Workspace Drive
 * with automatic Supabase Storage fallback.
 */
export default async function handler(req, res) {
  setCorsHeaders(res, req);

  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
    return res.status(204).end();
  }

  // Handle DELETE request to remove stored proof photos from Google Drive
  if (req.method === 'DELETE') {
    const creds = getGoogleCredentials();
    if (!creds) {
      return res.status(200).json({ success: false, message: 'Google Drive credentials not configured' });
    }

    try {
      // 1. Robust body & query parsing (handling strings, objects, query params)
      let parsedBody = req.body;
      if (typeof parsedBody === 'string') {
        try { parsedBody = JSON.parse(parsedBody); } catch (e) {}
      }

      const rawUrlsOrIds = [];
      if (req.query?.fileId) rawUrlsOrIds.push(req.query.fileId);
      if (req.query?.fileUrl) rawUrlsOrIds.push(req.query.fileUrl);
      if (req.query?.folderId) rawUrlsOrIds.push(req.query.folderId);
      if (req.query?.folderUrl) rawUrlsOrIds.push(req.query.folderUrl);
      if (parsedBody?.fileId) rawUrlsOrIds.push(parsedBody.fileId);
      if (parsedBody?.fileUrl) rawUrlsOrIds.push(parsedBody.fileUrl);
      if (parsedBody?.folderId) rawUrlsOrIds.push(parsedBody.folderId);
      if (parsedBody?.folderUrl) rawUrlsOrIds.push(parsedBody.folderUrl);
      if (Array.isArray(parsedBody?.fileIds)) rawUrlsOrIds.push(...parsedBody.fileIds);
      if (Array.isArray(parsedBody?.fileUrls)) rawUrlsOrIds.push(...parsedBody.fileUrls);
      if (Array.isArray(parsedBody?.folderIds)) rawUrlsOrIds.push(...parsedBody.folderIds);
      if (Array.isArray(parsedBody?.folderUrls)) rawUrlsOrIds.push(...parsedBody.folderUrls);
      if (Array.isArray(parsedBody?.urls)) rawUrlsOrIds.push(...parsedBody.urls);

      if (rawUrlsOrIds.length === 0) {
        return res.status(400).json({ success: false, error: 'Missing fileId, fileUrl, folderId, or fileUrls for deletion' });
      }

      const accessToken = await getGoogleAccessToken(creds);
      const deletedIds = [];
      const failed = [];

      for (const item of rawUrlsOrIds) {
        if (!item) continue;
        let fileId = null;

        // Support strings or objects with url/id/fileId/folderId
        let cleanItem = '';
        if (typeof item === 'string') {
          cleanItem = item.trim();
        } else if (typeof item === 'object') {
          cleanItem = String(item.fileId || item.folderId || item.id || item.fileUrl || item.url || '').trim();
        }

        if (!cleanItem) continue;

        // Try extracting Google Drive File/Folder ID from URL
        const idMatch = cleanItem.match(/\/d\/([a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)/) || 
                        cleanItem.match(/\/folders\/([a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)/) ||
                        cleanItem.match(/[?&]id=([a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)/) ||
                        cleanItem.match(/\/file\/d\/([a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)/);
        
        if (idMatch && idMatch[1]) {
          fileId = idMatch[1].split(/[?&=/]/)[0];
        } else if (/^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{15,65}$/.test(cleanItem)) {
          // Direct fileId or folderId passed
          fileId = cleanItem;
        } else {
          // Attempt filename search in Google Drive as fallback
          const filename = cleanItem.split('/').pop()?.split('?')[0];
          if (filename && filename.length > 5) {
            try {
              const searchQ = `name = '${filename}' and trashed = false`;
              const sRes = await fetch(
                `https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3/files?q=${encodeURIComponent(searchQ)}&fields=files(id,name)&pageSize=5&supportsAllDrives=true&includeItemsFromAllDrives=true&corpora=allDrives`,
                { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${accessToken}` } }
              );
              if (sRes.ok) {
                const sJson = await sRes.json();
                if (sJson.files && sJson.files.length > 0) {
                  fileId = sJson.files[0].id;
                }
              }
            } catch (searchErr) {
              console.warn('[Google Drive File Search Notice]:', searchErr.message);
            }
          }
        }

        if (!fileId) {
          failed.push({ item, reason: 'Could not extract or locate Google Drive File ID' });
          continue;
        }

        try {
          // Attempt 1: Permanent delete (supported if service account has Manager/Organizer role)
          const delRes = await fetch(
            `https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3/files/${fileId}?supportsAllDrives=true`,
            {
              method: 'DELETE',
              headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${accessToken}` },
            }
          );

          if (delRes.status === 204 || delRes.ok || delRes.status === 404) {
            console.log(`[Google Drive] Asset permanently deleted or already removed: ${fileId}`);
            deletedIds.push(fileId);
            continue;
          }

          const delErrText = await delRes.text();
          console.warn(`[Google Drive Permanent Delete Notice for ${fileId}]: ${delErrText}. Attempting fallback to move file/folder to trash...`);

          // Attempt 2: Move file or folder to trash (supported for Content Managers and Managers in Shared Drives)
          const trashRes = await fetch(
            `https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3/files/${fileId}?supportsAllDrives=true`,
            {
              method: 'PATCH',
              headers: {
                Authorization: `Bearer ${accessToken}`,
                'Content-Type': 'application/json',
              },
              body: JSON.stringify({ trashed: true }),
            }
          );

          if (trashRes.ok || trashRes.status === 200 || trashRes.status === 404) {
            console.log(`[Google Drive] Asset successfully moved to trash: ${fileId}`);
            deletedIds.push(fileId);
            continue;
          }

          const trashErrText = await trashRes.text();
          console.warn(`[Google Drive Trash Fallback Notice for ${fileId}]: ${trashErrText}`);
          failed.push({
            fileId,
            error: delErrText,
            trashError: trashErrText,
            hint: 'Ensure Google Service Account has "Content Manager" or "Manager" role in the Google Shared Drive members settings.'
          });
        } catch (itemErr) {
          console.warn(`[Google Drive Delete Error for ${fileId}]:`, itemErr.message);
          failed.push({ fileId, error: itemErr.message });
        }
      }

      return res.status(200).json({
        success: deletedIds.length > 0 || failed.length === 0,
        deletedCount: deletedIds.length,
        deletedIds,
        failed
      });
    } catch (delErr) {
      console.warn('[Google Drive Delete Global Exception]:', delErr.message);
      return res.status(200).json({ success: false, error: delErr.message });
    }
  }

  if (req.method !== 'POST') {
    return res.status(405).json({ success: false, error: 'METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED' });
  }

  // 1. Handle Gemini Flash Paperwork Inspection
  if (req.query?.action === 'inspect-paperwork' || req.body?.action === 'inspect-paperwork' || req.url?.includes('inspect-paperwork')) {
    try {
      const { fileData, imageUrl, mimeType } = req.body || {};
      const result = await inspectPaperworkWithGemini({
        fileData: fileData || req.body?.image || req.body?.photo,
        imageUrl: imageUrl || req.body?.url,
        mimeType: mimeType || 'image/jpeg'
      });
      return res.status(200).json(result);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('[Gemini Paperwork Inspection Error]:', err);
      return res.status(500).json({
        is_valid_document: false,
        confidence: 0,
        error: err.message,
        rejection_reason: `AI inspection error: ${err.message}`
      });
    }
  }

  // 2. Check if Google Drive credentials exist
  const creds = getGoogleCredentials();
  if (!creds) {
    return res.status(200).json({
      success: false,
      fallback: 'supabase',
      message: 'Google Drive credentials not configured. Please use Supabase Storage fallback.',
    });
  }

  // 3. Parse body: expect base64 fileData, rmaNumber, and category ('damaged_items' | 'official_paperwork')
  const {
    fileData,
    fileName,
    mimeType = 'image/webp',
    rmaNumber = 'GENERAL',
    category = 'damaged_items'
  } = req.body || {};

  if (!fileData) {
    return res.status(400).json({
      success: false,
      error: 'MISSING_FILE_DATA',
      message: 'Base64 fileData is required for photo upload.',
    });
  }

  // Clean base64 prefix if present (e.g. data:image/webp;base64,...)
  const pureBase64 = fileData.includes(',') ? fileData.split(',')[1] : fileData;
  const buffer = Buffer.from(pureBase64, 'base64');

  // Hard timeout guard: 7500ms to stay safely under Vercel Hobby 10-second limit
  const controller = new AbortController();
  const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 7500);

  try {
    const accessToken = await getGoogleAccessToken(creds, controller.signal);

    // 4. Resolve target folder in Google Drive with clean hierarchical structure:
    // Wholesale RMA Records / [YYYY-MM] / [RMA_NUMBER] / [01_Damaged_Items | 02_Official_Paperwork]
    const {
      targetFolderId,
      rmaFolderId,
      rmaFolderUrl
    } = await resolveRmaHierarchy({
      rootFolderId: creds.folderId,
      rmaNumber,
      category,
      accessToken,
      signal: controller.signal
    });

    if (!targetFolderId) {
      return res.status(400).json({
        success: false,
        error: 'MISSING_TARGET_FOLDER',
        message: 'Google Drive requires a valid root folder or shared drive to store files without quota limits.'
      });
    }

    // 5. Construct Multipart Upload to Drive v3 with supportsAllDrives=true
    const safeName = fileName || `RMA_${rmaNumber}_${category}_${Date.now()}.webp`;
    const boundary = `----RmaPhotoBoundary${Date.now()}`;

    const metadataPart = JSON.stringify({
      name: safeName,
      parents: targetFolderId ? [targetFolderId] : undefined,
      description: `Wholesale RMA ${category} for ${rmaNumber} - Uploaded ${new Date().toISOString()}`,
    });

    const bodyParts = [
      `--${boundary}\r\nContent-Type: application/json; charset=UTF-8\r\n\r\n${metadataPart}\r\n`,
      `--${boundary}\r\nContent-Type: ${mimeType}\r\nContent-Transfer-Encoding: base64\r\n\r\n${buffer.toString('base64')}\r\n`,
      `--${boundary}--\r\n`,
    ];

    const multipartBody = bodyParts.join('');

    const uploadRes = await fetch(
      'https://www.googleapis.com/upload/drive/v3/files?uploadType=multipart&supportsAllDrives=true&fields=id,name,webViewLink',
      {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          Authorization: `Bearer ${accessToken}`,
          'Content-Type': `multipart/related; boundary=${boundary}`,
        },
        body: multipartBody,
        signal: controller.signal,
      }
    );

    if (!uploadRes.ok) {
      const errText = await uploadRes.text();
      console.error('[Google Drive Upload Error]:', errText);
      return res.status(200).json({
        success: false,
        fallback: 'supabase',
        error: `Google Drive upload failed: ${errText}`,
      });
    }

    const file = await uploadRes.json();
    const fileId = file.id;

    // 5. Grant public read permission so the photo can be rendered directly in web portals & emails
    try {
      await fetch(`https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3/files/${fileId}/permissions?supportsAllDrives=true`, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          Authorization: `Bearer ${accessToken}`,
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          role: 'reader',
          type: 'anyone',
        }),
        signal: controller.signal,
      });
    } catch (permErr) {
      console.warn('[Google Drive Permission Notice]:', permErr.message);
    }

    // Direct Google CDN image preview link (no interstitials, embeds smoothly in <img src>)
    const directCdnUrl = `https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/d/${fileId}`;
    const webViewLink = file.webViewLink || `https://drive.google.com/file/d/${fileId}/view?usp=sharing`;

    clearTimeout(timeoutId);

    return res.status(200).json({
      success: true,
      provider: 'google_drive',
      fileId,
      url: directCdnUrl,
      previewUrl: directCdnUrl,
      webViewLink,
      rmaFolderUrl,
      rmaFolderId,
      category,
      fileName: safeName,
      sizeBytes: buffer.length,
    });
  } catch (err) {
    clearTimeout(timeoutId);
    console.warn('[Photo Upload Fallback Notice]:', err.message);

    // Gracefully instruct client to fall back to Supabase Storage
    return res.status(200).json({
      success: false,
      fallback: 'supabase',
      message: err.name === 'AbortError' ? 'Google Drive upload timed out (>7.5s)' : err.message,
    });
  }
}

--- START FILE: api/v1/api-keys/index.js ---
import { supabase } from '../../_lib/supabase.js';
import { generateApiKeyPair, ALLOWED_SYSTEMS } from '../../_lib/keyUtils.js';
import { sendJson, setCorsHeaders } from '../../_lib/auth.js';
import { handleVerifyPin, handleClearCooldown } from '../../_lib/verifyPinHandler.js';

export default async function handler(req, res) {
  setCorsHeaders(res, req);

  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
    return res.status(204).end();
  }

  // Route: /api/v1/auth/verify-pin or action=verify-pin
  if (req.query?.action === 'verify-pin' || req.url?.includes('verify-pin')) {
    return handleVerifyPin(req, res);
  }

  // Route: /api/v1/auth/clear-cooldown or action=clear-cooldown
  if (req.query?.action === 'clear-cooldown' || req.url?.includes('clear-cooldown')) {
    return handleClearCooldown(req, res);
  }

  // GET: List all API Keys (Masked only, safe for admin dashboard)
  if (req.method === 'GET') {
    try {
      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from('api_keys')
        .select('id, name, masked_key, is_active, rate_limit, expires_at, last_used_at, created_at, updated_at')
        .order('created_at', { ascending: false });

      if (error) {
        console.error('[API Keys GET] Database error:', error);
        return sendJson(res, 500, {
          success: false,
          error: 'DATABASE_ERROR',
          message: error.message
        });
      }

      return sendJson(res, 200, {
        success: true,
        count: data ? data.length : 0,
        keys: data || []
      });
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('[API Keys GET] Server error:', err);
      return sendJson(res, 500, {
        success: false,
        error: 'SERVER_ERROR',
        message: err.message
      });
    }
  }

  // POST: Generate a new API Key for one of the 4 systems
  if (req.method === 'POST') {
    try {
      let body = req.body;
      if (typeof body === 'string') {
        try {
          body = JSON.parse(body);
        } catch (e) {}
      }

      const { name, rateLimit, expiresAt } = body || {};

      if (!name || typeof name !== 'string' || !name.trim()) {
        return sendJson(res, 400, {
          success: false,
          error: 'BAD_REQUEST',
          message: 'Client name is required. Must be one of: ' + ALLOWED_SYSTEMS.join(', ')
        });
      }

      const cleanName = name.trim();
      const limit = Number(rateLimit) > 0 ? Number(rateLimit) : 60;
      const expiry = expiresAt ? new Date(expiresAt).toISOString() : null;

      // Generate raw secret key and compute SHA-256 hash
      const { rawKey, keyHash, maskedKey } = generateApiKeyPair();

      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from('api_keys')
        .insert({
          name: cleanName,
          key_hash: keyHash,
          masked_key: maskedKey,
          is_active: true,
          rate_limit: limit,
          expires_at: expiry
        })
        .select('id, name, masked_key, is_active, rate_limit, expires_at, created_at')
        .single();

      if (error) {
        console.error('[API Keys POST] Insert error:', error);
        return sendJson(res, 500, {
          success: false,
          error: 'INSERT_ERROR',
          message: error.message
        });
      }

      // CRITICAL: Raw secret key is returned ONCE here so user can copy it!
      return sendJson(res, 201, {
        success: true,
        message: `API Key successfully generated for ${cleanName}. Please copy and save the secret key now; it cannot be viewed again.`,
        apiKey: rawKey,
        keyRecord: data
      });
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('[API Keys POST] Server error:', err);
      return sendJson(res, 500, {
        success: false,
        error: 'SERVER_ERROR',
        message: err.message
      });
    }
  }

  // DELETE: Revoke / Delete API key via query (?id=...) or body ({ id })
  if (req.method === 'DELETE') {
    try {
      let body = req.body;
      if (typeof body === 'string') {
        try { body = JSON.parse(body); } catch (e) {}
      }
      const targetId = req.query.id || (body && body.id);

      if (!targetId) {
        return sendJson(res, 400, {
          success: false,
          error: 'BAD_REQUEST',
          message: 'API Key ID is required (e.g., ?id=<uuid> or body { id }).'
        });
      }

      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from('api_keys')
        .delete()
        .eq('id', targetId)
        .select('id, name, masked_key')
        .maybeSingle();

      if (error) {
        return sendJson(res, 500, { success: false, error: 'DELETE_ERROR', message: error.message });
      }

      if (!data) {
        return sendJson(res, 404, { success: false, error: 'NOT_FOUND', message: `API Key with ID ${targetId} was not found.` });
      }

      return sendJson(res, 200, {
        success: true,
        message: `API Key for ${data.name} (${data.masked_key}) has been permanently deleted/revoked.`,
        deletedKey: data
      });
    } catch (err) {
      return sendJson(res, 500, { success: false, error: 'SERVER_ERROR', message: err.message });
    }
  }

  // PATCH: Rotate API key via query (?id=...) or body ({ id })
  if (req.method === 'PATCH') {
    try {
      let body = req.body;
      if (typeof body === 'string') {
        try { body = JSON.parse(body); } catch (e) {}
      }
      const targetId = req.query.id || (body && body.id);

      if (!targetId) {
        return sendJson(res, 400, {
          success: false,
          error: 'BAD_REQUEST',
          message: 'API Key ID is required (e.g., ?id=<uuid> or body { id }).'
        });
      }

      const { data: existing, error: fetchErr } = await supabase
        .from('api_keys')
        .select('*')
        .eq('id', targetId)
        .maybeSingle();

      if (fetchErr || !existing) {
        return sendJson(res, 404, { success: false, error: 'NOT_FOUND', message: `API Key with ID ${targetId} was not found.` });
      }

      const { rawKey, keyHash, maskedKey } = generateApiKeyPair();

      const { data: updated, error: updateErr } = await supabase
        .from('api_keys')
        .update({
          key_hash: keyHash,
          masked_key: maskedKey,
          is_active: true,
          updated_at: new Date().toISOString()
        })
        .eq('id', targetId)
        .select('id, name, masked_key, is_active, rate_limit, updated_at')
        .single();

      if (updateErr) {
        return sendJson(res, 500, { success: false, error: 'UPDATE_ERROR', message: updateErr.message });
      }

      return sendJson(res, 200, {
        success: true,
        message: `API Key for ${updated.name} has been rotated successfully. Old key is revoked. Please copy and store the new secret key now.`,
        apiKey: rawKey,
        keyRecord: updated
      });
    } catch (err) {
      return sendJson(res, 500, { success: false, error: 'SERVER_ERROR', message: err.message });
    }
  }

  return sendJson(res, 405, {
    success: false,
    error: 'METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED',
    message: `Method ${req.method} not allowed.`
  });
}

--- START FILE: api/v1/api-keys/[id].js ---
import { supabase } from '../../_lib/supabase.js';
import { generateApiKeyPair } from '../../_lib/keyUtils.js';
import { sendJson, setCorsHeaders } from '../../_lib/auth.js';

export default async function handler(req, res) {
  setCorsHeaders(res);

  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
    return res.status(200).end();
  }

  const { id } = req.query;

  if (!id) {
    return sendJson(res, 400, {
      success: false,
      error: 'BAD_REQUEST',
      message: 'API Key ID is required in URL path.'
    });
  }

  // DELETE: Revoke / Delete API key
  if (req.method === 'DELETE') {
    try {
      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from('api_keys')
        .delete()
        .eq('id', id)
        .select('id, name, masked_key')
        .maybeSingle();

      if (error) {
        console.error('[API Key DELETE] Database error:', error);
        return sendJson(res, 500, {
          success: false,
          error: 'DELETE_ERROR',
          message: error.message
        });
      }

      if (!data) {
        return sendJson(res, 404, {
          success: false,
          error: 'NOT_FOUND',
          message: `API Key with ID ${id} was not found.`
        });
      }

      return sendJson(res, 200, {
        success: true,
        message: `API Key for ${data.name} (${data.masked_key}) has been permanently deleted/revoked.`,
        deletedKey: data
      });
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('[API Key DELETE] Server error:', err);
      return sendJson(res, 500, {
        success: false,
        error: 'SERVER_ERROR',
        message: err.message
      });
    }
  }

  // PATCH: Rotate / Renew API Key (Revokes current, generates new replacement key)
  if (req.method === 'PATCH') {
    try {
      // 1. Fetch current key
      const { data: existing, error: fetchErr } = await supabase
        .from('api_keys')
        .select('*')
        .eq('id', id)
        .maybeSingle();

      if (fetchErr || !existing) {
        return sendJson(res, 404, {
          success: false,
          error: 'NOT_FOUND',
          message: `API Key with ID ${id} was not found.`
        });
      }

      // 2. Generate new key pair
      const { rawKey, keyHash, maskedKey } = generateApiKeyPair();

      // 3. Update record with new hash and mask
      const { data: updated, error: updateErr } = await supabase
        .from('api_keys')
        .update({
          key_hash: keyHash,
          masked_key: maskedKey,
          is_active: true,
          updated_at: new Date().toISOString()
        })
        .eq('id', id)
        .select('id, name, masked_key, is_active, rate_limit, updated_at')
        .single();

      if (updateErr) {
        console.error('[API Key ROTATE] Update error:', updateErr);
        return sendJson(res, 500, {
          success: false,
          error: 'UPDATE_ERROR',
          message: updateErr.message
        });
      }

      // Return the new raw secret key ONCE
      return sendJson(res, 200, {
        success: true,
        message: `API Key for ${updated.name} has been rotated successfully. Old key is revoked. Please copy and store the new secret key now.`,
        apiKey: rawKey,
        keyRecord: updated
      });
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('[API Key ROTATE] Server error:', err);
      return sendJson(res, 500, {
        success: false,
        error: 'SERVER_ERROR',
        message: err.message
      });
    }
  }

  return sendJson(res, 405, {
    success: false,
    error: 'METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED',
    message: `Method ${req.method} not allowed.`
  });
}

--- START FILE: api/v1/credit-memos/index.js ---
import { supabase } from '../../_lib/supabase.js';
import { requireApiKey, sendJson, setCorsHeaders } from '../../_lib/auth.js';

export default async function handler(req, res) {
  setCorsHeaders(res);

  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
    return res.status(200).end();
  }

  const client = await requireApiKey(req, res);
  if (!client) return;

  // 1. GET: List credit memos
  if (req.method === 'GET') {
    try {
      const { search, rma_number, barcode, limit = '50', offset = '0' } = req.query;

      const numLimit = Math.min(Math.max(parseInt(limit, 10) || 50, 1), 200);
      const numOffset = Math.max(parseInt(offset, 10) || 0, 0);

      let query = supabase
        .from('credit_memos')
        .select('*', { count: 'exact' });

      if (rma_number) {
        query = query.eq('rma_number', rma_number.trim());
      }
      if (barcode) {
        query = query.eq('barcode', barcode.trim());
      }
      if (search) {
        query = query.or(`credit_memo_number.ilike.%${search}%,pull_out_ref.ilike.%${search}%,product_name.ilike.%${search}%,customer_ae_name.ilike.%${search}%`);
      }

      query = query
        .order('created_at', { ascending: false })
        .range(numOffset, numOffset + numLimit - 1);

      const { data, count, error } = await query;

      if (error) {
        return sendJson(res, 500, { success: false, error: 'DATABASE_ERROR', message: error.message });
      }

      return sendJson(res, 200, {
        success: true,
        client: client.name,
        total: count || 0,
        limit: numLimit,
        offset: numOffset,
        data: data || []
      });
    } catch (err) {
      return sendJson(res, 500, { success: false, error: 'SERVER_ERROR', message: err.message });
    }
  }

  // 2. POST: Issue Credit Memo
  if (req.method === 'POST') {
    try {
      let body = req.body;
      if (typeof body === 'string') {
        try { body = JSON.parse(body); } catch (e) {}
      }

      const {
        rma_number,
        barcode,
        product_name,
        sku,
        supplier_name = 'Savemore',
        company = 'Wholesale Distribution',
        customer_ae_name,
        customer_ae_email,
        quantity = 1,
        unit_name = 'pc',
        unit_price = 0,
        pull_out_ref,
        pull_out_date,
        credit_amount,
        notes
      } = body || {};

      if (!rma_number || !barcode || !product_name || !pull_out_ref || credit_amount === undefined) {
        return sendJson(res, 400, {
          success: false,
          error: 'VALIDATION_ERROR',
          message: '"rma_number", "barcode", "product_name", "pull_out_ref", and "credit_amount" are required.'
        });
      }

      // Auto-generate CM Number: CM-YYYYMMDD-XXXX
      const dateStr = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10).replace(/-/g, '');
      const rand = Math.floor(1000 + Math.random() * 9000);
      const cmNumber = `CM-${dateStr}-${rand}`;

      const numQty = parseFloat(quantity) || 1;
      const numUnitPrice = parseFloat(unit_price) || 0;
      const calculatedAmount = numQty * numUnitPrice;
      const finalCreditAmount = parseFloat(credit_amount) || calculatedAmount;

      const payload = {
        credit_memo_number: cmNumber,
        rma_number: String(rma_number).trim(),
        barcode: String(barcode).trim(),
        product_name: String(product_name).trim(),
        sku: sku ? String(sku).trim() : null,
        supplier_name: supplier_name || 'Savemore',
        company: company || 'Wholesale Distribution',
        customer_ae_name: customer_ae_name || null,
        customer_ae_email: customer_ae_email || null,
        quantity: numQty,
        unit_name: unit_name || 'pc',
        unit_price: numUnitPrice,
        amount: calculatedAmount,
        pull_out_ref: String(pull_out_ref).trim(),
        pull_out_date: pull_out_date || new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10),
        credit_amount: finalCreditAmount,
        credit_issued_by: `${client.name} (API)`,
        credit_issued_at: new Date().toISOString(),
        notes: notes || `Issued via REST API by ${client.name}`,
        status: 'issued'
      };

      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from('credit_memos')
        .insert(payload)
        .select('*')
        .single();

      if (error) {
        return sendJson(res, 500, { success: false, error: 'INSERT_ERROR', message: error.message });
      }

      return sendJson(res, 201, {
        success: true,
        message: `Credit Memo ${cmNumber} issued successfully by ${client.name}.`,
        data
      });
    } catch (err) {
      return sendJson(res, 500, { success: false, error: 'SERVER_ERROR', message: err.message });
    }
  }

  return sendJson(res, 405, { success: false, error: 'METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED', message: `Method ${req.method} not allowed.` });
}

import { supabase } from '../../_lib/supabase.js';
import { requireApiKey, sendJson, setCorsHeaders } from '../../_lib/auth.js';

export default async function handler(req, res) {
  setCorsHeaders(res);

  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
    return res.status(200).end();
  }

  const client = await requireApiKey(req, res);
  if (!client) return;

  const { id } = req.query;
  if (!id) {
    return sendJson(res, 400, { success: false, error: 'BAD_REQUEST', message: 'Credit Memo ID or CM Number is required in URL.' });
  }

  const cleanId = String(id).trim();
  const isNumeric = /^\d+$/.test(cleanId);

  const matchCM = (query) => {
    return isNumeric ? query.eq('id', parseInt(cleanId, 10)) : query.eq('credit_memo_number', cleanId);
  };

  // 1. GET: Fetch Credit Memo
  if (req.method === 'GET') {
    try {
      const { data, error } = await matchCM(supabase.from('credit_memos').select('*')).maybeSingle();

      if (error) {
        return sendJson(res, 500, { success: false, error: 'DATABASE_ERROR', message: error.message });
      }

      if (!data) {
        return sendJson(res, 404, { success: false, error: 'NOT_FOUND', message: `Credit Memo ${cleanId} not found.` });
      }

      return sendJson(res, 200, { success: true, data });
    } catch (err) {
      return sendJson(res, 500, { success: false, error: 'SERVER_ERROR', message: err.message });
    }
  }

  // 2. DELETE: Remove Credit Memo
  if (req.method === 'DELETE') {
    try {
      const { data, error } = await matchCM(
        supabase.from('credit_memos').delete().select('id, credit_memo_number, product_name')
      ).maybeSingle();

      if (error) {
        return sendJson(res, 500, { success: false, error: 'DELETE_ERROR', message: error.message });
      }

      if (!data) {
        return sendJson(res, 404, { success: false, error: 'NOT_FOUND', message: `Credit Memo ${cleanId} not found.` });
      }

      return sendJson(res, 200, {
        success: true,
        message: `Credit Memo ${data.credit_memo_number} deleted by ${client.name}.`,
        deleted: data
      });
    } catch (err) {
      return sendJson(res, 500, { success: false, error: 'SERVER_ERROR', message: err.message });
    }
  }

  return sendJson(res, 405, { success: false, error: 'METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED', message: `Method ${req.method} not allowed.` });
}

--- START FILE: api/v1/health.js ---
import { supabase } from '../_lib/supabase.js';
import { setCorsHeaders, sendJson } from '../_lib/auth.js';
import { hashApiKey } from '../_lib/keyUtils.js';

export default async function handler(req, res) {
  setCorsHeaders(res, req);

  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
    return res.status(204).end();
  }

  const startTime = Date.now();
  let dbStatus = 'connected';
  let dbLatencyMs = 0;

  try {
    const { error } = await supabase.from('api_keys').select('id').limit(1);
    dbLatencyMs = Date.now() - startTime;
    if (error) {
      dbStatus = 'degraded';
    }
  } catch (e) {
    dbStatus = 'disconnected';
    dbLatencyMs = Date.now() - startTime;
  }

  // Optional client identity check
  let clientIdentity = 'public / unauthenticated';
  let rawKey = req.headers['x-api-key'];
  if (!rawKey && req.headers['authorization']) {
    const authHeader = req.headers['authorization'];
    rawKey = authHeader.startsWith('Bearer ') ? authHeader.substring(7).trim() : authHeader.trim();
  }

  if (rawKey) {
    const keyHash = hashApiKey(rawKey);
    const { data: keyRecord } = await supabase
      .from('api_keys')
      .select('name, masked_key, is_active')
      .eq('key_hash', keyHash)
      .maybeSingle();

    if (keyRecord && keyRecord.is_active) {
      clientIdentity = `${keyRecord.name} (${keyRecord.masked_key})`;
    } else {
      clientIdentity = 'invalid or revoked key';
    }
  }

  return sendJson(res, 200, {
    status: 'healthy',
    version: '1.0.0',
    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
    environment: 'production',
    service: 'Wholesale RMA Multi-System REST API',
    database: {
      status: dbStatus,
      latency_ms: dbLatencyMs
    },
    authenticated_client: clientIdentity,
    documentation: '/docs'
  });
}

import { supabase } from '../../_lib/supabase.js';
import { requireApiKey, sendJson, setCorsHeaders } from '../../_lib/auth.js';

export default async function handler(req, res) {
  setCorsHeaders(res);

  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
    return res.status(200).end();
  }

  const client = await requireApiKey(req, res);
  if (!client) return;

  // 1. GET: Search / list products
  if (req.method === 'GET') {
    try {
      const { barcode, code, search, limit = '50', offset = '0' } = req.query;

      const numLimit = Math.min(Math.max(parseInt(limit, 10) || 50, 1), 200);
      const numOffset = Math.max(parseInt(offset, 10) || 0, 0);

      let query = supabase
        .from('products')
        .select('*', { count: 'exact' });

      if (barcode) {
        query = query.eq('barcode', barcode.trim());
      }
      if (code) {
        query = query.eq('code', code.trim());
      }
      if (search) {
        query = query.or(`name.ilike.%${search}%,code.ilike.%${search}%,barcode.ilike.%${search}%`);
      }

      query = query
        .order('name', { ascending: true })
        .range(numOffset, numOffset + numLimit - 1);

      const { data, count, error } = await query;

      if (error) {
        return sendJson(res, 500, { success: false, error: 'DATABASE_ERROR', message: error.message });
      }

      return sendJson(res, 200, {
        success: true,
        client: client.name,
        total: count || 0,
        limit: numLimit,
        offset: numOffset,
        data: data || []
      });
    } catch (err) {
      return sendJson(res, 500, { success: false, error: 'SERVER_ERROR', message: err.message });
    }
  }

  // 2. POST: Create or upsert product
  if (req.method === 'POST') {
    try {
      let body = req.body;
      if (typeof body === 'string') {
        try { body = JSON.parse(body); } catch (e) {}
      }

      const {
        barcode,
        name,
        code,
        price = 0,
        price_with_vat = 0,
        supplier_name = 'Savemore',
        brand_name,
        unit_name = 'pc',
        image_url
      } = body || {};

      if (!barcode || !name) {
        return sendJson(res, 400, {
          success: false,
          error: 'VALIDATION_ERROR',
          message: '"barcode" and "name" are required.'
        });
      }

      const payload = {
        barcode: String(barcode).trim(),
        name: String(name).trim(),
        code: code ? String(code).trim() : null,
        price: parseFloat(price) || 0,
        price_with_vat: parseFloat(price_with_vat) || 0,
        supplier_name: supplier_name ? String(supplier_name).trim() : 'Savemore',
        brand_name: brand_name ? String(brand_name).trim() : null,
        unit_name: unit_name || 'pc',
        image_url: image_url || null,
        is_verified: true,
        updated_at: new Date().toISOString()
      };

      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from('products')
        .upsert(payload, { onConflict: 'barcode' })
        .select('*')
        .single();

      if (error) {
        return sendJson(res, 500, { success: false, error: 'UPSERT_ERROR', message: error.message });
      }

      return sendJson(res, 201, {
        success: true,
        message: `Product ${data.name} (${data.barcode}) upserted successfully by ${client.name}.`,
        data
      });
    } catch (err) {
      return sendJson(res, 500, { success: false, error: 'SERVER_ERROR', message: err.message });
    }
  }

  return sendJson(res, 405, { success: false, error: 'METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED', message: `Method ${req.method} not allowed.` });
}

import { supabase } from '../../_lib/supabase.js';
import { requireApiKey, sendJson, setCorsHeaders } from '../../_lib/auth.js';
import lookupHandler from '../../_lib/lookupHandler.js';

export default async function handler(req, res) {
  setCorsHeaders(res);

  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
    return res.status(200).end();
  }

  // Gracefully route /api/v1/products/lookup to lookupHandler if invoked by dynamic router
  if (req.query?.id === 'lookup' || req.url?.includes('/lookup')) {
    return lookupHandler(req, res);
  }

  const client = await requireApiKey(req, res);
  if (!client) return;

  const { id } = req.query;
  if (!id) {
    return sendJson(res, 400, { success: false, error: 'BAD_REQUEST', message: 'Product ID or Barcode is required in URL.' });
  }

  const cleanId = String(id).trim();
  const isNumeric = /^\d+$/.test(cleanId);

  const matchProduct = (query) => {
    return isNumeric ? query.or(`id.eq.${cleanId},barcode.eq.${cleanId}`) : query.eq('barcode', cleanId);
  };

  // 1. GET: Fetch product
  if (req.method === 'GET') {
    try {
      const { data, error } = await matchProduct(supabase.from('products').select('*')).maybeSingle();

      if (error) {
        return sendJson(res, 500, { success: false, error: 'DATABASE_ERROR', message: error.message });
      }

      if (!data) {
        return sendJson(res, 404, { success: false, error: 'NOT_FOUND', message: `Product ${cleanId} not found.` });
      }

      return sendJson(res, 200, { success: true, data });
    } catch (err) {
      return sendJson(res, 500, { success: false, error: 'SERVER_ERROR', message: err.message });
    }
  }

  // 2. PATCH: Update product
  if (req.method === 'PATCH' || req.method === 'PUT') {
    try {
      let body = req.body;
      if (typeof body === 'string') {
        try { body = JSON.parse(body); } catch (e) {}
      }

      const allowedFields = ['name', 'code', 'price', 'price_with_vat', 'supplier_name', 'brand_name', 'unit_name', 'image_url', 'is_verified'];
      const updateData = { updated_at: new Date().toISOString() };

      for (const field of allowedFields) {
        if (body && body[field] !== undefined) {
          updateData[field] = body[field];
        }
      }

      const { data, error } = await matchProduct(
        supabase.from('products').update(updateData).select('*')
      ).maybeSingle();

      if (error) {
        return sendJson(res, 500, { success: false, error: 'UPDATE_ERROR', message: error.message });
      }

      if (!data) {
        return sendJson(res, 404, { success: false, error: 'NOT_FOUND', message: `Product ${cleanId} not found.` });
      }

      return sendJson(res, 200, {
        success: true,
        message: `Product ${data.name} updated by ${client.name}.`,
        data
      });
    } catch (err) {
      return sendJson(res, 500, { success: false, error: 'SERVER_ERROR', message: err.message });
    }
  }

  // 3. DELETE: Remove product
  if (req.method === 'DELETE') {
    try {
      const { data, error } = await matchProduct(
        supabase.from('products').delete().select('id, barcode, name')
      ).maybeSingle();

      if (error) {
        return sendJson(res, 500, { success: false, error: 'DELETE_ERROR', message: error.message });
      }

      if (!data) {
        return sendJson(res, 404, { success: false, error: 'NOT_FOUND', message: `Product ${cleanId} not found.` });
      }

      return sendJson(res, 200, {
        success: true,
        message: `Product ${data.name} (${data.barcode}) deleted by ${client.name}.`,
        deleted: data
      });
    } catch (err) {
      return sendJson(res, 500, { success: false, error: 'SERVER_ERROR', message: err.message });
    }
  }

  return sendJson(res, 405, { success: false, error: 'METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED', message: `Method ${req.method} not allowed.` });
}

import { supabase } from '../../_lib/supabase.js';
import { requireApiKey, sendJson, setCorsHeaders } from '../../_lib/auth.js';

export default async function handler(req, res) {
  setCorsHeaders(res);

  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
    return res.status(200).end();
  }

  // 1. Authenticate API Key
  const client = await requireApiKey(req, res);
  if (!client) return; // Response already sent by middleware

  // 2. GET: List RMA Reports with query filters
  if (req.method === 'GET') {
    try {
      const { status, barcode, search, limit = '50', offset = '0' } = req.query;

      const numLimit = Math.min(Math.max(parseInt(limit, 10) || 50, 1), 200);
      const numOffset = Math.max(parseInt(offset, 10) || 0, 0);

      let query = supabase
        .from('rma_reports')
        .select('*', { count: 'exact' });

      if (status) {
        query = query.eq('status', status);
      }
      if (barcode) {
        query = query.eq('barcode', barcode.trim());
      }
      if (search) {
        query = query.or(`name.ilike.%${search}%,code.ilike.%${search}%,rma_number.ilike.%${search}%,reporter_name.ilike.%${search}%`);
      }

      query = query
        .order('created_at', { ascending: false })
        .range(numOffset, numOffset + numLimit - 1);

      const { data, count, error } = await query;

      if (error) {
        console.error('[API v1 RMA GET] Query error:', error);
        return sendJson(res, 500, {
          success: false,
          error: 'DATABASE_ERROR',
          message: error.message
        });
      }

      return sendJson(res, 200, {
        success: true,
        client: client.name,
        total: count || 0,
        limit: numLimit,
        offset: numOffset,
        data: data || []
      });
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('[API v1 RMA GET] Server error:', err);
      return sendJson(res, 500, {
        success: false,
        error: 'SERVER_ERROR',
        message: err.message
      });
    }
  }

  // 3. POST: Create new RMA Report from client system
  if (req.method === 'POST') {
    try {
      let body = req.body;
      if (typeof body === 'string') {
        try {
          body = JSON.parse(body);
        } catch (e) {}
      }

      const {
        barcode,
        name,
        code,
        quantity = 1,
        supplier_name,
        price = 0,
        price_with_vat = 0,
        unit_name = 'pc',
        status = 'received_at_dock',
        condition_grade = 'B - Damaged Packaging Only',
        disposition = 'Pending Triage',
        warehouse_location,
        inspected_by,
        reason = 'Damaged Box / Crushed Packaging',
        explanation,
        photos = [],
        reporter_name,
        reporter_contact,
        ae_name,
        ae_email,
        store_branch,
        invoice_dr_number,
        si_number,
        dr_number,
        po_number,
        expiry_date,
        batch_lot_number,
        notes
      } = body || {};

      if (!barcode || !name) {
        return sendJson(res, 400, {
          success: false,
          error: 'VALIDATION_ERROR',
          message: 'Both "barcode" and "name" are required fields.'
        });
      }

      // Generate unique RMA Number: RMA-YYYYMMDD-XXXX
      const dateStr = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10).replace(/-/g, '');
      const randomSuffix = Math.floor(1000 + Math.random() * 9000);
      const rmaNumber = `RMA-${dateStr}-${randomSuffix}`;

      const reportPayload = {
        rma_number: rmaNumber,
        barcode: String(barcode).trim(),
        code: code ? String(code).trim() : null,
        name: String(name).trim(),
        quantity: parseInt(quantity, 10) || 1,
        supplier_name: supplier_name ? String(supplier_name).trim() : 'Savemore',
        price: parseFloat(price) || 0,
        price_with_vat: parseFloat(price_with_vat) || 0,
        unit_name: unit_name || 'pc',
        status: status || 'received_at_dock',
        condition_grade: condition_grade || 'B - Damaged Packaging Only',
        disposition: disposition || 'Pending Triage',
        warehouse_location: warehouse_location ? String(warehouse_location).trim().toUpperCase() : null,
        inspected_by: inspected_by ? String(inspected_by).trim() : null,
        inspected_at: inspected_by ? new Date().toISOString() : null,
        reason: reason || 'Damaged Box / Crushed Packaging',
        explanation: explanation || null,
        photos: Array.isArray(photos) ? photos : [],
        reporter_name: reporter_name ? String(reporter_name).trim() : client.name,
        reporter_contact: reporter_contact ? String(reporter_contact).trim() : null,
        reported_by: `${client.name} (API)`,
        ae_name: ae_name || null,
        ae_email: ae_email || null,
        store_branch: store_branch ? String(store_branch).trim() : null,
        invoice_dr_number: invoice_dr_number ? String(invoice_dr_number).trim() : null,
        si_number: si_number ? String(si_number).trim() : null,
        dr_number: dr_number ? String(dr_number).trim() : null,
        po_number: po_number ? String(po_number).trim() : null,
        expiry_date: expiry_date || null,
        batch_lot_number: batch_lot_number ? String(batch_lot_number).trim() : null,
        notes: notes ? String(notes).trim() : `Reported via REST API by ${client.name}`,
        created_at: new Date().toISOString()
      };

      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from('rma_reports')
        .insert(reportPayload)
        .select('*')
        .single();

      if (error) {
        console.error('[API v1 RMA POST] Insert error:', error);
        return sendJson(res, 500, {
          success: false,
          error: 'INSERT_ERROR',
          message: error.message
        });
      }

      return sendJson(res, 201, {
        success: true,
        message: `RMA report ${rmaNumber} created successfully.`,
        client: client.name,
        data
      });
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('[API v1 RMA POST] Server error:', err);
      return sendJson(res, 500, {
        success: false,
        error: 'SERVER_ERROR',
        message: err.message
      });
    }
  }

  return sendJson(res, 405, {
    success: false,
    error: 'METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED',
    message: `Method ${req.method} not allowed.`
  });
}

--- START FILE: api/v1/rma/[id].js ---
import { supabase } from '../../_lib/supabase.js';
import { requireApiKey, sendJson, setCorsHeaders } from '../../_lib/auth.js';

export default async function handler(req, res) {
  setCorsHeaders(res);

  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
    return res.status(200).end();
  }

  const client = await requireApiKey(req, res);
  if (!client) return;

  const { id } = req.query;
  if (!id) {
    return sendJson(res, 400, {
      success: false,
      error: 'BAD_REQUEST',
      message: 'RMA ID or RMA Number is required in URL.'
    });
  }

  const cleanId = String(id).trim();
  const isNumeric = /^\d+$/.test(cleanId);

  // Helper query builder for ID or rma_number
  const matchRma = (query) => {
    return isNumeric ? query.eq('id', parseInt(cleanId, 10)) : query.eq('rma_number', cleanId);
  };

  // 1. GET: Fetch single RMA
  if (req.method === 'GET') {
    try {
      const { data, error } = await matchRma(supabase.from('rma_reports').select('*')).maybeSingle();

      if (error) {
        return sendJson(res, 500, { success: false, error: 'DATABASE_ERROR', message: error.message });
      }

      if (!data) {
        return sendJson(res, 404, { success: false, error: 'NOT_FOUND', message: `RMA report ${cleanId} not found.` });
      }

      return sendJson(res, 200, { success: true, data });
    } catch (err) {
      return sendJson(res, 500, { success: false, error: 'SERVER_ERROR', message: err.message });
    }
  }

  // 2. PATCH / PUT: Update RMA status or fields
  if (req.method === 'PATCH' || req.method === 'PUT') {
    try {
      let body = req.body;
      if (typeof body === 'string') {
        try { body = JSON.parse(body); } catch (e) {}
      }

      const allowedFields = [
        'status', 'notes', 'explanation', 'price', 'price_with_vat',
        'code', 'name', 'supplier_name', 'unit_name', 'quantity', 'ae_name', 'ae_email',
        'condition_grade', 'disposition', 'warehouse_location', 'inspected_by', 'inspected_at',
        'store_branch', 'invoice_dr_number', 'si_number', 'dr_number', 'po_number', 'expiry_date', 'batch_lot_number'
      ];

      const updateData = {};
      for (const field of allowedFields) {
        if (body && body[field] !== undefined) {
          updateData[field] = body[field];
        }
      }

      if (Object.keys(updateData).length === 0) {
        return sendJson(res, 400, {
          success: false,
          error: 'BAD_REQUEST',
          message: 'No valid fields provided to update.'
        });
      }

      const { data, error } = await matchRma(
        supabase.from('rma_reports').update(updateData).select('*')
      ).maybeSingle();

      if (error) {
        return sendJson(res, 500, { success: false, error: 'UPDATE_ERROR', message: error.message });
      }

      if (!data) {
        return sendJson(res, 404, { success: false, error: 'NOT_FOUND', message: `RMA report ${cleanId} not found.` });
      }

      return sendJson(res, 200, {
        success: true,
        message: `RMA report ${data.rma_number} updated by ${client.name}.`,
        data
      });
    } catch (err) {
      return sendJson(res, 500, { success: false, error: 'SERVER_ERROR', message: err.message });
    }
  }

  // 3. DELETE: Remove RMA
  if (req.method === 'DELETE') {
    try {
      const { data, error } = await matchRma(
        supabase.from('rma_reports').delete().select('id, rma_number, name')
      ).maybeSingle();

      if (error) {
        return sendJson(res, 500, { success: false, error: 'DELETE_ERROR', message: error.message });
      }

      if (!data) {
        return sendJson(res, 404, { success: false, error: 'NOT_FOUND', message: `RMA report ${cleanId} not found.` });
      }

      return sendJson(res, 200, {
        success: true,
        message: `RMA report ${data.rma_number} deleted by ${client.name}.`,
        deleted: data
      });
    } catch (err) {
      return sendJson(res, 500, { success: false, error: 'SERVER_ERROR', message: err.message });
    }
  }

  return sendJson(res, 405, { success: false, error: 'METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED', message: `Method ${req.method} not allowed.` });
}

--- START FILE: api/_lib/auth.js ---
import { supabase } from './supabase.js';
import { hashApiKey } from './keyUtils.js';

/**
 * Applies standard RFC CORS headers to the response.
 * Dynamically reflects caller origin when present to support browser clients (fetch/axios) with credentials.
 */
export function setCorsHeaders(res, req = null) {
  const origin = req?.headers?.origin;
  if (origin) {
    res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', origin);
    res.setHeader('Vary', 'Origin');
    res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Credentials', 'true');
  } else {
    res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', '*');
  }
  res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Methods', 'GET,OPTIONS,PATCH,DELETE,POST,PUT');
  res.setHeader(
    'Access-Control-Allow-Headers',
    'X-CSRF-Token, X-Requested-With, Accept, Accept-Version, Content-Length, Content-MD5, Content-Type, Date, X-Api-Version, x-api-key, Authorization'
  );
  res.setHeader('Access-Control-Max-Age', '86400');
}

/**
 * Standardized JSON response helper.
 */
export function sendJson(res, statusCode, body, req = null) {
  setCorsHeaders(res, req);
  return res.status(statusCode).json(body);
}

/**
 * Validates request API key against SHA-256 hashed keys in Supabase database.
 * Supports:
 *  - Header: x-api-key: sk_live_...
 *  - Header: Authorization: Bearer sk_live_...
 * 
 * Returns client context { id, name, rateLimit, maskedKey } or throws/responds with 401/403.
 */
export async function requireApiKey(req, res) {
  setCorsHeaders(res, req);

  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
    res.status(204).end();
    return null;
  }

  // 1. Extract raw key
  let rawKey = req.headers['x-api-key'];

  if (!rawKey && req.headers['authorization']) {
    const authHeader = req.headers['authorization'];
    if (authHeader.startsWith('Bearer ')) {
      rawKey = authHeader.substring(7).trim();
    } else {
      rawKey = authHeader.trim();
    }
  }

  if (!rawKey || typeof rawKey !== 'string' || !rawKey.trim()) {
    sendJson(res, 401, {
      success: false,
      error: 'Unauthorized',
      code: 'MISSING_API_KEY',
      message: "Missing API key. Provide via 'x-api-key' header or 'Authorization: Bearer <key>'."
    });
    return null;
  }

  // 2. Hash key using SHA-256
  const keyHash = hashApiKey(rawKey);

  // 3. Query Supabase
  try {
    const { data: keyRecord, error } = await supabase
      .from('api_keys')
      .select('*')
      .eq('key_hash', keyHash)
      .maybeSingle();

    if (error) {
      console.error('[API Auth] Database query error:', error);
      sendJson(res, 500, {
        success: false,
        error: 'Internal Server Error',
        code: 'AUTH_DB_ERROR',
        message: 'Failed to verify API key against database.'
      });
      return null;
    }

    if (!keyRecord) {
      sendJson(res, 401, {
        success: false,
        error: 'Unauthorized',
        code: 'INVALID_API_KEY',
        message: 'The provided API key does not exist or is invalid.'
      });
      return null;
    }

    // 4. Check active status
    if (!keyRecord.is_active) {
      sendJson(res, 403, {
        success: false,
        error: 'Forbidden',
        code: 'KEY_REVOKED',
        message: 'This API key has been revoked and is inactive.'
      });
      return null;
    }

    // 5. Check expiration if configured
    if (keyRecord.expires_at) {
      const expiry = new Date(keyRecord.expires_at);
      if (expiry < new Date()) {
        sendJson(res, 403, {
          success: false,
          error: 'Forbidden',
          code: 'KEY_EXPIRED',
          message: `This API key expired on ${expiry.toISOString()}.`
        });
        return null;
      }
    }

    // 6. Asynchronously update last_used_at timestamp (fire and forget)
    supabase
      .from('api_keys')
      .update({ last_used_at: new Date().toISOString() })
      .eq('id', keyRecord.id)
      .then(() => {})
      .catch((err) => console.warn('[API Auth] Update last_used_at notice:', err));

    // 7. Inject client context into request
    const client = {
      id: keyRecord.id,
      name: keyRecord.name,
      rateLimit: keyRecord.rate_limit || 60,
      maskedKey: keyRecord.masked_key
    };

    req.client = client;
    return client;
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('[API Auth] Unexpected exception:', err);
    sendJson(res, 500, {
      success: false,
      error: 'Internal Server Error',
      code: 'AUTH_EXCEPTION',
      message: 'Unexpected authentication error.'
    });
    return null;
  }
}
