/**
 * Validates and inspects paperwork photo using Google Gemini Flash
 * Extracts DR/SI number, store branch, vendor, and document type.
 * Rejects photos that are not official logistics paperwork with clear reasons.
 */
export async function inspectPaperworkWithGemini({ fileData, imageUrl, mimeType = 'image/jpeg' }) {
  const apiKey = process.env.GEMINI_API_KEY ||
    process.env.GOOGLE_AI_KEY ||
    process.env.GOOGLE_API_KEY ||
    process.env.GOOGLE_GENAI_API_KEY;

  // 1. Prepare Base64 Image & Mime
  let cleanMimeType = mimeType || 'image/jpeg';
  let base64String = '';

  if (fileData) {
    if (fileData.includes(';base64,')) {
      const parts = fileData.split(';base64,');
      cleanMimeType = parts[0].replace('data:', '') || cleanMimeType;
      base64String = parts[1];
    } else if (fileData.includes(',')) {
      base64String = fileData.split(',')[1];
    } else {
      base64String = fileData;
    }
  } else if (imageUrl) {
    const imgRes = await fetch(imageUrl);
    if (!imgRes.ok) {
      throw new Error(`Failed to fetch image from URL: ${imgRes.statusText}`);
    }
    const arrayBuf = await imgRes.arrayBuffer();
    cleanMimeType = imgRes.headers.get('content-type') || cleanMimeType;
    base64String = Buffer.from(arrayBuf).toString('base64');
  } else {
    throw new Error('Either fileData (Base64) or imageUrl must be provided.');
  }

  // 2. If API Key is missing, reject document validation with clear notice (NEVER create fake numbers!)
  if (!apiKey) {
    console.warn('[Gemini Flash Inspector] GEMINI_API_KEY environment variable is not configured.');
    return {
      is_valid_document: false,
      document_type: 'Unknown / Unverified',
      confidence: 0.0,
      si_number: null,
      dr_number: null,
      po_number: null,
      invoice_dr_number: null,
      store_branch: null,
      detected_date: null,
      vendor_name: null,
      error: 'MISSING_GEMINI_API_KEY',
      rejection_reason: 'Google AI Studio API key (GEMINI_API_KEY) is not configured in Vercel Environment Variables. Please configure the key to enable AI verification, or enter SI#, DR#, and PO# manually.'
    };
  }

  const promptText = `
You are a strict Wholesale Commercial Logistics Auditor and High-Accuracy Document OCR Specialist.
Your task is to examine the provided photo and determine if it is an authentic wholesale logistics paper document:
- Sales Invoice (SI)
- Delivery Receipt (DR)
- Purchase Order (PO)
- Official Pull-Out Slip / Credit Slip

CRITICAL REJECTION RULES (Return is_valid_document: false):
1. If the photo does NOT depict an authentic commercial/logistics paper document:
   You MUST reject it with a specific rejection_reason explaining what was detected instead:
   - For a person or face: "Photo shows a person or selfie instead of a commercial delivery document."
   - For merchandise or snack packaging: "Photo shows product packaging only, not the official Delivery Receipt, Invoice, or PO paperwork."
   - For an empty desk, floor, or room: "Photo shows a surface or room with no readable paperwork."
   - For a casual retail grocery receipt or cafe bill: "Photo appears to be a casual retail receipt rather than an official wholesale Delivery Receipt (DR), Sales Invoice (SI), or Purchase Order (PO)."
2. If it is a photo of paper, but NO identifying document numbers (Sales Invoice #, Delivery Receipt #, or Purchase Order #) are legible:
   You MUST reject it with: "Paperwork detected, but document numbers (Sales Invoice #, DR #, or PO #) are blurry, dark, or cropped. Please retake a clear, well-lit close-up."
3. If the image is blurry, out of focus, or glare blocks the text:
   You MUST reject it with: "Image is too blurry or has excessive glare to read document numbers. Please retake under clear lighting."

CRITICAL EXTRACTION RULES (When is_valid_document: true):
- Extract whatever numbers are present on the document:
  - "si_number": Exact Sales Invoice # (e.g. "SI-2026-9021", "SI# 10482"), or null if not an invoice or not present.
  - "dr_number": Exact Delivery Receipt # (e.g. "DR-2026-8812", "DR# 99421"), or null if not a DR or not present.
  - "po_number": Exact Purchase Order # (e.g. "PO-2026-4401", "PO# 3318"), or null if not a PO or not present.
  - "invoice_dr_number": The primary tracking number (prefer SI# > DR# > PO#).
  - "store_branch": Store, supermarket branch, or customer recipient name printed on the document.
  - "vendor_name": Vendor, distributor, or company name printed on the document.
  - "detected_date": Date found on document (YYYY-MM-DD format if possible).
  - "document_type": "Sales Invoice" | "Delivery Receipt" | "Purchase Order" | "Official Pull-Out Slip" | "Commercial Paperwork"

NEVER invent, guess, or synthesize fake numbers! If a field is not visibly written on the page, return null.

Return ONLY valid JSON matching this schema:
{
  "is_valid_document": boolean,
  "document_type": string,
  "confidence": number,
  "si_number": string | null,
  "dr_number": string | null,
  "po_number": string | null,
  "invoice_dr_number": string | null,
  "store_branch": string | null,
  "detected_date": string | null,
  "vendor_name": string | null,
  "rejection_reason": string | null
}
`;

  // Direct fast REST model cascade: gemini-3.5-flash-lite first for instant <1.5s OCR
  const configuredModel = process.env.GEMINI_MODEL;
  const modelsToTry = [
    configuredModel || 'gemini-3.5-flash-lite',
    'gemini-2.5-flash-lite',
    'gemini-2.5-flash',
    'gemini-flash-latest'
  ].filter(Boolean);

  let lastError = null;

  for (const modelName of modelsToTry) {
    try {
      const endpoint = `https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/${modelName}:generateContent?key=${apiKey}`;

      const apiRes = await fetch(endpoint, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          contents: [
            {
              role: 'user',
              parts: [
                { text: promptText },
                {
                  inlineData: {
                    mimeType: cleanMimeType,
                    data: base64String
                  }
                }
              ]
            }
          ],
          generationConfig: {
            responseMimeType: 'application/json',
            temperature: 0.1
          }
        })
      });

      if (!apiRes.ok) {
        const errBody = await apiRes.text();
        throw new Error(`Google API ${apiRes.status} on model ${modelName}: ${errBody}`);
      }

      const resData = await apiRes.json();
      const candidate = resData?.candidates?.[0];
      const partText = candidate?.content?.parts?.[0]?.text?.trim() || '';

      if (!partText) {
        throw new Error(`Empty response from model ${modelName}`);
      }

      // Parse JSON from response
      const jsonStart = partText.indexOf('{');
      const jsonEnd = partText.lastIndexOf('}');
      if (jsonStart !== -1 && jsonEnd !== -1) {
        const cleanJsonStr = partText.substring(jsonStart, jsonEnd + 1);
        const parsed = JSON.parse(cleanJsonStr);
        const isValid = Boolean(parsed.is_valid_document);
        const siNum = parsed.si_number ? String(parsed.si_number).trim() : null;
        const drNum = parsed.dr_number ? String(parsed.dr_number).trim() : null;
        const poNum = parsed.po_number ? String(parsed.po_number).trim() : null;
        const fallbackPrimary = parsed.invoice_dr_number ? String(parsed.invoice_dr_number).trim() : null;
        const primaryDocNum = siNum || drNum || poNum || fallbackPrimary;

        return {
          is_valid_document: isValid,
          document_type: parsed.document_type || (isValid ? 'Commercial Logistics Paperwork' : 'Non-Document / Rejected'),
          confidence: typeof parsed.confidence === 'number' ? parsed.confidence : (isValid ? 0.95 : 0.0),
          si_number: siNum,
          dr_number: drNum,
          po_number: poNum,
          invoice_dr_number: primaryDocNum,
          store_branch: parsed.store_branch ? String(parsed.store_branch).trim() : null,
          detected_date: parsed.detected_date || null,
          vendor_name: parsed.vendor_name ? String(parsed.vendor_name).trim() : null,
          rejection_reason: isValid ? null : (parsed.rejection_reason || 'Photo does not appear to be an authentic Sales Invoice, DR, or PO, or document numbers are unreadable.')
        };
      }

      throw new Error(`Invalid JSON format from model ${modelName}`);
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn(`[Gemini Flash] Model ${modelName} attempt notice:`, err.message);
      lastError = err;
    }
  }

  // If all models failed
  throw new Error(`Gemini inspection failed: ${lastError?.message || 'Unknown error'}`);
}

import crypto from 'crypto';

export const ALLOWED_SYSTEMS = [
  'Primary System (Mine)',
  'Jarmen',
  'Jelo',
  'Arlito'
];

/**
 * Computes SHA-256 hash of a raw API key.
 * @param {string} rawKey 
 * @returns {string} 64-char hex hash
 */
export function hashApiKey(rawKey) {
  if (!rawKey || typeof rawKey !== 'string') return '';
  return crypto.createHash('sha256').update(rawKey.trim()).digest('hex');
}

/**
 * Creates a masked version for safe UI display (e.g. "sk_live_...4a2b")
 * @param {string} rawKey 
 * @returns {string} Masked string
 */
export function maskApiKey(rawKey) {
  if (!rawKey || typeof rawKey !== 'string') return 'sk_live_...';
  const clean = rawKey.trim();
  const last4 = clean.slice(-4);
  return `sk_live_...${last4}`;
}

/**
 * Generates a cryptographically strong raw API key and its hash + mask.
 * Format: sk_live_rma_<48 hex chars>
 */
export function generateApiKeyPair() {
  const entropy = crypto.randomBytes(24).toString('hex'); // 48 chars
  const rawKey = `sk_live_rma_${entropy}`;
  const keyHash = hashApiKey(rawKey);
  const maskedKey = maskApiKey(rawKey);

  return {
    rawKey,
    keyHash,
    maskedKey
  };
}

import { supabase } from './supabase.js';
import { sendJson, setCorsHeaders } from './auth.js';
import { INITIAL_PRODUCTS } from './mockProducts.js';

/**
 * Retrieve the Laravel Cloud API Key:
 * 1. Checks server environment variables (EXTERNAL_CATALOG_API_KEY, etc.)
 * 2. Fallback to Supabase products table (__CONFIG_PO_API_KEY__) saved by Admin in Settings
 */
async function getCatalogApiKey() {
  const envKey = process.env.EXTERNAL_CATALOG_API_KEY || 
                 process.env.EXTERNAL_API_KEY_DANILO || 
                 process.env.VITE_EXTERNAL_API_KEY_DANILO || 
                 process.env.PO_API_KEY || 
                 process.env.VITE_PO_API_KEY;

  if (envKey && envKey.trim() && envKey.trim() !== 'pk_live_po_cloud_db_2026_dev_key') {
    return envKey.trim();
  }

  try {
    const { data } = await supabase
      .from('products')
      .select('code')
      .eq('barcode', '__CONFIG_PO_API_KEY__')
      .maybeSingle();

    if (data?.code && data.code.trim() && data.code.trim() !== 'pk_live_po_cloud_db_2026_dev_key') {
      return data.code.trim();
    }
  } catch (e) {
    // Quiet catch
  }

  try {
    const { data: settingData } = await supabase
      .from('rma_settings')
      .select('value')
      .eq('key', 'EXTERNAL_API_KEY_DANILO')
      .maybeSingle();

    if (settingData?.value && typeof settingData.value === 'string' && settingData.value.trim() !== 'pk_live_po_cloud_db_2026_dev_key') {
      return settingData.value.trim();
    }
  } catch (e) {
    // Quiet catch
  }

  return envKey || 'pk_live_po_cloud_db_2026_dev_key';
}

/**
 * Public Secure Product Lookup Endpoint:
 * GET /api/v1/products/lookup?barcode=[barcode]&search=[search]
 * 
 * Securely proxies external Laravel Cloud catalog calls on the server
 * so anonymous dock workers, mobile phones, and incognito sessions
 * never need client-side credentials.
 */
export default async function handler(req, res) {
  setCorsHeaders(res);

  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
    return res.status(200).end();
  }

  if (req.method !== 'GET') {
    return sendJson(res, 405, { success: false, error: 'METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED', message: `Method ${req.method} not allowed.` });
  }

  const barcodeParam = req.query.barcode || req.query.code || req.query.ean_code;
  const searchParam = req.query.search || req.query.q;
  const limitParam = Math.min(Math.max(parseInt(req.query.limit, 10) || 50, 1), 100);

  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // MODE 1: SINGLE BARCODE / SKU LOOKUP
  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  if (barcodeParam) {
    const cleanBarcode = String(barcodeParam).trim();
    if (!cleanBarcode) {
      return sendJson(res, 400, { success: false, error: 'BAD_REQUEST', message: 'Barcode is required.' });
    }

    try {
      // 1. Check Supabase 'products' table first (Priority 1)
      const { data: supaProds, error: supaErr } = await supabase
        .from('products')
        .select('*')
        .or(`barcode.eq.${cleanBarcode},code.ilike.${cleanBarcode}`)
        .limit(1);

      if (!supaErr && supaProds && supaProds.length > 0) {
        const item = supaProds[0];
        if (!item.name?.startsWith('[DELETED]')) {
          return sendJson(res, 200, {
            success: true,
            found: true,
            source: 'database',
            product: {
              id: item.id,
              barcode: item.barcode,
              code: item.code || item.barcode,
              sku: item.code || item.barcode,
              ean_code: item.ean_code || item.barcode,
              name: item.name,
              price: Number(item.price || 0),
              price_with_vat: Number(item.price_with_vat || item.price || 0),
              priceWithVat: Number(item.price_with_vat || item.price || 0),
              supplier_name: item.supplier_name || 'Savemore',
              supplier: item.supplier_name || 'Savemore',
              brand_name: item.brand_name || null,
              brand: item.brand_name || null,
              unit_name: item.unit_name || 'pc',
              has_serial_numbers: Boolean(item.has_serial_numbers),
              image_url: item.image_url || null,
              imageUrl: item.image_url || null,
              ae_name: item.ae_name || null,
              ae_email: item.ae_email || null,
              company: item.company || null,
              is_verified: item.is_verified !== false,
              isVerified: item.is_verified !== false
            }
          });
        }
      }

      // 2. Query Coworker's Live Catalog API (erply_products) securely from server
      const key = await getCatalogApiKey();
      const baseUrl = process.env.PO_API_URL || process.env.VITE_PO_API_URL || 'https://purchase-order-db-production-ff1oho.laravel.cloud/api/v1';
      const codeCandidates = Array.from(new Set([cleanBarcode, cleanBarcode.toUpperCase(), cleanBarcode.toLowerCase()]));
      let matchedItem = null;

      for (const code of codeCandidates) {
        // Priority A: Direct equality on ean_code (Manufacturer / Retail Barcode)
        try {
          const eanUrl = `${baseUrl}/data/erply_products?ean_code=${encodeURIComponent(code)}&columns=id,code,code2,ean_code,name,priceWithVat,price,supplierName,brandName,unitName,hasSerialNumbers`;
          const rEan = await fetch(eanUrl, { headers: { 'X-API-Key': key, 'Accept': 'application/json' } });
          if (rEan.ok) {
            const jEan = await rEan.json();
            if (jEan.data && jEan.data.length > 0) {
              matchedItem = jEan.data[0];
              break;
            }
          }
        } catch (e) {}

        // Priority B: Direct equality on code2 (Secondary Barcode / UPC)
        try {
          const code2Url = `${baseUrl}/data/erply_products?code2=${encodeURIComponent(code)}&columns=id,code,code2,ean_code,name,priceWithVat,price,supplierName,brandName,unitName,hasSerialNumbers`;
          const r2 = await fetch(code2Url, { headers: { 'X-API-Key': key, 'Accept': 'application/json' } });
          if (r2.ok) {
            const j2 = await r2.json();
            if (j2.data && j2.data.length > 0) {
              matchedItem = j2.data[0];
              break;
            }
          }
        } catch (e) {}

        // Priority C: Direct equality on code (Internal SKU)
        try {
          const skuUrl = `${baseUrl}/data/erply_products?code=${encodeURIComponent(code)}&columns=id,code,code2,ean_code,name,priceWithVat,price,supplierName,brandName,unitName,hasSerialNumbers`;
          const rSku = await fetch(skuUrl, { headers: { 'X-API-Key': key, 'Accept': 'application/json' } });
          if (rSku.ok) {
            const jSku = await rSku.json();
            if (jSku.data && jSku.data.length > 0) {
              matchedItem = jSku.data[0];
              break;
            }
          }
        } catch (e) {}
      }

      if (matchedItem) {
        const sku = matchedItem.code || matchedItem.sku || `SKU-${matchedItem.id}`;
        const barcodeVal = matchedItem.ean_code || matchedItem.code2 || cleanBarcode;
        const priceWithVat = parseFloat(matchedItem.priceWithVat) || parseFloat(matchedItem.price) || 0;
        const netPrice = parseFloat(matchedItem.price) || (priceWithVat / 1.12);

        const normalized = {
          id: String(matchedItem.id || sku),
          barcode: barcodeVal,
          code: sku,
          sku: sku,
          ean_code: matchedItem.ean_code || null,
          name: matchedItem.name || '',
          price: netPrice,
          price_with_vat: priceWithVat,
          priceWithVat: priceWithVat,
          supplier_name: matchedItem.supplierName || 'Savemore',
          supplier: matchedItem.supplierName || 'Savemore',
          brand_name: matchedItem.brandName || null,
          brand: matchedItem.brandName || null,
          unit_name: matchedItem.unitName || 'pc',
          has_serial_numbers: Boolean(matchedItem.hasSerialNumbers),
          image_url: null,
          imageUrl: null,
          ae_name: null,
          ae_email: null,
          company: null,
          is_verified: true,
          isVerified: true,
          source: 'erply_api'
        };

        // Cache into Supabase so subsequent scans find it directly in Supabase
        try {
          await supabase.from('products').upsert({
            barcode: barcodeVal,
            code: sku,
            name: normalized.name,
            supplier_name: normalized.supplier_name,
            price: normalized.price,
            price_with_vat: normalized.price_with_vat,
            brand_name: normalized.brand_name,
            unit_name: normalized.unit_name,
            is_verified: true,
            updated_at: new Date().toISOString()
          }, { onConflict: 'barcode' });
        } catch (err) {}

        return sendJson(res, 200, {
          success: true,
          found: true,
          source: 'erply_api',
          product: normalized
        });
      }

      // 3. Wholesale Verified Catalog Fallback (INITIAL_PRODUCTS)
      const mock = INITIAL_PRODUCTS.find(p => 
        p.barcode === cleanBarcode || 
        (p.sku && p.sku.toLowerCase() === cleanBarcode.toLowerCase())
      );

      if (mock) {
        return sendJson(res, 200, {
          success: true,
          found: true,
          source: 'verified_catalog',
          product: {
            id: mock.id,
            barcode: mock.barcode,
            code: mock.sku,
            sku: mock.sku,
            name: mock.name,
            price: Number(mock.unit_price || 0),
            price_with_vat: Number(mock.unit_price || 0) * 1.12,
            priceWithVat: Number(mock.unit_price || 0) * 1.12,
            supplier_name: mock.supplier || 'Savemore',
            supplier: mock.supplier || 'Savemore',
            brand_name: mock.brand || null,
            brand: mock.brand || null,
            unit_name: 'pc',
            image_url: mock.image_url || null,
            imageUrl: mock.image_url || null,
            ae_name: null,
            ae_email: null,
            is_verified: true,
            isVerified: true
          }
        });
      }

      // 4. Not registered anywhere
      return sendJson(res, 200, {
        success: true,
        found: false,
        product: null,
        message: `Barcode "${cleanBarcode}" is not registered in the catalog.`
      });
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Error during product lookup proxy:', err);
      return sendJson(res, 500, { success: false, error: 'SERVER_ERROR', message: err.message });
    }
  }

  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // MODE 2: MULTI-PRODUCT KEYWORD SEARCH
  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  if (searchParam) {
    const cleanSearch = String(searchParam).trim();
    if (!cleanSearch) {
      return sendJson(res, 200, { success: true, count: 0, products: [] });
    }

    try {
      const results = [];
      const seenKeys = new Set();

      // 1. Search Supabase
      const { data: supaItems } = await supabase
        .from('products')
        .select('*')
        .or(`name.ilike.%${cleanSearch}%,barcode.ilike.%${cleanSearch}%,code.ilike.%${cleanSearch}%`)
        .order('is_verified', { ascending: false })
        .limit(limitParam);

      if (supaItems && Array.isArray(supaItems)) {
        for (const item of supaItems) {
          if (item.name?.startsWith('[DELETED]') || item.barcode?.startsWith('__CONFIG_')) continue;
          const key = String(item.barcode || item.code || item.id).trim().toLowerCase();
          seenKeys.add(key);
          results.push({
            id: item.id,
            barcode: item.barcode,
            code: item.code || item.barcode,
            name: item.name,
            price: Number(item.price || 0),
            price_with_vat: Number(item.price_with_vat || item.price || 0),
            priceWithVat: Number(item.price_with_vat || item.price || 0),
            supplier_name: item.supplier_name || 'Savemore',
            supplier: item.supplier_name || 'Savemore',
            brand_name: item.brand_name || null,
            brand: item.brand_name || null,
            unit_name: item.unit_name || 'pc',
            image_url: item.image_url || null,
            imageUrl: item.image_url || null,
            is_verified: item.is_verified !== false,
            isVerified: item.is_verified !== false,
            source: 'database'
          });
        }
      }

      // 2. Search Laravel Cloud API
      const key = await getCatalogApiKey();
      const baseUrl = process.env.PO_API_URL || process.env.VITE_PO_API_URL || 'https://purchase-order-db-production-ff1oho.laravel.cloud/api/v1';

      try {
        const searchUrl = `${baseUrl}/data/erply_products?search=${encodeURIComponent(cleanSearch)}&per_page=25&columns=id,code,code2,ean_code,name,priceWithVat,price,supplierName,brandName,unitName,hasSerialNumbers`;
        const resSearch = await fetch(searchUrl, { headers: { 'X-API-Key': key, 'Accept': 'application/json' } });
        if (resSearch.ok) {
          const jsonSearch = await resSearch.json();
          if (jsonSearch.data && Array.isArray(jsonSearch.data)) {
            for (const item of jsonSearch.data) {
              const sku = item.code || item.sku || `SKU-${item.id}`;
              const barcodeVal = item.ean_code || item.code2 || sku;
              const prodKey = String(barcodeVal || sku || item.id).trim().toLowerCase();
              if (!seenKeys.has(prodKey)) {
                seenKeys.add(prodKey);
                const priceWithVat = parseFloat(item.priceWithVat) || parseFloat(item.price) || 0;
                const netPrice = parseFloat(item.price) || (priceWithVat / 1.12);
                results.push({
                  id: String(item.id || sku),
                  barcode: barcodeVal,
                  code: sku,
                  name: item.name || '',
                  price: netPrice,
                  price_with_vat: priceWithVat,
                  priceWithVat: priceWithVat,
                  supplier_name: item.supplierName || 'Savemore',
                  supplier: item.supplierName || 'Savemore',
                  brand_name: item.brandName || null,
                  brand: item.brandName || null,
                  unit_name: item.unitName || 'pc',
                  image_url: null,
                  imageUrl: null,
                  is_verified: true,
                  isVerified: true,
                  source: 'erply_api'
                });
              }
            }
          }
        }
      } catch (err) {}

      // 3. Search Mock Catalog
      for (const mock of INITIAL_PRODUCTS) {
        const matchText = `${mock.name} ${mock.brand || ''} ${mock.category || ''} ${mock.sku || ''} ${mock.barcode || ''}`.toLowerCase();
        if (matchText.includes(cleanSearch.toLowerCase())) {
          const key = String(mock.barcode || mock.sku || mock.id).trim().toLowerCase();
          if (!seenKeys.has(key)) {
            seenKeys.add(key);
            results.push({
              id: mock.id,
              barcode: mock.barcode,
              code: mock.sku,
              name: mock.name,
              price: Number(mock.unit_price || 0),
              price_with_vat: Number(mock.unit_price || 0) * 1.12,
              priceWithVat: Number(mock.unit_price || 0) * 1.12,
              supplier_name: mock.supplier || 'Savemore',
              brand_name: mock.brand || null,
              unit_name: 'pc',
              image_url: mock.image_url || null,
              imageUrl: mock.image_url || null,
              is_verified: true,
              isVerified: true,
              source: 'verified_catalog'
            });
          }
        }
      }

      return sendJson(res, 200, {
        success: true,
        count: results.length,
        products: results.slice(0, limitParam)
      });
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Error during product search proxy:', err);
      return sendJson(res, 500, { success: false, error: 'SERVER_ERROR', message: err.message });
    }
  }

  return sendJson(res, 400, {
    success: false,
    error: 'BAD_REQUEST',
    message: 'Provide either ?barcode=[code] or ?search=[term].'
  });
}

import { OpenAPIRegistry, OpenApiGeneratorV31 } from '@asteasolutions/zod-to-openapi';
import { registerHealthRoutes } from './schemas/health.schema.js';
import { registerRMARoutes } from './schemas/rma.schema.js';
import { registerProductRoutes } from './schemas/products.schema.js';
import { registerCreditMemoRoutes } from './schemas/creditMemos.schema.js';
import { registerApiKeyRoutes } from './schemas/apiKeys.schema.js';

/**
 * Builds the Code-First OpenAPI 3.1 Specification dynamically.
 * Whenever routes or Zod schemas are edited/added/removed in code,
 * this registry regenerates the full OpenAPI document automatically.
 */
export function generateCodeFirstOpenApiSpec() {
  const registry = new OpenAPIRegistry();

  // 1. Register Global Security Schemes
  registry.registerComponent('securitySchemes', 'ApiKeyHeader', {
    type: 'apiKey',
    in: 'header',
    name: 'x-api-key',
    description: 'Pass secret key via x-api-key header'
  });

  registry.registerComponent('securitySchemes', 'BearerAuth', {
    type: 'http',
    scheme: 'bearer',
    bearerFormat: 'API-Key',
    description: 'Pass secret key via Authorization: Bearer <key>'
  });

  // 2. Register all Route Schemas (Code-First)
  registerHealthRoutes(registry);
  registerRMARoutes(registry);
  registerProductRoutes(registry);
  registerCreditMemoRoutes(registry);
  registerApiKeyRoutes(registry);

  // 3. Generate OpenAPI 3.1 Document
  const generator = new OpenApiGeneratorV31(registry.definitions);

  return generator.generateDocument({
    openapi: '3.1.0',
    info: {
      title: 'Wholesale RMA Multi-System REST API',
      version: '1.0.0',
      description: `
**Code-First & Schema-Driven REST API** for Wholesale RMA Portal v2.
Built with Zod & \`@asteasolutions/zod-to-openapi\`.

### 4 Authenticated Client Systems:
- **Primary System (Mine)**
- **Jarmen**
- **Jelo**
- **Arlito**

### Authentication:
Pass your secret API key in all requests:
- \`x-api-key: sk_live_rma_...\`
- Or \`Authorization: Bearer sk_live_rma_...\`

Click **Authorize** on the top right to test live endpoints directly from this interactive documentation.
      `,
      contact: {
        name: 'Finance & Systems Engineering',
        email: 'finance2@keysysincorporated.com'
      }
    },
    servers: [
      {
        url: '/',
        description: 'Current Environment (Vercel Serverless)'
      }
    ],
    security: [
      { ApiKeyHeader: [] },
      { BearerAuth: [] }
    ]
  });
}

--- START FILE: api/_lib/schemas/apiKeys.schema.js ---
import { z, StandardErrorSchema } from './common.js';

export const ApiKeyRecordSchema = z.object({
  id: z.string().uuid().openapi({ example: 'a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7a8b-9c0d-1e2f3a4b5c6d' }),
  name: z.string().openapi({ example: 'Jarmen' }),
  masked_key: z.string().openapi({ example: 'sk_live_...e6c6' }),
  is_active: z.boolean().openapi({ example: true }),
  rate_limit: z.number().int().default(60).openapi({ example: 60 }),
  expires_at: z.string().datetime().nullable().optional(),
  last_used_at: z.string().datetime().nullable().optional(),
  created_at: z.string().datetime().optional()
}).openapi('ApiKeyRecord');

export const CreateApiKeyRequestSchema = z.object({
  name: z.enum(['Primary System (Mine)', 'Jarmen', 'Jelo', 'Arlito']).openapi({
    description: 'Target client system',
    example: 'Jarmen'
  }),
  rateLimit: z.number().int().min(10).max(300).default(60).optional().openapi({ example: 60 }),
  expiresAt: z.string().datetime().optional()
}).openapi('CreateApiKeyRequest');

export function registerApiKeyRoutes(registry) {
  // GET /api/v1/api-keys
  registry.registerPath({
    method: 'get',
    path: '/api/v1/api-keys',
    summary: 'List Registered API Keys (Masked)',
    description: 'Returns all client keys with masked tokens. Never exposes secret keys or SHA-256 hashes.',
    tags: ['API Key Administration'],
    responses: {
      200: {
        description: 'List of registered API keys',
        content: {
          'application/json': {
            schema: z.object({
              success: z.boolean().openapi({ example: true }),
              count: z.number().openapi({ example: 4 }),
              keys: z.array(ApiKeyRecordSchema)
            })
          }
        }
      }
    }
  });

  // POST /api/v1/api-keys
  registry.registerPath({
    method: 'post',
    path: '/api/v1/api-keys',
    summary: 'Generate New API Key for Client System',
    description: 'Issues a new secret API key for Primary System, Jarmen, Jelo, or Arlito. Returns the raw secret key ONCE.',
    tags: ['API Key Administration'],
    request: {
      body: {
        required: true,
        content: {
          'application/json': {
            schema: CreateApiKeyRequestSchema
          }
        }
      }
    },
    responses: {
      201: {
        description: 'API key generated with one-time raw secret',
        content: {
          'application/json': {
            schema: z.object({
              success: z.boolean().openapi({ example: true }),
              message: z.string().openapi({ example: 'API Key successfully generated for Jarmen.' }),
              apiKey: z.string().openapi({ example: 'sk_live_rma_b68541b70325e2d858fbf11a4adbb6fcc79709c075cee6c6' }),
              keyRecord: ApiKeyRecordSchema
            })
          }
        }
      },
      400: { description: 'Validation error', content: { 'application/json': { schema: StandardErrorSchema } } }
    }
  });

  // PATCH /api/v1/api-keys/{id}
  registry.registerPath({
    method: 'patch',
    path: '/api/v1/api-keys/{id}',
    summary: 'Rotate Client API Key',
    description: 'Immediately revokes the current secret key and issues a new replacement key for the client.',
    tags: ['API Key Administration'],
    request: {
      params: z.object({
        id: z.string().uuid().openapi({ description: 'API Key UUID', example: 'a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7a8b-9c0d-1e2f3a4b5c6d' })
      })
    },
    responses: {
      200: {
        description: 'Key rotated with new raw secret returned once',
        content: {
          'application/json': {
            schema: z.object({
              success: z.boolean().openapi({ example: true }),
              message: z.string().openapi({ example: 'API Key rotated successfully.' }),
              apiKey: z.string().openapi({ example: 'sk_live_rma_new_key_here' }),
              keyRecord: ApiKeyRecordSchema
            })
          }
        }
      },
      404: { description: 'API key not found', content: { 'application/json': { schema: StandardErrorSchema } } }
    }
  });

  // DELETE /api/v1/api-keys/{id}
  registry.registerPath({
    method: 'delete',
    path: '/api/v1/api-keys/{id}',
    summary: 'Revoke and Delete API Key',
    description: 'Permanently deletes an API key. Calls made with this key will immediately fail with 401 Unauthorized.',
    tags: ['API Key Administration'],
    request: {
      params: z.object({
        id: z.string().uuid().openapi({ example: 'a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7a8b-9c0d-1e2f3a4b5c6d' })
      })
    },
    responses: {
      200: {
        description: 'Key revoked and deleted',
        content: {
          'application/json': {
            schema: z.object({
              success: z.boolean().openapi({ example: true }),
              message: z.string().openapi({ example: 'API key deleted.' }),
              deletedKey: ApiKeyRecordSchema
            })
          }
        }
      },
      404: { description: 'Key not found', content: { 'application/json': { schema: StandardErrorSchema } } }
    }
  });
}

    description: 'Secure server-side product lookup proxy. Resolves barcodes across Supabase, ERPLY POS/ERP live catalog, and wholesale verified catalog without requiring client credentials.',
    tags: ['Products & Catalog'],
    request: {
      query: z.object({
        barcode: z.string().optional().openapi({ description: 'Barcode or SKU code to scan and resolve', example: '4800016644833' }),

        limit: z.string().optional().openapi({ description: 'Maximum products to return', example: '25' })
      })
    },
    responses: {
      200: {
        description: 'Lookup result',
        content: {
          'application/json': {
            schema: z.object({
              success: z.boolean().openapi({ example: true }),

              source: z.string().optional().openapi({ example: 'erply_api' }),
              product: ProductSchema.nullable().optional(),
              products: z.array(ProductSchema).optional()
            })
          }
        }
      }
    }
  });

  // GET /api/v1/products
  registry.registerPath({
    method: 'get',

        search: z.string().optional().openapi({ description: 'Search name or barcode', example: 'Crackers' })

    responses: {
      200: {
        description: 'Matching products',
        content: {

            schema: z.object({
              success: z.boolean().openapi({ example: true }),
              client: z.string().openapi({ example: 'Arlito' }),
              total: z.number().openapi({ example: 450 }),
              limit: z.number().openapi({ example: 50 }),
              offset: z.number().openapi({ example: 0 }),
              data: z.array(ProductSchema)
            })
          }
        }
      },
      401: { description: 'Unauthorized', content: { 'application/json': { schema: StandardErrorSchema } } }
    }
  });

  // POST /api/v1/products
  registry.registerPath({

  condition_grade: RMAConditionGradeEnum.optional().openapi({ example: 'A - Like New / Resellable' }),
  disposition: RMADispositionEnum.optional().openapi({ example: 'Restock to Inventory' }),
  warehouse_location: z.string().optional().openapi({ example: 'RACK-03-BIN-A' }),
  inspected_by: z.string().optional().openapi({ example: 'Supervisor Danilo' }),
  quantity: z.number().int().min(1).optional().openapi({ example: 3 }),
  store_branch: z.string().optional().openapi({ example: 'Savemore Taguig - Branch 14' }),
  invoice_dr_number: z.string().optional().openapi({ example: 'DR-2026-8891' }),
  si_number: z.string().optional().openapi({ example: 'SI-2026-9021' }),
  dr_number: z.string().optional().openapi({ example: 'DR-2026-8891' }),
  po_number: z.string().optional().openapi({ example: 'PO-2026-4401' }),
  expiry_date: z.string().optional().openapi({ example: '2026-12-31' }),
  batch_lot_number: z.string().optional().openapi({ example: 'LOT-B42' }),
  notes: z.string().optional().openapi({ example: 'Inspection verified by supervisor' }),
  explanation: z.string().optional().openapi({ example: 'Replacement voucher issued' }),
  price: z.number().optional().openapi({ example: 25.00 }),
  price_with_vat: z.number().optional().openapi({ example: 28.00 })
}).openapi('UpdateRMAReportRequest');

import { createClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js';

const supabaseUrl = process.env.VITE_SUPABASE_URL || process.env.SUPABASE_URL || 'https://lschluviltzsknptwgrz.supabase.co';
const supabaseKey = process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY || process.env.VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY || process.env.SUPABASE_ANON_KEY || 'sb_publishable_Jrv9ZNgGXJ4PZoNWCJSHxQ_7hZtQqd3';

// Dummy WebSocket class to avoid Node.js Realtime WebSocket instantiation error in serverless environments
class NoopWebSocketTransport {}

/**
 * Free-Tier Connection Optimization:
 * Serverless lambdas run over HTTPS/PostgREST.
 * Caching on globalThis reuses TCP/TLS connections and HTTP keep-alive agents across warm Vercel invocations,
 * preventing connection spikes against Supabase's free-tier pool.
 * Note: If using direct PostgreSQL connections (e.g. pg / prisma), use Supavisor Transaction Pooler port 6543.
 */
function getSupabaseClient() {
  if (globalThis._supabaseServerlessClient) {
    return globalThis._supabaseServerlessClient;
  }

  const client = createClient(supabaseUrl, supabaseKey, {
    auth: {
      persistSession: false,
      autoRefreshToken: false,
    },
    realtime: {
      transport: NoopWebSocketTransport,
    },
  });

  globalThis._supabaseServerlessClient = client;
  return client;
}

export const supabase = getSupabaseClient();

--- START FILE: api/_lib/verifyPinHandler.js ---
import { supabase } from './supabase.js';
import { sendJson, setCorsHeaders } from './auth.js';

/**
 * Enterprise Anti-Fraud Gatekeeper Verification & Cooldown Lockout Engine
 * 
 * Verifies 6-digit PIN against active QR profile, checks physical device fingerprint
 * and client IP against public.device_intake_sessions, and enforces unbypassable
 * hardware-level cooldown periods across Incognito, private tabs, and different browsers.
 */

export async function handleVerifyPin(req, res) {
  setCorsHeaders(res, req);

  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
    return res.status(204).end();
  }

  if (req.method !== 'POST') {
    return sendJson(res, 405, {
      success: false,
      error: 'METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED',
      message: 'Only POST method is permitted for PIN verification.'
    });
  }

  try {
    let body = req.body;
    if (typeof body === 'string') {
      try {
        body = JSON.parse(body);
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    const { slug, pin, deviceFingerprint } = body || {};

    if (!slug || typeof slug !== 'string' || !slug.trim()) {
      return sendJson(res, 400, {
        success: false,
        error: 'BAD_REQUEST',
        message: 'Station access slug is required.'
      });
    }

    if (!pin || !/^\d{6}$/.test(String(pin).trim())) {
      return sendJson(res, 400, {
        success: false,
        error: 'BAD_REQUEST',
        message: 'A valid 6-digit numeric PIN is required.'
      });
    }

    // Extract client IP address from network headers
    const forwarded = req.headers['x-forwarded-for'];
    const clientIp = forwarded 
      ? String(forwarded).split(',')[0].trim() 
      : (req.headers['x-real-ip'] || req.socket?.remoteAddress || '127.0.0.1');

    const cleanSlug = String(slug).trim().toLowerCase();
    const cleanPin = String(pin).trim();
    const cleanFingerprint = String(deviceFingerprint || `ip_${clientIp}`).trim();

    // 1. STEP A: Profile & PIN check
    let profile = null;

    // Check public.portal_access_keys in Supabase
    try {
      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from('portal_access_keys')
        .select('*')
        .eq('access_slug', cleanSlug)
        .maybeSingle();

      if (!error && data) {
        profile = data;
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('portal_access_keys query error:', e);
    }

    // Fallback to rma_settings if table empty or in migration
    if (!profile) {
      try {
        const { data: settingsData } = await supabase
          .from('rma_settings')
          .select('value')
          .eq('key', 'portal_access_keys_store')
          .single();

        if (settingsData?.value && Array.isArray(settingsData.value)) {
          profile = settingsData.value.find(p => p.access_slug?.toLowerCase() === cleanSlug);
        }
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    // Fallback to hardcoded defaults for seamless out-of-the-box bootstrapping
    if (!profile) {
      if (cleanSlug === 'dock') {
        profile = {
          name: 'Main Warehouse Floor',
          type: 'internal_warehouse',
          access_slug: 'dock',
          pin_code: '123456',
          session_duration_hours: 0,
          cooldown_duration_hours: 0,
          is_active: true
        };
      } else if (cleanSlug === 'returns') {
        profile = {
          name: 'Customer Delivery Boxes',
          type: 'external_customer',
          access_slug: 'returns',
          pin_code: '654321',
          session_duration_hours: 2,
          cooldown_duration_hours: 6,
          is_active: true
        };
      }
    }

    if (!profile) {
      return sendJson(res, 404, {
        success: false,
        error: 'NOT_FOUND',
        message: 'QR Access Profile not found.'
      });
    }

    if (!profile.is_active) {
      return sendJson(res, 403, {
        success: false,
        error: 'INACTIVE',
        message: 'This QR Access Code has been deactivated by warehouse administration.'
      });
    }

    // Verify 6-digit PIN
    if (cleanPin !== String(profile.pin_code).trim()) {
      return sendJson(res, 401, {
        success: false,
        error: 'INVALID_PIN',
        message: 'Incorrect 6-digit PIN code. Please retry.'
      });
    }

    const now = new Date();
    const nowIso = now.toISOString();

    // 2. STEP B: Internal Warehouse profiles bypass customer cooldowns
    if (profile.type === 'internal_warehouse' || Number(profile.session_duration_hours) === 0) {
      const sessionToken = `gate_wh_${profile.access_slug}_${Date.now().toString(36)}_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 8)}`;
      return sendJson(res, 200, {
        success: true,
        profile: {
          id: profile.id,
          name: profile.name,
          type: profile.type,
          access_slug: profile.access_slug,
          session_duration_hours: 0,
          cooldown_duration_hours: 0
        },
        session: {
          token: sessionToken,
          slug: profile.access_slug,
          profileId: profile.id,
          profileName: profile.name,
          type: profile.type,
          durationHours: 0,
          unlockedAt: nowIso,
          expiresAt: null, // Permanent
          cooldownUntil: null,
          deviceFingerprint: cleanFingerprint
        }
      });
    }

    // 3. STEP C: External Customer Cooldown & Anti-Bypass Check
    // Query public.device_intake_sessions for this device or IP
    try {
      const { data: existingSessions, error: sessErr } = await supabase
        .from('device_intake_sessions')
        .select('*')
        .or(`device_fingerprint.eq.${cleanFingerprint},ip_address.eq.${clientIp}`)
        .eq('access_slug', cleanSlug)
        .order('cooldown_until', { ascending: false })
        .limit(5);

      if (!sessErr && Array.isArray(existingSessions) && existingSessions.length > 0) {
        for (const s of existingSessions) {
          const cooldownDate = new Date(s.cooldown_until);
          const expiresDate = new Date(s.session_expires_at);

          // CASE 1: Device is currently within an ACTIVE unlocked session window
          if (now < expiresDate) {
            return sendJson(res, 200, {
              success: true,
              existingActiveSession: true,
              profile: {
                id: profile.id,
                name: profile.name,
                type: profile.type,
                access_slug: profile.access_slug,
                session_duration_hours: profile.session_duration_hours,
                cooldown_duration_hours: profile.cooldown_duration_hours || 6
              },
              session: {
                token: `gate_cust_${profile.access_slug}_${new Date(s.session_started_at).getTime().toString(36)}`,
                slug: profile.access_slug,
                profileId: profile.id,
                profileName: profile.name,
                type: profile.type,
                durationHours: profile.session_duration_hours,
                unlockedAt: s.session_started_at,
                expiresAt: s.session_expires_at,
                cooldownUntil: s.cooldown_until,
                deviceFingerprint: cleanFingerprint
              }
            });
          }

          // CASE 2: Active session has expired, and device is strictly in COOLDOWN LOCKOUT
          if (now >= expiresDate && now < cooldownDate) {
            const diffMs = cooldownDate.getTime() - now.getTime();
            const cooldownRemainingMinutes = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(diffMs / (60 * 1000)));

            return sendJson(res, 429, {
              success: false,
              error: 'COOLDOWN_ACTIVE',
              message: 'Return Window Currently Locked: Your previous RMA session has concluded. To prevent duplicate submissions, this portal will unlock again once the cooldown concludes.',
              cooldownRemainingMinutes,
              unlocksAt: s.cooldown_until,
              sessionExpiresAt: s.session_expires_at,
              profileName: profile.name,
              cooldownDurationHours: profile.cooldown_duration_hours || 6
            });
          }
        }
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('device_intake_sessions lookup notice:', err);
    }

    // 4. STEP D: Create new session record
    const durationHours = Math.max(0.01, parseFloat(profile.session_duration_hours) || 2);
    const cooldownHours = Math.max(0, parseFloat(profile.cooldown_duration_hours !== undefined ? profile.cooldown_duration_hours : 6));

    const sessionExpiresAt = new Date(now.getTime() + (durationHours * 3600 * 1000));
    const cooldownUntil = new Date(sessionExpiresAt.getTime() + (cooldownHours * 3600 * 1000));
    const sessionToken = `gate_cust_${profile.access_slug}_${now.getTime().toString(36)}_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 8)}`;

    try {
      const isUuid = profile.id && /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i.test(profile.id);
      await supabase.from('device_intake_sessions').insert([{
        profile_id: isUuid ? profile.id : null,
        access_slug: profile.access_slug,
        device_fingerprint: cleanFingerprint,
        ip_address: clientIp,
        session_started_at: nowIso,
        session_expires_at: sessionExpiresAt.toISOString(),
        cooldown_until: cooldownUntil.toISOString(),
        status: 'active'
      }]);
    } catch (insertErr) {
      console.warn('device_intake_sessions insert notice:', insertErr);
    }

    return sendJson(res, 200, {
      success: true,
      profile: {
        id: profile.id,
        name: profile.name,
        type: profile.type,
        access_slug: profile.access_slug,
        session_duration_hours: durationHours,
        cooldown_duration_hours: cooldownHours
      },
      session: {
        token: sessionToken,
        slug: profile.access_slug,
        profileId: profile.id,
        profileName: profile.name,
        type: profile.type,
        durationHours,
        unlockedAt: nowIso,
        expiresAt: sessionExpiresAt.toISOString(),
        cooldownUntil: cooldownUntil.toISOString(),
        deviceFingerprint: cleanFingerprint
      }
    });

  } catch (err) {
    console.error('[Verify PIN Endpoint] Internal error:', err);
    return sendJson(res, 500, {
      success: false,
      error: 'SERVER_ERROR',
      message: err.message || 'An internal error occurred during PIN verification.'
    });
  }
}

/**
 * Admin Emergency Cooldown Reset
 * Clears all active device sessions and cooldown lockouts for a profile.
 */
export async function handleClearCooldown(req, res) {
  setCorsHeaders(res, req);

  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
    return res.status(204).end();
  }

  if (req.method !== 'POST') {
    return sendJson(res, 405, {
      success: false,
      error: 'METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED',
      message: 'Only POST method is permitted for emergency cooldown reset.'
    });
  }

  try {
    let body = req.body;
    if (typeof body === 'string') {
      try {
        body = JSON.parse(body);
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    const { slug, profileId } = body || {};

    if (!slug && !profileId) {
      return sendJson(res, 400, {
        success: false,
        error: 'BAD_REQUEST',
        message: 'Profile slug or ID is required.'
      });
    }

    let query = supabase.from('device_intake_sessions').delete();
    if (slug) {
      query = query.eq('access_slug', String(slug).trim().toLowerCase());
    } else if (profileId) {
      query = query.eq('profile_id', profileId);
    }

    const { error } = await query;
    if (error) {
      console.warn('Failed to clear device sessions:', error);
    }

    return sendJson(res, 200, {
      success: true,
      message: `Emergency reset successful: All device cooldown lockouts for "${slug || profileId}" have been cleared.`
    });
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('[Clear Cooldown Endpoint] Error:', err);
    return sendJson(res, 500, {
      success: false,
      error: 'SERVER_ERROR',
      message: err.message || 'Failed to clear cooldown lockouts.'
    });
  }
}

const DEFECT_REASONS = [
  '1- Damaged Box / Crushed Packaging',
  '2- Expired / Near Expiry Date',
  '3- Spoiled / Broken Seal / Leaking',
  '4- Wrong Item / Incorrect Shipment',
  '5- Customer Pull-out / Unsold',
  '6- Other Defect'
];

/**
 * Universal Lifecycle Stage Formatter & Color Resolver
 */
function formatLifecycleStage(status) {
  if (!status) return { label: '2- Received at Dock', color: 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-800 dark:bg-blue-950/70 dark:text-blue-300 border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-800' };
  const s = String(status).toLowerCase();
  switch (s) {
    case 'draft':
      return { label: '1- Draft / Intake', color: 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-300 border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700' };
    case 'pending':
    case 'received_at_dock':
      return { label: '2- Received at Dock', color: 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-800 dark:bg-blue-950/70 dark:text-blue-300 border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-800' };
    case 'under_inspection':
      return { label: '3- Under Inspection', color: 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 dark:bg-amber-950/70 dark:text-amber-300 border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-800' };
    case 'pending_finance_approval':
      return { label: '4- Pending Finance Approval', color: 'bg-purple-100 text-purple-800 dark:bg-purple-950/70 dark:text-purple-300 border-purple-200 dark:border-purple-800' };
    case 'credit_memo_issued':
      return { label: '5- Credit Memo Issued', color: 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 dark:bg-emerald-950/70 dark:text-emerald-300 border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-800' };
    case 'closed':
    case 'restocked':
      return { label: '6- Closed / Restocked', color: 'bg-teal-100 text-teal-800 dark:bg-teal-950/70 dark:text-teal-300 border-teal-200 dark:border-teal-800' };
    case 'rejected':
      return { label: '7- Rejected / Invalid Claim', color: 'bg-rose-100 text-rose-800 dark:bg-rose-950/70 dark:text-rose-300 border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-800' };
    case 'pending_admin_details':
      return { label: 'Awaiting SKU', color: 'bg-orange-100 text-orange-800 dark:bg-orange-950/70 dark:text-orange-300 border-orange-200 dark:border-orange-800' };
    default:
      return { label: s.replace(/_/g, ' '), color: 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-300 border-slate-300' };
  }
}


/**
 * Resolves the QR Intake slug from pathname, hash, or query parameters.
 * Examples:
 * - /intake/dock -> "dock"
 * - /intake/returns -> "returns"
 * - #/intake/dock -> "dock"
 * - /?intake=dock -> "dock"
 * - /?slug=dock -> "dock"
 */
function getIntakeSlugFromUrl() {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return null;
  const path = window.location.pathname.toLowerCase();
  const hash = window.location.hash.toLowerCase();

  const pathMatch = path.match(/^\/intake\/([^/?#]+)/i);
  if (pathMatch && pathMatch[1]) return decodeURIComponent(pathMatch[1]);

  const hashMatch = hash.match(/^#\/intake\/([^/?#]+)/i);
  if (hashMatch && hashMatch[1]) return decodeURIComponent(hashMatch[1]);

  try {
    const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    const paramSlug = params.get('intake') || params.get('slug');
    if (paramSlug) return decodeURIComponent(paramSlug);
  } catch { }

  return null;
}

export default function App() {
  // ROUTE DETECTION: '/' (Public Reporter) vs '/admin' (Staff Admin Portal)
  const [isAdminView, setIsAdminView] = useState(() => {
    const path = window.location.pathname.toLowerCase();
    const hash = window.location.hash.toLowerCase();
    return path === '/admin' || path.startsWith('/admin/') || hash === '#/admin' || window.location.search.includes('admin=true');
  });

  // Authenticated Admin User (Strictly from verified authService session)
  const [currentUser, setCurrentUser] = useState(() => {
    return authService.getCurrentUser();
  });
  const [isLoginModalOpen, setIsLoginModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isEmployeeModalOpen, setIsEmployeeModalOpen] = useState(false);

  // Admin Dashboard Active Tab: 'products' | 'reports' | 'search'
  const [adminActiveTab, setAdminActiveTab] = useState('products');

  // Strict role gate: Only Super Admin can view Settings & SMTP
  useEffect(() => {
    if (adminActiveTab === 'settings' && currentUser?.role !== 'super_admin') {
      setAdminActiveTab('products');
    }
  }, [adminActiveTab, currentUser]);

  // Saved Products State
  const [savedProductsList, setSavedProductsList] = useState([]);
  const [isSavedProductsLoading, setIsSavedProductsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [isProductEditOpen, setIsProductEditOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editingProduct, setEditingProduct] = useState(null);
  const [staffList, setStaffList] = useState([]);

  // Credit Memos State
  const [creditMemosList, setCreditMemosList] = useState([]);
  const [isCreditMemoModalOpen, setIsCreditMemoModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [selectedCreditMemoReport, setSelectedCreditMemoReport] = useState(null);
  const [editingCreditMemo, setEditingCreditMemo] = useState(null);
  const [voucherModalMemo, setVoucherModalMemo] = useState(null);
  const [voucherModalMemos, setVoucherModalMemos] = useState([]);
  const [isVoucherModalOpen, setIsVoucherModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [qrModalReport, setQrModalReport] = useState(null);

  // Quick RMA Action Modal State (triggered by Box QR scan or ?rma= URL parameter)
  const [isQuickRmaModalOpen, setIsQuickRmaModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [quickRmaNumber, setQuickRmaNumber] = useState(null);
  const [pendingQuickRmaNumber, setPendingQuickRmaNumber] = useState(null);
  const [isPortalAccessQrOpen, setIsPortalAccessQrOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isAccessKeysModalOpen, setIsAccessKeysModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isPinRequestsModalOpen, setIsPinRequestsModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [pendingPinRequestsCount, setPendingPinRequestsCount] = useState(0);

  // Role-Based QR Code & 6-Digit PIN Gatekeeper Engine
  const [intakeSlug, setIntakeSlug] = useState(() => getIntakeSlugFromUrl());
  const [gateSession, setGateSession] = useState(() => {
    const slug = getIntakeSlugFromUrl();
    return accessKeyService.getActiveSession(slug);
  });

  // Active Real-Time Watchdog for Gatekeeper Session Expiration (Unbypassable live enforcement)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!gateSession?.expiresAt) return;

    const checkExpiration = () => {
      const expTime = new Date(gateSession.expiresAt).getTime();
      const now = Date.now();
      if (now >= expTime) {
        // Session reached expiration!
        const slug = gateSession.slug;
        accessKeyService.clearSession(slug);
        setGateSession(null);
        setIntakeSlug(slug);
        showToast('Your return session has expired. Device locked.', 'warning');
      }
    };

    checkExpiration();
    const interval = setInterval(checkExpiration, 1000);
    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [gateSession]);

  const handleLockStation = () => {
    const slug = gateSession?.slug || intakeSlug || 'dock';
    accessKeyService.clearSession(slug);
    setGateSession(null);
    setIntakeSlug(slug);
    showToast('Device locked. Enter 6-digit PIN to unlock station.', 'info');
  };

  const restoreQuickRmaIfPending = () => {
    if (pendingQuickRmaNumber) {
      setQuickRmaNumber(pendingQuickRmaNumber);
      setIsQuickRmaModalOpen(true);
      setPendingQuickRmaNumber(null);
    }
  };

  const parseRmaFromScan = (rawText) => {
    if (!rawText) return null;
    const str = String(rawText).trim();
    if (str.includes('rma=')) {
      try {
        const url = new URL(str.startsWith('http') ? str : `https://example.com/${str.replace(/^\/?/, '')}`);
        const val = url.searchParams.get('rma') || url.searchParams.get('rma_number');
        if (val) return val;
      } catch { }
    }
    if (str.startsWith('{') && str.endsWith('}')) {
      try {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(str);
        if (parsed.rma) return parsed.rma;
      } catch { }
    }
    if (/^RMA-\d{4}-\d+-[A-Z0-9]+/i.test(str) || /^RMA-/i.test(str)) {
      return str;
    }
    return null;
  };

  const handleCloseQuickRma = () => {
    setIsQuickRmaModalOpen(false);
    setQuickRmaNumber(null);
    setPendingQuickRmaNumber(null);
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      const url = new URL(window.location.href);
      if (url.searchParams.has('rma') || url.searchParams.has('rma_number')) {
        url.searchParams.delete('rma');
        url.searchParams.delete('rma_number');
        window.history.replaceState({}, '', url.pathname + (url.search ? url.search : ''));
      }
    }
  };

  // Listen to browser navigation & check ?rma= query parameter
  useEffect(() => {
    const checkRmaParam = () => {
      const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
      const rmaParam = params.get('rma') || params.get('rma_number');
      if (rmaParam) {
        setQuickRmaNumber(rmaParam);
        setIsQuickRmaModalOpen(true);
      }
    };

    const handleLocationChange = () => {
      const path = window.location.pathname.toLowerCase();
      const hash = window.location.hash.toLowerCase();
      const onAdmin = path === '/admin' || path.startsWith('/admin/') || hash === '#/admin' || window.location.search.includes('admin=true');
      setIsAdminView(onAdmin);

      const newSlug = getIntakeSlugFromUrl();
      setIntakeSlug(newSlug);
      setGateSession(accessKeyService.getActiveSession(newSlug));

      // If entering /admin without an active session, open login gate
      if (onAdmin && !authService.getCurrentUser()) {
        setIsLoginModalOpen(true);
      }

      checkRmaParam();
    };

    checkRmaParam();

    window.addEventListener('popstate', handleLocationChange);
    window.addEventListener('hashchange', handleLocationChange);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('popstate', handleLocationChange);
      window.removeEventListener('hashchange', handleLocationChange);
    };
  }, []);

  // When visiting /admin initially, trigger login if not authenticated
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isAdminView && !currentUser) {
      setIsLoginModalOpen(true);
    }
  }, [isAdminView, currentUser]);

  // Handle Supabase Auth magic link redirect or session
  useEffect(() => {
    const checkSession = async () => {
      try {
        const hasAuthHash = window.location.hash.includes('access_token') ||
          window.location.hash.includes('type=recovery') ||
          window.location.search.includes('code=');

        const localUser = authService.getCurrentUser();

        // If user is not logged in locally and not clicking a magic link in URL, ensure Supabase local session is cleared
        if (!localUser && !hasAuthHash) {
          await supabase.auth.signOut({ scope: 'local' }).catch(() => { });
          return;
        }

        const { data: { session } } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
        if (session?.user?.email && (localUser || hasAuthHash)) {
          const email = session.user.email.toLowerCase().trim();
          const employees = await authService.getEmployees();
          const emp = employees.find(e => e.email.toLowerCase() === email) || {
            name: email.split('@')[0],
            email: email,
            role: email === 'finance2@keysysincorporated.com' ? 'super_admin' : 'inventory_staff',
            is_active: true
          };

          if (emp.is_active === false) {
            await authService.logout();
            setCurrentUser(null);
            return;
          }

          const sessionUser = {
            id: emp.id || 1,
            name: emp.name,
            email: emp.email,
            role: emp.role || (email === 'finance2@keysysincorporated.com' ? 'super_admin' : 'inventory_staff'),
            department: emp.department || 'General',
            loggedInAt: new Date().toISOString()
          };

          localStorage.setItem('rma_portal_admin_session', JSON.stringify(sessionUser));
          setCurrentUser(sessionUser);
          setIsLoginModalOpen(false);

          if (window.location.hash.includes('access_token')) {
            window.history.replaceState(null, '', window.location.pathname);
          }
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn('Supabase session check notice:', err);
      }
    };
    checkSession();

    // Listen for cross-tab logout events
    const unsubscribeAuth = authService.onAuthChange((event) => {
      if (event?.type === 'LOGOUT') {
        setCurrentUser(null);
        setIsAdminView(false);
        setIsLoginModalOpen(false);
        setIsQuickRmaModalOpen(false);
        setQuickRmaNumber(null);
        if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
          window.history.replaceState({}, '', '/');
        }
      }
    });

    return () => {
      unsubscribeAuth();
    };
  }, []);

  const navigateTo = (path) => {
    window.history.pushState({}, '', path);
    const onAdmin = path === '/admin' || path === '#/admin';
    setIsAdminView(onAdmin);
    setSelectedReportIds(new Set());
    const nextSlug = getIntakeSlugFromUrl();
    setIntakeSlug(nextSlug);
    setGateSession(accessKeyService.getActiveSession(nextSlug));
    if (onAdmin && !currentUser) {
      setIsLoginModalOpen(true);
    }
    window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
  };

  const handleLogout = async () => {
    try {
      await authService.logout();
    } catch (e) { }
    setCurrentUser(null);
    setIsAdminView(false);
    setIsLoginModalOpen(false);
    setIsQuickRmaModalOpen(false);
    setQuickRmaNumber(null);
    sessionStorage.removeItem('rma_login_pending_email');
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      window.history.replaceState({}, '', '/');
    }
    showToast('Logged out of admin dashboard.', 'success');
  };

  // Dark / Light Theme State (Persisted in localStorage)
  const [isDarkMode, setIsDarkMode] = useState(() => {
    try {
      const saved = localStorage.getItem('rma_theme');
      if (saved) return saved === 'dark';
      return window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches;
    } catch (e) {
      return false;
    }
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      if (isDarkMode) {
        document.documentElement.classList.add('dark');
        localStorage.setItem('rma_theme', 'dark');
      } else {
        document.documentElement.classList.remove('dark');
        localStorage.setItem('rma_theme', 'light');
      }
    } catch (e) { }
  }, [isDarkMode]);

  const toggleTheme = () => setIsDarkMode(prev => !prev);

  // Test Mode State: Exclusively permitted for Super Admin. For all other roles it is ALWAYS false.
  const [isTestMode, setIsTestMode] = useState(() => {
    try {
      const fromAuth = authService.getCurrentUser();
      if (fromAuth?.role !== 'super_admin') return false;
      return localStorage.getItem('rma_portal_test_mode') === 'true';
    } catch (e) {
      return false;
    }
  });

  // Strict Role Enforcement: Only Super Admin can have Test Mode enabled.
  // For all other roles (inventory staff, warehouse, admin, viewer, public), Test Mode is ALWAYS FALSE.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (currentUser?.role !== 'super_admin') {
      if (isTestMode) {
        setIsTestMode(false);
      }
      try {
        localStorage.setItem('rma_portal_test_mode', 'false');
      } catch (e) { }
    }
  }, [currentUser, isTestMode]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleSyncTestMode = () => {
      try {
        if (currentUser?.role === 'super_admin') {
          setIsTestMode(localStorage.getItem('rma_portal_test_mode') === 'true');
        } else {
          setIsTestMode(false);
        }
      } catch (e) { }
    };
    window.addEventListener('storage', handleSyncTestMode);
    window.addEventListener('rma-data-changed', handleSyncTestMode);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('storage', handleSyncTestMode);
      window.removeEventListener('rma-data-changed', handleSyncTestMode);
    };
  }, [currentUser]);

  const toggleTestMode = () => {
    if (currentUser?.role !== 'super_admin') {
      showToast('Simulation / Test Mode is strictly restricted to Super Admin.', 'error');
      setIsTestMode(false);
      try {
        localStorage.setItem('rma_portal_test_mode', 'false');
      } catch (e) { }
      return;
    }

    setIsTestMode(prev => {
      const next = !prev;
      try {
        localStorage.setItem('rma_portal_test_mode', String(next));
        window.dispatchEvent(new Event('storage'));
        window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('rma-data-changed', { detail: { type: 'test-mode-toggled', isTestMode: next } }));
      } catch (e) { }
      if (next) {
        showToast('🧪 Test Mode Enabled: Emails safely sent exclusively to finance2@keysysincorporated.com', 'success');
      } else {
        showToast('Live Mode Enabled: Real email delivery active.', 'success');
      }
      return next;
    });
  };

  // Facebook-Style Notifications System
  const [notifications, setNotifications] = useState(() => {
    try {
      const saved = localStorage.getItem('rma_portal_notifications_v2');
      if (saved) return JSON.parse(saved);
    } catch (e) { }
    return [
      {
        id: 'seed-notif-1',
        type: 'rma',
        title: 'Wholesale RMA Portal Active',
        message: 'Notification center ready. Intake events and return submissions will alert here.',
        subtext: 'System Notification',
        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
        read: false
      }
    ];
  });

  // Persist notifications to localStorage
  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem('rma_portal_notifications_v2', JSON.stringify(notifications.slice(0, 60)));
    } catch (e) { }
  }, [notifications]);

  const addNotification = (notif) => {
    setNotifications(prev => [
      {
        id: `notif-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 5)}`,
        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
        read: false,
        ...notif
      },
      ...prev
    ]);
  };

  const handleMarkAsRead = (id) => {
    setNotifications(prev => prev.map(n => n.id === id ? { ...n, read: true } : n));
  };

  const handleMarkAllAsRead = () => {
    setNotifications(prev => prev.map(n => ({ ...n, read: true })));
    showToast('All notifications marked as read.', 'success');
  };

  const handleClearAllNotifications = () => {
    setNotifications([]);
    showToast('All notifications cleared.', 'success');
  };

  const notifiedPinRequestIds = useRef(new Set());

  const handleSelectNotification = (notif) => {
    if (notif.type === 'pin_request') {
      setIsPinRequestsModalOpen(true);
      handleMarkAsRead(notif.id);
      return;
    }
    if (notif.type === 'rma') {
      if (isAdminView) {
        setAdminActiveTab('reports');
      } else {
        setIsReportsModalOpen(true);
      }
    } else if (notif.type === 'unknown') {
      setIsPendingModalOpen(true);
    } else if (notif.type === 'product' || notif.type === 'delete') {
      if (isAdminView) {
        setAdminActiveTab('products');
      }
    }
  };

  // Real-time synchronization for PIN requests & Notification Bell alerts
  useEffect(() => {
    let isMounted = true;

    // Load initial count and initialize known request IDs
    pinRequestService.getRequests().then(reqs => {
      if (!isMounted) return;
      reqs.forEach(r => notifiedPinRequestIds.current.add(r.id));
      setPendingPinRequestsCount(reqs.filter(r => r.status === 'pending').length);
    }).catch(() => {});

    const refreshRequests = async () => {
      try {
        const reqs = await pinRequestService.getRequests();
        if (!isMounted) return;
        const pendingCount = reqs.filter(r => r.status === 'pending').length;
        setPendingPinRequestsCount(pendingCount);

        // Check for any new pending requests not yet in notification bell
        reqs.forEach(r => {
          if (r.status === 'pending' && !notifiedPinRequestIds.current.has(r.id)) {
            notifiedPinRequestIds.current.add(r.id);
            addNotification({
              id: `pin-req-${r.id}`,
              type: 'pin_request',
              title: `New PIN Request: ${r.requester_name}`,
              message: `${r.organization_name ? r.organization_name + ' • ' : ''}Requested authorization PIN for /${r.access_slug}`,
              subtext: r.notes ? `Note: ${r.notes}` : 'Return Authorization Request',
              timestamp: r.created_at || new Date().toISOString(),
              read: false,
              requestId: r.id
            });
            if (isAdminView) {
              showToast(`New PIN request: ${r.requester_name} (/${r.access_slug})`, 'info');
            }
          }
        });
      } catch (e) {}
    };

    // 1. Supabase Postgres Realtime Subscription on public.pin_requests
    let pinChannel = null;
    try {
      pinChannel = supabase
        .channel('public:pin_requests_realtime')
        .on('postgres_changes', { event: '*', schema: 'public', table: 'pin_requests' }, () => {
          refreshRequests();
        })
        .subscribe();
    } catch (e) {}

    // 2. BroadcastChannel for cross-tab instant sync
    let bc = null;
    try {
      if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.BroadcastChannel) {
        bc = new BroadcastChannel('rma_portal_sync_bus');
        bc.onmessage = (evt) => {
          if (evt.data?.type === 'pin-requests-changed' || evt.data?.type === 'pin-request-created') {
            refreshRequests();
          }
        };
      }
    } catch (e) {}

    // 3. Local window event listener
    const handleLocalEvent = () => refreshRequests();
    window.addEventListener('rma-pin-requests-changed', handleLocalEvent);

    // 4. Polling watchdog (every 6 seconds for guaranteed freshness)
    const pollTimer = setInterval(refreshRequests, 6000);

    return () => {
      isMounted = false;
      if (pinChannel) supabase.removeChannel(pinChannel);
      if (bc) bc.close();
      window.removeEventListener('rma-pin-requests-changed', handleLocalEvent);
      clearInterval(pollTimer);
    };
  }, [isAdminView]);

  // Role Permissions
  const canManageRoles = currentUser?.role === 'super_admin';
  const canEditProducts = currentUser?.role === 'super_admin' || currentUser?.role === 'admin';
  const canDeleteProducts = currentUser?.role === 'super_admin' || currentUser?.role === 'admin';
  const canDeleteReports = currentUser?.role === 'super_admin' || currentUser?.role === 'admin';
  const canVerifyBarcodes = currentUser?.role !== 'viewer';

  // Dedicated Confirmation Modal State for Deletions
  const [deleteModalState, setDeleteModalState] = useState(null); // { type, item, id, rmaNumber, title, itemName, itemDetails, itemType }
  const [isDeleteModalLoading, setIsDeleteModalLoading] = useState(false);

  const requestDeleteProduct = (prod) => {
    if (!canDeleteProducts) {
      showToast('You do not have permission to delete catalog products.', 'error');
      return;
    }
    const name = prod?.name || `Barcode ${prod?.barcode || ''}`;
    setDeleteModalState({
      type: 'product',
      item: prod,
      title: 'Delete Product from Catalog?',
      itemName: name,
      itemType: 'product',
      itemDetails: `Barcode: ${prod?.barcode || 'N/A'}${prod?.code ? ` • SKU: ${prod.code}` : ''}`
    });
  };

  const requestDeleteReport = (id, rmaNumber, item) => {
    if (!canDeleteReports) {
      showToast('You do not have permission to delete RMA reports.', 'error');
      return;
    }
    const resolvedItem = item || recentReportsList.find(r => (id && r.id === id) || (rmaNumber && r.rma_number === rmaNumber));
    setDeleteModalState({
      type: 'report',
      id,
      rmaNumber,
      item: resolvedItem,
      title: 'Delete RMA Return Report?',
      itemName: `RMA #${rmaNumber}`,
      itemType: 'report',
      itemDetails: `ID: ${id || 'N/A'} • Return Ticket`
    });
  };

  const requestBulkDeleteProducts = (productsList) => {
    if (!canDeleteProducts) {
      showToast('You do not have permission to delete catalog products.', 'error');
      return;
    }
    if (!productsList || productsList.length === 0) return;

    setDeleteModalState({
      type: 'bulk_products',
      items: productsList,
      title: `Delete ${productsList.length} Selected Products?`,
      itemName: `${productsList.length} Products will be permanently removed from catalog`,
      itemType: 'products',
      itemDetails: productsList.slice(0, 3).map(p => p.name || p.barcode).join(', ') + (productsList.length > 3 ? '...' : '')
    });
  };

  const requestBulkDeleteReports = (reportsList) => {
    if (!canDeleteReports) {
      showToast('You do not have permission to delete RMA reports.', 'error');
      return;
    }
    if (!reportsList || reportsList.length === 0) return;

    setDeleteModalState({
      type: 'bulk_reports',
      items: reportsList,
      title: `Delete ${reportsList.length} Selected Return Reports?`,
      itemName: `${reportsList.length} Return reports will be permanently removed`,
      itemType: 'reports',
      itemDetails: reportsList.slice(0, 3).map(r => r.rma_number || `#${r.id}`).join(', ') + (reportsList.length > 3 ? '...' : '')
    });
  };

  // Credit Memo Handlers
  const handleOpenCreditMemoForReport = (report) => {
    setSelectedCreditMemoReport(report);
    setEditingCreditMemo(null);
    setIsCreditMemoModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleOpenCreateCreditMemo = () => {
    setSelectedCreditMemoReport(null);
    setEditingCreditMemo(null);
    setIsCreditMemoModalOpen(true);

    setSelectedCreditMemoReport(null);
    setEditingCreditMemo(memo);
    setIsCreditMemoModalOpen(true);

  // Edit item from Return Reports to save into Products catalog
  const handleEditProductFromReport = (report) => {
    if (!report) return;
    const existing = savedProductsList.find(p => p.barcode && String(p.barcode) === String(report.barcode));
    if (existing && existing.is_verified) {
      setEditingProduct(existing);
    } else {
      const cleanName = report.name && !report.name.toLowerCase().includes('unidentified')
        ? report.name
        : '';

      // Unassigned barcode: MUST start with NO default product image (empty placeholder state)
      // Never preload damage / defect report photos as product catalog images!
      setEditingProduct({
        name: cleanName,
        barcode: report.barcode || '',
        code: report.code || report.sku || (existing?.code || ''),
        supplier_name: report.supplier_name || existing?.supplier_name || 'Savemore',
        price: report.price || existing?.price || 0,
        price_with_vat: report.price_with_vat || existing?.price_with_vat || report.price || 0,
        unit_name: report.unit_name || existing?.unit_name || 'pc',
        image_url: '', // Strictly empty state / placeholder
        ae_name: report.ae_name || existing?.ae_name || '',
        ae_email: report.ae_email || existing?.ae_email || '',
        company: 'Wholesale Distribution',
        is_verified: false
      });

  const handleViewCreditMemoVoucher = (memoOrMemos) => {

      setVoucherModalMemos(memoOrMemos);
      setVoucherModalMemo(memoOrMemos[0] || null);

      setVoucherModalMemos(memoOrMemos ? [memoOrMemos] : []);

  const requestDeleteCreditMemo = (memo) => {
    if (!canDeleteReports) {
      showToast('You do not have permission to void credit memos.', 'error');

      itemType: 'credit memo',

    });

  const requestBulkDeleteCreditMemos = (memos) => {
    if (!canDeleteReports) {
      showToast('You do not have permission to void credit memos.', 'error');
      return;
    }
    if (!memos || memos.length === 0) return;

    setDeleteModalState({
      type: 'bulk_credit_memos',
      items: memos,
      title: `Void & Delete ${memos.length} Selected Credit Memos?`,
      itemName: `${memos.length} Credit Memos will be permanently voided from database`,
      itemType: 'credit memos',
      itemDetails: memos.slice(0, 3).map(m => m.credit_memo_number).join(', ') + (memos.length > 3 ? '...' : '')
    });
  };

  const handleConfirmDelete = async () => {
    if (!deleteModalState) return;
    setIsDeleteModalLoading(true);
    try {
      if (deleteModalState.type === 'product') {
        const prod = deleteModalState.item;
        const id = prod?.id;
        const barcode = prod?.barcode;
        await catalogService.deleteProduct(prod);
        setSavedProductsList(prev => prev.filter(p => {
          if (id && p.id === id) return false;
          if (barcode && p.barcode === barcode) return false;
          return true;
        }));
        showToast(`Deleted "${deleteModalState.itemName}" from database.`, 'success');
        refreshAllData();
      } else if (deleteModalState.type === 'report') {
        const { id, rmaNumber, item } = deleteModalState;
        await catalogService.deleteReport(id, rmaNumber, item);
        setSelectedReportIds(prev => {
          const next = new Set(prev);
          if (id) next.delete(id);
          if (rmaNumber) next.delete(rmaNumber);
          return next;
        });
        setRecentReportsList(prev => prev.filter(r => (id ? r.id !== id : r.rma_number !== rmaNumber)));
        showToast(`Deleted return report RMA #${rmaNumber}.`, 'success');
        refreshAllData();
      } else if (deleteModalState.type === 'bulk_products') {
        const items = deleteModalState.items || [];
        await catalogService.deleteMultipleProducts(items);
        const deletedIds = new Set(items.map(p => p.id));
        const deletedBarcodes = new Set(items.map(p => p.barcode));
