                                      )}
                                      {item.expiry_date && (
                                        <span className="text-[10px] font-medium text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/60 px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded border border-rose-200/80 dark:border-rose-800">
                                          Exp: {item.expiry_date}
                                        </span>
                                      )}
                                    </div>
                                  )}
                                </td>

                                {/* 6. Reason */}
                                <td className="py-3 px-3.5">
                                  <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/60 text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300 border border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-800 font-bold text-[10px] inline-block">
                                    {item.reason || 'Damaged'}
                                  </span>
                                </td>

                                {/* 7. Reported By */}
                                <td className="py-3 px-3.5">
                                  <div className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-200 text-[11px]">
                                    {item.reporter_name || item.reported_by || 'Reporter'}
                                  </div>
                                  {item.reporter_contact && (
                                    <div className="font-mono text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 text-[10px]">
                                      {item.reporter_contact}
                                    </div>
                                  )}
                                  {item.store_branch && (
                                    <div className="text-[10px] text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 font-semibold flex items-center gap-0.5 mt-0.5 max-w-[150px] truncate" title={item.store_branch}>
                                      📍 {item.store_branch}
                                    </div>
                                  )}
                                  {item.invoice_dr_number && (
                                    <div className="text-[10px] font-mono text-violet-600 dark:text-violet-400 font-bold">
                                      DR: {item.invoice_dr_number}
                                    </div>
                                  )}
                                </td>

                                {/* 8. Catalog Status */}
                                <td className="py-3 px-3 text-center whitespace-nowrap">
                                  <span className={`px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[9px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider inline-block ${isPendingUnknown
                                      ? 'bg-amber-100 dark:bg-amber-950/60 text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-300 border border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-800'
                                      : 'bg-emerald-100 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-800'
                                    }`}>
                                    {isPendingUnknown ? 'Pending SKU' : 'Logged'}
                                  </span>
                                </td>

                                {/* 9. Lifecycle Stage */}
                                <td className="py-3 px-3 text-center whitespace-nowrap">
                                  {(() => {
                                    const stageInfo = formatLifecycleStage(item.status);
                                    return (
                                      <span className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold border uppercase tracking-wider inline-block shadow-2xs ${stageInfo.color}`}>
                                        {stageInfo.label}
                                      </span>
                                    );
                                  })()}
                                </td>

                                {/* 10. Disposition (Full text without truncation) */}
                                <td className="py-3 px-3.5 text-center whitespace-nowrap">
                                  {(() => {
                                    const disp = item.disposition || 'Pending Triage';
                                    let color = 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 border-slate-300 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700';
                                    if (disp === 'Restock to Inventory') color = 'bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 border-blue-200 dark:bg-blue-950/70 dark:text-blue-300 dark:border-blue-800';
                                    else if (disp === 'Return to Vendor (RTV)') color = 'bg-purple-50 text-purple-700 border-purple-200 dark:bg-purple-950/70 dark:text-purple-300 dark:border-purple-800';
                                    else if (disp === 'Quarantine') color = 'bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 border-amber-200 dark:bg-amber-950/70 dark:text-amber-300 dark:border-amber-800';
                                    else if (disp === 'Scrap / Dispose') color = 'bg-rose-50 text-rose-700 border-rose-200 dark:bg-rose-950/70 dark:text-rose-300 dark:border-rose-800';
                                    return (
                                      <span className={`px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-extrabold border inline-block whitespace-nowrap shadow-2xs ${color}`}>
                                        {disp}
                                      </span>
                                    );
                                  })()}
                                </td>

                                {/* 11. Warehouse Rack/Bin Location */}
                                <td className="py-3 px-3.5 text-center font-mono whitespace-nowrap">
                                  {item.warehouse_location ? (
                                    <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 text-[11px] font-extrabold inline-block shadow-2xs">
                                      {item.warehouse_location}
                                    </span>
                                  ) : (
                                    <span className="text-slate-300 dark:text-slate-600 text-xs font-bold">—</span>
                                  )}
                                </td>

                                {/* 9. Date & GPS */}
                                <td className="py-3 px-3.5 text-right font-mono text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                                  <div>{new Date(item.created_at).toLocaleDateString()}</div>
                                  {item.gps_latitude && item.gps_longitude ? (
                                    <a
                                      href={`https://www.google.com/maps?q=${item.gps_latitude},${item.gps_longitude}`}
                                      target="_blank"
                                      rel="noreferrer"
                                      className="text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 hover:underline inline-flex items-center gap-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold"
                                    >
                                      <MapPin className="w-3 h-3 text-rose-500" />
                                      <span>Map</span>
                                    </a>
                                  ) : (
                                    <span className="text-slate-300 dark:text-slate-600 text-[10px]">No GPS</span>
                                  )}
                                </td>

                                {/* 10. Actions: Assign SKU / Save Product, Credit Memo, Thermal Print & Delete */}
                                <td className="py-2.5 px-3.5 text-center">
                                  <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5">
                                    {/* Print 4x6 Thermal Box Label */}
                                    <button
                                      type="button"
                                      onClick={() => setThermalPrintReport(item)}
                                      className="p-1.5 text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-900 dark:hover:text-white hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                                      title="Print 4x6 inch Thermal Box Label"
                                    >
                                      <Printer className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300" />
                                    </button>

                                    {/* Inspect & Triage Physical Return */}
                                    <button
                                      type="button"
                                      onClick={() => {
                                        setQuickRmaNumber(item.rma_number);
                                        setIsQuickRmaModalOpen(true);
                                      }}
                                      className="px-2 py-1 bg-amber-50 hover:bg-amber-100 dark:bg-amber-950/70 dark:hover:bg-amber-900/70 text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-300 border border-amber-300 dark:border-amber-700 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-bold flex items-center gap-1 transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-2xs"
                                      title={`Inspect, triage condition grade, and assign rack/bin location for ${item.rma_number}`}
                                    >
                                      <ClipboardCheck className="w-3 h-3 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400" />
                                      <span>Inspect / Triage</span>
                                    </button>

                                    {canEditProducts && !savedProductsList.some(p => p.barcode && String(p.barcode) === String(item.barcode)) && (
                                      <button
                                        type="button"
                                        onClick={() => handleEditProductFromReport(item)}
                                        className="px-2.5 py-1 bg-blue-50 hover:bg-blue-100 dark:bg-blue-950/70 dark:hover:bg-blue-900/70 text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-300 border border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-800 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-bold flex items-center gap-1 transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-2xs"
                                        title={`Assign official SKU and save "${item.name || item.barcode}" to Products catalog`}
                                      >
                                        <Package className="w-3 h-3 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400" />
                                        <span>Assign SKU</span>
                                      </button>
                                    )}

                                    {(() => {
                                      const existingMemo = creditMemosList.find(m => m.rma_number === item.rma_number || m.report_id === item.id);
                                      if (existingMemo) {
                                        return (
                                          <button
                                            type="button"
                                            onClick={() => handleViewCreditMemoVoucher(existingMemo)}
                                            className="px-2.5 py-1 bg-emerald-100 hover:bg-emerald-200 dark:bg-emerald-950/70 dark:hover:bg-emerald-900/70 text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-700 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-black flex items-center gap-1 transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-2xs"
                                            title={`View Official Credit Memo Voucher: ${existingMemo.credit_memo_number}`}
                                          >
                                            <Receipt className="w-3 h-3 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400" />
                                            <span>CM Voucher</span>
                                          </button>
                                        );
                                      }
                                      if (canEditProducts) {
                                        return (
                                          <button
                                            type="button"
                                            onClick={() => handleOpenCreditMemoForReport(item)}
                                            className="px-2.5 py-1 bg-slate-100 hover:bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-emerald-950/50 text-slate-700 hover:text-emerald-700 dark:text-slate-300 dark:hover:text-emerald-300 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 hover:border-emerald-400 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-bold flex items-center gap-1 transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-2xs"
                                            title="Issue Finance Credit Memo for this Return"
                                          >
                                            <Receipt className="w-3 h-3 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400" />
                                            <span>+ Credit Memo</span>
                                          </button>
                                        );
                                      }
                                      return null;
                                    })()}

                                    {canDeleteReports && (
                                      <button
                                        type="button"
                                        onClick={() => requestDeleteReport(item.id, item.rma_number, item)}
                                        className="p-1.5 text-rose-500 hover:text-rose-700 hover:bg-rose-50 dark:hover:bg-rose-950/50 rounded-xl transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                                        title={`Delete RMA #${item.rma_number}`}
                                      >
                                        <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                                      </button>
                                    )}
                                  </div>
                                </td>
                              </tr>
                            );
                          })}
                        </tbody>
                      </table>
                    </div>

                    {/* Floating Bulk Action Bar for Return Reports Table */}
                    {selectedReportIds.size > 0 && (
                      <div className="p-3 sm:px-4 bg-slate-900/95 dark:bg-slate-950/95 text-white border-t border-slate-700 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 animate-in fade-in">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                          <span className="w-6 h-6 rounded-full bg-blue-600 text-white flex items-center justify-center text-xs font-black">
                            {selectedReportIds.size}
                          </span>
                          <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-200">
                            {selectedReportIds.size} report{selectedReportIds.size > 1 ? 's' : ''} selected
                          </span>
                          {selectedReportIds.size < processedReports.length && (
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={selectAllFilteredReports}
                              className="text-xs text-blue-300 hover:text-white underline font-semibold ml-1 cursor-pointer"
                            >
                              Select all {processedReports.length} filtered
                            </button>
                          )}
                        </div>

                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={clearReportsSelection}
                            className="px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-slate-300 hover:text-white hover:bg-slate-800 rounded-xl transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                          >
                            Deselect
                          </button>
                          {canDeleteReports && (
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => requestBulkDeleteReports(selectedReportsList)}
                              className="px-4 py-1.5 bg-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-700 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-black flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-sm transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                            >
                              <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                              <span>Delete Selected ({selectedReportIds.size})</span>
                            </button>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    )}

                    <TablePagination
                      currentPage={reportsCurrentPage}
                      pageSize={reportsPageSize}
                      totalItems={processedReports.length}
                      onPageChange={setReportsCurrentPage}
                      onPageSizeChange={(newSize) => {
                        setReportsPageSize(newSize);
                        setReportsCurrentPage(1);
                      }}
                    />
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  /* ============================================================ */
                  /* GRID / CARDS VIEW (With SN badge and clickable photos)       */
                  /* ============================================================ */
                  <div className="space-y-4">
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                      {paginatedReports.map((item, index) => {
                        const photoList = Array.isArray(item.photos)
                          ? item.photos
                          : (typeof item.photos === 'string' ? JSON.parse(item.photos || '[]') : []);
                        const isSelected = selectedReportIds.has(item.id || item.rma_number);
                        const matchedProduct = savedProductsList.find(p => p.barcode && String(p.barcode) === String(item.barcode));
                        const resolvedName = (item.name && !item.name.toLowerCase().startsWith('unidentified'))
                          ? item.name
                          : (matchedProduct?.name || item.name || `Unidentified (${item.barcode})`);
                        const isPendingUnknown = !matchedProduct && item.status === 'pending_admin_details';

                        return (
                          <div
                            key={item.id || item.rma_number}
                            className={`p-4 border rounded-2xl space-y-2 transition-all shadow-sm ${isSelected
                                ? 'bg-blue-50/90 dark:bg-blue-950/60 border-blue-500'
                                : 'bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800/60 border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 hover:border-slate-300 dark:hover:border-slate-600'
                              }`}
                          >
                            <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
                              <div>
                                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">
                                  <input
                                    type="checkbox"
                                    checked={isSelected}
                                    onChange={() => toggleSelectReport(item.id || item.rma_number)}
                                    className="w-4 h-4 rounded text-blue-600 focus:ring-blue-500 border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-600 cursor-pointer"
                                  />
                                  <span className="font-mono font-black text-xs text-blue-900 dark:text-blue-300 bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-950/60 border border-blue-200/80 dark:border-blue-800 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg">
                                    SN #{(reportsCurrentPage - 1) * reportsPageSize + index + 1}
                                  </span>
                                  <button
                                    type="button"
                                    onClick={() => {
                                      setQuickRmaNumber(item.rma_number);
                                      setIsQuickRmaModalOpen(true);
                                    }}
                                    className="font-mono font-black text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-400 hover:text-blue-900 dark:hover:text-blue-200 hover:underline text-sm cursor-pointer"
                                    title={`Inspect & Triage RMA #${item.rma_number}`}
                                  >
                                    {item.rma_number}
                                  </button>
                                  <button
                                    type="button"
                                    onClick={() => setQrModalReport({ ...item, name: resolvedName })}
                                    className="p-1 text-slate-400 hover:text-blue-600 dark:hover:text-blue-400 hover:bg-blue-50 dark:hover:bg-blue-950/60 rounded-md transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                                    title={`View & Print Box QR Sticker for ${item.rma_number}`}
                                  >
                                    <QrCode className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                                  </button>
                                </div>
                                <h4 className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white text-xs sm:text-sm mt-0.5 truncate" title={resolvedName}>
                                  {resolvedName}
                                </h4>
                                <div className="font-mono text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                                  Barcode: <strong className="text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200">{item.barcode}</strong>
                                  {(item.code || matchedProduct?.code) && <span> • SKU: {item.code || matchedProduct?.code}</span>}
                                </div>
                              </div>
                              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 shrink-0">
                                {/* Print 4x6 Thermal Box Label */}
                                <button
                                  type="button"
                                  onClick={() => setThermalPrintReport(item)}
                                  className="p-1 text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-900 dark:hover:text-white hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                                  title="Print 4x6 inch Thermal Box Label"
                                >
                                  <Printer className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300" />
                                </button>

                                {/* Inspect & Triage Physical Return */}
                                <button
                                  type="button"
                                  onClick={() => {
                                    setQuickRmaNumber(item.rma_number);
                                    setIsQuickRmaModalOpen(true);
                                  }}
                                  className="px-2 py-0.5 bg-amber-50 hover:bg-amber-100 dark:bg-amber-950/70 text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-300 border border-amber-300 dark:border-amber-700 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-bold flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer"
                                  title={`Inspect condition and set warehouse disposition for ${item.rma_number}`}
                                >
                                  <ClipboardCheck className="w-3 h-3 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400" />
                                  <span>Triage</span>
                                </button>

                                {canEditProducts && !savedProductsList.some(p => p.barcode && String(p.barcode) === String(item.barcode)) && (
                                  <button
                                    type="button"
                                    onClick={() => handleEditProductFromReport(item)}
                                    className="px-2 py-0.5 bg-blue-50 hover:bg-blue-100 dark:bg-blue-950/70 text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-300 border border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-800 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-bold flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer"
                                    title="Assign official SKU and save to Products catalog"
                                  >
                                    <Package className="w-3 h-3 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400" />
                                    <span>Assign SKU</span>
                                  </button>
                                )}
                                {(() => {
                                  const existingMemo = creditMemosList.find(m => m.rma_number === item.rma_number || m.report_id === item.id);
                                  if (existingMemo) {
                                    return (
                                      <button
                                        type="button"
                                        onClick={() => handleViewCreditMemoVoucher(existingMemo)}
                                        className="px-2 py-0.5 bg-emerald-100 hover:bg-emerald-200 dark:bg-emerald-950/70 text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-700 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-black flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer"
                                        title={`View Voucher: ${existingMemo.credit_memo_number}`}
                                      >
                                        <Receipt className="w-3 h-3 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400" />
                                        <span>Voucher</span>
                                      </button>
                                    );
                                  }
                                  if (canEditProducts) {
                                    return (
                                      <button
                                        type="button"
                                        onClick={() => handleOpenCreditMemoForReport(item)}
                                        className="px-2 py-0.5 bg-slate-100 hover:bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-emerald-950/50 text-slate-700 hover:text-emerald-700 dark:text-slate-300 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-bold flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer"
                                        title="Issue Credit Memo"
                                      >
                                        <Receipt className="w-3 h-3 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400" />
                                        <span>+ CM</span>
                                      </button>
                                    );
                                  }
                                  return null;
                                })()}
                                <span className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-rose-100 dark:bg-rose-950/60 text-rose-800 dark:text-rose-300">
                                  {item.reason || 'Damaged'}
                                </span>
                                {canDeleteReports && (
                                  <button
                                    type="button"
                                    onClick={() => requestDeleteReport(item.id, item.rma_number, item)}
                                    className="p-1.5 text-rose-500 hover:text-rose-700 hover:bg-rose-100 dark:hover:bg-rose-900/50 rounded-xl transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                                    title={`Delete RMA #${item.rma_number}`}
                                  >
                                    <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                                  </button>
                                )}
                              </div>
                            </div>

                            {/* Reporter Details */}
                            <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 pt-1 border-t border-slate-200/60 dark:border-slate-700/60 flex items-center justify-between">
                              <span>Reported by: <strong className="text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200">{item.reporter_name || item.reported_by}</strong></span>
                              <span className="font-mono text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400">{item.reporter_contact || ''}</span>
                            </div>

                            {/* Enterprise Logistics Badges (Store Branch, DR#, Batch/Lot, Expiry) */}
                            {(item.store_branch || item.invoice_dr_number || item.batch_lot_number || item.expiry_date) && (
                              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 pt-1 text-[10px]">
                                {item.store_branch && (
                                  <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-950/70 text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-300 border border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-800 font-semibold flex items-center gap-1">
                                    📍 {item.store_branch}
                                  </span>
                                )}
                                {item.invoice_dr_number && (
                                  <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-violet-50 dark:bg-violet-950/70 text-violet-700 dark:text-violet-300 border border-violet-200 dark:border-violet-800 font-mono font-bold">
                                    DR: {item.invoice_dr_number}
                                  </span>
                                )}
                                {item.batch_lot_number && (
                                  <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/70 text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-300 border border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-800 font-mono font-semibold">
                                    Lot: {item.batch_lot_number}
                                  </span>
                                )}
                                {item.expiry_date && (
                                  <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/70 text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300 border border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-800 font-medium">
                                    Exp: {item.expiry_date}
                                  </span>
                                )}
                              </div>
                            )}

                            {/* Photos preview with click-to-zoom multi-image */}
                            {photoList.length > 0 && (
                              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 pt-1">
                                <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 font-semibold">
                                  {photoList.length} Photo{photoList.length > 1 ? 's' : ''}:
                                </span>
                                <div className="flex gap-1.5 overflow-x-auto py-0.5">
                                  {photoList.map((url, i) => (
                                    <button
                                      key={i}
                                      type="button"
                                      onClick={() => setLightboxPhoto({
                                        images: photoList,
                                        initialIndex: i,
                                        url,
                                        title: item.name || `Return ${item.rma_number}`,
                                        subtitle: `Photo ${i + 1} of ${photoList.length} • RMA #${item.rma_number}`
                                      })}
                                      className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl overflow-hidden border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 cursor-zoom-in hover:opacity-85 transition-opacity shrink-0"
                                      title="Click to zoom proof photo"
                                    >
                                      <img
                                        src={url}
                                        alt="Proof"
                                        className="w-full h-full object-cover"
                                      />
                                    </button>
                                  ))}
                                </div>
                              </div>
                            )}
                          </div>
                        );
                      })}
                    </div>

                    {/* Floating Bulk Action Bar for Grid Cards */}
                    {selectedReportIds.size > 0 && (
                      <div className="p-3 sm:px-4 bg-slate-900/95 dark:bg-slate-950/95 text-white rounded-2xl border border-slate-700 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 animate-in fade-in">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                          <span className="w-6 h-6 rounded-full bg-blue-600 text-white flex items-center justify-center text-xs font-black">
                            {selectedReportIds.size}
                          </span>
                          <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-200">
                            {selectedReportIds.size} report{selectedReportIds.size > 1 ? 's' : ''} selected
                          </span>
                          {selectedReportIds.size < processedReports.length && (
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={selectAllFilteredReports}
                              className="text-xs text-blue-300 hover:text-white underline font-semibold ml-1 cursor-pointer"
                            >
                              Select all {processedReports.length} filtered
                            </button>
                          )}
                        </div>

                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={clearReportsSelection}
                            className="px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-slate-300 hover:text-white hover:bg-slate-800 rounded-xl transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                          >
                            Deselect
                          </button>
                          {canDeleteReports && (
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => requestBulkDeleteReports(selectedReportsList)}
                              className="px-4 py-1.5 bg-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-700 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-black flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-sm transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                            >
                              <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                              <span>Delete Selected ({selectedReportIds.size})</span>
                            </button>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    )}

                    <TablePagination
                      currentPage={reportsCurrentPage}
                      pageSize={reportsPageSize}
                      totalItems={processedReports.length}
                      onPageChange={setReportsCurrentPage}
                      onPageSizeChange={(newSize) => {
                        setReportsPageSize(newSize);
                        setReportsCurrentPage(1);
                      }}
                    />
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            )}

            {/* TAB 3: FINANCE CREDIT MEMO SECTION */}
            {adminActiveTab === 'credit_memos' && (
              <CreditMemosTab
                creditMemosList={creditMemosList}
                recentReportsList={recentReportsList}
                currentUser={currentUser}
                onOpenCreateModal={handleOpenCreateCreditMemo}
                onEditCreditMemo={handleEditCreditMemo}
                onViewVoucher={handleViewCreditMemoVoucher}
                onPrintBulk={handleViewCreditMemoVoucher}
                onRequestDeleteCreditMemo={requestDeleteCreditMemo}
                onRequestBulkDeleteCreditMemo={requestBulkDeleteCreditMemos}
              />
            )}

            {/* TAB 4: SUPPLIER RECOVERY / CHARGEBACK BATCHING (RTV CLAIMS) */}
            {adminActiveTab === 'supplier_claims' && (
              <SupplierClaimsTab
                reportsList={recentReportsList}
                currentUser={currentUser}
                onRefresh={refreshAllData}
                onViewPhoto={(photoObj) => setLightboxPhoto(photoObj)}
                onRequestDeleteReport={requestDeleteReport}
                onRequestBulkDeleteReports={requestBulkDeleteReports}
              />
            )}

            {/* TAB 5: SETTINGS & GOOGLE SMTP NOTIFICATION SERVICE (Super Admin Only) */}
            {adminActiveTab === 'settings' && currentUser?.role === 'super_admin' && (
              <SettingsTab
                isTestMode={isTestMode}
                onToggleTestMode={toggleTestMode}
                onOpenPortalQr={() => setIsAccessKeysModalOpen(true)}
                currentUser={currentUser}
              />
            )}

          </div>
        )}

      </div>

      {/* Admin Login Modal (OTP Verification Gate) */}
      <AdminLoginModal
        key={isLoginModalOpen ? 'active-admin-login-modal' : 'inactive-admin-login-modal'}
        isOpen={isLoginModalOpen}
        onClose={() => {
          setIsLoginModalOpen(false);
          if (!currentUser) navigateTo('/');
        }}
        onLoginSuccess={(user) => {
          setCurrentUser(user);
          setIsLoginModalOpen(false);
          showToast(`Welcome back, ${user.name}! Authenticated as ${user.role}.`, 'success');
        }}
      />

      {/* Super Admin Employee Access & Roles Management Modal */}
      <EmployeeManagementModal
        isOpen={isEmployeeModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsEmployeeModalOpen(false)}
        currentUser={currentUser}
      />

      {/* Camera Scanner Modal */}
      <ScannerModal
        isOpen={isScannerOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsScannerOpen(false)}
        onScanSuccess={(code) => {
          setIsScannerOpen(false);
          const rma = parseRmaFromScan(code);
          if (rma) {
            setQuickRmaNumber(rma);
            setIsQuickRmaModalOpen(true);
          } else {
            setBarcodeInput(code);
          }
        }}
      />

      {/* Admin Pending Barcodes Modal (With Photo Upload) */}
      <PendingBarcodesModal
        isOpen={isPendingModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsPendingModalOpen(false)}
        pendingList={pendingBarcodesList}
        currentUser={currentUser}
        onUpdated={() => {
          refreshAllData();
          showToast('Barcode details and reference photo updated!', 'success');
        }}
      />

      {/* Full Reports Modal */}
      <RMAReportsModal
        isOpen={isReportsModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsReportsModalOpen(false)}
        reports={recentReportsList}
        currentUser={currentUser}
        onDeleteReport={requestDeleteReport}
        onBulkDeleteReport={requestBulkDeleteReports}
        creditMemosList={creditMemosList}
        savedProductsList={savedProductsList}
        onEditProductFromReport={handleEditProductFromReport}
        onViewReportQR={(rep) => setQrModalReport(rep)}
        onOpenCreditMemo={(rep) => {
          setIsReportsModalOpen(false);
          handleOpenCreditMemoForReport(rep);
        }}
        onViewCreditMemoVoucher={(memo) => {
          setIsReportsModalOpen(false);
          handleViewCreditMemoVoucher(memo);
        }}
      />

      {/* Product Edit / Add Modal */}
      <ProductEditModal
        isOpen={isProductEditOpen}
        onClose={() => {
          setIsProductEditOpen(false);
          setEditingProduct(null);
          restoreQuickRmaIfPending();
        }}
        product={editingProduct}
        currentUser={currentUser}
        onSaved={async (prod) => {
          const barcode = prod?.barcode ? String(prod.barcode).trim() : '';
          const name = prod?.name || '';
          const code = prod?.code || prod?.sku || '';
          const supplierName = prod?.supplier_name || prod?.supplierName || 'Savemore';
          const price = Number(prod?.price || 0);
          const priceWithVat = Number(prod?.price_with_vat || prod?.priceWithVat || price || 0);
          const unitName = prod?.unit_name || prod?.unitName || 'pc';
          const aeName = prod?.ae_name || prod?.aeName || null;
          const aeEmail = prod?.ae_email || prod?.aeEmail || null;

          if (barcode) {
            // Optimistically update in-memory reports state so UI shows Logged immediately
            setRecentReportsList(prev => prev.map(rep => {
              if (rep.barcode && String(rep.barcode).trim() === barcode) {
                return {
                  ...rep,
                  name: name || rep.name,
                  code: code || rep.code,
                  status: 'logged',
                  supplier_name: supplierName,
                  price: price,
                  price_with_vat: priceWithVat,
                  unit_name: unitName
                };
              }
              return rep;
            }));

            // Persist to Supabase rma_reports table and alert on newly verified pending reports
            try {
              const { data: matchedPending } = await supabase
                .from('rma_reports')
                .select('*')
                .eq('barcode', barcode)
                .or('status.eq.pending_admin_details,name.ilike.%unidentified%');

              await supabase
                .from('rma_reports')
                .update({
                  name: name,
                  code: code,
                  price: price,
                  price_with_vat: priceWithVat,
                  supplier_name: supplierName,
                  unit_name: unitName,
                  ae_name: aeName,
                  ae_email: aeEmail,
                  status: 'logged'
                })
                .eq('barcode', barcode);

              // If this return was waiting for SKU assignment, dispatch the official RMA report notification email!
              if (matchedPending && matchedPending.length > 0) {
                const isTestActive = typeof window !== 'undefined' && localStorage.getItem('rma_portal_test_mode') === 'true';
                for (const rep of matchedPending) {
                  const enrichedReport = {
                    ...rep,
                    name: name,
                    code: code,
                    price: price,
                    price_with_vat: priceWithVat,
                    supplier_name: supplierName,
                    unit_name: unitName,
                    ae_name: aeName,
                    ae_email: aeEmail,
                    status: 'logged'
                  };
                  notificationService.sendRMANotification(enrichedReport, isTestActive).catch(e => {
                    console.warn('Background RMA report notification notice on SKU assignment:', e);
                  });
                }
              }
            } catch (e) {
              console.warn('Sync rma_reports from product save notice:', e);
            }
          }
          await refreshAllData();
          showToast(`Product "${name || 'Item'}" saved to catalog and linked reports updated!`, 'success');
          restoreQuickRmaIfPending();
        }}
        onDeleted={(prod) => {
          refreshAllData();
          showToast(`Product "${prod.name}" deleted from catalog.`, 'success');
          restoreQuickRmaIfPending();
        }}
      />

      {/* Finance Credit Memo Issue / Edit Modal */}
      <CreditMemoModal
        isOpen={isCreditMemoModalOpen}
        onClose={() => {
          setIsCreditMemoModalOpen(false);
          setSelectedCreditMemoReport(null);
          setEditingCreditMemo(null);
          restoreQuickRmaIfPending();
        }}
        report={selectedCreditMemoReport}
        creditMemo={editingCreditMemo}
        currentUser={currentUser}
        reportsList={recentReportsList}
        creditMemosCount={creditMemosList?.length || 0}
        onSaved={(memo) => {
          if (memo) {
            setRecentReportsList(prev => prev.map(r => {
              if (r.rma_number === memo.rma_number || String(r.id) === String(memo.report_id)) {
                return { ...r, status: 'credit_memo_issued' };
              }
              return r;
            }));
          }
          refreshAllData();
          showToast(`Credit Memo ${memo.credit_memo_number} saved!`, 'success');
          restoreQuickRmaIfPending();
        }}
        onViewVoucher={(memo) => {
          setVoucherModalMemo(memo);
          setIsVoucherModalOpen(true);
        }}
      />

      {/* Official Printable Credit Memorandum Voucher Modal */}
      <CreditMemoVoucherModal
        isOpen={isVoucherModalOpen}
        onClose={() => {
          setIsVoucherModalOpen(false);
          setVoucherModalMemo(null);
          setVoucherModalMemos([]);
          restoreQuickRmaIfPending();
        }}
        creditMemo={voucherModalMemo}
        creditMemos={voucherModalMemos}
      />

      {/* Fullscreen Image Lightbox Modal */}
      <ImageLightboxModal
        isOpen={Boolean(lightboxPhoto)}
        imageUrl={lightboxPhoto?.url}
        images={lightboxPhoto?.images || (lightboxPhoto?.url ? [lightboxPhoto.url] : [])}
        initialIndex={lightboxPhoto?.initialIndex || 0}
        title={lightboxPhoto?.title}
        subtitle={lightboxPhoto?.subtitle}
        onClose={() => setLightboxPhoto(null)}
      />

      {/* Return Merchandise Authorization QR Sticker Modal */}
      <ReturnQRModal
        isOpen={Boolean(qrModalReport)}
        onClose={() => {
          setQrModalReport(null);
          restoreQuickRmaIfPending();
        }}
        report={qrModalReport}
        onOpenQuickAction={(rma) => {
          setPendingQuickRmaNumber(null);
          setQuickRmaNumber(rma);
          setIsQuickRmaModalOpen(true);
        }}
      />

      {/* RMA QR Code Quick Processing Modal */}
      <QuickRMAActionModal
        isOpen={isQuickRmaModalOpen}
        onClose={handleCloseQuickRma}
        rmaNumber={quickRmaNumber}
        currentUser={currentUser}
        onAdminVerified={(admin) => setCurrentUser(admin)}
        savedProductsList={savedProductsList}
        creditMemosList={creditMemosList}
        recentReportsList={recentReportsList}
        onAssignSku={(reportToEdit) => {
          const currentRma = quickRmaNumber || reportToEdit?.rma_number;
          setPendingQuickRmaNumber(currentRma);
          setIsQuickRmaModalOpen(false);
          handleEditProductFromReport(reportToEdit);
        }}
        onOpenCreditMemo={(rep, existing) => {
          const currentRma = quickRmaNumber || rep?.rma_number;
          setPendingQuickRmaNumber(currentRma);
          setIsQuickRmaModalOpen(false);
          if (existing) {
            setEditingCreditMemo(existing);
            setSelectedCreditMemoReport(rep);
            setIsCreditMemoModalOpen(true);
          } else {
            handleOpenCreditMemoForReport(rep);
          }
        }}
        onViewCreditMemoVoucher={(memo) => {
          const currentRma = quickRmaNumber || memo?.rma_number;
          setPendingQuickRmaNumber(currentRma);
          setIsQuickRmaModalOpen(false);
          setVoucherModalMemo(memo);
          setIsVoucherModalOpen(true);
        }}
        onViewReportQR={(rep) => {
          const currentRma = quickRmaNumber || rep?.rma_number;
          setPendingQuickRmaNumber(currentRma);
          setIsQuickRmaModalOpen(false);
          setQrModalReport(rep);
        }}
        onOpenLightbox={setLightboxPhoto}
        onRefresh={(updated) => {
          if (updated && (updated.id || updated.rma_number)) {
            setRecentReportsList(prev => prev.map(r =>
              (r.id === updated.id || (r.rma_number && r.rma_number === updated.rma_number))
                ? { ...r, ...updated }
                : r
            ));
          }
          refreshAllData();
        }}
      />

      {/* Toast Alert Notification */}
      {toastMessage && (
        <div className="fixed bottom-6 right-6 z-50 animate-in fade-in slide-in-from-bottom-3">
          <div className={`px-4 py-3 rounded-2xl shadow-xl border text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-2 ${toastMessage.type === 'error'
              ? 'bg-rose-50 border-rose-300 text-rose-800'
              : 'bg-slate-900 border-slate-700 text-white'
            }`}>
            <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400 shrink-0" />
            <span>{toastMessage.text}</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Universal Delete Confirmation Modal */}
      <DeleteConfirmationModal
        isOpen={Boolean(deleteModalState)}
        onClose={() => setDeleteModalState(null)}
        onConfirm={handleConfirmDelete}
        title={deleteModalState?.title || 'Confirm Deletion'}
        itemName={deleteModalState?.itemName}
        itemType={deleteModalState?.itemType || 'item'}
        itemDetails={deleteModalState?.itemDetails}
        isDeleting={isDeleteModalLoading}
      />


      {/* Role-Based QR Code & 6-Digit PIN Gatekeeper Screen (Active at root / or /intake/:slug when device is not unlocked) */}
      <GatekeeperPinModal
        isOpen={!isAdminView && !currentUser && !gateSession}
        currentSlug={intakeSlug}
        onUnlock={(session) => {
          setGateSession(session);
          showToast(`Station Unlocked: ${session.profileName || session.slug}`, 'success');
        }}
        onOpenAdminLogin={() => {
          setIsAdminView(true);
          setIsLoginModalOpen(true);
        }}
        isTestMode={isTestMode}
      />

      {/* Admin QR Access Keys & 6-Digit PIN Manager Modal */}
      <PortalAccessKeysModal
        isOpen={isAccessKeysModalOpen || isPortalAccessQrOpen}
        onClose={() => {
          setIsAccessKeysModalOpen(false);
          setIsPortalAccessQrOpen(false);
        }}
        currentUser={currentUser}
        onOpenPinRequests={() => {
          setIsAccessKeysModalOpen(false);
          setIsPortalAccessQrOpen(false);
          setIsPinRequestsModalOpen(true);
        }}
      />

      {/* Return Authorization PIN Requests Queue Modal */}
      <PinRequestsQueueModal
        isOpen={isPinRequestsModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsPinRequestsModalOpen(false)}
        currentUser={currentUser}
        isTestMode={isTestMode}
        onQueueUpdated={(reqs) => {
          const pending = reqs.filter(r => r.status === 'pending').length;
          setPendingPinRequestsCount(pending);
        }}
      />


      {/* 4x6" Thermal Box Label Generator Modal */}
      {thermalPrintReport && (
        <ThermalBoxLabelModal
          isOpen={Boolean(thermalPrintReport)}
          onClose={() => setThermalPrintReport(null)}
          report={thermalPrintReport}
          currentUser={currentUser}
        />
      )}

    </div>
  );
}

import { createClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js';
import { INITIAL_PRODUCTS, INITIAL_TICKETS } from './data/mockData';

const supabaseUrl = import.meta.env.VITE_SUPABASE_URL || 'https://lschluviltzsknptwgrz.supabase.co';
const supabaseAnonKey = import.meta.env.VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY || 'sb_publishable_Jrv9ZNgGXJ4PZoNWCJSHxQ_7hZtQqd3';

export const isSupabaseConfigured = Boolean(
  supabaseUrl &&
  supabaseAnonKey &&
  supabaseUrl !== 'https://your-project.supabase.co'
);

export const supabase = createClient(supabaseUrl, supabaseAnonKey, {
  auth: {
    persistSession: false
  }
});

// Local Storage Fallback Helpers
const STORAGE_KEYS = {
  PRODUCTS: 'wholesale_rma_products_v2',
  TICKETS: 'wholesale_rma_tickets_v2',
  SETTINGS: 'wholesale_rma_settings_v2'
};

export const getLocalProducts = () => {
  try {
    const cached = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEYS.PRODUCTS);
    if (!cached) {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEYS.PRODUCTS, JSON.stringify(INITIAL_PRODUCTS));
      return INITIAL_PRODUCTS;
    }
    return JSON.parse(cached);
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('Error reading local products fallback:', err);
    return INITIAL_PRODUCTS;
  }
};

export const getLocalTickets = () => {
  try {
    const cached = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEYS.TICKETS);
    if (!cached) {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEYS.TICKETS, JSON.stringify(INITIAL_TICKETS));
      return INITIAL_TICKETS;
    }
    return JSON.parse(cached);
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('Error reading local tickets fallback:', err);
    return INITIAL_TICKETS;
  }
};

export const saveLocalTickets = (tickets) => {
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEYS.TICKETS, JSON.stringify(tickets));
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('Failed to save to local storage:', err);
  }
};

// Unified Data Access Layer (Supabase + Local Fallback)

export const rmaApi = {
  async testConnection() {
    if (!isSupabaseConfigured) {
      return { 
        connected: false, 
        message: 'Offline Mock Mode active.'
      };
    }
    try {
      const { data, error } = await supabase.from('products').select('count', { count: 'exact', head: true });
      if (error) throw error;
      return {
        connected: true,
        mode: 'live',
        message: 'Connected to Supabase Database.'
      };
    } catch (err) {
      return {
        connected: false,
        mode: 'offline',
        message: `Supabase unreachable (${err.message || 'Network notice'}). Local storage active.`
      };
    }
  },

  async getProducts() {
    if (isSupabaseConfigured) {
      try {
        const { data, error } = await supabase.from('products').select('*');
        if (!error && data && data.length > 0) {
          return data;
        }
      } catch (e) {
        console.warn('Supabase products fetch failed, using local fallback:', e);
      }
    }
    return getLocalProducts();
  },

  /**
   * Fast Barcode / SKU Lookup:
   * 1. Check Supabase products table
   * 2. If not found, check local verified catalog
   */
  async findProductByBarcode(barcode) {
    const cleanBarcode = String(barcode).trim();
    if (!cleanBarcode) return null;

    // 1. Secure Serverless Proxy (/api/v1/products/lookup)
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/v1/products/lookup?barcode=${encodeURIComponent(cleanBarcode)}`, {
        headers: { 'Accept': 'application/json' }
      });
      if (res && res.ok) {
        const json = await res.json();
        if (json.success && json.found && json.product) {
          return json.product;
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {}

    // 2. Direct Supabase lookup fallback
    if (isSupabaseConfigured) {
      try {
        const { data, error } = await supabase
          .from('products')
          .select('*')
          .eq('barcode', cleanBarcode)
          .maybeSingle();

        if (!error && data) {
          return data;
        }
      } catch (e) {
        console.warn('Supabase barcode lookup failed, checking local catalog:', e);
      }
    }

    // 3. Local catalog fallback
    const localProds = getLocalProducts();
    return localProds.find(p => 
      String(p.barcode).trim().toLowerCase() === cleanBarcode.toLowerCase() ||
      String(p.sku || p.code || '').trim().toLowerCase() === cleanBarcode.toLowerCase()
    ) || null;
  },

  async searchLiveProducts(query, limit = 15) {
    if (!query) return [];
    if (isSupabaseConfigured) {
      try {
        const { data, error } = await supabase
          .from('products')
          .select('*')
          .or(`name.ilike.%${query}%,barcode.ilike.%${query}%`)
          .limit(limit);
        if (!error && data) return data;
      } catch (e) {}
    }
    return getLocalProducts().filter(p => 
      (p.name && p.name.toLowerCase().includes(query.toLowerCase())) ||
      (p.barcode && p.barcode.includes(query))
    ).slice(0, limit);
  },

  async getLiveSuppliers(limit = 100) {
    if (isSupabaseConfigured) {
      try {
        const { data, error } = await supabase.from('products').select('supplier_name').limit(limit);
        if (!error && data) {
          const list = Array.from(new Set(data.map(d => d.supplier_name).filter(Boolean)));
          return list.map((name, i) => ({ id: i + 1, name }));
        }
      } catch (e) {}
    }
    return [{ id: 1, name: 'Savemore' }];
  },

  async getTickets() {
    if (isSupabaseConfigured) {
      try {
        const { data, error } = await supabase
          .from('rma_tickets')
          .select('*')
          .order('created_at', { ascending: false });

        if (!error && data && data.length > 0) {
          return data;
        }
      } catch (e) {
        console.warn('Supabase tickets fetch failed, using local storage:', e);
      }
    }
    return getLocalTickets();
  },

  async createTicket(ticket) {
    // Attempt saving to Supabase
    let savedToSupabase = false;
    if (isSupabaseConfigured) {
      try {
        const { error } = await supabase.from('rma_tickets').insert([ticket]);
        if (!error) savedToSupabase = true;
      } catch (e) {
        console.warn('Supabase ticket insert failed, saving locally:', e);
      }
    }

    // Always update local storage for offline redundancy & instant UI reactivity
    const current = getLocalTickets();
    const updated = [ticket, ...current];
    saveLocalTickets(updated);

    return { ticket, savedToSupabase };
  },

  async updateTicket(id, updates) {
    if (isSupabaseConfigured) {
      try {
        await supabase.from('rma_tickets').update(updates).eq('id', id);
      } catch (e) {
        console.warn('Supabase ticket update failed, updating local storage:', e);
      }
    }

    const current = getLocalTickets();
    const updated = current.map(t => (t.id === id ? { ...t, ...updates } : t));
    saveLocalTickets(updated);
    return updated.find(t => t.id === id);
  },

  async uploadPhoto(file, rmaNumber = 'GENERAL') {
    if (!file) return null;

    // Helper: Client-side WebP compression (1280px max, 0.7 quality)
    const compress = (imgFile) => {
      if (!imgFile || !imgFile.type?.startsWith('image/') || imgFile.type === 'image/svg+xml') {
        return Promise.resolve(imgFile);
      }
      return new Promise((resolve) => {
        try {
          const img = new Image();
          const url = URL.createObjectURL(imgFile);
          img.onload = () => {
            URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
            let { width, height } = img;
            const maxDimension = 1280;
            if (width > maxDimension || height > maxDimension) {
              if (width > height) {
                height = Math.round((height * maxDimension) / width);
                width = maxDimension;
              } else {
                width = Math.round((width * maxDimension) / height);
                height = maxDimension;
              }
            }
            const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
            canvas.width = width;
            canvas.height = height;
            const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
            ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0, width, height);

            canvas.toBlob(
              (blob) => {
                if (blob) {
                  const cleanBase = imgFile.name ? imgFile.name.replace(/\.[^.]+$/, '') : 'photo';
                  resolve(new File([blob], `${cleanBase}.webp`, { type: 'image/webp', lastModified: Date.now() }));
                } else {
                  resolve(imgFile);
                }
              },
              'image/webp',
              0.7
            );
          };
          img.onerror = () => {
            URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
            resolve(imgFile);
          };
          img.src = url;
        } catch (e) {
          resolve(imgFile);
        }
      });
    };

    const toBase64 = (f) => new Promise((resolve) => {
      const reader = new FileReader();
      reader.onloadend = () => resolve(reader.result);
      reader.onerror = () => resolve('');
      reader.readAsDataURL(f);
    });

    try {
      const compressed = await compress(file);
      const base64Data = await toBase64(compressed);

      // 1. Primary: Google Drive serverless upload
      try {
        const gdriveRes = await fetch('/api/upload-photo', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({
            fileData: base64Data,
            fileName: compressed.name || `photo_${Date.now()}.webp`,
            mimeType: compressed.type || 'image/webp',
            rmaNumber
          })
        });
        if (gdriveRes.ok) {
          const json = await gdriveRes.json();
          if (json.success && (json.url || json.previewUrl)) {
            return json.url || json.previewUrl;
          }
        }
      } catch (gdriveErr) {
        console.warn('Google Drive notice, falling back to Supabase:', gdriveErr.message);
      }

      // 2. Secondary: Supabase Storage
      if (isSupabaseConfigured) {
        try {
          const filename = `reports/${Date.now()}-${compressed.name ? compressed.name.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9.-]/g, '_') : 'photo.webp'}`;
          const { data, error } = await supabase.storage
            .from('rma-photos')
            .upload(filename, compressed, { cacheControl: '3600', upsert: true, contentType: compressed.type || 'image/webp' });

          if (!error) {
            const { data: publicData } = supabase.storage.from('rma-photos').getPublicUrl(filename);
            return publicData.publicUrl;
          }
        } catch (e) {
          console.warn('Supabase photo upload notice:', e.message);
        }
      }

      // 3. Tertiary: Base64 data URL
      return base64Data;
    } catch (err) {
      return toBase64(file);
    }
  }
};

--- START FILE: src/components/AdminLoginModal.jsx ---
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { Lock, Mail, ShieldCheck, KeyRound, AlertCircle, RefreshCw, CheckCircle, ArrowRight, X } from 'lucide-react';
import { authService } from '../services/authService';

export default function AdminLoginModal({ isOpen, onClose, onLoginSuccess }) {
  const [step, setStep] = useState(() => {
    return sessionStorage.getItem('rma_login_pending_email') ? 'otp' : 'email';
  });
  const [emailInput, setEmailInput] = useState(() => {
    return sessionStorage.getItem('rma_login_pending_email') || '';
  });
  const [otpInput, setOtpInput] = useState('');
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState(null);
  const [countdown, setCountdown] = useState(0);

  // Countdown timer for resend OTP cooldown (prevents 429 errors)
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (countdown > 0) {
      const timer = setTimeout(() => setCountdown(c => c - 1), 1000);
      return () => clearTimeout(timer);
    }
  }, [countdown]);

  // Sync state when modal is opened fresh
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      const savedEmail = sessionStorage.getItem('rma_login_pending_email');
      if (savedEmail) {
        setStep('otp');
        setEmailInput(savedEmail);
      } else {
        setStep('email');
      }
      setIsLoading(false);
      setErrorMessage(null);
    }
  }, [isOpen]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  // Step 1: Request OTP
  const handleRequestOtp = async (e) => {
    if (e && e.preventDefault) e.preventDefault();
    const email = emailInput.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!email) return;

    if (countdown > 0) {
      return; // Under cooldown
    }

    setIsLoading(true);
    setErrorMessage(null);

    try {
      const res = await authService.requestOtp(email);
      sessionStorage.setItem('rma_login_pending_email', email);
      setStep('otp');
      setCountdown(60); // 60 seconds cooldown to protect from rate limits
      if (res.rateLimited) {
        setErrorMessage(res.message);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setErrorMessage(err.message);
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  // Step 2: Verify OTP
  const handleVerifyOtp = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const code = otpInput.trim();
    if (!code) return;

    setIsLoading(true);
    setErrorMessage(null);

    try {
      const res = await authService.verifyOtp(emailInput, code);
      if (res.success && onLoginSuccess) {
        sessionStorage.removeItem('rma_login_pending_email');
        onLoginSuccess(res.user);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setErrorMessage(err.message);
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-end sm:items-center justify-center p-0 sm:p-4 bg-slate-900/70 backdrop-blur-md animate-in fade-in">
      <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 rounded-t-3xl sm:rounded-3xl shadow-2xl border-t sm:border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 max-w-md w-full p-6 sm:p-7 space-y-5 pb-safe max-h-[92dvh] overflow-y-auto">
        
        {/* Mobile bottom-sheet drag handle */}
        <div className="sm:hidden -mt-2 mb-2 flex justify-center shrink-0">
          <div className="w-10 h-1 rounded-full bg-slate-300 dark:bg-slate-700"></div>
        </div>
        
        {/* Top Icon & Title */}
        <div className="text-center space-y-1.5">
          <div className="w-12 h-12 bg-blue-100 dark:bg-blue-900/40 text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-400 rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center mx-auto shadow-inner">
            <Lock className="w-6 h-6" />
          </div>
          <h2 className="text-xl font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white tracking-tight">
            Company Staff Verification
          </h2>
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
            One-Time Password (OTP) security gate for RMA admin access.
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* Error Notice */}
        {errorMessage && (
          <div className="p-3 bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/40 border border-rose-300 dark:border-rose-800 text-rose-800 dark:text-rose-200 rounded-2xl text-xs font-semibold flex items-start gap-2 animate-in fade-in">
            <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-rose-600 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
            <span>{errorMessage}</span>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* STEP 1: Enter Company Email */}
        {step === 'email' && (
          <form onSubmit={handleRequestOtp} className="space-y-4">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mb-1.5">
                Official Company Email Address
              </label>
              <div className="relative">
                <Mail className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400 absolute left-3.5 top-3.5" />
                <input
                  type="email"
                  required
                  autoFocus
                  value={emailInput}
                  onChange={(e) => setEmailInput(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full pl-11 pr-4 py-3 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-2xl text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-blue-600 focus:bg-white dark:focus:bg-slate-800"
                />
              </div>
              <span className="block text-[11px] text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 mt-1">
                Must be an active employee in company directory. Personal emails (@gmail) are not accepted.
              </span>
            </div>

            <button
              type="submit"
              disabled={isLoading || !emailInput.trim()}
              className="w-full py-3.5 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 disabled:opacity-50 text-white font-extrabold text-sm rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center gap-2 shadow-md shadow-blue-600/20 transition-all"
            >
              {isLoading ? (
                <RefreshCw className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" />
              ) : (
                <KeyRound className="w-4 h-4" />
              )}
              <span>Send OTP Verification Code</span>
            </button>

            {onClose && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={onClose}
                className="w-full py-2 text-xs font-bold text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-400 dark:hover:text-slate-200 text-center"
              >
                Cancel & Return to Public Portal
              </button>
            )}
          </form>
        )}

        {/* STEP 2: Enter 6-digit OTP */}
        {step === 'otp' && (
          <form onSubmit={handleVerifyOtp} className="space-y-4 animate-in fade-in">
            <div className="p-3.5 bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 border border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-800 rounded-2xl text-xs text-emerald-900 dark:text-emerald-200 space-y-1">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 font-bold">
                <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600 shrink-0" />
                <span>Verification code dispatched!</span>
              </div>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-300">
                Please check your inbox at <strong>{emailInput}</strong> for your OTP access code.
              </p>
            </div>

            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mb-1.5 text-center">
                Enter Verification Code or Token
              </label>
              <input
                type="text"
                required
                autoFocus
                maxLength={64}
                value={otpInput}
                onChange={(e) => setOtpInput(e.target.value.trim())}
                placeholder="e.g. 123456"
                className={`w-full py-3.5 text-center font-black font-mono bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800 border-2 border-blue-500 rounded-2xl text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none focus:bg-white dark:focus:bg-slate-800 transition-all ${
                  otpInput.length <= 8 ? 'tracking-[0.35em] text-2xl' : 'text-xs tracking-normal px-3'
                }`}
              />
              <span className="block text-[10px] text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 text-center mt-1">
                Enter the 6-digit OTP code sent to your email
              </span>
            </div>

            <button
              type="submit"
              disabled={isLoading || otpInput.length < 6}
              className="w-full py-3.5 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 disabled:opacity-50 text-white font-extrabold text-sm rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center gap-2 shadow-md shadow-emerald-600/20 transition-all"
            >
              {isLoading ? (
                <RefreshCw className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" />
              ) : (
                <ShieldCheck className="w-4 h-4" />
              )}
              <span>Verify & Access Dashboard</span>
            </button>

            <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-semibold pt-1">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  sessionStorage.removeItem('rma_login_pending_email');
                  setStep('email');
                  setOtpInput('');
                  setErrorMessage(null);
                }}
                className="text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-400 dark:hover:text-slate-200 underline cursor-pointer"
              >
                Change Email
              </button>
              {countdown > 0 ? (
                <span className="text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 text-xs font-mono">
                  Resend Code ({countdown}s)
                </span>
              ) : (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handleRequestOtp}
                  className="text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 hover:text-blue-800 dark:hover:text-blue-300 underline cursor-pointer"
                >
                  Resend Code
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          </form>
        )}

      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

--- END FILE: src/components/AdminLoginModal.jsx ---

--- START FILE: src/components/AdminPinModal.jsx ---
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { X, Lock, KeyRound, ShieldAlert, ArrowRight, CheckCircle2 } from 'lucide-react';

export default function AdminPinModal({ isOpen, onClose, onUnlock }) {
  const [pin, setPin] = useState('');
  const [errorMsg, setErrorMsg] = useState(null);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const handleSubmit = (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (pin === '1234' || pin === 'admin' || pin.trim() === '') {
      onUnlock();
      onClose();
      setPin('');
      setErrorMsg(null);
    } else {
      setErrorMsg('Incorrect security PIN. Default staff PIN is 1234.');
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-end sm:items-center justify-center p-0 sm:p-4 bg-slate-950/60 backdrop-blur-sm animate-in fade-in duration-150">
      <div className="relative w-full max-w-sm bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border-t sm:border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-t-3xl sm:rounded-3xl shadow-2xl p-6 space-y-4 pb-safe max-h-[92dvh] overflow-y-auto">
        
        {/* Mobile bottom-sheet drag handle */}
        <div className="sm:hidden -mt-2 mb-2 flex justify-center shrink-0">
          <div className="w-10 h-1 rounded-full bg-slate-300 dark:bg-slate-700"></div>
        </div>

        {/* Close Button */}
        <button
          onClick={onClose}
          className="absolute top-4 right-4 min-w-[44px] min-h-[44px] flex items-center justify-center rounded-xl text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-white hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 transition-colors"
          aria-label="Close"
        >
          <X className="w-5 h-5" />
        </button>

        {/* Icon & Title */}
        <div className="text-center space-y-1.5 pt-2">
          <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-2xl bg-brand-50 dark:bg-brand-500/10 text-brand-600 dark:text-brand-400 border border-brand-200 dark:border-brand-500/20 flex items-center justify-center mx-auto">
            <Lock className="w-6 h-6" />
          </div>
          <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">Admin & Staff Portal</h3>
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
            Enter staff PIN to access Tickets Vault, Finance Credit Memos, and Replenishment Buffer.
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* Form */}
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-3 pt-2">
          <div>
            <div className="relative">
              <KeyRound className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400 absolute left-3.5 top-3.5" />
              <input
                type="password"
                maxLength={6}
                autoFocus
                value={pin}
                onChange={(e) => {
                  setPin(e.target.value);
                  setErrorMsg(null);
                }}
                placeholder="Enter PIN (Default: 1234)"
                className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-2xl pl-10 pr-4 py-3 text-sm font-mono text-center tracking-widest text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-brand-500"
              />
            </div>
            {errorMsg && (
              <p className="text-[11px] text-rose-500 font-medium text-center mt-1.5">
                {errorMsg}
              </p>
            )}
          </div>

          <button
            type="submit"
            className="w-full py-3 bg-brand-600 hover:bg-brand-500 text-white font-bold text-xs rounded-xl shadow-md transition-all active:scale-95 flex items-center justify-center space-x-1.5"
          >
            <span>Unlock Admin Workstation</span>
            <ArrowRight className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              onUnlock();
              onClose();
            }}
            className="w-full py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-400 dark:hover:text-white transition-colors"
          >
            One-Click Staff Access (Skip PIN)
          </button>
        </form>

      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

--- END FILE: src/components/AdminPinModal.jsx ---

--- START FILE: src/components/ApiKeysManagementSection.jsx ---
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { 
  Key, 
  ShieldCheck, 
  Copy, 
  Check, 
  RefreshCw, 
  AlertTriangle, 
  Trash2, 
  ExternalLink, 
  Plus, 
  Clock, 
  CheckCircle2, 
  Lock,
  Layers
} from 'lucide-react';
import { supabase } from '../supabaseClient';

const TARGET_SYSTEMS = [
  { id: 'primary', name: 'Primary System (Mine)', role: 'Internal Central System', badge: 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-700 dark:bg-blue-900/40 dark:text-blue-300' },
  { id: 'jarmen', name: 'Jarmen', role: 'Partner Wholesale System', badge: 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-900/40 dark:text-emerald-300' },
  { id: 'jelo', name: 'Jelo', role: 'Partner Operations System', badge: 'bg-purple-100 text-purple-700 dark:bg-purple-900/40 dark:text-purple-300' },
  { id: 'arlito', name: 'Arlito', role: 'Partner Inventory System', badge: 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-900/40 dark:text-amber-300' }
];

export default function ApiKeysManagementSection() {
  const [keys, setKeys] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [actionLoading, setActionLoading] = useState(null);
  const [feedback, setFeedback] = useState(null);

  // New Key Generation / Reveal State
  const [showGenerateModal, setShowGenerateModal] = useState(false);
  const [selectedSystem, setSelectedSystem] = useState(TARGET_SYSTEMS[0].name);
  const [rateLimit, setRateLimit] = useState(60);
  
  // One-time revealed key
  const [revealedKey, setRevealedKey] = useState(null);
  const [hasCopied, setHasCopied] = useState(false);

  // Load existing API keys
  const loadKeys = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      // Fetch via Supabase table public.api_keys
      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from('api_keys')
        .select('id, name, masked_key, is_active, rate_limit, expires_at, last_used_at, created_at')
        .order('created_at', { ascending: false });

      if (error) {
        // Table might not exist yet if user hasn't run the SQL migration
        if (error.code === '42P01') {
          setFeedback({
            type: 'warning',
            message: 'Database table "api_keys" not found. Please run the SQL migration script in your Supabase SQL Editor.'
          });
          setKeys([]);
          return;
        }
        throw error;
      }

      setKeys(data || []);
      setFeedback(null);
    } catch (err) {
