                        {sortField === 'rma_number' || sortField === 'supplier_name' ? (
                          sortDirection === 'asc' ? <ArrowUp className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600" /> : <ArrowDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600" />
                        ) : <ArrowUpDown className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-300" />}
                      </div>
                    </th>
                    <th 
                      onClick={() => handleSort('product_name')}
                      className="py-3 px-3.5 font-bold cursor-pointer select-none hover:text-emerald-600 transition-colors"
                    >
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                        <span>Product & Barcode</span>
                        {sortField === 'product_name' ? (
                          sortDirection === 'asc' ? <ArrowUp className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600" /> : <ArrowDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600" />
                        ) : <ArrowUpDown className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-300" />}
                      </div>
                    </th>
                    <th 
                      onClick={() => handleSort('quantity')}
                      className="py-3 px-3 font-bold text-center cursor-pointer select-none hover:text-emerald-600 transition-colors"
                    >
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1">
                        <span>Quantity</span>
                        {sortField === 'quantity' ? (
                          sortDirection === 'asc' ? <ArrowUp className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600" /> : <ArrowDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600" />
                        ) : <ArrowUpDown className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-300" />}
                      </div>
                    </th>
                    <th 
                      onClick={() => handleSort('gross_amount')}
                      className="py-3 px-3 text-right font-bold cursor-pointer select-none hover:text-emerald-600 transition-colors"
                    >
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-1">
                        <span>Gross Amount</span>
                        {sortField === 'gross_amount' ? (
                          sortDirection === 'asc' ? <ArrowUp className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600" /> : <ArrowDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600" />
                        ) : <ArrowUpDown className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-300" />}
                      </div>
                    </th>
                    <th 
                      onClick={() => handleSort('pull_out_ref')}
                      className="py-3 px-3.5 font-bold cursor-pointer select-none hover:text-emerald-600 transition-colors"
                    >
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                        <span>Pull Out Reference</span>
                        {sortField === 'pull_out_ref' ? (
                          sortDirection === 'asc' ? <ArrowUp className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600" /> : <ArrowDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600" />
                        ) : <ArrowUpDown className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-300" />}
                      </div>
                    </th>
                    <th 
                      onClick={() => handleSort('credit_amount')}
                      className="py-3 px-3.5 font-black text-right cursor-pointer select-none hover:text-emerald-600 transition-colors"
                    >
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-1">
                        <span>Credit Amount (₱)</span>
                        {sortField === 'credit_amount' ? (
                          sortDirection === 'asc' ? <ArrowUp className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600" /> : <ArrowDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600" />
                        ) : <ArrowUpDown className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-300" />}
                      </div>
                    </th>
                    <th 
                      onClick={() => handleSort('credit_issued_by')}
                      className="py-3 px-3.5 font-bold cursor-pointer select-none hover:text-emerald-600 transition-colors"
                    >
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                        <span>Credit Issued By</span>
                        {sortField === 'credit_issued_by' ? (
                          sortDirection === 'asc' ? <ArrowUp className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600" /> : <ArrowDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600" />
                        ) : <ArrowUpDown className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-300" />}
                      </div>
                    </th>
                    <th className="py-3 px-3 text-center font-bold">Actions</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100 dark:divide-slate-800 font-medium">
                  {paginatedMemos.map((memo, idx) => {
                    const isSelected = selectedMemoNumbers.has(memo.credit_memo_number);
                    return (
                      <tr 
                        key={memo.credit_memo_number}
                        className={`transition-colors ${isSelected ? 'bg-emerald-50/50 dark:bg-emerald-950/30' : 'hover:bg-slate-50/80 dark:hover:bg-slate-800/50'}`}
                      >
                        {/* Checkbox */}
                        <td className="py-3 px-3 text-center w-10">
                          <input
                            type="checkbox"
                            checked={isSelected}
                            onChange={() => toggleSelect(memo.credit_memo_number)}
                            className="w-4 h-4 rounded border-slate-300 text-emerald-600 focus:ring-emerald-500 cursor-pointer"
                          />
                        </td>

                        {/* SN */}
                        <td className="py-3 px-3 font-mono">
                          <span className="font-black text-emerald-900 dark:text-emerald-300 bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 border border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-800 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg text-xs">
                            #{(currentPage - 1) * pageSize + idx + 1}
                          </span>
                        </td>

                        {/* CM # */}
                        <td className="py-3 px-3">
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => onViewVoucher(memo)}
                            className="font-mono font-black text-xs text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400 hover:underline flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer"
                            title="Click to view official printable voucher"
                          >
                            <Receipt className="w-3.5 h-3.5 shrink-0" />
                            <span>{memo.credit_memo_number}</span>
                          </button>
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 mt-0.5">
                            <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 font-sans">
                              {memo.credit_issued_at ? new Date(memo.credit_issued_at).toLocaleDateString() : ''}
                            </span>
                            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-0.5 text-[9px] font-bold text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300 bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded-full" title="Stored in Supabase database">
                              <Database className="w-2.5 h-2.5" />
                              <span>DB</span>
                            </span>
                          </div>
                        </td>

                        {/* RMA # */}
                        <td className="py-3 px-3.5 font-mono font-bold text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-400 text-xs">
                          {memo.rma_number || 'N/A'}
                          <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 font-sans">
                            Supplier: {memo.supplier_name || 'Savemore'}
                          </div>
                        </td>

                        {/* Product Name & Barcode */}
                        <td className="py-3 px-3.5 max-w-[200px]">
                          <div className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white truncate" title={memo.product_name}>
                            {memo.product_name}
                          </div>
                          <div className="font-mono text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 truncate">
                            {memo.barcode} {memo.sku ? `• SKU: ${memo.sku}` : ''}
                          </div>
                        </td>

                        {/* Quantity */}
                        <td className="py-3 px-3 text-center font-bold font-mono text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                          {memo.quantity} {memo.unit_name || 'pc'}
                        </td>

                        {/* Gross Amount (Strict 2 Decimals) */}
                        <td className="py-3 px-3 text-right font-mono text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400">
                          ₱{Number(memo.amount || 0).toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}
                        </td>

                        {/* Pull Out Reference */}
                        <td className="py-3 px-3.5 max-w-[180px]">
                          <div className="font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 truncate" title={memo.pull_out_ref}>
                            {memo.pull_out_ref || 'Warehouse Pull-Out'}
                          </div>
                          <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 font-mono">
                            Date: {memo.pull_out_date || 'N/A'}
                          </div>
                        </td>

                        {/* Credit Amount (₱) (Strict 2 Decimals) */}
                        <td className="py-3 px-3.5 text-right font-black font-mono text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400 text-sm">
                          ₱{Number(memo.credit_amount || memo.amount || 0).toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}
                        </td>

                        {/* Credit Issued By */}
                        <td className="py-3 px-3.5">
                          <div className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white text-xs truncate max-w-[140px]" title={memo.credit_issued_by}>
                            {memo.credit_issued_by || 'Finance'}
                          </div>
                          <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 font-mono truncate max-w-[140px]">
                            {memo.credit_issued_by_email || ''}
                          </div>
                        </td>

                        {/* Actions */}
                        <td className="py-3 px-3 text-center">
                          <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5">
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => onViewVoucher(memo)}
                              className="p-1.5 text-emerald-600 hover:text-emerald-700 hover:bg-emerald-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                              title="Print Official Credit Voucher"
                            >
                              <Printer className="w-4 h-4" />
                            </button>

                            {canManageCreditMemos && (
                              <button
                                type="button"
                                onClick={() => onEditCreditMemo(memo)}
                                className="p-1.5 text-blue-600 hover:text-blue-700 hover:bg-blue-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                                title="Edit Credit Memo"
                              >
                                <Edit3 className="w-4 h-4" />
                              </button>
                            )}

                            {canManageCreditMemos && onRequestDeleteCreditMemo && (
                              <button
                                type="button"
                                onClick={() => onRequestDeleteCreditMemo(memo)}
                                className="p-1.5 text-rose-500 hover:text-rose-700 hover:bg-rose-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                                title="Void / Delete Credit Memo"
                              >
                                <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                              </button>
                            )}
                          </div>
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    );
                  })}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>

            {/* Pagination */}
            <TablePagination
              currentPage={currentPage}
              pageSize={pageSize}
              totalItems={processedMemos.length}
              onPageChange={setCurrentPage}
              onPageSizeChange={(newSize) => {
                setPageSize(newSize);
                setCurrentPage(1);
              }}
            />
          </div>
        )}

      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import React from 'react';
import { X, Printer, Receipt, CheckCircle2, Building2, UserCheck } from 'lucide-react';

export default function CreditMemoVoucherModal({ isOpen, onClose, creditMemo, creditMemos = [] }) {
  if (!isOpen) return null;

  // Resolve memos array: either passed array or single creditMemo
  const memosToRender = (creditMemos && creditMemos.length > 0)
    ? creditMemos
    : (creditMemo ? [creditMemo] : []);

  if (memosToRender.length === 0) return null;

  const handlePrint = () => {
    const originalTitle = document.title;
    if (memosToRender.length === 1 && memosToRender[0]?.credit_memo_number) {
      document.title = `Credit-Memo-${memosToRender[0].credit_memo_number}`;
    } else if (memosToRender.length > 1) {
      document.title = `Batch-Credit-Memos-${memosToRender.length}-Vouchers`;
    }
    window.print();
    setTimeout(() => {
      document.title = originalTitle;
    }, 1200);
  };

  const isBulk = memosToRender.length > 1;

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[70] flex items-end sm:items-center justify-center p-0 sm:p-6 md:p-8 bg-slate-900/70 backdrop-blur-md animate-in fade-in overflow-y-auto">
      
      {/* Print Specific Stylesheet Injection */}
      <style>{`
        @media print {
          @page {
            size: portrait;
            margin: 10mm 14mm;
          }
          html, body {
            background: #ffffff !important;
            color: #0f172a !important;
            font-size: 11pt !important;
            margin: 0 !important;
            padding: 0 !important;
          }
          #app-main-view-container,
          .print-hidden, .print\\:hidden {
            display: none !important;
          }
          #credit-memo-voucher-print-root {
            position: static !important;
            display: block !important;
            width: 100% !important;
            max-width: 100% !important;
            margin: 0 !important;
            padding: 0 !important;
            background: #ffffff !important;
            box-shadow: none !important;
            border: none !important;
            border-radius: 0 !important;
            overflow: visible !important;
          }
          .voucher-sheet {
            page-break-after: always;
            break-after: page;
            page-break-inside: avoid;
            break-inside: avoid;
            margin: 0 0 10mm 0;
            padding: 12px 16px !important;
            box-sizing: border-box;
            background: #ffffff !important;
          }
          .voucher-sheet:last-child {
            page-break-after: auto;
            break-after: auto;
          }
        }
      `}</style>

      <div 
        id="credit-memo-voucher-print-root"
        className="bg-white rounded-t-3xl sm:rounded-3xl shadow-2xl border border-slate-200 max-w-2xl w-full flex flex-col max-h-[92dvh] sm:max-h-[95vh] overflow-hidden text-slate-900 my-0 sm:my-auto pb-safe"
      >
        {/* Mobile Drag Indicator */}
        <div className="bottom-sheet-handle sm:hidden print:hidden" />
        {/* Top Control Bar (Hidden when printing) */}
        <div className="p-4 sm:px-6 bg-slate-100 border-b border-slate-200 flex items-center justify-between shrink-0 print:hidden">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Receipt className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-600" />
            <span className="font-extrabold text-xs text-slate-800">
              {isBulk ? `Batch Credit Vouchers (${memosToRender.length})` : 'Official Credit Memorandum Voucher'}
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handlePrint}
              className="px-4 py-2 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-black flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-sm transition-all cursor-pointer"
            >
              <Printer className="w-4 h-4" />
              <span>{isBulk ? `Print All ${memosToRender.length} Vouchers` : 'Print Voucher / Save PDF'}</span>
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onClose}
              className="p-2 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 rounded-xl hover:bg-slate-200 transition-colors"
            >
              <X className="w-5 h-5" />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Scrollable Document Container (Contains 1 or multiple vouchers) */}
        <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto divide-y-4 divide-slate-200 print:divide-y-0 print:overflow-visible">
          {memosToRender.map((memo, idx) => (
            <div 
              key={memo.credit_memo_number || idx}
              className="voucher-sheet p-6 sm:p-8 space-y-4 sm:space-y-5 print:p-2 print:space-y-3.5"
            >
              
              {/* Header with Unified Corporate Identity (Divisions Removed) */}
              <div className="border-b-2 border-slate-900 pb-3 sm:pb-4">
                <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4">
                  <div className="pl-1">
                    <div className="text-[11px] font-black tracking-wider uppercase text-slate-500">
                      WHOLESALE DISTRIBUTION & RETURNS
                    </div>
                    <h1 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-black tracking-tight text-slate-900 mt-0.5">
                      FINANCE CREDIT MEMORANDUM
                    </h1>
                    <p className="text-xs text-slate-600 font-medium mt-0.5">
                      Finance & Accounting Department • Official Accounting Voucher
                    </p>
                  </div>

                  <div className="text-right shrink-0">
                    <span className="px-3 py-1 bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 rounded-lg text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wider inline-block">
                      CREDIT MEMO
                    </span>
                    <div className="font-mono font-black text-sm text-slate-900 mt-1">
                      {memo.credit_memo_number}
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">
                      Date: {memo.credit_issued_at ? new Date(memo.credit_issued_at).toLocaleDateString() : new Date().toLocaleDateString()}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Reference Overview Grid */}
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 text-xs bg-slate-50 p-3.5 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200">
                <div>
                  <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 block">Customer / Supplier</span>
                  <div className="font-black text-slate-900 text-sm mt-0.5">
                    {memo.supplier_name || 'Savemore'}
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-600 mt-1 font-mono">
                    Assigned AE: <strong>{memo.customer_ae_name || 'N/A'}</strong>
                    {memo.customer_ae_email ? ` (${memo.customer_ae_email})` : ''}
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="text-right">
                  <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 block">Linked RMA Return Ticket</span>
                  <div className="font-mono font-black text-blue-700 text-sm mt-0.5">
                    {memo.rma_number || 'N/A'}
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-600 mt-1">
                    Pull Out Ref: <strong className="font-semibold">{memo.pull_out_ref || 'N/A'}</strong>
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">
                    Pull Out Date: {memo.pull_out_date || 'N/A'}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Line Items Table */}
              <div className="border border-slate-200 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden">
                <table className="w-full text-left text-xs border-collapse">
                  <thead>
                    <tr className="bg-slate-100 border-b border-slate-200 text-slate-700 font-black uppercase text-[10px]">
                      <th className="py-2 px-3">Item Description</th>
                      <th className="py-2 px-3 font-mono">Barcode / SKU</th>
                      <th className="py-2 px-3 text-center">Qty</th>
                      <th className="py-2 px-3 text-right">Unit Price</th>
                      <th className="py-2 px-3 text-right">Gross Amount</th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100 font-medium">
                    <tr>
                      <td className="py-2.5 px-3">
                        <div className="font-bold text-slate-900 text-xs">{memo.product_name}</div>
                        <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-500">Wholesale Return Pull-Out</div>
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-2.5 px-3 font-mono text-[11px] text-slate-700">
                        <div>{memo.barcode}</div>
                        {memo.sku && <div className="text-slate-400">SKU: {memo.sku}</div>}
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-2.5 px-3 text-center font-bold font-mono">
                        {memo.quantity} {memo.unit_name || 'pc'}
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-2.5 px-3 text-right font-mono">
                        ₱{Number(memo.unit_price || 0).toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-2.5 px-3 text-right font-bold font-mono text-slate-900">
                        ₱{Number(memo.amount || 0).toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </div>

              {/* Financial Summary & Total Credit Box (Strict 2 decimals) */}
              <div className="flex justify-end">
                <div className="w-full sm:w-72 bg-emerald-50 border-2 border-emerald-300 rounded-2xl p-3.5 text-right space-y-1">
                  <div className="text-xs text-slate-600 flex justify-between">
                    <span>Gross Returned Value:</span>
                    <span className="font-mono font-bold">
                      ₱{Number(memo.amount || 0).toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="pt-1.5 border-t border-emerald-200 flex justify-between items-baseline">
                    <span className="text-xs font-black uppercase text-emerald-950">Total Credit Granted:</span>
                    <span className="font-mono text-lg sm:text-xl font-black text-emerald-800">
                      ₱{Number(memo.credit_amount || memo.amount || 0).toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-[10px] text-emerald-700 font-semibold pt-0.5">
                    Approved for account deduction / statement credit
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Accounting Remarks */}
              {memo.notes && (
                <div className="p-2.5 bg-slate-50 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 text-xs text-slate-700">
                  <span className="font-bold block text-[10px] uppercase text-slate-400 mb-0.5">Finance Notes / Audit Remarks:</span>
                  <span>{memo.notes}</span>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Signatures & Certification Grid */}
              <div className="pt-6 sm:pt-7 border-t border-slate-200 grid grid-cols-3 gap-3 text-center text-xs">
                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <div className="border-b border-slate-400 pb-1 font-bold text-slate-900 text-xs">
                    Analiza B. Benoza
                  </div>
                  <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 block">
                    Finance Head
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 font-mono block">
                    {memo.credit_issued_at ? new Date(memo.credit_issued_at).toLocaleString() : ''}
                  </span>
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <div className="border-b border-slate-400 pb-1 font-bold text-slate-900 text-xs">
                    {memo.customer_ae_name || 'Customer AE'}
                  </div>
                  <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 block">
                    Account Executive
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 block">
                    Customer Coordination
                  </span>
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <div className="border-b border-slate-400 pb-1 font-bold text-slate-400 text-xs italic">
                    (Customer Signature)
                  </div>
                  <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 block">
                    Received & Acknowledged
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 block">
                    Customer Authorized Rep
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Document Footer Notice */}
              <div className="text-[10px] text-center text-slate-400 pt-2 border-t border-slate-100">
                This Credit Memorandum is an official accounting instrument. Authorized adjustments are directly applied to company ledger accounts.
              </div>

            </div>
          ))}
        </div>

      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

--- START FILE: src/components/DeleteConfirmationModal.jsx ---
import React from 'react';
import { Trash2, AlertTriangle, X, RefreshCw } from 'lucide-react';

export default function DeleteConfirmationModal({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  onConfirm,
  title = 'Confirm Deletion',
  itemName = '',
  itemType = 'item', // 'product' | 'report' | 'item'
  itemDetails = '',
  isDeleting = false
}) {
  if (!isOpen) return null;

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-end sm:items-center justify-center p-0 sm:p-4 bg-slate-900/65 backdrop-blur-sm animate-in fade-in">
      <div 
        className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 rounded-t-3xl sm:rounded-3xl shadow-2xl border-t sm:border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 max-w-md w-full overflow-hidden animate-in zoom-in-95 duration-150 pb-safe"
        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
      >
        {/* Mobile bottom-sheet drag handle */}
        <div className="sm:hidden pt-2.5 pb-1 flex justify-center shrink-0">
          <div className="w-10 h-1 rounded-full bg-slate-300 dark:bg-slate-700"></div>
        </div>

        {/* Header with Hazard Icon */}
        <div className="p-5 sm:p-6 pb-4 flex items-start gap-4">
          <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-2xl bg-rose-100 dark:bg-rose-950/70 text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 shadow-inner">
            <Trash2 className="w-6 h-6" />
          </div>

          <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <h3 className="text-base sm:text-lg font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white tracking-tight">
                {title}
              </h3>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={onClose}
                disabled={isDeleting}
                className="min-w-[44px] min-h-[44px] flex items-center justify-center text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-slate-200 rounded-xl hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 transition-colors"
                aria-label="Close"
              >
                <X className="w-5 h-5" />
              </button>
            </div>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mt-1">
              Please confirm if you want to permanently remove this {itemType}.
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Item Info Callout */}
        <div className="px-6 pb-2">
          <div className="p-4 bg-rose-50/70 dark:bg-rose-950/40 border border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-900/60 rounded-2xl space-y-1.5">
            <div className="text-xs font-black text-rose-950 dark:text-rose-200 break-words">
              {itemName || `Selected ${itemType}`}
            </div>
            {itemDetails && (
              <div className="text-[11px] font-mono text-rose-800/80 dark:text-rose-300/80">
                {itemDetails}
              </div>
            )}
            <div className="text-[11px] text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-400 pt-1 font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <AlertTriangle className="w-3.5 h-3.5 shrink-0" />
              <span>This record will be permanently deleted from the database.</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Footer Actions */}
        <div className="p-4 sm:px-6 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-900/80 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800/80 flex items-center justify-end gap-2.5 mt-2">
          <button
            type="button"
            disabled={isDeleting}
            onClick={onClose}
            className="px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 text-xs font-bold transition-colors cursor-pointer"
          >
            Cancel
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            disabled={isDeleting}
            onClick={onConfirm}
            className="px-5 py-2.5 bg-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-700 text-white font-extrabold text-xs rounded-xl shadow-md shadow-rose-600/25 flex items-center gap-2 transition-all cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
          >
            {isDeleting ? (
              <RefreshCw className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" />
            ) : (
              <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4" />
            )}
            <span>{isDeleting ? 'Deleting...' : 'Yes, Delete Permanently'}</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

--- START FILE: src/components/EmployeeManagementModal.jsx ---
import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from 'react';
import { X, CheckCircle, AlertTriangle, UserCheck, UserX, Shield, RefreshCw, Plus, Users, Key, Search, Mail, Building2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { authService } from '../services/authService';
import TablePagination from './TablePagination';

const ROLES = [
  { id: 'super_admin', label: '👑 Super Admin', desc: 'Full permissions (manage roles, catalog, verify barcodes, view reports)' },
  { id: 'admin', label: '🛡️ Admin', desc: 'Catalog management, verify barcodes, view reports' },
  { id: 'inventory_staff', label: '📦 Inventory Staff', desc: 'Can verify pending barcodes & update item details' },
  { id: 'viewer', label: '👁️ Viewer', desc: 'Read-only access to view RMA reports' }
];

export default function EmployeeManagementModal({ isOpen, onClose, currentUser }) {
  const [employees, setEmployees] = useState([]);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [roleFilter, setRoleFilter] = useState('all');
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState('all');
  const [sortBy, setSortBy] = useState('name_asc');
  const [currentPage, setCurrentPage] = useState(1);
  const [pageSize, setPageSize] = useState(10);
  const [hrApiKey, setHrApiKey] = useState(authService.getHrApiKey());
  const [showApiKeyInput, setShowApiKeyInput] = useState(false);
  const [isSyncing, setIsSyncing] = useState(false);
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState(null);

  // Add new employee state
  const [isAdding, setIsAdding] = useState(false);
  const [newName, setNewName] = useState('');
  const [newEmail, setNewEmail] = useState('');
  const [newRole, setNewRole] = useState('inventory_staff');
  const [newDept, setNewDept] = useState('Operations');

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      loadEmployees();
    }
  }, [isOpen]);

  const loadEmployees = async () => {
    setIsLoading(true);
    try {
      const list = await authService.getEmployees();
      setEmployees(list);
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('Load employees error:', err);
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const showStatus = (text, type = 'success') => {
    setNotice({ text, type });
    setTimeout(() => setNotice(null), 4000);
  };

  const handleRoleChange = async (email, newRole) => {
    try {
      await authService.setEmployeeRole(email, newRole);
      setEmployees(prev => prev.map(e => e.email === email ? { ...e, role: newRole } : e));
      showStatus(`Updated role for ${email} to ${newRole}`);
    } catch (err) {
      showStatus(err.message, 'error');
    }
  };

  const handleStatusToggle = async (email, currentStatus) => {
    const nextStatus = !currentStatus;
    try {
      await authService.setEmployeeStatus(null, email, nextStatus);
      setEmployees(prev => prev.map(e => e.email === email ? { ...e, is_active: nextStatus } : e));
      showStatus(`Employee ${email} is now marked as ${nextStatus ? 'ACTIVE' : 'RESIGNED'}`);
    } catch (err) {
      showStatus(err.message, 'error');
    }
  };

  const handleAddEmployee = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!newEmail.trim() || !newName.trim()) return;

    try {
      await authService.addEmployee({
        name: newName,
        email: newEmail,
        role: newRole,
        department: newDept
      });
      showStatus(`Added ${newName} (${newEmail}) to company directory!`);
      setNewName('');
      setNewEmail('');
      setIsAdding(false);
      loadEmployees();
    } catch (err) {
      showStatus(err.message, 'error');
    }
  };

  const handleSyncFromHRCenter = async () => {
    setIsSyncing(true);
    setNotice(null);
    try {
      const res = await authService.syncFromHRCenter(hrApiKey);
      showStatus(res.message, 'success');
      loadEmployees();
      setShowApiKeyInput(false);
    } catch (err) {
      showStatus(err.message, 'error');
    } finally {
      setIsSyncing(false);
    }
  };

  // Filter and sort employees memo
  const filteredEmployees = useMemo(() => {
    const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase().trim();
    return employees
      .filter(emp => {
        if (q) {
          const matches = (
            (emp.name || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
            (emp.email || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
            (emp.department || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
            (emp.role || '').toLowerCase().includes(q)
          );
          if (!matches) return false;
        }

        if (roleFilter !== 'all' && (emp.role || 'inventory_staff') !== roleFilter) {
          return false;
        }

        if (statusFilter === 'active' && emp.is_active === false) return false;
        if (statusFilter === 'resigned' && emp.is_active !== false) return false;

        return true;
      })
      .sort((a, b) => {
        if (sortBy === 'name_asc') {
          return (a.name || '').localeCompare(b.name || '');
        } else if (sortBy === 'name_desc') {
          return (b.name || '').localeCompare(a.name || '');
        } else if (sortBy === 'role') {
          return (a.role || '').localeCompare(b.role || '');
        } else if (sortBy === 'status') {
          return (a.is_active === false ? 1 : 0) - (b.is_active === false ? 1 : 0);
        }
        return 0;
      });
  }, [employees, searchQuery, roleFilter, statusFilter, sortBy]);

  // Paginated slice
  const paginatedEmployees = useMemo(() => {
    const start = (currentPage - 1) * pageSize;
    return filteredEmployees.slice(start, start + pageSize);
  }, [filteredEmployees, currentPage, pageSize]);

  // All hooks declared above. Early return only right before JSX render!
  if (!isOpen) return null;

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-end sm:items-center justify-center p-0 sm:p-4 bg-slate-900/60 backdrop-blur-sm animate-in fade-in">
      {/* Outer Card: Clean rounded corners with overflow-hidden so scrollbar never overlaps borders */}
      <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 rounded-t-3xl sm:rounded-3xl shadow-2xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 max-w-2xl w-full flex flex-col max-h-[92dvh] sm:max-h-[88vh] overflow-hidden my-0 sm:my-auto pb-safe">
        {/* Mobile Drag Indicator */}
        <div className="bottom-sheet-handle sm:hidden" />
        
        {/* Pinned Header */}
        <div className="p-5 sm:p-6 pb-4 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between shrink-0 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="p-2.5 bg-purple-100 dark:bg-purple-900/40 text-purple-700 dark:text-purple-300 rounded-2xl shadow-inner">
              <Users className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h2 className="text-base sm:text-lg font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white tracking-tight">
                Employee Access & Roles Management
              </h2>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                Super Admin portal to assign staff roles & toggle active / resigned status.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="p-2 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-slate-200 rounded-xl hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 transition-colors"
          >
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Pinned Top Controls & Search Bar */}
        <div className="p-4 sm:px-6 sm:py-3.5 bg-slate-50/80 dark:bg-slate-900/80 border-b border-slate-200/80 dark:border-slate-800 space-y-3 shrink-0">
          
          {/* Status Notice */}
          {notice && (
            <div className={`p-3 rounded-2xl text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-2 animate-in fade-in ${
              notice.type === 'success' 
                ? 'bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-200 border border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-800' 
                : 'bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/40 text-rose-800 dark:text-rose-200 border border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-800'
            }`}>
              {notice.type === 'success' ? <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0 text-emerald-600" /> : <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0 text-rose-600" />}
              <span>{notice.text}</span>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Quick Toolbar: Add Staff & HR Sync */}
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setIsAdding(!isAdding)}
                className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-extrabold flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-sm transition-all"
              >
                <Plus className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span>Add Employee</span>
              </button>

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setShowApiKeyInput(!showApiKeyInput)}
                className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-sm transition-all"
              >
                <Key className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-400" />
                <span>HR Center API Sync</span>
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
              Total Staff: <strong className="text-slate-800 dark:text-white">{employees.length}</strong>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* SEARCH BAR (Filter by name, company email, or department) */}
          <div className="relative">
            <Search className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400 absolute left-3.5 top-2.5" />
            <input
              type="text"
              value={searchQuery}
              onChange={(e) => {
                setSearchQuery(e.target.value);
                setCurrentPage(1);
              }}
              placeholder="Search by employee name, company email (@keysys, @pingcon, @a2z2go), or department..."
              className="w-full pl-10 pr-9 py-2 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-white placeholder-slate-400 dark:placeholder-slate-500 focus:outline-none focus:border-blue-500 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-100 dark:focus:ring-blue-900/30 shadow-sm transition-all"
            />
            {searchQuery && (
              <button
                onClick={() => {
                  setSearchQuery('');
                  setCurrentPage(1);
                }}
                className="absolute right-3 top-2.5 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-slate-200 p-0.5 rounded-full hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-700"
                title="Clear search"
              >
                <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              </button>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Quick Filters Strip */}
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-xs">
            <select
              value={roleFilter}
              onChange={(e) => {
                setRoleFilter(e.target.value);
                setCurrentPage(1);
              }}
              className="px-2.5 py-1.5 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 focus:outline-none focus:border-blue-500 shadow-xs"
            >
              <option value="all">All Roles</option>
              <option value="super_admin">👑 Super Admin</option>
              <option value="admin">🛡️ Admin</option>
              <option value="inventory_staff">📦 Inventory Staff</option>
              <option value="viewer">👁️ Viewer</option>
            </select>

            <select
              value={statusFilter}
              onChange={(e) => {
                setStatusFilter(e.target.value);
                setCurrentPage(1);
              }}
              className="px-2.5 py-1.5 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 focus:outline-none focus:border-blue-500 shadow-xs"
            >
              <option value="all">All Status</option>
              <option value="active">Active Only</option>
              <option value="resigned">Resigned Only</option>
            </select>

            <select
              value={sortBy}
              onChange={(e) => {
                setSortBy(e.target.value);
                setCurrentPage(1);
              }}
              className="px-2.5 py-1.5 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 focus:outline-none focus:border-blue-500 shadow-xs"
            >
              <option value="name_asc">Sort: Name (A-Z)</option>
              <option value="name_desc">Sort: Name (Z-A)</option>
              <option value="role">Sort: Role</option>
              <option value="status">Sort: Status</option>
            </select>

            {(searchQuery.trim() !== '' || roleFilter !== 'all' || statusFilter !== 'all') && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  setSearchQuery('');
                  setRoleFilter('all');
                  setStatusFilter('all');
                  setCurrentPage(1);
                }}
                className="px-2 py-1.5 bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-300 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 rounded-xl font-bold text-[11px] transition-colors"
              >
                Reset
              </button>
            )}

            <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 font-semibold ml-auto">
              Showing {filteredEmployees.length} of {employees.length}
            </span>
          </div>

          {/* HR Center API Key Drawer */}
          {showApiKeyInput && (
            <div className="p-3.5 bg-purple-50/80 dark:bg-purple-950/40 border border-purple-200 dark:border-purple-800 rounded-2xl space-y-2 text-xs animate-in fade-in">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <span className="font-bold text-purple-900 dark:text-purple-200 block">
                  Sync Active Staff with HR Center API
                </span>
                <span className="text-[10px] text-purple-700 dark:text-purple-400 font-mono">/api/v1/employees</span>
              </div>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-purple-800 dark:text-purple-300 leading-tight">
                Pulls employee records and strictly connects their official company emails (@keysysincorporated.com, @ph.keysys.com, @pingcon.com, @a2z2go.net).
              </p>
              <div className="flex gap-2">
                <input
                  type="password"
                  value={hrApiKey}
                  onChange={(e) => setHrApiKey(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Bearer API Key..."
                  className="flex-1 px-3 py-1.5 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-purple-300 dark:border-purple-700 rounded-xl text-xs font-mono text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-purple-600 shadow-sm"
                />
                <button
                  type="button"
                  disabled={isSyncing || !hrApiKey.trim()}
                  onClick={handleSyncFromHRCenter}
                  className="px-3.5 py-1.5 bg-purple-600 hover:bg-purple-700 disabled:opacity-50 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-sm"
                >
                  {isSyncing ? <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin" /> : <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
                  <span>Sync Now</span>
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Add Employee Form Drawer */}
          {isAdding && (
            <form onSubmit={handleAddEmployee} className="p-3.5 bg-blue-50/70 dark:bg-blue-950/40 border border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-800 rounded-2xl space-y-2.5 text-xs animate-in fade-in">
              <span className="font-bold text-blue-900 dark:text-blue-200 block">Add Authorized Company Staff</span>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                <input
                  type="text"
                  required
                  placeholder="Full Name (e.g. Maria Clara)"
                  value={newName}
                  onChange={(e) => setNewName(e.target.value)}
                  className="px-3 py-2 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 text-slate-900 dark:text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold focus:outline-none focus:border-blue-600"
                />
                <input
                  type="email"
                  required
                  placeholder="Company Email (@keysys, @pingcon...)"
                  value={newEmail}
                  onChange={(e) => setNewEmail(e.target.value)}
                  className="px-3 py-2 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 text-slate-900 dark:text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold focus:outline-none focus:border-blue-600"
                />
              </div>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                <select
                  value={newRole}
                  onChange={(e) => setNewRole(e.target.value)}
                  className="px-3 py-2 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 text-slate-900 dark:text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold focus:outline-none focus:border-blue-600"
                >
                  {ROLES.map(r => (
                    <option key={r.id} value={r.id}>{r.label}</option>
                  ))}
                </select>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  placeholder="Department (e.g. Finance / Warehouse)"
                  value={newDept}
                  onChange={(e) => setNewDept(e.target.value)}
                  className="px-3 py-2 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 text-slate-900 dark:text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold focus:outline-none focus:border-blue-600"
                />
              </div>
              <div className="flex justify-end gap-2 pt-1">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setIsAdding(false)}
                  className="px-3 py-1.5 text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-400 dark:hover:text-slate-200 text-xs font-bold"
                >
                  Cancel
                </button>
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  className="px-4 py-1.5 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold"
                >
                  Save Employee
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          )}

        </div>

        {/* Scrollable Employee List Container (Scrollbar stays strictly within this area, avoiding curved card borders) */}
        <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto px-4 sm:px-6 py-3.5 space-y-2.5 overscroll-contain">
          {filteredEmployees.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="py-12 text-center text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 space-y-1">
              <Users className="w-8 h-8 mx-auto text-slate-300 dark:text-slate-600" />
              <p className="text-xs font-semibold">No employees found matching "{searchQuery}"</p>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500">Try searching with a different name or company email address.</p>
            </div>
          ) : (
            paginatedEmployees.map((emp, idx) => (
              <div
                key={emp.email}
                className={`p-3 sm:p-3.5 rounded-2xl border transition-all flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 text-xs ${
                  emp.is_active === false 
                    ? 'bg-slate-100/80 dark:bg-slate-800/40 border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 opacity-60' 
                    : 'bg-white dark:bg-slate-800/80 hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700/80 shadow-sm'
                }`}
              >
                <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 sm:gap-2">
                    <span className="font-mono font-black text-[10px] text-purple-900 dark:text-purple-300 bg-purple-100 dark:bg-purple-950/80 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-md">
                      #{(currentPage - 1) * pageSize + idx + 1}
                    </span>
                    <span className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white text-sm truncate">
                      {emp.name}
                    </span>
                    {emp.email === currentUser?.email && (
                      <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-black bg-blue-100 dark:bg-blue-900/50 text-blue-800 dark:text-blue-300 shrink-0">
                        YOU
                      </span>
                    )}
                    {emp.role === 'super_admin' && (
                      <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-black bg-purple-100 dark:bg-purple-900/50 text-purple-800 dark:text-purple-300 shrink-0">
                        SUPER ADMIN
                      </span>
                    )}
                    {emp.is_active === false ? (
                      <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-black bg-rose-100 dark:bg-rose-950/60 text-rose-800 dark:text-rose-300 border border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-800 shrink-0">
                        RESIGNED
                      </span>
                    ) : (
                      <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold bg-emerald-100 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-300 shrink-0">
                        ACTIVE
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-[11px] font-mono text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mt-0.5 truncate">
                    <strong className="text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 font-semibold">{emp.email}</strong> • {emp.department || 'General'}
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Role Selection & Active/Resigned Toggle */}
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0 pt-1 sm:pt-0 border-t sm:border-t-0 border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-700/60">
                  <select
                    value={emp.role || 'inventory_staff'}
                    onChange={(e) => handleRoleChange(emp.email, e.target.value)}
                    disabled={emp.email === currentUser?.email}
                    className="px-2.5 py-1.5 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-700 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-600 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 focus:outline-none focus:border-blue-600 disabled:opacity-50"
                  >
                    {ROLES.map(r => (
                      <option key={r.id} value={r.id}>{r.label}</option>
                    ))}
                  </select>

                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => handleStatusToggle(emp.email, emp.is_active !== false)}
                    disabled={emp.email === currentUser?.email}
                    className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1 transition-all disabled:opacity-30 ${
                      emp.is_active !== false
                        ? 'bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/40 hover:bg-rose-100 dark:hover:bg-rose-900/60 text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300 border border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-800'
                        : 'bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 hover:bg-emerald-100 dark:hover:bg-emerald-900/60 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-800'
                    }`}
                    title={emp.is_active !== false ? 'Mark as Resigned (Block Access)' : 'Restore Active Access'}
                  >
                    {emp.is_active !== false ? (
                      <>
                        <UserX className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                        <span>Mark Resigned</span>
                      </>
                    ) : (
                      <>
                        <UserCheck className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                        <span>Reactivate</span>
                      </>
                    )}
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Pinned Footer with pagination */}
        <div className="bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-900 border-t border-slate-200/80 dark:border-slate-800 shrink-0">
          <TablePagination
            currentPage={currentPage}
            pageSize={pageSize}
            totalItems={filteredEmployees.length}
            onPageChange={setCurrentPage}
            onPageSizeChange={(newSize) => {
              setPageSize(newSize);
              setCurrentPage(1);
            }}
          />
        </div>

      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

--- END FILE: src/components/EmployeeManagementModal.jsx ---

--- START FILE: src/components/FinanceCreditMemoTab.jsx ---
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { 
  DollarSign, 
  CheckSquare, 
  Square, 
  FileCheck2, 
  Receipt, 
  AlertCircle, 
  Clock, 
  Building2, 
  CheckCircle2,
  Calendar,
  UserCheck
} from 'lucide-react';
import { formatPeso } from '../utils/rmaHelpers';

export default function FinanceCreditMemoTab({ tickets = [], onUpdateTicket }) {
  const [selectedTicketId, setSelectedTicketId] = useState(null);
  const [creditMemoNo, setCreditMemoNo] = useState('');
  const [creditAmount, setCreditAmount] = useState('');
  const [issuedBy, setIssuedBy] = useState('Analiza B. Benoza');
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [toastMessage, setToastMessage] = useState(null);

  // Financial Stats
  const totalRmaValue = tickets.reduce((acc, t) => acc + (Number(t.total_amount) || 0), 0);
  const totalCreditIssued = tickets
    .filter(t => t.status === 'Credit Memo Issued')
    .reduce((acc, t) => acc + (Number(t.credit_amount) || Number(t.total_amount) || 0), 0);
  const pendingCreditValue = tickets
    .filter(t => t.status !== 'Credit Memo Issued' && t.status !== 'Rejected')
    .reduce((acc, t) => acc + (Number(t.total_amount) || 0), 0);
  const totalPullOuts = tickets.filter(t => t.pull_out_confirmed).length;

  // Select ticket to issue memo
  const handleSelectTicketForMemo = (ticket) => {
    setSelectedTicketId(ticket.id);
    const year = new Date().getFullYear();
    const randomSeq = String(Math.floor(1000 + Math.random() * 9000));
    setCreditMemoNo(`CM-${year}-${randomSeq}`);
    setCreditAmount(ticket.total_amount);
  };

  // Toggle Pull-Out confirmation checkbox
  const handleTogglePullOut = async (ticket) => {
    const updatedStatus = !ticket.pull_out_confirmed;
    await onUpdateTicket(ticket.id, {
      pull_out_confirmed: updatedStatus,
      status: updatedStatus && ticket.status === 'Pending Inspection' ? 'In Transit' : ticket.status
    });
    showToast(`Physical pull-out ${updatedStatus ? 'CONFIRMED' : 'UNCHECKED'} for ${ticket.id}`);
  };

  // Issue Credit Memo submission
  const handleIssueCreditMemo = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!selectedTicketId) return;

    if (!creditMemoNo.trim()) {
      alert('Please enter a Credit Memo number.');
      return;
    }

    const amt = Number(creditAmount);
    if (isNaN(amt) || amt <= 0) {
      alert('Please enter a valid credit amount in ₱.');
      return;
    }

    setIsSubmitting(true);
    try {
      await onUpdateTicket(selectedTicketId, {
        credit_memo_no: creditMemoNo.trim(),
        credit_amount: amt,
        credit_issued_by: issuedBy,
        credit_issued_date: new Date().toISOString(),
        status: 'Credit Memo Issued',
        pull_out_confirmed: true
      });

      showToast(`Credit Memo ${creditMemoNo} successfully issued for ${formatPeso(amt)}!`);
      setSelectedTicketId(null);
      setCreditMemoNo('');
      setCreditAmount('');
    } catch (err) {
      alert('Error issuing credit memo: ' + err.message);
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const showToast = (msg) => {
    setToastMessage(msg);
    setTimeout(() => setToastMessage(null), 4000);
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      
      {/* Toast Alert */}
      {toastMessage && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950 border border-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-500/40 text-emerald-900 dark:text-emerald-200 rounded-2xl flex items-center space-x-3 text-xs sm:text-sm animate-in slide-in-from-top-2 shadow-sm">
          <CheckCircle2 className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 shrink-0" />
          <span className="font-semibold">{toastMessage}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* KPI Cards */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-3.5 sm:gap-4">
        <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-2xl p-4 shadow-sm">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 text-xs mb-1">
            <span>Total Returns Value</span>
            <DollarSign className="w-4 h-4 text-brand-600 dark:text-brand-400" />
          </div>
          <div className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-black font-mono text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
            {formatPeso(totalRmaValue)}
          </div>
          <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400">Gross claimed merchandise</span>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-2xl p-4 shadow-sm">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 text-xs mb-1">
            <span>Credit Memos Issued</span>
            <Receipt className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400" />
          </div>
          <div className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-black font-mono text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">
            {formatPeso(totalCreditIssued)}
          </div>
          <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400">Credited to customer accounts</span>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-2xl p-4 shadow-sm">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 text-xs mb-1">
            <span>Pending Credit Balance</span>
            <Clock className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-500" />
          </div>
          <div className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-black font-mono text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400">
            {formatPeso(pendingCreditValue)}
          </div>
          <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400">Awaiting finance reconciliation</span>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-2xl p-4 shadow-sm">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 text-xs mb-1">
            <span>Pull-Out Verified</span>
            <CheckSquare className="w-4 h-4 text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-400" />
          </div>
          <div className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-black font-mono text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-400">
            {totalPullOuts} of {tickets.length} Units
          </div>
          <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400">Physical receipt at warehouse</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Main Finance Workstation Grid */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
        
        {/* Left Column: RMA Pull-out & Returns Table (2 Cols) */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-2 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-3xl p-5 sm:p-6 shadow-sm space-y-4">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 pb-3">
            <div>
              <h2 className="text-base font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white flex items-center gap-2">
                <FileCheck2 className="w-5 h-5 text-brand-600 dark:text-brand-400" />
                <span>Warehouse Pull-Out & Finance Clearance</span>
              </h2>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                Confirm physical pull-out checkbox, then select ticket to authorize Credit Memo.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-3 max-h-[620px] overflow-y-auto pr-1">
            {tickets.map((ticket) => {
              const isSelected = selectedTicketId === ticket.id;
              const isCredited = ticket.status === 'Credit Memo Issued';

              return (
                <div
                  key={ticket.id}
                  className={`p-4 rounded-2xl border transition-all ${
                    isSelected 
                      ? 'bg-brand-50/50 dark:bg-brand-950/40 border-brand-500 ring-1 ring-brand-500/40' 
                      : isCredited
                      ? 'bg-slate-50/60 dark:bg-slate-950/40 border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800/80'
                      : 'bg-white dark:bg-slate-950/70 border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 hover:border-slate-300 dark:hover:border-slate-700'
                  }`}
                >
                  <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
                    
                    {/* Pull-out checkbox */}
                    <div className="flex items-start space-x-3">
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => handleTogglePullOut(ticket)}
                        className="mt-0.5 text-slate-400 hover:text-brand-600 transition-colors"
                        title="Toggle Physical Pull-Out Confirmation"
                      >
                        {ticket.pull_out_confirmed ? (
                          <CheckSquare className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400" />
                        ) : (
                          <Square className="w-5 h-5 text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-600" />
                        )}
                      </button>

                      <div className="space-y-1">
                        <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                          <span className="font-mono font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white text-sm">{ticket.id}</span>
                          <span className="text-xs px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 font-mono">
                            {ticket.sku}
                          </span>
                          {ticket.pull_out_confirmed ? (
                            <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400 bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-500/15 border border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-500/30 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded">
                              PULL-OUT CONFIRMED
                            </span>
                          ) : (
                            <span className="text-[10px] font-medium text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400 bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-500/10 border border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-500/20 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded">
                              Awaiting Logistics Pull-Out
                            </span>
                          )}
                        </div>

                        <div className="text-xs text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 font-medium">
                          {ticket.product_name} ({ticket.quantity} units)
                        </div>

                        <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 flex items-center space-x-2">
                          <span>{ticket.customer_name}</span>
                          <span>•</span>
                          <span>AE: {ticket.ae_name}</span>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* Right: Value & Issue Action */}
                    <div className="text-right space-y-1.5 shrink-0">
                      <div className="text-sm font-bold font-mono text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">
                        {formatPeso(ticket.total_amount)}
                      </div>

                      {isCredited ? (
                        <div className="text-[11px] font-mono text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300 bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 border border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-500/40 px-2 py-1 rounded-lg">
                          CM #{ticket.credit_memo_no}
                        </div>
                      ) : (
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => handleSelectTicketForMemo(ticket)}
                          className="px-3 py-1 bg-brand-600 hover:bg-brand-500 text-white text-xs font-semibold rounded-lg shadow-sm transition-colors"
                        >
                          {isSelected ? 'Editing Memo...' : 'Issue Credit Memo'}
                        </button>
                      )}
                    </div>

                  </div>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Right Column: Issue Credit Memo Form (1 Col) */}
        <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-3xl p-5 sm:p-6 shadow-sm space-y-4 self-start">
          <div className="border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 pb-3">
            <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white flex items-center gap-2">
              <Receipt className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400" />
              <span>Credit Memo Generator</span>
            </h3>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
              {selectedTicketId 
                ? `Authorizing Credit Memo for ${selectedTicketId}` 
                : 'Select an RMA ticket from the list to issue credit memo'}
            </p>
          </div>

          {selectedTicketId ? (
            <form onSubmit={handleIssueCreditMemo} className="space-y-4 text-xs">
              
              <div>
                <label className="block font-medium text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mb-1">
                  Credit Memo #
                </label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  required
                  value={creditMemoNo}
                  onChange={(e) => setCreditMemoNo(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="e.g. CM-2026-089"
                  className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-sm text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 font-mono focus:outline-none focus:border-brand-500"
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block font-medium text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mb-1">
                  Credit Amount (₱)
                </label>
                <div className="relative">
                  <span className="absolute left-3 top-2.5 text-slate-400 font-mono">₱</span>
                  <input
                    type="number"
                    step="0.01"
                    required
                    value={creditAmount}
                    onChange={(e) => setCreditAmount(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl pl-7 pr-3 py-2 text-sm text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 font-mono focus:outline-none focus:border-brand-500 font-bold text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block font-medium text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mb-1">
                  Issued By (Finance Officer)
                </label>
                <select
                  value={issuedBy}
                  onChange={(e) => setIssuedBy(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-xs text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 focus:outline-none focus:border-brand-500"
                >
                  <option value="Analiza B. Benoza">Analiza B. Benoza (Finance Head)</option>
                  <option value="Finance Accounting Lead (A2Z2Go)">Finance Accounting Lead (A2Z2Go)</option>
                  <option value="Billing Specialist (Pingcon Marketing)">Billing Specialist (Pingcon Marketing)</option>
                </select>
              </div>

              <div className="p-3 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 space-y-1 text-[11px] text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 font-mono">
                <div className="flex justify-between">
                  <span className="text-slate-400">Date:</span>
                  <span>{new Date().toLocaleDateString()}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-between">
                  <span className="text-slate-400">General Ledger:</span>
                  <span className="text-brand-600 dark:text-brand-300">GL-4010 (Sales Returns)</span>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="pt-2 flex items-center space-x-2">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setSelectedTicketId(null)}
                  className="w-1/3 py-2.5 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 font-medium rounded-xl transition-colors"
                >
                  Cancel
                </button>
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  disabled={isSubmitting}
                  className="flex-1 py-2.5 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white font-bold rounded-xl shadow-md transition-all flex items-center justify-center space-x-1.5"
                >
                  <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                  <span>{isSubmitting ? 'Posting...' : 'AUTHORIZE CREDIT'}</span>
                </button>
              </div>

            </form>
          ) : (
            <div className="py-12 px-4 text-center text-slate-400 space-y-2">
              <Receipt className="w-12 h-12 text-slate-300 dark:text-slate-700 mx-auto" />
              <p className="text-xs">
                No ticket selected. Click <strong>"Issue Credit Memo"</strong> on any verified return to post credit.
              </p>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

      </div>

    </div>
  );
}
