export function formatDurationLabel(hours) {
  const h = Number(hours || 0);
  if (h <= 0) return 'Permanent (0h)';
  const totalMins = Math.round(h * 60);
  if (totalMins < 60) return `${totalMins} Minute${totalMins === 1 ? '' : 's'}`;
  if (totalMins % 60 === 0) {
    const hoursNum = totalMins / 60;
    return `${hoursNum} Hour${hoursNum === 1 ? '' : 's'}`;
  }
  return `${totalMins} Minutes`;
}

export function formatCooldownLabel(hours) {
  const h = Number(hours || 0);
  if (h <= 0) return 'Disabled (0h)';
  const totalMins = Math.round(h * 60);
  if (totalMins < 60) return `${totalMins} Minute${totalMins === 1 ? '' : 's'}`;
  if (totalMins % 60 === 0) {
    const hoursNum = totalMins / 60;
    return `${hoursNum} Hour${hoursNum === 1 ? '' : 's'}`;
  }
  return `${totalMins} Minutes`;
}

export default function PortalAccessKeysModal({ isOpen, onClose, currentUser, onOpenPinRequests }) {
  const [profiles, setProfiles] = useState([]);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);
  const [copiedSlug, setCopiedSlug] = useState(null);
  const [visiblePins, setVisiblePins] = useState(new Set());

  // Modal Sub-States: 'list' | 'create' | 'edit' | 'print'
  const [modalMode, setModalMode] = useState('list');
  const [selectedProfile, setSelectedProfile] = useState(null);

  // Form State for Create / Edit
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    name: '',
    type: 'internal_warehouse',
    accessSlug: '',
    pinCode: '123456',
    sessionDurationHours: 0
  });
  const [formError, setFormError] = useState('');
  const [isSaving, setIsSaving] = useState(false);

  // Dynamic Session Duration Mode: 'permanent' | 'custom'
  const [durationMode, setDurationMode] = useState('permanent');
  const [customDurationVal, setCustomDurationVal] = useState(2);
  const [customDurationUnit, setCustomDurationUnit] = useState('hrs');
  // Cooldown Lockout Duration (Hours or Minutes) for Anti-Fraud Lockout
  const [cooldownDurationVal, setCooldownDurationVal] = useState(6);
  const [cooldownDurationUnit, setCooldownDurationUnit] = useState('hrs');

  // Dynamic Print Sizes: 'a4' | '4x6' | '3x3' | '2x2'
  const [printSize, setPrintSize] = useState('a4');

  // Print Poster Options
  const [showPinOnPoster, setShowPinOnPoster] = useState(true);
  const [isDownloadingPoster, setIsDownloadingPoster] = useState(false);

  // Load profiles on open
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      loadProfiles();
      setModalMode('list');
      setFormError('');
    }
  }, [isOpen]);

  const loadProfiles = async () => {
    setIsLoading(true);
    try {
      const list = await accessKeyService.getProfiles();
      setProfiles(list || []);
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Failed to load profiles:', e);
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const isAuthorized = currentUser?.role === 'super_admin' || currentUser?.role === 'admin';
  if (!isAuthorized) {
    return (
      <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-slate-950/80 backdrop-blur-sm animate-in fade-in duration-200">
        <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-900/60 rounded-3xl p-6 sm:p-8 max-w-md w-full text-center space-y-4 shadow-2xl">
          <div className="w-14 h-14 rounded-2xl bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/70 border border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-800 text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 flex items-center justify-center mx-auto">
            <ShieldAlert className="w-7 h-7" />
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <h3 className="text-lg font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white">Admin Access Restricted</h3>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 leading-relaxed">
              QR Access Keys & 6-Digit PIN management is restricted strictly to <strong>Super Admin</strong> and <strong>Admin</strong> roles.
            </p>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            className="w-full py-2.5 bg-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-colors cursor-pointer"
          >
            Close Window
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const originUrl = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window.location.origin : 'https://rma-portal-v2.vercel.app';

  const togglePinVisibility = (id) => {
    setVisiblePins(prev => {
      const next = new Set(prev);
      if (next.has(id)) next.delete(id);
      else next.add(id);
      return next;
    });
  };

  const handleCopyLink = (slug) => {
    const fullUrl = `${originUrl}/intake/${slug}`;
    try {
      navigator.clipboard.writeText(fullUrl);
      setCopiedSlug(slug);
      setTimeout(() => setCopiedSlug(null), 2000);
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Copy failed:', e);
    }
  };

  const generateRandomPin = () => {
    const pin = Math.floor(100000 + Math.random() * 900000).toString();
    setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, pinCode: pin }));
  };

  // Open Create Modal
  const handleOpenCreate = () => {
    setFormData({
      name: '',
      type: 'internal_warehouse',
      accessSlug: '',
      pinCode: Math.floor(100000 + Math.random() * 900000).toString(),
      sessionDurationHours: 0
    });
    setDurationMode('permanent');
    setCustomDurationVal(2);
    setCustomDurationUnit('hrs');
    setCooldownDurationVal(6);
    setCooldownDurationUnit('hrs');
    setFormError('');
    setModalMode('create');
  };

  // Open Edit Modal
  const handleOpenEdit = (prof) => {
    setSelectedProfile(prof);
    const h = Number(prof.session_duration_hours || 0);
    if (h <= 0) {
      setDurationMode('permanent');
      setCustomDurationVal(2);
      setCustomDurationUnit('hrs');
    } else if (h * 60 < 60) {
      setDurationMode('custom');
      setCustomDurationVal(Math.round(h * 60));
      setCustomDurationUnit('mins');
    } else {
      setDurationMode('custom');
      setCustomDurationVal(h);
      setCustomDurationUnit('hrs');
    }

    const cd = Number(prof.cooldown_duration_hours || 0);
    if (cd <= 0) {
      setCooldownDurationVal(0);
      setCooldownDurationUnit('hrs');
    } else if (cd * 60 < 60) {
      setCooldownDurationVal(Math.round(cd * 60));
      setCooldownDurationUnit('mins');
    } else {
      setCooldownDurationVal(cd);
      setCooldownDurationUnit('hrs');
    }
    setFormData({
      name: prof.name,
      type: prof.type,
      accessSlug: prof.access_slug,
      pinCode: prof.pin_code,
      sessionDurationHours: h
    });
    setFormError('');
    setModalMode('edit');
  };

  // Emergency Reset Cooldowns (Instantly unlocks all blocked devices for this QR profile)
  const handleEmergencyResetCooldowns = async (prof) => {
    if (!window.confirm(`Emergency Reset Cooldowns for "${prof.name}" (/${prof.access_slug})?\n\nThis will immediately unlock all physical devices and allow users to re-authenticate with the PIN.`)) return;

    try {
      await accessKeyService.emergencyResetCooldowns(prof.access_slug, prof.id);
      alert(`Emergency Reset Successful: All device lockouts for "${prof.name}" have been cleared.`);
    } catch (err) {
      alert(err.message || 'Failed to clear cooldown lockouts');
    }
  };

  // Open Print Poster Modal
  const handleOpenPrint = (prof) => {
    setSelectedProfile(prof);
    setShowPinOnPoster(prof.type === 'internal_warehouse');
    setModalMode('print');
  };

  // Toggle Active/Inactive Status
  const handleToggleActive = async (prof) => {
    try {
      await accessKeyService.updateProfile(prof.access_slug, { is_active: !prof.is_active });
      loadProfiles();
    } catch (err) {
      alert(err.message || 'Failed to update status');
    }
  };

  // Submit Create or Edit Form
  const handleSubmitForm = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setFormError('');

    if (!formData.name.trim()) {
      setFormError('Please enter a profile name');
      return;
    }

    if (!/^\d{6}$/.test(String(formData.pinCode).trim())) {
      setFormError('PIN code must be exactly 6 numeric digits (0-9)');
      return;
    }

    setIsSaving(true);
    let finalDurationHours = 0;
    if (durationMode === 'custom') {
      const numVal = Math.max(0.1, parseFloat(customDurationVal) || 1);
      finalDurationHours = customDurationUnit === 'mins' ? numVal / 60 : numVal;
    }

    try {
      let finalCooldown = 0;
      if (formData.type === 'external_customer') {
        const cdNum = parseFloat(cooldownDurationVal) || 0;
        if (cdNum > 0) {
          finalCooldown = cooldownDurationUnit === 'mins' ? cdNum / 60 : cdNum;
        }
      }

      if (modalMode === 'create') {
        await accessKeyService.createProfile({
          name: formData.name,
          type: formData.type,
          accessSlug: formData.accessSlug,
          pinCode: formData.pinCode,
          sessionDurationHours: finalDurationHours,
          cooldownDurationHours: finalCooldown,
          createdBy: currentUser?.name || 'Admin'
        });
      } else if (modalMode === 'edit' && selectedProfile) {
        await accessKeyService.updateProfile(selectedProfile.access_slug, {
          name: formData.name,
          type: formData.type,
          pin_code: formData.pinCode,
          session_duration_hours: finalDurationHours,
          cooldown_duration_hours: finalCooldown
        });
      }

      await loadProfiles();
      setModalMode('list');
    } catch (err) {
      setFormError(err.message || 'Failed to save profile');
    } finally {
      setIsSaving(false);
    }
  };

  // Delete profile
  const handleDeleteProfile = async (prof) => {
    if (!window.confirm(`Permanently delete QR Access Profile "${prof.name}" (/${prof.access_slug})?\n\nDevices scanning this QR code will no longer be granted intake access.`)) return;

    try {
      await accessKeyService.deleteProfile(prof.access_slug);
      await loadProfiles();
    } catch (err) {
      alert(err.message || 'Failed to delete');
    }
  };

  // High-Fidelity Isolated Print Handler (Guarantees exactly 1 page & 100% preview match)
  const handlePrintPoster = () => {
    const sizeConfig = {
      'a4': {
        pageSize: 'A4 portrait',
        pageMargin: '0.3in',
        scale: 1.0,
        customStyles: `
          #portal-poster-print-mount {
            width: 100% !important;
            max-width: 180mm !important;
            box-shadow: none !important;
            margin: 0 auto !important;
            box-sizing: border-box !important;
          }
        `
      },
      '4x6': {
        pageSize: '4in 6in',
        pageMargin: '0.2in',
        scale: 1.0,
        customStyles: `
          #portal-poster-print-mount {
            width: 3.0in !important;
            max-width: 3.0in !important;
            box-shadow: none !important;
            margin: 0 auto !important;
            box-sizing: border-box !important;
          }
        `
      },
      '3x3': {
        pageSize: '3in 3in',
        pageMargin: '0.1in',
        scale: 1.0,
        customStyles: `
          #portal-poster-print-mount {
            width: 2.15in !important;
            max-width: 2.15in !important;
            box-shadow: none !important;
            margin: 0 auto !important;
            box-sizing: border-box !important;
            border-width: 1.5px !important;
            padding: 8px !important;
          }
        `
      },
      '2x2': {
        pageSize: '2in 2in',
        pageMargin: '0.05in',
        scale: 1.0,
        customStyles: `
          #portal-poster-print-mount {
            width: 1.45in !important;
            max-width: 1.45in !important;
            box-shadow: none !important;
            margin: 0 auto !important;
            box-sizing: border-box !important;
            border-width: 1.5px !important;
            padding: 5px !important;
          }
        `
      }
    }[printSize] || { pageSize: 'A4 portrait', pageMargin: '0.3in', scale: 1.0, customStyles: '' };

    printIsolatedElement({
      elementId: 'portal-poster-print-mount',
      documentTitle: `RMA-QR-${selectedProfile?.access_slug || 'Station'}-${printSize}`,
      pageSize: sizeConfig.pageSize,
      pageMargin: sizeConfig.pageMargin,
      scale: sizeConfig.scale,
      customStyles: sizeConfig.customStyles
    });
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 sm:p-6 md:p-8 overflow-y-auto bg-slate-950/80 backdrop-blur-md animate-in fade-in duration-200">
      <div 
        className="relative w-full max-w-4xl my-auto bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-3xl shadow-2xl overflow-hidden flex flex-col max-h-[85vh] animate-in zoom-in-95 duration-150"
        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
      >

        {/* Modal Header */}
        <div className="px-4 sm:px-8 py-3.5 sm:py-5 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 shrink-0 bg-slate-50/80 dark:bg-slate-800/50 space-y-2.5 sm:space-y-0 sm:flex sm:items-center sm:justify-between">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between sm:justify-start gap-2.5 min-w-0">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 min-w-0">
              <div className="w-9 h-9 sm:w-10 sm:h-10 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-br from-blue-600 to-indigo-700 text-white flex items-center justify-center shadow-md shadow-blue-600/20 shrink-0">
                <KeyRound className="w-4 h-4 sm:w-5 sm:h-5" />
              </div>
              <div className="min-w-0">
                <h2 className="text-sm sm:text-base font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap">
                  <span className="truncate">QR Access Keys & PINs</span>
                  <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[9px] font-extrabold bg-blue-100 text-blue-800 dark:bg-blue-950 dark:text-blue-300 shrink-0">
                    Gatekeeper
                  </span>
                </h2>
                <p className="text-[11px] sm:text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 line-clamp-1">
                  Authorize warehouse docks & customer delivery cartons
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Mobile close button (top-right of header) */}
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onClose}
              className="sm:hidden p-2 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-slate-200 rounded-xl hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 transition-colors cursor-pointer shrink-0"
              aria-label="Close modal"
            >
              <X className="w-5 h-5" />
            </button>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap sm:flex-nowrap">
            {modalMode === 'list' && (
              <>
                {onOpenPinRequests && (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={onOpenPinRequests}
                    className="flex-1 sm:flex-initial px-3 py-2 bg-amber-50 hover:bg-amber-100 dark:bg-amber-950/60 dark:hover:bg-amber-900/60 text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-200 border border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-800 rounded-xl text-xs font-black flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 transition-all cursor-pointer active:scale-95"
                    title="View & Approve Pending Return Authorization PIN Requests"
                  >
                    <Mail className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400" />
                    <span>PIN Requests</span>
                  </button>
                )}
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handleOpenCreate}
                  className="flex-1 sm:flex-initial px-3.5 py-2 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-black flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 shadow-md shadow-blue-600/20 transition-all cursor-pointer active:scale-95 whitespace-nowrap"
                >
                  <Plus className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
                  <span>New QR Code</span>
                </button>
              </>
            )}

            {/* Desktop close button */}
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onClose}
              className="hidden sm:block p-2 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-slate-200 rounded-xl hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 transition-colors cursor-pointer shrink-0 ml-1"
              aria-label="Close modal"
            >
              <X className="w-5 h-5" />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* =================================================================== */}
        {/* VIEW 1: PROFILE LIST VIEW                                           */}
        {/* =================================================================== */}
        {modalMode === 'list' && (
          <div className="p-6 sm:p-8 overflow-y-auto space-y-4 flex-1">
            {isLoading ? (
              <div className="text-center py-12 space-y-2">
                <div className="w-6 h-6 border-2 border-blue-600 border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin mx-auto" />
                <p className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-500">Loading Access Profiles...</p>
              </div>
            ) : profiles.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="text-center py-12 space-y-3 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800/50 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700">
                <QrCode className="w-10 h-10 text-slate-400 mx-auto" />
                <p className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200">No custom QR Access Profiles yet.</p>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handleOpenCreate}
                  className="px-4 py-2 bg-blue-600 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold"
                >
                  Create First QR Profile
                </button>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                {profiles.map(prof => {
                  const isPinShown = visiblePins.has(prof.id || prof.access_slug);
                  const isCopied = copiedSlug === prof.access_slug;
                  const fullUrl = `${originUrl}/intake/${prof.access_slug}`;

                  return (
                    <div 
                      key={prof.id || prof.access_slug}
                      className={`relative p-5 rounded-2xl border transition-all ${
                        prof.is_active 
                          ? 'bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 shadow-sm hover:border-blue-400 dark:hover:border-blue-700' 
                          : 'bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-900/50 border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 opacity-60'
                      }`}
                    >
                      {/* Top Badges */}
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 mb-3">
                        <span className={`px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider ${
                          prof.type === 'internal_warehouse'
                            ? 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-800 dark:bg-blue-950 dark:text-blue-300 border border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-900'
                            : 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 dark:bg-emerald-950 dark:text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-900'
                        }`}>
                          {prof.type === 'internal_warehouse' ? 'Internal Warehouse' : 'External Customer'}
                        </span>

                        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                          <span className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold ${
                            prof.is_active 
                              ? 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 dark:text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-900'
                              : 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-400'
                          }`}>
                            {prof.is_active ? 'Active' : 'Inactive'}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      {/* Station Title */}
                      <div className="flex items-start gap-3 mb-4">
                        <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 p-1 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 shrink-0 flex items-center justify-center">
                          <QRCodeSVG 
                            value={fullUrl}
                            size={40}
                            level="M"
                          />
                        </div>
                        <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                          <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white truncate">
                            {prof.name}
                          </h3>
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] font-mono text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mt-0.5">
                            <span className="truncate">/intake/{prof.access_slug}</span>
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => handleCopyLink(prof.access_slug)}
                              className="text-blue-600 hover:text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-400 p-0.5"
                              title="Copy full scan URL"
                            >
                              {isCopied ? <Check className="w-3 h-3 text-emerald-600" /> : <Copy className="w-3 h-3" />}
                            </button>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      {/* Detail Metrics: 6-Digit PIN, Active Session, & Cooldown Window */}
                      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-2 p-2.5 sm:p-3 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800/60 rounded-xl border border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 text-xs mb-3.5">
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between sm:block">
                          <div className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase text-slate-400">6-Digit PIN</div>
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-1 font-mono font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white mt-0.5">
                            <span className="truncate">{isPinShown ? prof.pin_code : '••••••'}</span>
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => togglePinVisibility(prof.id || prof.access_slug)}
                              className="text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 p-0.5 shrink-0"
                            >
                              {isPinShown ? <EyeOff className="w-3 h-3" /> : <Eye className="w-3 h-3" />}
                            </button>
                          </div>
                        </div>

                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between sm:block pt-1.5 sm:pt-0 border-t sm:border-t-0 border-slate-200/50 dark:border-slate-700/50">
                          <div className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase text-slate-400">Session Window</div>
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-1 font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mt-0.5 truncate">
                            <Clock className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-400 shrink-0" />
                            <span className="truncate">{formatDurationLabel(prof.session_duration_hours)}</span>
                          </div>
                        </div>

                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between sm:block pt-1.5 sm:pt-0 border-t sm:border-t-0 border-slate-200/50 dark:border-slate-700/50">
                          <div className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase text-slate-400">Anti-Fraud Cooldown</div>
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-1 font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mt-0.5 truncate">
                            <ShieldAlert className="w-3 h-3 text-amber-500 shrink-0" />
                            <span className="truncate">
                              {prof.type === 'internal_warehouse' ? 'Disabled' : formatCooldownLabel(prof.cooldown_duration_hours)}
                            </span>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      {/* Card Action Buttons */}
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-1 pt-2 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 text-xs font-bold">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-1 flex-wrap">
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => handleOpenPrint(prof)}
                            className="px-2.5 py-1.5 bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 rounded-lg flex items-center gap-1 transition-colors cursor-pointer text-xs font-bold"
                            title="Print official wall poster or delivery carton sticker"
                          >
                            <Printer className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                            <span>Poster / Sticker</span>
                          </button>

                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => handleOpenEdit(prof)}
                            className="px-2.5 py-1.5 bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 rounded-lg flex items-center gap-1 transition-colors cursor-pointer text-xs font-bold"
                            title="Change PIN, Session Duration, or Cooldown Lockout"
                          >
                            <Edit3 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                            <span>Edit PIN</span>
                          </button>

                          {prof.type === 'external_customer' && (
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => handleEmergencyResetCooldowns(prof)}
                              className="px-2.5 py-1.5 bg-amber-50 hover:bg-amber-100 dark:bg-amber-950/60 dark:hover:bg-amber-900/60 text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-300 border border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-900 rounded-lg flex items-center gap-1 transition-colors cursor-pointer text-xs font-bold"
                              title="Emergency Reset: Instantly clears all device lockouts for this QR profile"
                            >
                              <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                              <span>Clear Cooldowns</span>
                            </button>
                          )}

                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => handleDeleteProfile(prof)}
                            className="px-2.5 py-1.5 bg-rose-50 hover:bg-rose-100 dark:bg-rose-950/60 dark:hover:bg-rose-900/60 text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300 border border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-900 rounded-lg flex items-center gap-1 transition-colors cursor-pointer text-xs font-bold"
                            title="Permanently Delete QR Profile"
                          >
                            <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                            <span>Delete</span>
                          </button>
                        </div>

                        <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => handleToggleActive(prof)}
                            className={`p-1.5 rounded-lg border transition-colors cursor-pointer ${
                              prof.is_active
                                ? 'text-amber-600 hover:bg-amber-50 dark:hover:bg-amber-950 border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-900'
                                : 'text-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-50 dark:hover:bg-emerald-950 border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-900'
                            }`}
                            title={prof.is_active ? 'Deactivate QR Profile' : 'Reactivate QR Profile'}
                          >
                            <Power className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                          </button>
                        </div>
                      </div>

                    </div>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        )}

        {/* =================================================================== */}
        {/* VIEW 2: CREATE / EDIT PROFILE FORM                                  */}
        {/* =================================================================== */}
        {(modalMode === 'create' || modalMode === 'edit') && (
          <form onSubmit={handleSubmitForm} className="p-6 sm:p-8 overflow-y-auto space-y-5 flex-1">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 pb-3">
              <h3 className="text-sm font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                {modalMode === 'create' ? 'Generate New QR Access Profile' : `Edit Profile: ${selectedProfile?.name}`}
              </h3>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setModalMode('list')}
                className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-800"
              >
                Back to List
              </button>
            </div>

            {formError && (
              <div className="p-3 bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/50 border border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-800 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300 flex items-center gap-2">
                <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
                <span>{formError}</span>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Profile Name */}
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <label className="block text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">
                Station / Profile Name *
              </label>
              <input
                type="text"
                required
                value={formData.name}
                onChange={(e) => {
                  const val = e.target.value;
                  setFormData(prev => ({
                    ...prev,
                    name: val,
                    accessSlug: modalMode === 'create' && !prev.accessSlug 
                      ? val.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-').replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '') 
                      : prev.accessSlug
                  }));
                }}
                placeholder="e.g. North Receiving Dock Wall"
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-blue-600"
              />
            </div>

            {/* Profile Type: Internal vs External */}
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <label className="block text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">
                Station Role / User Type *
              </label>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-2.5">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, type: 'internal_warehouse', sessionDurationHours: 0 }))}
                  className={`p-3.5 rounded-2xl border text-left flex items-start gap-3 transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                    formData.type === 'internal_warehouse'
                      ? 'bg-blue-50/70 border-blue-500 ring-2 ring-blue-500/20 dark:bg-blue-950/40'
                      : 'bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800 border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 hover:border-slate-400'
                  }`}
                >
                  <Building2 className={`w-5 h-5 shrink-0 ${formData.type === 'internal_warehouse' ? 'text-blue-600' : 'text-slate-400'}`} />
                  <div>
                    <div className="text-xs font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white">Internal Warehouse</div>
                    <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mt-0.5">Warehouse dock scanners. Permanent unlock (no expiry).</div>
                  </div>
                </button>

                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, type: 'external_customer', sessionDurationHours: 2 }))}
                  className={`p-3.5 rounded-2xl border text-left flex items-start gap-3 transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                    formData.type === 'external_customer'
                      ? 'bg-emerald-50/70 border-emerald-500 ring-2 ring-emerald-500/20 dark:bg-emerald-950/40'
                      : 'bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800 border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 hover:border-slate-400'
                  }`}
                >
                  <Package className={`w-5 h-5 shrink-0 ${formData.type === 'external_customer' ? 'text-emerald-600' : 'text-slate-400'}`} />
                  <div>
                    <div className="text-xs font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white">External Customer</div>
                    <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mt-0.5">Delivery carton stickers. Expires after selected hours.</div>
                  </div>
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Access Slug (URL) */}
            <div className="space-y-1.5 min-w-0">
              <label className="block text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">
                Access Slug (QR URL) *
              </label>
              <div className="flex items-stretch min-w-0 rounded-xl border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 overflow-hidden focus-within:border-blue-600 focus-within:ring-2 focus-within:ring-blue-500/20 shadow-2xs">
                <span className="text-xs font-mono font-bold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 px-3 py-2.5 border-r border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 shrink-0 flex items-center select-none">
                  /intake/
                </span>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  required
                  disabled={modalMode === 'edit'}
                  value={formData.accessSlug}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, accessSlug: e.target.value.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9-]+/g, '') }))}
                  placeholder="e.g. wh-dock-north"
                  className="flex-1 min-w-0 px-3 py-2.5 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-900 text-xs font-bold font-mono text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none disabled:opacity-60 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
                />
              </div>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 font-mono truncate">
                Full Scan URL: {originUrl}/intake/{formData.accessSlug || '...'}
              </p>
            </div>

            {/* 6-Digit PIN Code & Randomizer */}
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <label className="block text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">
                  6-Digit Gatekeeper PIN *
                </label>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={generateRandomPin}
                  className="text-xs font-bold text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 hover:underline flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <Sparkles className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>Generate Random PIN</span>
                </button>
              </div>
              <input
                type="text"
                required
                maxLength={6}
                inputMode="numeric"
                pattern="[0-9]*"
                value={formData.pinCode}
                onChange={(e) => setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, pinCode: e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, '').slice(0, 6) }))}
                placeholder="e.g. 123456"
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-lg font-black font-mono tracking-widest text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-blue-600"
              />
            </div>

            {/* Customizable Session Expiration (Hours or Minutes) */}
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <label className="block text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">
                Session Expiration (Duration) *
              </label>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setDurationMode('permanent')}
                  className={`p-3 rounded-xl border text-left transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                    durationMode === 'permanent'
                      ? 'bg-blue-50 border-blue-500 ring-2 ring-blue-500/20 dark:bg-blue-950/40 text-blue-900 dark:text-blue-200'
                      : 'bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800 border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300'
                  }`}
                >
                  <div className="text-xs font-black">Permanent (No Expiry)</div>
                  <div className="text-[10px] opacity-75 mt-0.5">Stays unlocked indefinitely (Docks)</div>
                </button>

                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setDurationMode('custom')}
                  className={`p-3 rounded-xl border text-left transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                    durationMode === 'custom'
                      ? 'bg-emerald-50 border-emerald-500 ring-2 ring-emerald-500/20 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 text-emerald-900 dark:text-emerald-200'
                      : 'bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800 border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300'
                  }`}
                >
                  <div className="text-xs font-black">Custom Expiration</div>
                  <div className="text-[10px] opacity-75 mt-0.5">Expires in minutes or hours</div>
                </button>
              </div>

              {durationMode === 'custom' && (
                <div className="p-3 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800/60 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 space-y-2.5 animate-in fade-in">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <input
                      type="number"
                      min="1"
                      max="10000"
                      value={customDurationVal}
                      onChange={(e) => setCustomDurationVal(e.target.value)}
                      placeholder="Duration value"
                      className="w-28 px-3 py-2 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-xs font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-blue-600"
                    />

                    <select
                      value={customDurationUnit}
                      onChange={(e) => setCustomDurationUnit(e.target.value)}
                      className="px-3 py-2 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-blue-600 cursor-pointer"
                    >
                      <option value="mins">Minutes</option>
                      <option value="hrs">Hours</option>
                    </select>

                    <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-bold ml-1 truncate">
                      = {customDurationUnit === 'mins' 
                          ? `${customDurationVal} min${customDurationVal === '1' ? '' : 's'}` 
                          : `${customDurationVal} hour${customDurationVal === '1' ? '' : 's'} (${(parseFloat(customDurationVal) || 0) * 60}m)`}
                    </span>
                  </div>

                  {/* Quick Preset Pills */}
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap pt-1 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700">
                    <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase">Presets:</span>
                    {[
                      { label: '15m', val: 15, unit: 'mins' },
                      { label: '30m', val: 30, unit: 'mins' },
                      { label: '1h', val: 1, unit: 'hrs' },
                      { label: '2h', val: 2, unit: 'hrs' },
                      { label: '4h', val: 4, unit: 'hrs' },
                      { label: '12h', val: 12, unit: 'hrs' },
                      { label: '24h', val: 24, unit: 'hrs' }
                    ].map(p => (
                      <button
                        key={p.label}
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => {
                          setCustomDurationVal(p.val);
                          setCustomDurationUnit(p.unit);
                        }}
                        className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-bold border transition-colors cursor-pointer ${
                          String(customDurationVal) === String(p.val) && customDurationUnit === p.unit
                            ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white border-blue-600'
                            : 'bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 hover:border-slate-500'
                        }`}
                      >
                        {p.label}
                      </button>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* Anti-Fraud Cooldown Lockout Period (Hours) */}
            {formData.type === 'external_customer' && (
              <div className="space-y-2 p-3.5 bg-amber-50/60 dark:bg-amber-950/30 rounded-2xl border border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-900/60">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <label className="block text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-amber-900 dark:text-amber-200 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <ShieldAlert className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-600" />
                    <span>Anti-Fraud Cooldown Period *</span>
                  </label>
                  <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-300">
                    {Number(cooldownDurationVal) === 0 
                      ? 'Disabled (Immediate Re-login)' 
                      : `${cooldownDurationVal} ${cooldownDurationUnit === 'mins' ? (Number(cooldownDurationVal) === 1 ? 'Minute' : 'Minutes') : (Number(cooldownDurationVal) === 1 ? 'Hour' : 'Hours')} Lockout`}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                  Time a physical device must wait before it can unlock the intake form again after its session concludes.
                </p>

                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 pt-1">
                  <input
                    type="number"
                    min="0"
                    max="10000"
                    value={cooldownDurationVal}
                    onChange={(e) => setCooldownDurationVal(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="Cooldown value"
                    className="w-28 px-3 py-2 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-xs font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-amber-500"
                  />

                  <select
                    value={cooldownDurationUnit}
                    onChange={(e) => setCooldownDurationUnit(e.target.value)}
                    className="px-3 py-2 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-amber-500 cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    <option value="mins">Minutes</option>
                    <option value="hrs">Hours</option>
                  </select>

                  <span className="text-[11px] text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-300 font-bold ml-1 truncate">
                    {Number(cooldownDurationVal) === 0
                      ? '= 0 (Disabled - Immediate Re-login)'
                      : `= ${cooldownDurationUnit === 'mins' 
                          ? `${cooldownDurationVal} min${String(cooldownDurationVal) === '1' ? '' : 's'}` 
                          : `${cooldownDurationVal} hour${String(cooldownDurationVal) === '1' ? '' : 's'} (${(parseFloat(cooldownDurationVal) || 0) * 60}m)`}`}
                  </span>
                </div>

                {/* Quick Presets */}
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap pt-1 border-t border-amber-200/60 dark:border-amber-900/60">
                  <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase">Presets:</span>
                  {[
                    { label: '0 (Disabled)', val: 0, unit: 'hrs' },
                    { label: '15m', val: 15, unit: 'mins' },
                    { label: '30m', val: 30, unit: 'mins' },
                    { label: '1h', val: 1, unit: 'hrs' },
                    { label: '2h', val: 2, unit: 'hrs' },
                    { label: '4h', val: 4, unit: 'hrs' },
                    { label: '6h (Default)', val: 6, unit: 'hrs' },
                    { label: '12h', val: 12, unit: 'hrs' },
                    { label: '24h', val: 24, unit: 'hrs' }
                  ].map(p => (
                    <button
                      key={p.label}
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => {
                        setCooldownDurationVal(p.val);
                        setCooldownDurationUnit(p.unit);
                      }}
                      className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-bold border transition-colors cursor-pointer ${
                        String(cooldownDurationVal) === String(p.val) && cooldownDurationUnit === p.unit
                          ? 'bg-amber-600 text-white border-amber-600'
                          : 'bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 hover:border-slate-500'
                      }`}
                    >
                      {p.label}
                    </button>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Form Action Buttons */}
            <div className="pt-3 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-end gap-2">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setModalMode('list')}
                className="px-4 py-2 bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all"
              >
                Cancel
              </button>
              <button
                type="submit"
                disabled={isSaving}
                className="px-5 py-2 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 disabled:opacity-50 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-black transition-all shadow-md shadow-blue-600/20 cursor-pointer"
              >
                {isSaving ? 'Saving...' : modalMode === 'create' ? 'Create QR Profile' : 'Save Changes'}
              </button>
            </div>
          </form>
        )}

        {/* =================================================================== */}
        {/* VIEW 3: PRINT POSTER / STICKER VIEW (DYNAMIC SIZES & ISOLATED PRINT)*/}
        {/* =================================================================== */}
        {modalMode === 'print' && selectedProfile && (
          <div className="p-6 sm:p-8 overflow-y-auto space-y-5 flex-1">
            <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 pb-3">
              <div>
                <h3 className="text-sm font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                  Station QR Poster & Label: {selectedProfile.name}
                </h3>
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">
                  Select print size for workplace dock walls, cartons, or loose/unboxed items.
                </p>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setModalMode('list')}
                className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-800 self-start sm:self-auto cursor-pointer"
              >
                Back to List
              </button>
            </div>

            {/* Dynamic Print Size Selector Bar */}
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <label className="text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">
                  Select Output Print Size:
                </label>
                <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400">
                  {printSize === 'a4' && 'Full Sheet Wall Poster (A4 / Letter)'}
                  {printSize === '4x6' && 'Standard 4" x 6" Carton Sticker'}
                  {printSize === '3x3' && 'Medium 3" x 3" Parcel Label'}
                  {printSize === '2x2' && 'Small 2" x 2" Tag (Unboxed / Loose Items)'}
                </span>
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-2">
                {[
                  { id: 'a4', label: 'Wall Poster', sub: 'A4 / Letter Sheet', badge: 'Dock Wall' },
                  { id: '4x6', label: 'Carton Sticker', sub: '4" x 6" Thermal', badge: 'Box/Crate' },
                  { id: '3x3', label: 'Medium Label', sub: '3" x 3" Thermal', badge: 'Polybag' },
                  { id: '2x2', label: 'Small Item Tag', sub: '2" x 2" Mini Tag', badge: 'Unboxed / Loose' }
                ].map(s => (
                  <button
                    key={s.id}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setPrintSize(s.id)}
                    className={`p-2.5 rounded-xl border text-left transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                      printSize === s.id
                        ? 'bg-blue-50 border-blue-600 ring-2 ring-blue-500/20 dark:bg-blue-950/40 text-blue-900 dark:text-blue-100'
                        : 'bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 hover:border-slate-400'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-1">
                      <span className="text-xs font-black">{s.label}</span>
                      <span className="text-[9px] font-bold px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">
                        {s.badge}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-[10px] opacity-75 mt-0.5">{s.sub}</div>
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Poster Sheet Preview Mount (Strict Target for Print) */}
            <div className="flex justify-center p-2 sm:p-5 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-950 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 overflow-x-hidden max-w-full">
              
              {/* VARIANT 1: A4 FULL SHEET WALL POSTER (Responsive & Zero Overflow) */}
              {printSize === 'a4' && (
                <div 
                  id="portal-poster-print-mount"
                  className="bg-white text-black p-4 sm:p-8 md:p-10 rounded-2xl sm:rounded-3xl border-2 sm:border-4 border-black shadow-xl text-center font-sans space-y-3.5 sm:space-y-5 w-full max-w-[540px] mx-auto transition-all box-border overflow-hidden"
                >
                  {/* Header */}
                  <div className="border-b-2 sm:border-b-4 border-black pb-3 sm:pb-4 space-y-1">
                    <div className="text-[10px] sm:text-xs md:text-sm font-black uppercase tracking-[0.2em] sm:tracking-[0.25em] text-black">
                      {selectedProfile.type === 'internal_warehouse' ? 'WHOLESALE WAREHOUSE DOCK' : 'CUSTOMER RETURN INTAKE'}
                    </div>
                    <h2 className="text-xl sm:text-3xl md:text-4xl font-black text-black uppercase tracking-tight leading-tight">
                      {selectedProfile.name}
                    </h2>
                    <p className="text-[11px] sm:text-xs md:text-sm text-black font-semibold pt-0.5">
                      Scan with <strong>Google Lens</strong> or Phone Camera to File Return Report
                    </p>
                  </div>

                  {/* Big Responsive QR Code */}
                  <div className="inline-block p-2.5 sm:p-4 bg-white border-2 sm:border-4 border-black rounded-2xl sm:rounded-3xl shadow-xs max-w-full">
                    <QRCodeSVG
                      id="station-qr-svg"
                      value={`${originUrl}/intake/${selectedProfile.access_slug}`}
                      size={180}
                      level="H"
                      includeMargin={false}
                      className="w-40 h-40 sm:w-56 sm:h-56 max-w-full h-auto mx-auto"
                    />
                  </div>

                  {/* Slug Pill */}
                  <div className="px-2">
                    <span className="bg-black text-white font-mono text-[10px] sm:text-xs md:text-sm font-bold py-1 sm:py-1.5 px-3 sm:px-4 rounded-xl inline-block max-w-full truncate shadow-xs">
                      {originUrl.replace(/^https?:\/\//, '')}/intake/{selectedProfile.access_slug}
                    </span>
                  </div>

                  {/* Large 6-Digit PIN on Poster */}
                  {showPinOnPoster && (
                    <div className="p-2.5 sm:p-4 border-2 sm:border-3 border-black rounded-xl sm:rounded-2xl bg-slate-50 space-y-0.5 sm:space-y-1">
                      <div className="text-[10px] sm:text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-black">
                        Station 6-Digit Gatekeeper PIN
                      </div>
                      <div className="font-mono font-black text-2xl sm:text-4xl tracking-[0.25em] sm:tracking-[0.3em] text-black">
                        {selectedProfile.pin_code}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  )}

                  {/* Numbered Google Lens Instructions */}
                  <div className="text-left text-[11px] sm:text-xs md:text-sm space-y-1.5 sm:space-y-2 text-black pt-2.5 sm:pt-3.5 border-t-2 sm:border-t-4 border-black font-medium leading-relaxed">
                    <div><strong>1.</strong> Open <strong>Google Lens</strong> (or phone camera) on your mobile device.</div>
                    <div><strong>2.</strong> Point camera directly at QR code above and tap the link to launch portal.</div>
                    <div><strong>3.</strong> Enter station 6-digit PIN (<strong>{selectedProfile.pin_code}</strong>) when prompted to unlock intake scanner.</div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* VARIANT 2: 4" x 6" CARTON STICKER (Symmetrical & Balanced Margins) */}
              {printSize === '4x6' && (
                <div 
                  id="portal-poster-print-mount"
                  className="bg-white text-black p-4 sm:p-5 rounded-2xl border-2 border-black shadow-md text-center font-sans space-y-2.5 w-[280px] max-w-full mx-auto transition-all box-border"
                >
                  {/* Header */}
                  <div className="border-b-2 border-black pb-1.5 space-y-0.5">
                    <div className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-black">
                      {selectedProfile.type === 'internal_warehouse' ? 'WHOLESALE WAREHOUSE DOCK' : 'CUSTOMER RETURN INTAKE'}
                    </div>
                    <h2 className="text-base font-black text-black uppercase leading-tight truncate">
                      {selectedProfile.name}
                    </h2>
                    <p className="text-[10px] text-black font-semibold">
                      Scan with <strong>Google Lens</strong> or QR scanner app
                    </p>
                  </div>

                  {/* QR Code */}
                  <div className="inline-block p-1.5 bg-white border-2 border-black rounded-xl">
                    <QRCodeSVG
                      id="station-qr-svg"
                      value={`${originUrl}/intake/${selectedProfile.access_slug}`}
                      size={130}
                      level="H"
                      includeMargin={false}
                    />
                  </div>

                  {/* Slug Pill */}
                  <div>
                    <span className="bg-black text-white font-mono text-[9.5px] font-bold py-1 px-3 rounded-lg inline-block max-w-full truncate">
                      {originUrl.replace(/^https?:\/\//, '')}/intake/{selectedProfile.access_slug}
                    </span>
                  </div>

                  {/* Optional 6-Digit PIN on Sticker */}
                  {showPinOnPoster && (
                    <div className="p-1.5 border-2 border-black rounded-xl bg-slate-50 space-y-0.5">
                      <div className="text-[9px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-black">
                        Station 6-Digit Gatekeeper PIN
                      </div>
                      <div className="font-black font-mono text-xl tracking-widest text-black">
                        {selectedProfile.pin_code}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  )}

                  {/* Numbered Instructions */}
                  <div className="text-left text-[9.5px] space-y-1 text-black pt-1.5 border-t-2 border-black font-medium">
                    <div><strong>1.</strong> Open <strong>Google Lens</strong> (or QR scanner) on phone.</div>
                    <div><strong>2.</strong> Point at QR code above &amp; tap link to launch portal.</div>
                    <div><strong>3.</strong> Enter 6-digit station PIN when prompted.</div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* VARIANT 3: 3" x 3" MEDIUM LABEL (Zero Overflow, 100% Contained, No Cut-offs) */}
              {printSize === '3x3' && (
                <div 
                  id="portal-poster-print-mount"
                  className="bg-white text-black p-2 rounded-xl border-2 border-black shadow-md text-center font-sans space-y-1.5 w-[205px] max-w-full mx-auto transition-all box-border"
                >
                  {/* Header */}
                  <div className="border-b border-black pb-0.5 space-y-0.5">
                    <div className="text-[7.5px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-black">
                      {selectedProfile.type === 'internal_warehouse' ? 'WAREHOUSE DOCK' : 'CUSTOMER RETURN'}
                    </div>
                    <h2 className="text-[10.5px] font-black text-black uppercase leading-tight truncate">
                      {selectedProfile.name}
                    </h2>
                  </div>

                  {/* QR Code */}
                  <div className="inline-block p-1 bg-white border border-black rounded-lg">
                    <QRCodeSVG
                      id="station-qr-svg"
                      value={`${originUrl}/intake/${selectedProfile.access_slug}`}
                      size={74}
                      level="H"
                      includeMargin={false}
                    />
                  </div>

                  {/* Slug Pill */}
                  <div>
                    <span className="bg-black text-white font-mono text-[8px] font-bold py-0.5 px-2 rounded-md inline-block max-w-full truncate">
                      /{selectedProfile.access_slug}
                    </span>
                  </div>

                  {/* Compact Horizontal PIN Strip */}
                  {showPinOnPoster && (
                    <div className="py-0.5 px-2 border border-black rounded-md bg-slate-50 flex items-center justify-between text-black">
                      <span className="text-[8px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider">STATION PIN</span>
                      <span className="font-mono font-black text-xs tracking-wider">{selectedProfile.pin_code}</span>
                    </div>
                  )}

                  {/* Concise 1-line Instruction */}
                  <div className="text-[8px] font-bold text-black border-t border-black pt-0.5">
                    Scan with Google Lens to Return Item
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* VARIANT 4: 2" x 2" SMALL ITEM TAG (Zero Overflow, Complete Display for Loose Items) */}
              {printSize === '2x2' && (
                <div 
                  id="portal-poster-print-mount"
                  className="bg-white text-black p-1.5 rounded-lg border-2 border-black shadow-sm text-center font-sans space-y-1 w-[138px] max-w-full mx-auto transition-all box-border"
                >
                  {/* Title */}
                  <div className="border-b border-black pb-0.5">
                    <h2 className="text-[8.5px] font-black text-black uppercase leading-tight truncate">
                      {selectedProfile.name}
                    </h2>
                  </div>

                  {/* Mini QR Code */}
                  <div className="inline-block p-0.5 bg-white border border-black rounded-md">
                    <QRCodeSVG
                      id="station-qr-svg"
                      value={`${originUrl}/intake/${selectedProfile.access_slug}`}
                      size={52}
                      level="H"
                      includeMargin={false}
                    />
                  </div>

                  {/* Inline PIN Pill */}
                  {showPinOnPoster && (
                    <div className="py-0.5 px-1.5 bg-black text-white rounded text-[8px] font-mono font-black flex items-center justify-between">
                      <span className="text-[7px] uppercase opacity-90">PIN:</span>
                      <span className="tracking-wider">{selectedProfile.pin_code}</span>
                    </div>
                  )}

                  {/* Mini Scan Prompt */}
                  <div className="text-[7px] font-black uppercase text-black pt-0.5 border-t border-black">
                    Scan via Google Lens
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}

            </div>

            {/* Poster Controls Bar */}
            <div className="pt-3 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
              <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 cursor-pointer">
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  checked={showPinOnPoster}
                  onChange={(e) => setShowPinOnPoster(e.target.checked)}
                  className="rounded text-blue-600 w-4 h-4 cursor-pointer"
                />
                <span>Include 6-Digit PIN on Printed Sheet</span>
              </label>

              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handlePrintPoster}
                  className="px-5 py-2.5 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-black flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-md shadow-blue-600/20 cursor-pointer active:scale-95 transition-all"
                >
                  <Printer className="w-4 h-4" />
                  <span>Print {printSize === 'a4' ? 'Wall Poster' : printSize === '4x6' ? '4x6" Sticker' : printSize === '3x3' ? '3x3" Label' : '2x2" Tag'}</span>
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

          </div>
        )}

      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export default function PortalAccessQRModal({ isOpen, onClose }) {
  const [isCopied, setIsCopied] = useState(false);
  const [isDownloadingPoster, setIsDownloadingPoster] = useState(false);
  const [isDownloadingQr, setIsDownloadingQr] = useState(false);
  const [isPrinting, setIsPrinting] = useState(false);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const portalUrl = typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.location.origin 
    ? window.location.origin 
    : 'https://rma-portal-v2.vercel.app';

  const handleCopyLink = () => {
    try {
      navigator.clipboard.writeText(portalUrl);
      setIsCopied(true);
      setTimeout(() => setIsCopied(false), 2200);
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Clipboard write failed:', e);
    }
  };

  const handleDownloadPoster = async () => {
    setIsDownloadingPoster(true);
    try {
      await downloadPortalPosterPng({
        svgElementOrId: 'portal-access-qr-svg',

        filename: 'RMA-Public-Reporting-Poster.png'
      });
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Error downloading poster:', err);
      alert('Failed to generate poster. You can use browser print as an alternative.');

      setIsDownloadingPoster(false);
    }

      alert('Failed to download QR code image.');
    } finally {
      setIsDownloadingQr(false);
    }
  };

    setIsPrinting(true);
    try {
      await printPortalPoster({
        svgElementOrId: 'portal-access-qr-svg',
        portalUrl,
        documentTitle: 'RMA-Public-Reporting-Poster'

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { QRCodeSVG } from 'qrcode.react';

export default function PrintBarcodesTab({ catalog = [] }) {
  const [selectedBrand, setSelectedBrand] = useState('ALL');

    if (selectedBrand === 'BONITA') return item.sku.startsWith('BON-') || item.brand === 'Bonita';

              Warehouse Label Generator

                  <div className="flex-1 ml-3 flex flex-col items-center">

                        const widthClass = digit % 3 === 0 ? 'w-1 bg-black' : digit % 2 === 0 ? 'w-0.5 bg-black' : 'w-1.5 bg-black';

                          <React.Fragment key={i}>
                            <span className={widthClass}></span>

                          </React.Fragment>
                        );
                      })}

                  <span>Standard Box Sticker</span>
                  <span>SRP: {formatPeso(prod.unit_price)}</span>
                </div>

              </div>
            ))
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

    </div>
  );
}
