            <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 max-w-xl">
              When ON, test emails are safely sent exclusively to <code className="text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-300 font-mono font-bold">finance2@keysysincorporated.com</code> with <code className="text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-300 font-mono font-bold">Test - </code> in the subject. <strong>This setting is strictly restricted to Super Admin; all other staff roles and public intake users operate permanently in Live Mode.</strong>
            </p>
          </div>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onToggleTestMode}
            className={`flex items-center space-x-2 px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl font-bold text-xs transition-all shadow-sm ${
              isTestMode 
                ? 'bg-amber-500 hover:bg-amber-400 text-slate-950 shadow-amber-500/20' 
                : 'bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700'
            }`}
          >
            {isTestMode ? (
              <>
                <ToggleRight className="w-5 h-5 text-slate-950" />
                <span>Test Mode: ON</span>
              </>
            ) : (
              <>
                <ToggleLeft className="w-5 h-5 text-slate-400" />
                <span>Test Mode: OFF</span>
              </>
            )}
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Live email preview example */}
        <div className="p-3 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 text-xs font-mono space-y-1.5">
          <span className="text-[11px] font-sans font-semibold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 block mb-1">
            Live Recipient Output with Current Configuration:
          </span>
          <div className="text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">
            <strong>Target TO:</strong> <span className={isTestMode ? 'text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 font-bold' : 'text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 font-bold'}>
              {isTestMode ? `finance2@keysysincorporated.com (Live target "${mainRecipient}" safely bypassed)` : mainRecipient}
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">
            <strong>Target CC:</strong> <span className={isTestMode ? 'text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 font-bold' : 'text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300'}>
              {isTestMode 
                ? '[] (All CC recipients bypassed in Sandbox)' 
                : `${ccRecipients.join(', ') || 'None'} + [Customer AE email]`}
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Supabase Connection Status Card */}
      <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-3xl p-5 sm:p-6 shadow-sm space-y-4">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 pb-3">
          <div className="flex items-center space-x-2.5">
            <Database className="w-5 h-5 text-brand-600 dark:text-brand-400" />
            <h2 className="text-base font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">Supabase Backend Connection</h2>
          </div>

          <button
            onClick={handleCheckConnection}
            disabled={connectionStatus.loading}
            className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 text-xs font-medium rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 flex items-center space-x-1.5 transition-colors"
          >
            <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${connectionStatus.loading ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
            <span>{connectionStatus.loading ? 'Testing...' : 'Test Connection'}</span>
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4 text-xs font-mono">
          <div className="bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 p-3 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
            <span className="text-slate-400 text-[10px] block font-sans">ENDPOINT (VITE_SUPABASE_URL)</span>
            <span className="text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 truncate block mt-0.5">{supabaseUrl}</span>
          </div>

          <div className="bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 p-3 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
            <span className="text-slate-400 text-[10px] block font-sans">ANON KEY (VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY)</span>
            <span className="text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 truncate block mt-0.5">
              {supabaseKey.slice(0, 14)}...{supabaseKey.slice(-6)}
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Connection Result Badge */}
        <div className={`p-4 rounded-2xl border flex items-center space-x-3 text-xs ${
          connectionStatus.connected 
            ? 'bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-500/40 text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-300' 
            : 'bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/60 border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-500/40 text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-300'
        }`}>
          {connectionStatus.connected ? (
            <CheckCircle2 className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 shrink-0" />
          ) : (
            <AlertCircle className="w-5 h-5 text-amber-500 shrink-0" />
          )}
          <div>
            <div className="font-bold text-sm">
              {connectionStatus.connected ? 'Supabase Backend Connected' : 'Offline / Mock Redundancy Mode'}
            </div>
            <div className="text-[11px] opacity-90 mt-0.5">
              {connectionStatus.message || 'Ready'}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Google SMTP Email Dispatch Service Card */}
      <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-3xl p-5 sm:p-6 shadow-sm space-y-4">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 pb-3">
          <div className="flex items-center space-x-2.5">
            <Mail className="w-5 h-5 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400" />
            <div>
              <h2 className="text-base font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">Google SMTP Notification Service</h2>
              <span className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">Automated intake & catalog updates dispatcher</span>
            </div>
          </div>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handleTestSmtp}
            disabled={smtpStatus.loading}
            className="px-3.5 py-1.5 bg-indigo-50 hover:bg-indigo-100 dark:bg-indigo-950/70 dark:hover:bg-indigo-900 text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-300 text-xs font-bold rounded-xl border border-indigo-200 dark:border-indigo-800 flex items-center space-x-1.5 transition-colors cursor-pointer shadow-2xs"
          >
            <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${smtpStatus.loading ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
            <span>{smtpStatus.loading ? 'Authenticating...' : 'Test SMTP Credentials'}</span>
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4 text-xs font-mono">
          <div className="bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 p-3 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
            <span className="text-slate-400 text-[10px] block font-sans font-semibold">SENDER ACCOUNT (GMAIL_USER)</span>
            <span className="text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 truncate block mt-0.5 font-bold">finance2@keysysincorporated.com</span>
          </div>

          <div className="bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 p-3 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
            <span className="text-slate-400 text-[10px] block font-sans font-semibold">GMAIL APP PASSWORD STATUS</span>
            <span className="text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 truncate block mt-0.5 font-bold">
              {smtpStatus.checked ? (smtpStatus.success ? '✓ 16-character key authenticated' : `Detected: ${smtpStatus.passLength || 0} chars`) : 'Configured in Vercel'}
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* SMTP Status Result Banner */}
        {smtpStatus.checked && (
          <div className={`p-4 rounded-2xl border space-y-2 text-xs animate-in fade-in ${
            smtpStatus.success
              ? 'bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-500/40 text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-300'
              : 'bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/60 border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-500/40 text-rose-800 dark:text-rose-300'
          }`}>
            <div className="flex items-center space-x-2.5">
              {smtpStatus.success ? (
                <CheckCircle2 className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 shrink-0" />
              ) : (
                <AlertCircle className="w-5 h-5 text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 shrink-0" />
              )}
              <div className="font-bold text-sm">
                {smtpStatus.success ? 'Google SMTP Verified & Operational' : 'SMTP Authentication Error (Bad Credentials)'}
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="text-[11px] leading-relaxed font-mono">
              {smtpStatus.message}
            </div>
            {smtpStatus.diagnostic && (
              <div className="mt-2 p-2.5 bg-rose-100/80 dark:bg-rose-900/40 rounded-xl text-[11px] font-sans text-rose-900 dark:text-rose-200 border border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-800/60">
                <strong>💡 Troubleshooting Guide:</strong> {smtpStatus.diagnostic}
              </div>
            )}
            {smtpStatus.hadSpaces && (
              <div className="text-[11px] text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-300 font-sans font-semibold">
                ℹ️ Note: Your App Password in Vercel contained spaces. The system has automatically stripped them for pure 16-character authentication.
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* 3. Public Reporting Portal Access QR & Dock Posters */}
      <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-3xl p-6 sm:p-7 shadow-sm space-y-4">
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 pb-4">
          <div className="flex items-center space-x-3">
            <div className="p-2.5 rounded-2xl bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-500/10 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 border border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-500/20">
              <QrCode className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h2 className="font-extrabold text-slate-900 dark:text-white text-base">Public Reporting Portal Access QR</h2>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">Generate high-res QR codes and printable posters for receiving docks & store repackers</p>
            </div>
          </div>

          {onOpenPortalQr && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onOpenPortalQr}
              className="px-4 py-2 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-colors shadow-sm cursor-pointer self-start sm:self-auto"
            >
              <QrCode className="w-4 h-4" />
              <span>View & Download Poster</span>
            </button>
          )}
        </div>

        <p className="text-xs text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 leading-relaxed">
          Users who report products do not need login credentials. They simply scan the QR code posted at your receiving docks or return desks to launch the portal, scan the retail barcode, attach photos of damaged items, and print box verification stickers.
        </p>
      </div>

      {/* 4. Live Product Catalog API Integration (EXTERNAL_API_KEY_DANILO) */}
      <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-3xl p-6 sm:p-7 shadow-sm space-y-5">
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 pb-4">
          <div className="flex items-center space-x-3">
            <div className="p-2.5 rounded-2xl bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-500/10 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 border border-indigo-200 dark:border-indigo-500/20">
              <KeyRound className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h2 className="font-extrabold text-slate-900 dark:text-white text-base flex items-center gap-2">
                <span>Live Product Catalog API (SKU Auto-Suggestions)</span>
                <span className="text-[10px] px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-indigo-100 dark:bg-indigo-950 text-indigo-800 dark:text-indigo-300 font-mono font-bold">
                  EXTERNAL_API_KEY_DANILO
                </span>
              </h2>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                Direct integration with Enterprise Laravel Cloud product catalog (5,793+ SKUs in erply_products)
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleCheckPoApi}
              disabled={poApiStatus.loading}
              className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold flex items-center space-x-1.5 transition-colors disabled:opacity-50 cursor-pointer"
            >
              <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${poApiStatus.loading ? 'animate-spin text-blue-600' : ''}`} />
              <span>{poApiStatus.loading ? 'Testing...' : 'Test Connection'}</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Status result strip */}
        {poApiStatus.checked && (
          <div className={`p-3.5 rounded-2xl border text-xs flex items-center gap-2.5 ${
            poApiStatus.connected
              ? 'bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-800 text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-300'
              : 'bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/60 border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-800 text-amber-900 dark:text-amber-200'
          }`}>
            {poApiStatus.connected ? (
              <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600 shrink-0" />
            ) : (
              <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-600 shrink-0" />
            )}
            <span className="font-semibold">{poApiStatus.message}</span>
          </div>
        )}

        <div className="space-y-3">
          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mb-1">
              API Base URL
            </label>
            <div className="p-2.5 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 rounded-xl font-mono text-xs text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
              https://purchase-order-db-production-ff1oho.laravel.cloud/api/v1
            </div>
          </div>

          <div>
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1">
              <label className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">
                Danilo's Private API Key (Header: <code className="font-mono">X-API-Key</code>)
              </label>
              {poKeyFeedback && (
                <span className={`text-[11px] font-bold ${poKeyFeedback.type === 'success' ? 'text-emerald-600' : 'text-rose-600'}`}>
                  {poKeyFeedback.message}
                </span>
              )}
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <input
                type="text"
                value={poApiKey}
                onChange={(e) => setPoApiKey(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Paste EXTERNAL_API_KEY_DANILO private key here..."
                className="flex-1 px-3 py-2 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-xs font-mono text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-indigo-600"
              />
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleSavePoKey}
                disabled={isSavingPoKey}
                className="px-4 py-2 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-extrabold flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-sm transition-all cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
              >
                <Save className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span>{isSavingPoKey ? 'Saving...' : 'Save Key'}</span>
              </button>
            </div>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mt-1">
              When assigning SKUs in Admin or Quick Process, typing into SKU or Product Name automatically suggests and auto-populates product details.
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 5. MULTI-SYSTEM REST API KEYS & INTEGRATION (SHA-256 HASHED) */}
      <ApiKeysManagementSection />

    </div>
  );
}

--- START FILE: src/components/SubmitRMATab.jsx ---
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { 
  Camera, 
  Barcode, 
  MapPin, 
  Upload, 
  Sparkles, 
  Plus, 
  Minus, 
  Building2, 
  FileText, 
  AlertTriangle, 
  CheckCircle, 
  RefreshCw,
  Send,
  Zap,
  Info,
  Check,
  Search,
  Package,
  Layers,
  DollarSign,
  Hash,
  X,
  Loader2
} from 'lucide-react';
import confetti from 'canvas-confetti';
import ScannerModal from './ScannerModal';
import { AE_ROSTERS } from '../data/mockData';
import { rmaApi } from '../supabaseClient';
import { catalogService } from '../services/catalogService';
import { generateTicketId, playBeep, formatPeso, generateAiDiagnosis } from '../utils/rmaHelpers';

export default function SubmitRMATab({ 
  catalog = [], 
  onTicketCreated, 
  isTestMode = false, 
  onOpenTicketModal 
}) {
  const [isScannerOpen, setIsScannerOpen] = useState(false);
  const [selectedProduct, setSelectedProduct] = useState(null);
  const [manualSkuInput, setManualSkuInput] = useState('');
  const [isSearchingManually, setIsSearchingManually] = useState(false);
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [liveSearchResults, setLiveSearchResults] = useState([]);
  const [isSearchingLive, setIsSearchingLive] = useState(false);

  // Form State (Simplified for Repackers & Store Customers)
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    // Store Info
    customerName: 'Puregold Price Club',
    storeBranch: 'Branch 042 - San Fernando Pampanga',
    invoiceNo: '',
    
    // Quantity
    quantity: 1,
    
    // Serial Numbers (Optional)
    serialNumbers: '',
    
    // Defect & Photos
    defectCategory: 'Damaged in Transit / Crushed Carton',
    technicalDiagnosis: '',
    gpsCoordinates: '',
    photos: []
  });

  // UI state
  const [isAiLoading, setIsAiLoading] = useState(false);
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [isGpsLoading, setIsGpsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [isUploadingPhoto, setIsUploadingPhoto] = useState(false);
  const [statusNotification, setStatusNotification] = useState(null);

  // Auto assign Group & AE based on matched product behind the scenes
  const getProductRouting = (product) => {
    const isGroup1 = product?.group?.includes('KEYSYS') || product?.brand === 'Keysys' || product?.brand === 'A2Z2Go';
    const groupKey = isGroup1 ? 'Group 1 (KEYSYS & A2Z2GO)' : 'Group 2 (PINGCON & BONITA TISSUE)';
    const roster = AE_ROSTERS[groupKey];
    const defaultAe = roster.aes[0];
    return {
      group: groupKey,
      aeName: defaultAe.name,
      aeEmail: defaultAe.email,
      supervisorEmail: defaultAe.supervisorEmail
    };
  };

  // Toast notification
  const showBannerNotification = (msg, type = 'info') => {
    setStatusNotification({ msg, type });
    setTimeout(() => {
      setStatusNotification(null);
    }, 4500);
  };

  // Live Search Debounce Effect (queries 5,793 live ERPLY products)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!searchQuery.trim()) {
      setLiveSearchResults([]);
      return;
    }
    const timer = setTimeout(async () => {
      setIsSearchingLive(true);
      try {
        const results = await rmaApi.searchLiveProducts(searchQuery, 12);
        setLiveSearchResults(results);
      } catch (e) {
        console.warn('Live search error:', e);
      } finally {
        setIsSearchingLive(false);
      }
    }, 280);

    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [searchQuery]);

  // Handle scanned or selected product
  const handleProductIdentified = async (productOrCode) => {
    let matched = null;

    if (typeof productOrCode === 'object' && productOrCode !== null) {
      matched = productOrCode;
    } else {
      const cleanCode = String(productOrCode).trim();
      if (!cleanCode) return;

      // If same product is scanned again, increment quantity +1!
      if (selectedProduct && (
        String(selectedProduct.sku).toLowerCase() === cleanCode.toLowerCase() || 
        String(selectedProduct.barcode).toLowerCase() === cleanCode.toLowerCase()
      )) {
        playBeep('increment');
        setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, quantity: (Number(prev.quantity) || 0) + 1 }));
        showBannerNotification(`Re-scanned ${selectedProduct.sku}: Quantity incremented to ${(Number(formData.quantity) || 1) + 1}!`, 'success');
        return;
      }

      // 1. Live ERPLY API & Multi-Tier Catalog Lookup
      try {
        matched = await catalogService.findProduct(cleanCode);
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn('Live barcode lookup failed:', err);
      }

      // 2. Fallback to local catalog
      if (!matched) {
        const query = cleanCode.toLowerCase();
        matched = catalog.find(p => 
          p.barcode?.toLowerCase() === query || 
          p.sku?.toLowerCase() === query ||
          p.name?.toLowerCase().includes(query)
        );
      }
    }

    if (matched) {
      playBeep('success');
      setSelectedProduct(matched);
      setManualSkuInput('');
      setSearchQuery('');
      setIsSearchingManually(false);
      showBannerNotification(`Product Matched: "${matched.name}" (${matched.sku}) • Supplier: ${matched.supplier}`, 'success');
    } else {
      playBeep('error');
      // Boss rule: If product does not appear, still accept barcode scanner
      const unlisted = {
        id: `unreg-${Date.now()}`,
        sku: `SKU-${String(productOrCode).slice(-8).toUpperCase()}`,
        barcode: String(productOrCode),
        name: `Uncatalogued Product (${productOrCode})`,
        brand: '',
        supplier: '',
        unit_price: 0,
        case_pack: 'pc',
        image_url: null,
        group: 'Standard Items',
        requires_serial: false
      };
      setSelectedProduct(unlisted);
      showBannerNotification(`Uncatalogued Barcode "${productOrCode}". Accepted with default profile.`, 'warning');
    }
  };

  // Quantity controls
  const handleQuantityIncrement = () => {
    setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, quantity: (Number(prev.quantity) || 0) + 1 }));
    playBeep('increment');
  };

  const handleQuantityDecrement = () => {
    setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, quantity: Math.max(1, (Number(prev.quantity) || 1) - 1) }));
  };

  const handleQuantityChange = (e) => {
    const val = parseInt(e.target.value, 10);
    if (isNaN(val)) {
      setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, quantity: '' }));
    } else {
      setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, quantity: Math.max(1, val) }));
    }
  };

  // GPS Grabber
  const handleGrabGps = () => {
    if (!navigator.geolocation) {
      alert('Geolocation is not supported by your browser.');
      return;
    }
    setIsGpsLoading(true);
    navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(
      (pos) => {
        const { latitude, longitude, accuracy } = pos.coords;
        const coordString = `${latitude.toFixed(5)}° N, ${longitude.toFixed(5)}° E (±${Math.round(accuracy)}m)`;
        setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, gpsCoordinates: coordString }));
        setIsGpsLoading(false);
        showBannerNotification(`GPS Logged: ${coordString}`, 'success');
      },
      () => {
        setIsGpsLoading(false);
        const fallback = '14.5995° N, 120.9842° E (Receiving Dock)';
        setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, gpsCoordinates: fallback }));
        showBannerNotification('GPS recorded (Receiving Dock)', 'info');
      },
      { timeout: 8000, enableHighAccuracy: true }
    );
  };

  // Defect Photo Upload
  const handlePhotoUpload = async (e) => {
    const files = Array.from(e.target.files || []);
    if (files.length === 0) return;

    setIsUploadingPhoto(true);
    try {
      const uploadPromises = files.map(file => rmaApi.uploadPhoto(file));
      const urls = await Promise.all(uploadPromises);

      setFormData(prev => ({
        ...prev,
        photos: [...prev.photos, ...urls]
      }));
      showBannerNotification(`${files.length} defect photo(s) added!`, 'success');
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Photo upload error:', err);
      showBannerNotification('Photo upload failed. Using local preview.', 'warning');
    } finally {
      setIsUploadingPhoto(false);
    }
  };

  const handleRemovePhoto = (index) => {
    setFormData(prev => ({
      ...prev,
      photos: prev.photos.filter((_, i) => i !== index)
    }));
  };

  // Simulated AI Defect Detection
  const handleAiDefectDetection = () => {
    setIsAiLoading(true);
    setTimeout(() => {
      const diagnosis = generateAiDiagnosis(
        selectedProduct?.name || 'Wholesale Merchandise', 
        formData.defectCategory, 
        formData.photos.length
      );
      setFormData(prev => ({
        ...prev,
        technicalDiagnosis: diagnosis
      }));
      setIsAiLoading(false);
      playBeep('success');
      showBannerNotification('AI Defect Inspection findings generated!', 'success');
    }, 900);
  };

  // Submit RMA Ticket
  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();

    if (!selectedProduct) {
      alert('Please scan or select a product first in Step 1.');
      return;
    }

    if (!formData.customerName.trim()) {
      alert('Please enter the Customer / Store Name.');
      return;
    }

    const qty = Number(formData.quantity) || 1;
    const unitPrice = Number(selectedProduct.unit_price) || 0;
    const totalAmount = qty * unitPrice;
    const routing = getProductRouting(selectedProduct);

    setIsSubmitting(true);

    try {
      const existingTickets = await rmaApi.getTickets();
      const ticketId = generateTicketId(existingTickets.length);

      const newTicket = {
        id: ticketId,
        created_at: new Date().toISOString(),
        customer_name: formData.customerName,
        store_branch: formData.storeBranch || 'Main Store',
        invoice_no: formData.invoiceNo || 'N/A',
        group: routing.group,
        ae_name: routing.aeName,
        ae_email: routing.aeEmail,
        supervisor_email: routing.supervisorEmail,
        product_name: selectedProduct.name,
        sku: selectedProduct.sku,
        barcode: selectedProduct.barcode || 'N/A',
        brand: selectedProduct.brand || 'Wholesale',
        supplier: selectedProduct.supplier || 'Primary Supplier',
        quantity: qty,
        unit_price: unitPrice,
        total_amount: totalAmount,
        serial_numbers: formData.serialNumbers || '',
        defect_category: formData.defectCategory,
        technical_diagnosis: formData.technicalDiagnosis || 'Physical inspection required by warehouse team.',
        gps_coordinates: formData.gpsCoordinates || 'Intake Terminal',
        photos: formData.photos.length > 0 ? formData.photos : (selectedProduct.image_url ? [selectedProduct.image_url] : []),
        status: 'Pending Inspection',
        pull_out_confirmed: false,
        credit_memo_no: '',
        credit_amount: 0,
        credit_issued_by: '',
        credit_issued_date: null,
        supplier_po_no: `PO-RET-${new Date().getFullYear()}-${String(existingTickets.length + 1).padStart(3, '0')}`,
        buffer_days_left: 7,
        notes: `Submitted by Repacker/Customer at ${new Date().toLocaleTimeString()}`
      };

      await rmaApi.createTicket(newTicket);

      // Trigger Confetti
      try {
        confetti({
          particleCount: 80,
          spread: 70,
          origin: { y: 0.6 }
        });
      } catch (e) {
        // optional
      }

      playBeep('success');
      onTicketCreated(newTicket);
      onOpenTicketModal(newTicket);

      // Reset
      setSelectedProduct(null);
      setFormData(prev => ({
        ...prev,
        quantity: 1,
        serialNumbers: '',
        technicalDiagnosis: '',
        photos: []
      }));
      showBannerNotification(`Ticket ${newTicket.id} created successfully!`, 'success');
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Error creating RMA ticket:', err);
      alert('Error saving ticket: ' + (err.message || 'Unknown error'));
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="max-w-3xl mx-auto space-y-6">
      
      {/* Toast Banner Notification */}
      {statusNotification && (
        <div className={`p-4 rounded-2xl border flex items-center space-x-3 text-sm shadow-md transition-all animate-in slide-in-from-top-2 duration-200 ${
          statusNotification.type === 'success' 
            ? 'bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/80 border-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-500/40 text-emerald-900 dark:text-emerald-200' 
            : statusNotification.type === 'warning'
            ? 'bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/80 border-amber-300 dark:border-amber-500/40 text-amber-900 dark:text-amber-200'
            : 'bg-blue-50 dark:bg-brand-950/80 border-blue-300 dark:border-brand-500/40 text-blue-900 dark:text-brand-200'
        }`}>
          {statusNotification.type === 'success' ? (
            <CheckCircle className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 shrink-0" />
          ) : (
            <AlertTriangle className="w-5 h-5 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 shrink-0" />
          )}
          <span className="font-semibold">{statusNotification.msg}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Main Intake Form */}
      <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-6">
        
        {/* =========================================================================
            STEP 1: SCAN PRODUCT QR CODE OR MANUAL SKU SEARCH
        ========================================================================= */}
        <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-3xl p-6 sm:p-7 shadow-sm transition-all space-y-4">
          <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-start sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 pb-4">
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                <span className="w-7 h-7 rounded-xl bg-brand-100 dark:bg-brand-500/20 text-brand-700 dark:text-brand-300 flex items-center justify-center font-black text-xs">
                  1
                </span>
                <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white tracking-tight">
                  Scan Product Barcode / SKU
                </h2>
                <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/80 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-800 flex items-center gap-1">
                  <Sparkles className="w-3 h-3 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400" />
                  5,793 Live Products
                </span>
              </div>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mt-1">
                Scan the factory barcode or SKU on the carton, or search by code
              </p>
            </div>

            {/* Manual Toggle */}
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setIsSearchingManually(!isSearchingManually)}
              className="text-xs font-semibold text-brand-600 dark:text-brand-400 hover:underline flex items-center gap-1"
            >
              <Search className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>{isSearchingManually ? 'Hide Search List' : 'Search by SKU / Name'}</span>
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* Primary Action: Big Camera Scanner Button */}
          <div className="pt-1">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setIsScannerOpen(true)}
              className="w-full py-4 px-6 bg-brand-600 hover:bg-brand-500 active:bg-brand-700 text-white font-bold text-base rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center space-x-3 shadow-lg shadow-brand-600/25 transition-all transform active:scale-[0.99]"
            >
              <Camera className="w-6 h-6" />
              <span>Launch Camera Barcode Scanner</span>
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* Live SKU Search Dropdown / Input */}
          {isSearchingManually && (
            <div className="p-4 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950/70 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 space-y-3 animate-in fade-in duration-200">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <label className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <Search className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-brand-600" />
                  Live Product Catalog Lookup:
                </label>
                <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 font-mono">
                  Type code or brand name
                </span>
              </div>

              {/* Real-time search bar */}
              <div className="relative">
                <Search className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400 absolute left-3.5 top-3" />
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={searchQuery}
                  onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Search code, SKU, or name (e.g. CDO, Fibisco, P2478, Swiss Miss, Royal)..."
                  className="w-full pl-10 pr-10 py-2.5 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-xs font-medium text-slate-900 dark:text-white placeholder-slate-400 focus:outline-none focus:border-brand-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-brand-500 shadow-sm"
                  autoFocus
                />
                {isSearchingLive && (
                  <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 text-brand-600 dark:text-brand-400 animate-spin absolute right-3.5 top-3" />
                )}
                {searchQuery && !isSearchingLive && (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setSearchQuery('')}
                    className="absolute right-3.5 top-3 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600"
                  >
                    <X className="w-4 h-4" />
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>

              {/* Fast Quick Filter Chips */}
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 pt-1">
                <span className="text-[10px] font-semibold text-slate-400">Quick suggestions:</span>
                {['CDO', 'Fibisco', 'Swiss Miss', 'Royal', 'P2478P', 'Pingcon'].map(tag => (
                  <button
                    key={tag}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setSearchQuery(tag)}
                    className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 text-[11px] font-medium text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 hover:border-brand-500 hover:text-brand-600 transition-colors"
                  >
                    {tag}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>

              {/* Results Grid */}
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-2 max-h-56 overflow-y-auto pr-1 pt-1">
                {liveSearchResults.length > 0 ? (
                  liveSearchResults.map(prod => (
                    <button
                      key={prod.id || prod.sku}
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => handleProductIdentified(prod)}
                      className="p-2.5 text-left bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 hover:border-brand-500 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl transition-all flex items-start space-x-3 group shadow-sm hover:shadow"
                    >
                      <img 
                        src={prod.image_url} 
                        alt={prod.name} 
                        className="w-10 h-10 rounded-lg object-cover border border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 shrink-0 mt-0.5" 
                      />
                      <div className="truncate flex-1 min-w-0">
                        <div className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 group-hover:text-brand-600 truncate">
                          {prod.name}
                        </div>
                        <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 font-mono flex items-center justify-between mt-0.5">
                          <span className="font-semibold text-brand-600 dark:text-brand-400">{prod.sku}</span>
                          <span className="font-bold text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">{formatPeso(prod.unit_price)}</span>
                        </div>
                        <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 truncate mt-0.5">
                          Supplier: {prod.supplier}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </button>
                  ))
                ) : searchQuery ? (
                  <div className="col-span-2 text-center py-6 text-xs text-slate-500">
                    {isSearchingLive ? 'Searching live catalog database...' : `No matching products found for "${searchQuery}". You can still type the barcode manually or launch the camera.`}
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  catalog.slice(0, 6).map(prod => (
                    <button
                      key={prod.sku}
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => handleProductIdentified(prod)}
                      className="p-2.5 text-left bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 hover:border-brand-500 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl transition-all flex items-center space-x-3 group"
                    >
                      <img 
                        src={prod.image_url} 
                        alt={prod.name} 
                        className="w-10 h-10 rounded-lg object-cover border border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 shrink-0" 
                      />
                      <div className="truncate flex-1">
                        <div className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 group-hover:text-brand-600 truncate">
                          {prod.name}
                        </div>
                        <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 font-mono">
                          {prod.sku} • {prod.brand}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </button>
                  ))
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* QUICK TEST BARCODES: ONLY VISIBLE WHEN TEST MODE IS ACTIVE */}
          {isTestMode && (
            <div className="pt-2">
              <div className="p-3 bg-amber-50/80 dark:bg-amber-950/30 rounded-xl border border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-500/30">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
                  <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-300 uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <Zap className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-500" />
                    Test Mode Simulation Barcodes (Tap to Simulate Scan)
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400">Visible only in Test Mode</span>
                </div>

                <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                  {[
                    { sku: 'P2478P', label: 'CDO Luncheon Meat' },
                    { sku: 'P1728P', label: 'Fibisco Crunchies' },
                    { sku: 'SS1247P', label: 'Swiss Miss Choco' },
                    { sku: 'SS1561P', label: 'Royal Filipino' },
                    { sku: 'PC-TIS-001', label: 'Pingcon Jumbo Tissue' },
                    { sku: 'BON-FAC-001', label: 'Bonita Facial Box' }
                  ].map((item) => (
                    <button
                      key={item.sku}
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => handleProductIdentified(item.sku)}
                      className="px-2.5 py-1 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 hover:border-amber-500 border border-amber-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-lg text-xs font-mono text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 transition-all flex items-center space-x-1.5 shadow-sm"
                      title={item.label}
                    >
                      <Barcode className="w-3 h-3 text-amber-600" />
                      <span className="font-bold">{item.sku}</span>
                      <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 font-sans">({item.label.split(' ')[0]})</span>
                    </button>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

        </div>

        {/* =========================================================================
            STEP 2: INSTANT PRODUCT DISPLAY (1 SKU = 1 PRODUCT PROFILE)
        ========================================================================= */}
        <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-3xl p-6 sm:p-7 shadow-sm transition-all space-y-4">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 pb-4">
            <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
              <span className="w-7 h-7 rounded-xl bg-brand-100 dark:bg-brand-500/20 text-brand-700 dark:text-brand-300 flex items-center justify-center font-black text-xs">
                2
              </span>
              <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white tracking-tight">
                Product Information
              </h2>
            </div>
            {selectedProduct && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setSelectedProduct(null)}
                className="text-xs text-rose-500 hover:text-rose-600 font-medium flex items-center gap-1"
              >
                <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span>Clear Item</span>
              </button>
            )}
          </div>

          {selectedProduct ? (
            /* Instant Product Hero Card */
            <div className="p-4 sm:p-5 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950/80 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-start sm:items-center gap-4 sm:gap-5 animate-in fade-in duration-200">
              
              {/* Product Photo */}
              <div className="w-24 h-24 sm:w-28 sm:h-28 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 shrink-0 shadow-xs flex items-center justify-center">
                {selectedProduct.image_url ? (
                  <img 
                    src={selectedProduct.image_url} 
                    alt={selectedProduct.name} 
                    className="w-full h-full object-cover" 
                  />
                ) : (
                  <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-slate-300 dark:text-slate-600 p-2 text-center">
                    <Package className="w-7 h-7 mb-1 opacity-60" />
                    <span className="text-[9px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500">No Image</span>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>

              {/* Product Profile Meta */}
              <div className="space-y-1.5 flex-1">
                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                  <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider bg-brand-100 dark:bg-brand-500/20 text-brand-700 dark:text-brand-300 border border-brand-200 dark:border-brand-500/30">
                    {selectedProduct.brand || 'Brand'}
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-xs font-mono text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-semibold">
                    SKU: {selectedProduct.sku}
                  </span>
                </div>

                <h3 className="text-base sm:text-lg font-extrabold text-slate-900 dark:text-white leading-snug">
                  {selectedProduct.name}
                </h3>

                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-2 text-xs pt-1 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300">
                  <div>
                    <span className="text-slate-400 text-[10px] block">Supplier:</span>
                    <span className="font-medium truncate block">{selectedProduct.supplier}</span>
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <span className="text-slate-400 text-[10px] block">Contract Price:</span>
                    <span className="font-bold font-mono text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">
                      {formatPeso(selectedProduct.unit_price)}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <span className="text-slate-400 text-[10px] block">Pack Size:</span>
                    <span className="truncate block">{selectedProduct.case_pack || 'Box Carton'}</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

            </div>
          ) : (
            /* Prompt to scan */
            <div className="py-8 px-4 text-center border-2 border-dashed border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-2xl space-y-2">
              <Package className="w-10 h-10 text-slate-300 dark:text-slate-600 mx-auto" />
              <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400">
                No product scanned yet.
              </p>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">
                Click <strong>"Launch Camera Barcode Scanner"</strong> in Step 1 above to identify the product.
              </p>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* OPTIONAL SERIAL NUMBER(S) INPUT FIELD (Requirement 4) */}
          {selectedProduct && (
            <div className="pt-2 animate-in fade-in duration-200">
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mb-1 flex items-center justify-between">
                <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <Hash className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-brand-600 dark:text-brand-400" />
                  <span>Serial Number(s) <span className="text-slate-400 font-normal">(Optional for tracked hardware)</span></span>
                </span>
                <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 font-mono">e.g. SN-49201, SN-49202</span>
              </label>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={formData.serialNumbers}
                onChange={(e) => setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, serialNumbers: e.target.value }))}
                placeholder="Enter unit serial numbers if printed on product (comma separated)..."
                className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl px-3.5 py-2 text-xs font-mono text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 focus:outline-none focus:border-brand-500"
              />
            </div>
          )}

        </div>

        {/* =========================================================================
            STEP 3: QUANTITY STEPPER & DEFECT PHOTO UPLOADER
        ========================================================================= */}
        <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-3xl p-6 sm:p-7 shadow-sm transition-all space-y-5">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 pb-4">
            <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
              <span className="w-7 h-7 rounded-xl bg-brand-100 dark:bg-brand-500/20 text-brand-700 dark:text-brand-300 flex items-center justify-center font-black text-xs">
                3
              </span>
              <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white tracking-tight">
                Quantity & Defect Photos
              </h2>
            </div>
            <span className="text-xs font-mono font-bold text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">
              Subtotal: {formatPeso((Number(formData.quantity) || 0) * (Number(selectedProduct?.unit_price) || 0))}
            </span>
          </div>

          {/* Stepper Controls */}
          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mb-2">
              Return Units (Type number directly or use buttons):
            </label>
            <div className="flex items-center space-x-3 max-w-xs">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleQuantityDecrement}
                className="w-14 h-14 bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-800 dark:text-white rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center font-black text-2xl transition-all shadow-sm active:scale-95"
                title="Decrease"
              >
                <Minus className="w-6 h-6" />
              </button>

              <input
                type="number"
                min="1"
                value={formData.quantity}
                onChange={handleQuantityChange}
                className="flex-1 h-14 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border-2 border-brand-500/50 rounded-2xl text-center text-2xl font-black font-mono text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-brand-500 shadow-inner"
              />

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleQuantityIncrement}
                className="w-14 h-14 bg-brand-600 hover:bg-brand-500 active:bg-brand-700 text-white rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center font-black text-2xl transition-all shadow-md shadow-brand-600/30 active:scale-95"
                title="Increase"
              >
                <Plus className="w-6 h-6" />
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Customer / Branch Store Inputs */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3 pt-1">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mb-1">
                Customer Store / Account
              </label>
              <input
                type="text"
                required
                value={formData.customerName}
                onChange={(e) => setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, customerName: e.target.value }))}
                placeholder="e.g. Puregold Price Club"
                className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl px-3.5 py-2.5 text-xs text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 focus:outline-none focus:border-brand-500"
              />
            </div>

            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mb-1">
                Branch / Location
              </label>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={formData.storeBranch}
                onChange={(e) => setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, storeBranch: e.target.value }))}
                placeholder="e.g. Branch 042 - San Fernando"
                className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl px-3.5 py-2.5 text-xs text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 focus:outline-none focus:border-brand-500"
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Defect Category & One-Click AI Helper */}
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <label className="text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">
                Defect Reason & Inspection Notes:
              </label>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleAiDefectDetection}
                disabled={isAiLoading}
                className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-300 hover:text-purple-700 flex items-center gap-1"
              >
                <Sparkles className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-500 ${isAiLoading ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
                <span>{isAiLoading ? 'Analyzing...' : 'Auto-fill AI Defect Statement'}</span>
              </button>
            </div>

            <select
              value={formData.defectCategory}
              onChange={(e) => setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, defectCategory: e.target.value }))}
              className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl px-3.5 py-2.5 text-xs text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 focus:outline-none focus:border-brand-500 font-medium"
            >
              <option value="Damaged in Transit / Crushed Carton">Damaged in Transit / Crushed Carton</option>
              <option value="Packaging Seal Breach / Moisture Exposure">Packaging Seal Breach / Moisture Exposure</option>
              <option value="Factory Short-fill / Core Deformation">Factory Short-fill / Core Deformation</option>
              <option value="Barcode Scan Failure / Unreadable GTIN">Barcode Scan Failure / Unreadable GTIN</option>
              <option value="Defective Electronic / Laser Trigger Stuck">Defective Electronic / Laser Trigger Stuck</option>
              <option value="Expired / Shelf-Life Reached">Expired / Shelf-Life Reached</option>
              <option value="Customer Return / Wrong SKU Shipped">Customer Return / Wrong SKU Shipped</option>
            </select>

            <textarea
              rows="2"
              value={formData.technicalDiagnosis}
              onChange={(e) => setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, technicalDiagnosis: e.target.value }))}
              placeholder="Inspection notes or click 'Auto-fill AI Defect Statement'..."
              className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl px-3.5 py-2 text-xs text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 focus:outline-none focus:border-brand-500 font-mono"
            ></textarea>
          </div>

          {/* Defect Photo Upload & GPS Tag */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3 pt-1">
            
            {/* Photo Uploader */}
            <div className="p-3.5 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 space-y-2">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <Upload className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-brand-600 dark:text-brand-400" />
                  <span>Defect Photos</span>
                </span>

                <label className="px-3 py-1 bg-brand-50 dark:bg-slate-800 hover:bg-brand-100 text-brand-700 dark:text-slate-200 text-xs font-bold rounded-lg cursor-pointer flex items-center space-x-1 transition-colors border border-brand-200 dark:border-slate-700">
                  <Camera className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>{isUploadingPhoto ? 'Uploading...' : 'Take / Upload Photo'}</span>
                  <input
                    type="file"
                    multiple
                    accept="image/*"
                    capture="environment"
                    onChange={handlePhotoUpload}
                    className="hidden"
                  />
                </label>
              </div>

              {/* Photos Gallery */}
              <div className="flex items-center space-x-2 overflow-x-auto py-1 min-h-[44px]">
                {formData.photos.length === 0 ? (
                  <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 italic">No defect photos attached yet.</span>
                ) : (
                  formData.photos.map((url, idx) => (
                    <div key={idx} className="relative w-12 h-12 rounded-xl overflow-hidden border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 shrink-0 group">
                      <img src={url} alt={`Defect ${idx + 1}`} className="w-full h-full object-cover" />
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => handleRemovePhoto(idx)}
                        className="absolute inset-0 bg-black/50 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 flex items-center justify-center text-white transition-opacity"
                      >
                        <X className="w-4 h-4" />
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  ))
                )}
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* GPS Dock Tag */}
            <div className="p-3.5 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 space-y-2">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <MapPin className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-rose-500" />
                  <span>Dock Location Tag</span>
                </span>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handleGrabGps}
                  disabled={isGpsLoading}
                  className="px-2.5 py-1 bg-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-300 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 text-xs font-semibold rounded-lg flex items-center space-x-1 transition-colors"
                >
                  <RefreshCw className={`w-3 h-3 ${isGpsLoading ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
                  <span>{isGpsLoading ? 'Getting...' : 'Tag GPS'}</span>
                </button>
              </div>

              <input
                type="text"
                readOnly
                value={formData.gpsCoordinates || 'Click "Tag GPS" to record receiving dock location'}
                className="w-full bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl px-2.5 py-1.5 text-[11px] font-mono text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300"
              />
            </div>

          </div>
        </div>

        {/* =========================================================================
            STEP 4: BIG "SUBMIT RETURN TICKET" BUTTON
        ========================================================================= */}
        <div className="pt-2">
          <button
            type="submit"
            disabled={isSubmitting || !selectedProduct}
            className={`w-full py-4 px-6 rounded-2xl font-black text-base shadow-xl flex items-center justify-center space-x-3 transition-all ${
              selectedProduct 
                ? 'bg-brand-600 hover:bg-brand-500 text-white shadow-brand-600/30 active:scale-[0.99]' 
                : 'bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-400 cursor-not-allowed'
            }`}
          >
            <Send className="w-5 h-5" />
            <span>
              {isSubmitting 
                ? 'Generating Return Ticket...' 
                : selectedProduct 
                ? `SUBMIT RETURN TICKET (${formData.quantity} UNITS • ${formatPeso((Number(formData.quantity) || 1) * (selectedProduct?.unit_price || 0))})`
                : 'SCAN PRODUCT TO SUBMIT RETURN'}
            </span>
          </button>
        </div>

      </form>

      {/* Camera Barcode Scanner Modal */}
      <ScannerModal
        isOpen={isScannerOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsScannerOpen(false)}
        onScanSuccess={handleProductIdentified}
        catalog={catalog}
      />

    </div>
  );
}

--- END FILE: src/components/SubmitRMATab.jsx ---

--- START FILE: src/components/SupplierClaimsTab.jsx ---
import React, { useState, useMemo, useEffect } from 'react';
import { 
  Building2, 
  Receipt, 
  CheckCircle2, 
  AlertTriangle, 
  Printer, 
  Download, 
  Search, 
  RotateCcw, 
  Trash2, 
  Image as ImageIcon, 
  X, 
  MapPin,
  ArrowUp,
  ArrowDown,
  ArrowUpDown
} from 'lucide-react';
import { exportRMAReportsToCSV } from '../utils/exportCsv';
import TablePagination from './TablePagination';
import ImageLightboxModal from './ImageLightboxModal';
import { supplierClaimService } from '../services/supplierClaimService';

export default function SupplierClaimsTab({
  reportsList = [],
  currentUser,
  onRefresh,
  onViewPhoto,
  onRequestDeleteReport,
  onRequestBulkDeleteReports
}) {
  const [selectedSupplier, setSelectedSupplier] = useState('All');
  const [dispositionFilter, setDispositionFilter] = useState('All');
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
  const [sortField, setSortField] = useState('created_at');
  const [sortDirection, setSortDirection] = useState('desc');
  const [selectedRmaIds, setSelectedRmaIds] = useState(new Set());
  const [activeClaimBatch, setActiveClaimBatch] = useState(null);
  const [currentPage, setCurrentPage] = useState(1);
  const [pageSize, setPageSize] = useState(10);
  const [localLightboxPhoto, setLocalLightboxPhoto] = useState(null);
  const [savedClaims, setSavedClaims] = useState([]);
  const [isSavingClaim, setIsSavingClaim] = useState(false);

  // Role permissions
  const canDeleteReports = currentUser?.role === 'super_admin' || currentUser?.role === 'admin';

  // Load saved supplier debit claims from database
  useEffect(() => {
    let isMounted = true;
    supplierClaimService.getClaims().then(claims => {
      if (isMounted && Array.isArray(claims)) {
        setSavedClaims(claims);
      }
    });
    return () => { isMounted = false; };
  }, [reportsList]);

  // Extract unique suppliers from reports
  const suppliers = useMemo(() => {
    const set = new Set();
    reportsList.forEach(r => {
      const sup = (r.supplier_name || 'Savemore').trim();
      if (sup) set.add(sup);
    });
    return ['All', ...Array.from(set).sort()];
  }, [reportsList]);

  // Reset pagination on filter or sort change
  useEffect(() => {
    setCurrentPage(1);
  }, [selectedSupplier, dispositionFilter, searchTerm, sortField, sortDirection]);

  // Handle column sorting
  const handleSort = (field) => {
    if (sortField === field) {
      setSortDirection(prev => (prev === 'asc' ? 'desc' : 'asc'));
    } else {
      setSortField(field);
      setSortDirection('asc');
    }
  };

  // Filter & sort reports suitable for RTV
  const rtvCandidates = useMemo(() => {
    let list = reportsList.filter(r => {
      const matchesSupplier = selectedSupplier === 'All' || 
        (r.supplier_name || 'Savemore').toLowerCase() === selectedSupplier.toLowerCase();

      const matchesDisposition = dispositionFilter === 'All' || 
        (r.disposition || 'Pending Triage').replace(/^\d+-\s*/, '').toLowerCase() === dispositionFilter.replace(/^\d+-\s*/, '').toLowerCase();

      const q = searchTerm.toLowerCase().trim();
      const matchesSearch = !q || 
        r.name?.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        r.barcode?.includes(q) ||
        r.rma_number?.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        r.code?.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        r.supplier_name?.toLowerCase().includes(q);

      return matchesSupplier && matchesDisposition && matchesSearch;
    });

    list.sort((a, b) => {
      let valA, valB;
      switch (sortField) {
        case 'rma_number':
          valA = String(a.rma_number || '').toLowerCase();
          valB = String(b.rma_number || '').toLowerCase();
          break;
        case 'supplier_name':
          valA = String(a.supplier_name || 'Savemore').toLowerCase();
          valB = String(b.supplier_name || 'Savemore').toLowerCase();
          break;
        case 'name':
          valA = String(a.name || '').toLowerCase();
          valB = String(b.name || '').toLowerCase();
          break;
        case 'disposition':
          valA = String(a.disposition || 'Pending Triage').toLowerCase();
          valB = String(b.disposition || 'Pending Triage').toLowerCase();
          break;
        case 'quantity':
          valA = Number(a.quantity || 1);
          valB = Number(b.quantity || 1);
          break;
        case 'price':
          valA = Number(a.price_with_vat || a.price || 0);
          valB = Number(b.price_with_vat || b.price || 0);
          break;
        case 'total':
          valA = (Number(a.quantity || 1)) * (Number(a.price_with_vat || a.price || 0));
          valB = (Number(b.quantity || 1)) * (Number(b.price_with_vat || b.price || 0));
          break;
        case 'created_at':
        default:
          valA = new Date(a.created_at || 0).getTime();
          valB = new Date(b.created_at || 0).getTime();
          break;
      }

      if (valA < valB) return sortDirection === 'asc' ? -1 : 1;
      if (valA > valB) return sortDirection === 'asc' ? 1 : -1;
      return 0;
    });

    return list;
  }, [reportsList, selectedSupplier, dispositionFilter, searchTerm, sortField, sortDirection]);

  // Paginated Slice
  const paginatedCandidates = useMemo(() => {
    const start = (currentPage - 1) * pageSize;
    return rtvCandidates.slice(start, start + pageSize);
  }, [rtvCandidates, currentPage, pageSize]);

  // Calculate totals of selected items
  const selectedItems = useMemo(() => {
    return rtvCandidates.filter(r => selectedRmaIds.has(r.id || r.rma_number));
  }, [rtvCandidates, selectedRmaIds]);

  const totalClaimAmount = useMemo(() => {
    return selectedItems.reduce((sum, r) => {
      const qty = Number(r.quantity || 1);
      const price = Number(r.price_with_vat || r.price || 0);
      return sum + (qty * price);
    }, 0);
  }, [selectedItems]);

  const totalQuantity = useMemo(() => {
    return selectedItems.reduce((sum, r) => sum + Number(r.quantity || 1), 0);
  }, [selectedItems]);

  const handleToggleSelect = (id) => {
    setSelectedRmaIds(prev => {
      const next = new Set(prev);
      if (next.has(id)) next.delete(id);
      else next.add(id);
      return next;
    });
  };

  const isAllPageSelected = paginatedCandidates.length > 0 && paginatedCandidates.every(r => selectedRmaIds.has(r.id || r.rma_number));

  const handleSelectAll = () => {
    if (selectedRmaIds.size === rtvCandidates.length && rtvCandidates.length > 0) {
      setSelectedRmaIds(new Set());
    } else {
      setSelectedRmaIds(new Set(rtvCandidates.map(r => r.id || r.rma_number)));
    }
  };

  const handleClearSelection = () => {
    setSelectedRmaIds(new Set());
  };

  // Helper to extract user clean name (roles removed, Danilo Alvaro excluded as requested)
  const getCleanUserName = (user) => {
    const raw = user?.name || 'Warehouse Staff';
    let clean = raw.replace(/\s*\([^)]*\)/g, '').trim();
    if (!clean || clean.toLowerCase().includes('danilo alvaro')) {
      clean = 'Warehouse Staff';
    }
    return clean;
  };

  // Helper to safely extract photo URLs
  const getPhotos = (report) => {
    if (!report?.photos) return [];
    if (Array.isArray(report.photos)) return report.photos.filter(Boolean);
    if (typeof report.photos === 'string') {
      try {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(report.photos);
        if (Array.isArray(parsed)) return parsed.filter(Boolean);
      } catch (e) {
        return [report.photos];
      }
    }
    return [];
  };

  const handleOpenPhotoPreview = (report) => {
    const photos = getPhotos(report);
    if (!photos.length) return;
    const photoObj = {
      images: photos,
      initialIndex: 0,
      url: photos[0],
      title: report.name || `Return ${report.rma_number}`,
      subtitle: `RMA #${report.rma_number} • Supplier: ${report.supplier_name || 'Savemore'} • ${report.reason || 'Damaged'}`
    };
    if (onViewPhoto) {
      onViewPhoto(photoObj);
    } else {
      setLocalLightboxPhoto(photoObj);
    }
  };

  // Look up if a report already has a generated RTV Claim
  const getClaimForReport = (report) => {
    if (!report) return null;
    const rma = report.rma_number;
    
    // 1. Search in saved claims items
    const found = savedClaims.find(c => 
      Array.isArray(c.items) && c.items.some(i => i.rma_number === rma)
    );
    if (found) return found;

    // 2. Search in report's notes tag [RTV: RTV-YYYY-XXXX-RAND]
    const notes = String(report.notes || '');
    const m = notes.match(/\[RTV:\s*([^\]]+)\]/i);
    if (m && m[1]) {
      const claimNum = m[1].trim();
      return {
        claimNumber: claimNum,
        claim_number: claimNum,
        supplierName: report.supplier_name || 'Savemore',
        supplier_name: report.supplier_name || 'Savemore',
        generatedBy: 'Warehouse Staff',
        createdAt: report.created_at,
        items: [report],
        totalQuantity: Number(report.quantity) || 1,
        totalClaimAmount: (Number(report.quantity) || 1) * Number(report.price_with_vat || report.price || 0)
      };
    }

    // 3. Search in report's audit_trail
    const audit = Array.isArray(report.audit_trail) ? report.audit_trail : [];
    const rtvAudit = audit.find(a => a.rtv_number || a.action === 'RTV_CLAIM_GENERATED');
    if (rtvAudit && rtvAudit.rtv_number) {
      return {
        claimNumber: rtvAudit.rtv_number,
        claim_number: rtvAudit.rtv_number,
        supplierName: report.supplier_name || 'Savemore',
        supplier_name: report.supplier_name || 'Savemore',
        generatedBy: rtvAudit.generated_by || 'Warehouse Staff',
        createdAt: rtvAudit.timestamp || report.created_at,
        items: [report],
        totalQuantity: Number(report.quantity) || 1,
        totalClaimAmount: (Number(report.quantity) || 1) * Number(report.price_with_vat || report.price || 0)
      };
    }

    return null;
  };

  /**
   * INDIVIDUAL ACTION: GENERATE DEBIT CLAIM FOR SINGLE ITEM
   */
  const handleGenerateSingleClaim = async (item) => {
    if (!item) return;
    const supplierName = (item.supplier_name || 'Savemore').trim();
    const cleanGeneratedBy = getCleanUserName(currentUser);
    const claimNumber = supplierClaimService.generateRtvId(savedClaims);
    const qty = Number(item.quantity) || 1;
    const price = Number(item.price_with_vat || item.price || 0);

    const newClaim = {
      claimNumber,
      claim_number: claimNumber,
      supplierName,
      supplier_name: supplierName,
      createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      created_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      generatedBy: cleanGeneratedBy,
      generated_by: cleanGeneratedBy,
      items: [item],
      totalQuantity: qty,
      totalClaimAmount: qty * price
    };

    setIsSavingClaim(true);
    try {
      await supplierClaimService.saveClaim(newClaim);
      setSavedClaims(prev => [newClaim, ...prev.filter(c => (c.claim_number || c.claimNumber) !== claimNumber)]);
      if (onRefresh) onRefresh();
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('Error saving single claim to database:', err);
    } finally {
      setIsSavingClaim(false);
    }

    setActiveClaimBatch(newClaim);
  };

  /**
   * BATCH ACTION: GENERATE DEBIT CLAIM FOR MULTIPLE ITEMS FROM SAME SUPPLIER
   */
  const handleGenerateBatchClaim = async () => {
    if (selectedItems.length === 0) {
      alert('Please select at least 1 RMA item to bundle into a supplier claim.');
      return;
    }

    // Enforce that all bundled items belong strictly to the SAME supplier
    const suppliersInBatch = [...new Set(selectedItems.map(i => (i.supplier_name || 'Savemore').trim()))];
    if (suppliersInBatch.length > 1) {
      alert(`You have selected items across ${suppliersInBatch.length} different suppliers (${suppliersInBatch.join(', ')}).\n\nAn official Supplier Debit Claim (RTV) voucher must be issued to a SINGLE vendor.\n\nPlease select items from the same supplier, or filter by "${suppliersInBatch[0]}" to generate a consolidated claim.`);
      return;
    }

    const supplierName = suppliersInBatch[0] || (selectedSupplier !== 'All' ? selectedSupplier : 'Savemore');
    const cleanGeneratedBy = getCleanUserName(currentUser);
    const claimNumber = supplierClaimService.generateRtvId(savedClaims);

    const newClaim = {
      claimNumber,
      claim_number: claimNumber,
      supplierName,
      supplier_name: supplierName,
      createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      created_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      generatedBy: cleanGeneratedBy,
      generated_by: cleanGeneratedBy,
      items: selectedItems,
      totalQuantity,
      totalClaimAmount
    };

    setIsSavingClaim(true);
    try {
      await supplierClaimService.saveClaim(newClaim);
      setSavedClaims(prev => [newClaim, ...prev.filter(c => (c.claim_number || c.claimNumber) !== claimNumber)]);
      if (onRefresh) onRefresh();
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('Error saving batch claim to database:', err);
    } finally {
      setIsSavingClaim(false);
    }

    setActiveClaimBatch(newClaim);
  };

  /**
   * BATCH ACTION: PRINT VOUCHERS FOR SELECTED ITEMS
   */
  const handlePrintSelectedVouchers = () => {
    if (selectedItems.length === 0) return;

    const suppliersInBatch = [...new Set(selectedItems.map(i => (i.supplier_name || 'Savemore').trim()))];
    if (suppliersInBatch.length > 1) {
      alert(`You have selected items across ${suppliersInBatch.length} different suppliers (${suppliersInBatch.join(', ')}).\n\nTo print a consolidated RTV voucher, please select items from a single supplier.`);
      return;
    }

    const supplierName = suppliersInBatch[0];
    const cleanGeneratedBy = getCleanUserName(currentUser);
    
    // Look up if a claim was already created for these items, or create temporary print preview
    let existingClaim = savedClaims.find(c => 
      c.supplier_name === supplierName && Array.isArray(c.items) && selectedItems.some(si => c.items.some(ci => ci.rma_number === si.rma_number))
    );

    if (!existingClaim) {
      const claimNumber = supplierClaimService.generateRtvId(savedClaims);
      existingClaim = {
        claimNumber,
        claim_number: claimNumber,
        supplierName,
        createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        generatedBy: cleanGeneratedBy,
        items: selectedItems,
        totalQuantity,
        totalClaimAmount
      };
    }

    setActiveClaimBatch(existingClaim);
    setTimeout(() => {
      window.print();
    }, 400);
  };

  /**
   * BATCH ACTION: DELETE SELECTED REPORTS
   */
  const handleBulkDelete = () => {
    if (selectedItems.length === 0) return;
    if (onRequestBulkDeleteReports) {
      onRequestBulkDeleteReports(selectedItems);
    }
  };

  const handlePrintClaimVoucher = () => {
    window.print();
  };

  const hasActiveFilters = selectedSupplier !== 'All' || dispositionFilter !== 'All' || Boolean(searchTerm);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-5 animate-in fade-in duration-200 w-full min-w-0 box-border">
      
      {/* Top Banner */}
      <div className="p-4 sm:p-5 bg-gradient-to-r from-amber-500/10 via-amber-500/5 to-transparent border border-amber-500/20 rounded-2xl flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 w-full min-w-0 box-border">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 min-w-0">
          <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-amber-500 text-white flex items-center justify-center font-black shadow-md shadow-amber-500/20 shrink-0">
            <Building2 className="w-5 h-5" />
          </div>
          <div className="min-w-0">
            <h3 className="text-base font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
              <span>Supplier Claims & RTV Chargeback Batching</span>
              <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-extrabold bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 dark:bg-amber-950 dark:text-amber-300 shrink-0">
                Vendor Recovery
              </span>
            </h3>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 truncate">
              Bundle damaged/defective merchandise by vendor to issue consolidated <strong>Return to Vendor (RTV) Debit Claims</strong>. All claims are automatically synced to database.
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Filter Controls Bar (Dropdowns + Search) */}
      <div className="p-3 sm:p-4 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-2xl space-y-3 shadow-xs w-full min-w-0 box-border">
        <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row items-stretch md:items-center justify-between gap-3 w-full min-w-0">
          
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 md:flex md:flex-wrap md:items-center gap-2.5 w-full md:w-auto min-w-0">
            {/* Supplier Select Dropdown */}
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 w-full md:w-auto min-w-0">
              <label className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 shrink-0">
                Supplier:
              </label>
              <select
                value={selectedSupplier}
                onChange={(e) => {
                  setSelectedSupplier(e.target.value);
                  setSelectedRmaIds(new Set());
                }}
                className="w-full md:w-auto px-3 py-2 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-amber-600 cursor-pointer shadow-2xs md:max-w-[200px] truncate box-border"
                title="Filter by Supplier / Vendor"
              >
                {suppliers.map(sup => (
                  <option key={sup} value={sup}>
                    {sup === 'All' ? 'All Suppliers' : sup}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>

            {/* Disposition Filter Dropdown */}
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 w-full md:w-auto min-w-0">
              <label className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 shrink-0">
                Triage:
              </label>
              <select
                value={dispositionFilter}
                onChange={(e) => {
                  setDispositionFilter(e.target.value);
                  setSelectedRmaIds(new Set());
                }}
                className="w-full md:w-auto px-3 py-2 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-amber-600 cursor-pointer shadow-2xs truncate box-border"
                title="Filter by Triage Disposition"
              >
                <option value="All">All Dispositions</option>
                <option value="1- Pending Triage">1- Pending Triage</option>
                <option value="2- Restock to Inventory">2- Restock to Inventory</option>
                <option value="3- Return to Vendor (RTV)">3- Return to Vendor (RTV)</option>
