                <option value="4- Quarantine">4- Quarantine</option>
                <option value="5- Scrap / Dispose">5- Scrap / Dispose</option>
              </select>
            </div>

            {hasActiveFilters && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  setSelectedSupplier('All');
                  setDispositionFilter('All');
                  setSearchTerm('');
                  setSelectedRmaIds(new Set());
                }}
                className="w-full sm:w-auto px-2.5 py-1.5 bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold flex items-center justify-center gap-1 transition-colors cursor-pointer box-border"
                title="Reset all filters"
              >
                <RotateCcw className="w-3 h-3 shrink-0" />
                <span>Reset</span>
              </button>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Search Bar with Clear Button */}
          <div className="relative w-full md:w-auto md:min-w-[240px] min-w-0">
            <Search className="w-3.5 h-3.5 absolute left-3 top-3 text-slate-400" />
            <input
              type="text"
              value={searchTerm}
              onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Search RMA#, product, SKU..."
              className="w-full pl-8 pr-8 py-2 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-white placeholder-slate-400 focus:outline-none focus:border-amber-600"
            />
            {searchTerm && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setSearchTerm('')}
                className="absolute right-2.5 top-2.5 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-slate-200"
                title="Clear search"
              >
                <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Selection & Multi-Select Toolbar (Printing or Deleting Only) */}
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 pt-2.5 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 text-xs">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2.5">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleSelectAll}
              className="font-bold text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 hover:underline cursor-pointer"
            >
              {selectedRmaIds.size === rtvCandidates.length && rtvCandidates.length > 0 ? 'Deselect All' : `Select All (${rtvCandidates.length})`}
            </button>

            {selectedRmaIds.size > 0 && (
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                <span className="font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/60 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg border border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-900">
                  {selectedRmaIds.size} selected • ₱{totalClaimAmount.toLocaleString(undefined, { minimumFractionDigits: 2 })}
                </span>

                {/* 1. Print Vouchers for Selected Items */}
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handlePrintSelectedVouchers}
                  className="px-3 py-1 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-900 text-white rounded-lg text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-colors cursor-pointer shadow-xs"
                  title="Print RTV claim vouchers for selected items"
                >
                  <Printer className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>Print Vouchers</span>
                </button>

                {/* 2. Delete Selected */}
                {canDeleteReports && onRequestBulkDeleteReports && (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={handleBulkDelete}
                    className="px-3 py-1 bg-rose-50 hover:bg-rose-100 dark:bg-rose-950/70 dark:hover:bg-rose-900/70 text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300 border border-rose-300 dark:border-rose-800 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-colors cursor-pointer shadow-2xs"
                    title="Permanently delete selected records and remove proof images"
                  >
                    <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    <span>Delete Selected ({selectedRmaIds.size})</span>
                  </button>
                )}

                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handleClearSelection}
                  className="text-xs text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-slate-200 font-bold ml-1 cursor-pointer"
                >
                  Clear
                </button>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => exportRMAReportsToCSV(selectedItems.length > 0 ? selectedItems : rtvCandidates)}
            className="text-xs text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-800 dark:hover:text-white flex items-center gap-1 font-bold cursor-pointer ml-auto"
          >
            <Download className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>Export RTV CSV</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* RTV Items Table */}
      <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden shadow-xs">
        {rtvCandidates.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="p-12 text-center text-xs text-slate-400 space-y-2">
            <Building2 className="w-8 h-8 mx-auto text-slate-300 dark:text-slate-700" />
            <p className="font-semibold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400">No return merchandise matching the selected filters.</p>
            {hasActiveFilters && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  setSelectedSupplier('All');
                  setDispositionFilter('All');
                  setSearchTerm('');
                  setSelectedRmaIds(new Set());
                }}
                className="text-amber-600 hover:underline font-bold text-xs"
              >
                Clear all filters
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            <table className="w-full text-left text-xs">
              <thead className="bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-bold border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 select-none">
                <tr>
                  {/* Select All Checkbox */}
                  <th className="p-3 w-10 text-center">
                    <input
                      type="checkbox"
                      checked={isAllPageSelected}
                      onChange={handleSelectAll}
                      className="rounded-md border-slate-300 text-amber-600 focus:ring-amber-500 cursor-pointer"
                      title="Select all on this page"
                    />
                  </th>

                  {/* SN Column */}
                  <th className="p-3 w-14 font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                    SN
                  </th>

                  {/* Photo Column */}
                  <th className="p-3 text-center w-12" title="Proof Photo">
                    <ImageIcon className="w-4 h-4 mx-auto text-slate-400" />
                  </th>

                  {/* RMA Identifier */}
                  <th 
                    onClick={() => handleSort('rma_number')}
                    className="p-3 cursor-pointer hover:text-amber-600 transition-colors group"
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                      <span>RMA Identifier</span>
                      {sortField === 'rma_number' || sortField === 'created_at' ? (
                        sortDirection === 'asc' ? <ArrowUp className="w-3 h-3 text-amber-600" /> : <ArrowDown className="w-3 h-3 text-amber-600" />
                      ) : <ArrowUpDown className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-300 group-hover:text-slate-400" />}
                    </div>
                  </th>

                  {/* Vendor / Supplier */}
                  <th 
                    onClick={() => handleSort('supplier_name')}
                    className="p-3 cursor-pointer hover:text-amber-600 transition-colors group"
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                      <span>Vendor / Supplier</span>
                      {sortField === 'supplier_name' ? (
                        sortDirection === 'asc' ? <ArrowUp className="w-3 h-3 text-amber-600" /> : <ArrowDown className="w-3 h-3 text-amber-600" />
                      ) : <ArrowUpDown className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-300 group-hover:text-slate-400" />}
                    </div>
                  </th>

                  {/* Product Description & SKU */}
                  <th 
                    onClick={() => handleSort('name')}
                    className="p-3 cursor-pointer hover:text-amber-600 transition-colors group"
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                      <span>Product Description & SKU</span>
                      {sortField === 'name' ? (
                        sortDirection === 'asc' ? <ArrowUp className="w-3 h-3 text-amber-600" /> : <ArrowDown className="w-3 h-3 text-amber-600" />
                      ) : <ArrowUpDown className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-300 group-hover:text-slate-400" />}
                    </div>
                  </th>

                  {/* Triage Disposition */}
                  <th 
                    onClick={() => handleSort('disposition')}
                    className="p-3 cursor-pointer hover:text-amber-600 transition-colors group"
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                      <span>Triage Disposition</span>
                      {sortField === 'disposition' ? (
                        sortDirection === 'asc' ? <ArrowUp className="w-3 h-3 text-amber-600" /> : <ArrowDown className="w-3 h-3 text-amber-600" />
                      ) : <ArrowUpDown className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-300 group-hover:text-slate-400" />}
                    </div>
                  </th>

                  {/* Qty */}
                  <th 
                    onClick={() => handleSort('quantity')}
                    className="p-3 text-right cursor-pointer hover:text-amber-600 transition-colors group"
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-1">
                      <span>Qty</span>
                      {sortField === 'quantity' ? (
                        sortDirection === 'asc' ? <ArrowUp className="w-3 h-3 text-amber-600" /> : <ArrowDown className="w-3 h-3 text-amber-600" />
                      ) : <ArrowUpDown className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-300 group-hover:text-slate-400" />}
                    </div>
                  </th>

                  {/* Unit Price */}
                  <th 
                    onClick={() => handleSort('price')}
                    className="p-3 text-right cursor-pointer hover:text-amber-600 transition-colors group"
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-1">
                      <span>Unit Price</span>
                      {sortField === 'price' ? (
                        sortDirection === 'asc' ? <ArrowUp className="w-3 h-3 text-amber-600" /> : <ArrowDown className="w-3 h-3 text-amber-600" />
                      ) : <ArrowUpDown className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-300 group-hover:text-slate-400" />}
                    </div>
                  </th>

                  {/* Total Claim */}
                  <th 
                    onClick={() => handleSort('total')}
                    className="p-3 text-right cursor-pointer hover:text-amber-600 transition-colors group"
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-1">
                      <span>Total Claim</span>
                      {sortField === 'total' ? (
                        sortDirection === 'asc' ? <ArrowUp className="w-3 h-3 text-amber-600" /> : <ArrowDown className="w-3 h-3 text-amber-600" />
                      ) : <ArrowUpDown className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-300 group-hover:text-slate-400" />}
                    </div>
                  </th>

                  {/* Actions Column */}
                  <th className="p-3 text-center font-bold">
                    Actions
                  </th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100 dark:divide-slate-800">
                {paginatedCandidates.map((r, idx) => {
                  const id = r.id || r.rma_number;
                  const isSelected = selectedRmaIds.has(id);
                  const qty = Number(r.quantity || 1);
                  const price = Number(r.price_with_vat || r.price || 0);
                  const total = qty * price;
                  const photos = getPhotos(r);
                  const existingClaim = getClaimForReport(r);

                  return (
                    <tr 
                      key={id}
                      onClick={() => handleToggleSelect(id)}
                      className={`hover:bg-slate-50/80 dark:hover:bg-slate-800/40 transition-colors cursor-pointer ${
                        isSelected ? 'bg-amber-50/60 dark:bg-amber-950/20' : ''
                      }`}
                    >
                      {/* Checkbox */}
                      <td className="p-3 text-center" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
                        <input
                          type="checkbox"
                          checked={isSelected}
                          onChange={() => handleToggleSelect(id)}
                          className="rounded-md border-slate-300 text-amber-600 focus:ring-amber-500 cursor-pointer"
                        />
                      </td>

                      {/* SN Column */}
                      <td className="p-3 font-mono">
                        <span className="font-black text-amber-900 dark:text-amber-300 bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/60 border border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-800 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg text-xs">
                          #{(currentPage - 1) * pageSize + idx + 1}
                        </span>
                      </td>

                      {/* Photo Thumbnail */}
                      <td className="p-2 text-center" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
                        {photos.length > 0 ? (
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => handleOpenPhotoPreview(r)}
                            className="relative w-9 h-9 rounded-xl overflow-hidden border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800 inline-block hover:scale-105 transition-all shadow-2xs cursor-zoom-in"
                            title="Click to view full-size photo"
                          >
                            <img 
                              src={photos[0]} 
                              alt="Proof" 
                              className="w-full h-full object-cover" 
                            />
                            {photos.length > 1 && (
                              <span className="absolute bottom-0 right-0 bg-black/70 text-white text-[8px] font-black px-1 rounded-tl">
                                +{photos.length - 1}
                              </span>
                            )}
                          </button>
                        ) : (
                          <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-300 dark:text-slate-600 flex items-center justify-center mx-auto border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700">
                            <ImageIcon className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                          </div>
                        )}
                      </td>

                      {/* RMA Identifier */}
                      <td className="p-3">
                        <div className="font-mono font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                          {r.rma_number}
                        </div>
                        <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap">
                          <span>{r.created_at ? new Date(r.created_at).toLocaleDateString() : ''}</span>
                          {r.gps_latitude && r.gps_longitude && (
                            <a
                              href={`https://www.google.com/maps?q=${r.gps_latitude},${r.gps_longitude}`}
                              target="_blank"
                              rel="noreferrer"
                              onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
                              className="text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 hover:underline inline-flex items-center gap-0.5 font-bold"
                              title="View GPS Location on Google Maps"
                            >
                              <MapPin className="w-2.5 h-2.5 text-rose-500" />
                              <span>Map</span>
                            </a>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </td>

                      {/* Vendor / Supplier */}
                      <td className="p-3 font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">
                        {r.supplier_name || 'Savemore'}
                      </td>

                      {/* Product Description & SKU */}
                      <td className="p-3">
                        <div className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white truncate max-w-xs" title={r.name}>
                          {r.name}
                        </div>
                        <div className="text-[10px] font-mono text-slate-400">
                          SKU: <strong className="text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300">{r.code || r.sku || 'Unassigned'}</strong> • BC: {r.barcode}
                        </div>
                      </td>

                      {/* Triage Disposition */}
                      <td className="p-3">
                        <span className={`px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-extrabold border inline-block whitespace-nowrap shadow-2xs ${
                          r.disposition === 'Return to Vendor (RTV)'
                            ? 'bg-rose-50 text-rose-700 border-rose-200 dark:bg-rose-950/70 dark:text-rose-300 dark:border-rose-800'
                            : r.disposition === 'Restock to Inventory'
                            ? 'bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 border-blue-200 dark:bg-blue-950/70 dark:text-blue-300 dark:border-blue-800'
                            : r.disposition === 'Quarantine'
                            ? 'bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 border-amber-200 dark:bg-amber-950/70 dark:text-amber-300 dark:border-amber-800'
                            : r.disposition === 'Scrap / Dispose'
                            ? 'bg-rose-100 text-rose-800 border-rose-300 dark:bg-rose-950 dark:text-rose-300'
                            : 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 border-slate-300 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700'
                        }`}>
                          {r.disposition || 'Pending Triage'}
                        </span>
                      </td>

                      {/* Qty */}
                      <td className="p-3 text-right font-mono font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                        {qty} {r.unit_name || 'pc'}
                      </td>

                      {/* Unit Price */}
                      <td className="p-3 text-right font-mono text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400">
                        ₱{price.toFixed(2)}
                      </td>

                      {/* Total Claim */}
                      <td className="p-3 text-right font-mono font-black text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400">
                        ₱{total.toFixed(2)}
                      </td>

                      {/* Actions Column: Individual Debit Claim & Delete Only */}
                      <td className="p-2.5 text-center" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap">
                          {/* Individual Action for Debit Claim Generation or Viewing */}
                          {existingClaim ? (
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => setActiveClaimBatch(existingClaim)}
                              className="px-2.5 py-1 bg-emerald-100 hover:bg-emerald-200 dark:bg-emerald-950/70 dark:hover:bg-emerald-900/70 text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-700 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-black flex items-center gap-1 transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-2xs"
                              title={`View Official RTV Debit Claim Voucher: ${existingClaim.claimNumber || existingClaim.claim_number}`}
                            >
                              <Receipt className="w-3 h-3 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400" />
                              <span>RTV Voucher</span>
                            </button>
                          ) : (
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => handleGenerateSingleClaim(r)}
                              disabled={isSavingClaim}
                              className="px-2.5 py-1 bg-amber-50 hover:bg-amber-100 dark:bg-amber-950/70 dark:hover:bg-amber-900/70 text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-300 border border-amber-300 dark:border-amber-700 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-bold flex items-center gap-1 transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-2xs"
                              title={`Generate RTV Debit Claim Voucher for ${r.rma_number}`}
                            >
                              <Receipt className="w-3 h-3 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400" />
                              <span>+ Debit Claim</span>
                            </button>
                          )}

                          {/* Delete Report */}
                          {canDeleteReports && onRequestDeleteReport && (
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => onRequestDeleteReport(r.id, r.rma_number, r)}
                              className="p-1.5 text-rose-500 hover:text-rose-700 hover:bg-rose-50 dark:hover:bg-rose-950/50 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                              title={`Delete RMA #${r.rma_number} and remove stored proof photos`}
                            >
                              <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                            </button>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  );
                })}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Table Pagination Component */}
        <TablePagination
          currentPage={currentPage}
          totalItems={rtvCandidates.length}
          pageSize={pageSize}
          onPageChange={setCurrentPage}
          onPageSizeChange={(newSize) => {
            setPageSize(newSize);
            setCurrentPage(1);
          }}
          pageSizeOptions={[10, 25, 50, 100]}
          itemLabel="claim items"
        />
      </div>

      {/* Lightbox Modal (Fallback if onViewPhoto is not supplied) */}
      {localLightboxPhoto && (
        <ImageLightboxModal
          isOpen={Boolean(localLightboxPhoto)}
          imageUrl={localLightboxPhoto?.url}
          images={localLightboxPhoto?.images || [localLightboxPhoto.url]}
          initialIndex={localLightboxPhoto?.initialIndex || 0}
          title={localLightboxPhoto?.title}
          subtitle={localLightboxPhoto?.subtitle}
          onClose={() => setLocalLightboxPhoto(null)}
        />
      )}

      {/* FORMAL RTV DEBIT CLAIM VOUCHER MODAL */}
      {activeClaimBatch && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-slate-900/80 backdrop-blur-xs flex items-center justify-center p-3 sm:p-4 overflow-y-auto">
          <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 max-w-3xl w-full shadow-2xl overflow-hidden flex flex-col max-h-[95vh] animate-in zoom-in-95">
            
            {/* Header */}
            <div className="p-4 sm:px-6 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-850 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between shrink-0">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <Receipt className="w-5 h-5 text-amber-600" />
                <h3 className="text-sm font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                  Supplier Debit Claim Voucher (RTV)
                </h3>
                <span className="text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 dark:bg-emerald-950 dark:text-emerald-300">
                  Synced to Database
                </span>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setActiveClaimBatch(null)}
                className="text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-700 dark:hover:text-white text-xs font-bold"
              >
                ✕
              </button>
            </div>

            {/* Printable Voucher Mount */}
            <div id="rtv-voucher-mount" className="p-6 overflow-y-auto space-y-6 text-xs bg-white text-black font-sans">
              
              {/* Header Grid */}
              <div className="border-b-2 border-black pb-4 flex items-start justify-between">
                <div>
                  <div className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-slate-600">
                    WHOLESALE REVERSE LOGISTICS & RECOVERY
                  </div>
                  <h2 className="text-xl font-black text-black">
                    SUPPLIER DEBIT CLAIM VOUCHER
                  </h2>
                  <div className="text-xs text-slate-600 mt-1">
                    Vendor / Counterparty: <strong>{activeClaimBatch.supplierName || activeClaimBatch.supplier_name}</strong>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="text-right">
                  <div className="font-mono text-sm font-black text-black bg-slate-100 px-2 py-1 border border-black inline-block">
                    {activeClaimBatch.claimNumber || activeClaimBatch.claim_number}
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 mt-1">
                    Date: {new Date(activeClaimBatch.createdAt || activeClaimBatch.created_at).toLocaleDateString()}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Summary Stats */}
              <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3 p-3 bg-slate-50 border border-black rounded-lg">
                <div>
                  <div className="text-[9px] font-black uppercase text-slate-500">TOTAL BUNDLED ITEMS</div>
                  <div className="text-base font-black text-black">{activeClaimBatch.items?.length || 1} Lines</div>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <div className="text-[9px] font-black uppercase text-slate-500">TOTAL RETURNED UNITS</div>
                  <div className="text-base font-black text-black">{activeClaimBatch.totalQuantity || activeClaimBatch.total_quantity} Units</div>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <div className="text-[9px] font-black uppercase text-slate-500">TOTAL CLAIM AMOUNT</div>
                  <div className="text-base font-black text-amber-600 font-mono">
                    ₱{Number(activeClaimBatch.totalClaimAmount || activeClaimBatch.total_claim_amount || 0).toLocaleString(undefined, { minimumFractionDigits: 2 })}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Items Table */}
              <div className="border border-black rounded-lg overflow-hidden">
                <table className="w-full text-left text-[11px]">
                  <thead className="bg-slate-100 border-b border-black font-bold uppercase text-[10px]">
                    <tr>
                      <th className="p-2">RMA #</th>
                      <th className="p-2">Barcode / SKU</th>
                      <th className="p-2">Description</th>
                      <th className="p-2 text-center">Qty</th>
                      <th className="p-2 text-right">Price</th>
                      <th className="p-2 text-right">Total</th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-200">
                    {(activeClaimBatch.items || []).map((item, idx) => {
                      const qty = Number(item.quantity) || 1;
                      const price = Number(item.price_with_vat || item.price || 0);
                      return (
                        <tr key={idx}>
                          <td className="p-2 font-mono font-bold">{item.rma_number}</td>
                          <td className="p-2 font-mono">{item.code || item.sku || item.barcode}</td>
                          <td className="p-2 font-semibold">{item.name}</td>
                          <td className="p-2 text-center font-mono">{qty} {item.unit_name || 'pc'}</td>
                          <td className="p-2 text-right font-mono">₱{price.toFixed(2)}</td>
                          <td className="p-2 text-right font-mono font-bold">₱{(qty * price).toFixed(2)}</td>
                        </tr>
                      );
                    })}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </div>

              {/* Signatures */}
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-8 pt-8 border-t border-black text-center text-[10px]">
                <div>
                  <div className="border-b border-black pb-8"></div>
                  <div className="font-bold pt-1 uppercase">Prepared By (Logistics / Warehouse)</div>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={activeClaimBatch.generatedBy || activeClaimBatch.generated_by || ''}
                    onChange={(e) => setActiveClaimBatch(prev => ({ ...prev, generatedBy: e.target.value, generated_by: e.target.value }))}
                    className="text-center font-semibold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100 print:text-black w-full bg-transparent border-none focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-brand-500 rounded text-[11px] px-1"
                    title="Click to edit name if needed"
                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <div className="border-b border-black pb-8"></div>
                  <div className="font-bold pt-1 uppercase">Supplier Acknowledgement / Driver Signature</div>
                  <div className="text-slate-500 print:text-black">Signature Over Printed Name & Date</div>
                </div>
              </div>

            </div>

            {/* Footer Actions */}
            <div className="p-4 sm:px-6 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-850 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between shrink-0">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setActiveClaimBatch(null)}
                className="px-4 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-400"
              >
                Close
              </button>

              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handlePrintClaimVoucher}
                  className="px-4 py-2 bg-slate-900 hover:bg-black text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-black flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-md cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <Printer className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>Print Voucher</span>
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

          </div>
        </div>
      )}

    </div>
  );
}

--- START FILE: src/components/SupplierInput.jsx ---
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { Building2, Check, Sparkles } from 'lucide-react';
import { catalogService } from '../services/catalogService';

/**
 * Modern Autocomplete Input for Supplier Names
 * - Automatically loads existing suppliers from catalog and RMA returns
 * - Shows instantaneous match suggestions (e.g. typing "Save" suggests "Savemore")
 * - Prevents discrepancies like Savemore vs Save More vs savemore
 */
export default function SupplierInput({
  value = '',
  onChange,
  placeholder = 'e.g. Savemore, Walter Mart, Mondelez',
  className = '',
  id = 'supplier-name-input',
  name = 'supplierName',
  required = false
}) {
  const [knownSuppliers, setKnownSuppliers] = useState([
    'Savemore',
    'Walter Mart',
    'SM Supermarket',
    'Puregold',
    'Robinsons Supermarket',
    'Mondelez',
    'Universal Robina Corporation (URC)',
    'Bonita',
    'Keysys',
    'A2Z2GO',
    'Pingcon Marketing'
  ]);
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  const [highlightedIndex, setHighlightedIndex] = useState(-1);
  const wrapperRef = useRef(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    let mounted = true;
    catalogService.getUniqueSuppliers().then(list => {
      if (mounted && Array.isArray(list) && list.length > 0) {
        setKnownSuppliers(list);
      }
    }).catch(() => {});
    return () => { mounted = false; };
  }, []);

  // Close on outside click
  useEffect(() => {
    function handleClickOutside(event) {
      if (wrapperRef.current && !wrapperRef.current.contains(event.target)) {
        setIsOpen(false);
      }
    }
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
    return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
  }, []);

  const cleanValue = String(value || '').trim();
  const cleanLower = cleanValue.toLowerCase();

  // Find matches that contain the query
  const matchingSuppliers = knownSuppliers.filter(s => {
    if (!cleanLower) return true;
    return s.toLowerCase().includes(cleanLower);
  });

  // Check if there is a primary suggestion that doesn't exactly match what was typed
  const topSuggestion = matchingSuppliers.find(
    s => s.toLowerCase() !== cleanLower && s.toLowerCase().startsWith(cleanLower)
  ) || matchingSuppliers.find(s => s.toLowerCase() !== cleanLower);

  const handleSelect = (supplier) => {
    onChange(supplier);
    setIsOpen(false);
    setHighlightedIndex(-1);
  };

  const handleKeyDown = (e) => {
    if (!isOpen || matchingSuppliers.length === 0) {
      if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
        setIsOpen(true);
      }
      return;
    }

    if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
      e.preventDefault();
      setHighlightedIndex(prev => (prev < matchingSuppliers.length - 1 ? prev + 1 : 0));
    } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
      e.preventDefault();
      setHighlightedIndex(prev => (prev > 0 ? prev - 1 : matchingSuppliers.length - 1));
    } else if (e.key === 'Enter') {
      if (highlightedIndex >= 0 && matchingSuppliers[highlightedIndex]) {
        e.preventDefault();
        handleSelect(matchingSuppliers[highlightedIndex]);
      } else if (topSuggestion) {
        e.preventDefault();
        handleSelect(topSuggestion);
      }
    } else if (e.key === 'Escape') {
      setIsOpen(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="relative w-full" ref={wrapperRef}>
      <div className="relative">
        <input
          id={id}
          name={name}
          type="text"
          autoComplete="off"
          list="known-suppliers-datalist"
          value={value}
          required={required}
          onChange={(e) => {
            onChange(e.target.value);
            setIsOpen(true);
            setHighlightedIndex(-1);
          }}
          onFocus={() => setIsOpen(true)}
          onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
          placeholder={placeholder}
          className={className}
        />

        <datalist id="known-suppliers-datalist">
          {knownSuppliers.map((s) => (
            <option key={s} value={s} />
          ))}
        </datalist>
      </div>

      {/* Quick Suggestion Pill when typing (e.g. typing "Save" suggests "Savemore") */}
      {cleanValue && topSuggestion && cleanLower !== topSuggestion.toLowerCase() && (
        <div className="mt-1 flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] animate-in fade-in">
          <span className="text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-medium">Suggestion:</span>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => handleSelect(topSuggestion)}
            className="px-2 py-0.5 bg-indigo-50 hover:bg-indigo-100 dark:bg-indigo-950/70 dark:hover:bg-indigo-900 border border-indigo-200 dark:border-indigo-800 text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-300 rounded-lg font-bold flex items-center gap-1 transition-colors cursor-pointer shadow-2xs"
            title={`Auto-fill "${topSuggestion}" to prevent discrepancy`}
          >
            <Sparkles className="w-3 h-3 text-indigo-500" />
            <span>Use "{topSuggestion}"</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Floating Dropdown of Matching Suppliers */}
      {isOpen && matchingSuppliers.length > 0 && cleanValue && (
        <div className="absolute left-0 right-0 top-full mt-1.5 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-2xl shadow-xl z-50 overflow-hidden max-h-56 overflow-y-auto animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95 duration-150">
          <div className="p-1.5">
            <div className="px-2.5 py-1 text-[10px] font-black tracking-wider uppercase text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 mb-1 flex items-center justify-between">
              <span>Recorded Suppliers</span>
              <span>{matchingSuppliers.length} match{matchingSuppliers.length > 1 ? 'es' : ''}</span>
            </div>
            {matchingSuppliers.slice(0, 8).map((supplier, idx) => {
              const isSelected = supplier.toLowerCase() === cleanLower;
              const isHighlighted = idx === highlightedIndex;

              return (
                <button
                  key={supplier}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => handleSelect(supplier)}
                  className={`w-full text-left px-3 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold flex items-center justify-between transition-colors cursor-pointer ${
                    isHighlighted || isSelected
                      ? 'bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-950/60 text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-300 font-bold'
                      : 'text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800'
                  }`}
                >
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <Building2 className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${isSelected ? 'text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400' : 'text-slate-400'}`} />
                    <span>{supplier}</span>
                  </div>
                  {isSelected && (
                    <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400" />
                  )}
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

--- START FILE: src/components/TablePagination.jsx ---
import React from 'react';
import { ChevronLeft, ChevronRight } from 'lucide-react';

export default function TablePagination({
  currentPage = 1,
  totalItems = 0,
  pageSize = 10,
  onPageChange,
  onPageSizeChange,
  pageSizeOptions = [10, 25, 50, 100],
  itemLabel = 'items'
}) {
  if (totalItems === 0) return null;

  const totalPages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(totalItems / pageSize));
  const startIndex = (currentPage - 1) * pageSize + 1;
  const endIndex = Math.min(totalItems, currentPage * pageSize);

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 p-3.5 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-900/90 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 text-xs text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 font-semibold select-none rounded-b-2xl">
      {/* Left: Rows Per Page & Item Range */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 sm:gap-3">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
          <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">Rows per page:</span>
          <select
            value={pageSize}
            onChange={(e) => {
              if (onPageSizeChange) onPageSizeChange(Number(e.target.value));
              if (onPageChange) onPageChange(1);
            }}
            className="px-2 py-1 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100 focus:outline-none focus:border-blue-600 cursor-pointer shadow-xs"
          >
            {pageSizeOptions.map(opt => (
              <option key={opt} value={opt}>{opt}</option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </div>

        <span className="text-slate-300 dark:text-slate-700">|</span>

        <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
          Showing <strong className="text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100">{startIndex} - {endIndex}</strong> of <strong className="text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100">{totalItems}</strong> {itemLabel}
        </span>
      </div>

      {/* Right: Page Navigation */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 self-end sm:self-auto">
        <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mr-1.5">
          Page <strong className="text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100">{currentPage}</strong> of <strong className="text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100">{totalPages}</strong>
        </span>

        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => onPageChange && onPageChange(Math.max(1, currentPage - 1))}
          disabled={currentPage <= 1}
          className="min-h-[44px] px-3 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 disabled:opacity-40 disabled:hover:bg-white dark:disabled:hover:bg-slate-800 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1 transition-all shadow-xs cursor-pointer disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
          title="Previous Page"
        >
          <ChevronLeft className="w-4 h-4" />
          <span>Prev</span>
        </button>

        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => onPageChange && onPageChange(Math.min(totalPages, currentPage + 1))}
          disabled={currentPage >= totalPages}
          className="min-h-[44px] px-3 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 disabled:opacity-40 disabled:hover:bg-white dark:disabled:hover:bg-slate-800 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1 transition-all shadow-xs cursor-pointer disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
          title="Next Page"
        >
          <span>Next</span>
          <ChevronRight className="w-4 h-4" />
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

  AlertTriangle

import { QRCodeSVG } from 'qrcode.react';
import { supabase } from '../supabaseClient';
import { printIsolatedElement } from '../utils/printIsolatedElement';

/**
 * Generates pseudo-Code128 SVG Barcode pattern based on string input
 */
function SimpleBarcodeSVG({ value, height = 48 }) {
  const cleanVal = String(value || '000000000000').trim();
  // Generate deterministic bar widths from character codes
  const bars = [];
  let currentX = 0;

  // Guard quiet zone
  bars.push({ x: 0, width: 4 });
  currentX += 8;

  for (let i = 0; i < cleanVal.length; i++) {
    const code = cleanVal.charCodeAt(i);
    const w1 = ((code % 3) + 1) * 2;
    const w2 = (((code >> 1) % 2) + 1) * 2;
    const w3 = (((code >> 2) % 3) + 1) * 2;

    bars.push({ x: currentX, width: w1 });
    currentX += w1 + 3;
    bars.push({ x: currentX, width: w2 });
    currentX += w2 + 2;
    bars.push({ x: currentX, width: w3 });
    currentX += w3 + 3;
  }

  // End quiet zone
  bars.push({ x: currentX, width: 4 });
  currentX += 8;

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col items-center">
      <svg
        width="100%"
        height={height}
        viewBox={`0 0 ${currentX} ${height}`}
        className="w-full max-h-12 overflow-visible"
        preserveAspectRatio="none"
      >
        {bars.map((bar, idx) => (
          <rect key={idx} x={bar.x} y={0} width={bar.width} height={height} fill="#000000" />
        ))}
      </svg>
      <div className="font-mono text-[11px] tracking-widest font-black text-black mt-1">
        *{cleanVal}*
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

              </div>
            </div>

              * AFFIX FIRMLY TO BULK CRATE / RETURN TOTE *
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 text-center max-w-sm">
            Ready to print on standard <strong>4" x 6" thermal adhesive rolls</strong> or standard letter/A4 warehouse paper.
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Modal Action Footer */}
        <div className="p-4 sm:px-6 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-850 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between shrink-0">

          >
            Close
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handlePrint}
            className="px-5 py-2.5 bg-slate-900 hover:bg-black text-white dark:bg-white dark:text-slate-900 dark:hover:bg-slate-100 rounded-xl text-xs font-black flex items-center gap-2 shadow-md transition-all cursor-pointer"
          >

          </button>
        </div>

    </div>
  );

--- START FILE: src/services/accessKeyService.js ---
import { supabase } from '../supabaseClient';
import { getDeviceFingerprint } from '../utils/deviceFingerprint';

const STORAGE_KEY = 'rma_portal_access_keys_v2';
const SETTINGS_KEY = 'portal_access_keys_store';
const SESSION_KEY = 'rma_portal_gate_session';
const ATTEMPTS_KEY = 'rma_gate_pin_attempts_';
const DELETED_KEY = 'rma_deleted_access_slugs';

function getDeletedSlugs() {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(DELETED_KEY);
    return raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : [];
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}

function addDeletedSlug(slug) {
  if (!slug) return;
  try {
    const list = getDeletedSlugs();
    const clean = String(slug).trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!list.includes(clean)) {
      list.push(clean);
      localStorage.setItem(DELETED_KEY, JSON.stringify(list));
    }
  } catch {}
}

export const DEFAULT_ACCESS_PROFILES = [
  {
    id: 'wh-dock-main-default',
    name: 'Main Warehouse Floor',
    type: 'internal_warehouse',
    access_slug: 'dock',
    pin_code: '123456',
    session_duration_hours: 0, // 0 = No Expiry (Permanent)
    cooldown_duration_hours: 0, // 0 = Cooldown Disabled
    is_active: true,
    created_by: 'System Default',
    created_at: '2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z',
    updated_at: '2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z'
  },
  {
    id: 'cust-delivery-box-default',
    name: 'Customer Delivery Boxes',
    type: 'external_customer',
    access_slug: 'returns',
    pin_code: '654321',
    session_duration_hours: 2, // 2 Hours per device
    cooldown_duration_hours: 6, // 6 Hours Cooldown Lockout
    is_active: true,
    created_by: 'System Default',
    created_at: '2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z',
    updated_at: '2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z'
  }
];

export const accessKeyService = {
  /**
   * GET ALL QR ACCESS PROFILES
   * 1. Query public.portal_access_keys table (if exists)
   * 2. Fallback to Supabase rma_settings table (key: 'portal_access_keys_store')
   * 3. Fallback to localStorage / DEFAULT_ACCESS_PROFILES
   */
  async getProfiles() {
    let remoteProfiles = null;

    // 1. Try dedicated table in Supabase
    try {
      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from('portal_access_keys')
        .select('*')
        .order('created_at', { ascending: false });

      if (!error && Array.isArray(data) && data.length > 0) {
        remoteProfiles = data;
      }
    } catch (e) {
      // Table may not exist yet in database
    }

    // 2. Fallback to rma_settings store
    if (!remoteProfiles) {
      try {
        const { data, error } = await supabase
          .from('rma_settings')
          .select('value')
          .eq('key', SETTINGS_KEY)
          .single();

        if (!error && data?.value && Array.isArray(data.value) && data.value.length > 0) {
          remoteProfiles = data.value;
        }
      } catch (e) {
        // Settings table notice
      }
    }

    // 3. Fallback to localStorage
    let localProfiles = [];
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
      if (raw) {
        localProfiles = JSON.parse(raw);
      }
    } catch (e) {}

    // Merge: Defaults -> LocalStorage -> Remote Supabase
    const profileMap = new Map();
    const deletedSlugs = getDeletedSlugs();

    DEFAULT_ACCESS_PROFILES.forEach(p => {
      if (!deletedSlugs.includes(p.access_slug.toLowerCase())) {
        profileMap.set(p.access_slug.toLowerCase(), p);
      }
    });
    localProfiles.forEach(p => {
      if (p.access_slug && !deletedSlugs.includes(p.access_slug.toLowerCase())) {
        profileMap.set(p.access_slug.toLowerCase(), p);
      }
    });
    (remoteProfiles || []).forEach(p => {
      if (p.access_slug && !deletedSlugs.includes(p.access_slug.toLowerCase())) {
        profileMap.set(p.access_slug.toLowerCase(), p);
      }
    });

    const merged = Array.from(profileMap.values()).sort((a, b) => {
      const dateA = new Date(a.created_at || 0).getTime();
      const dateB = new Date(b.created_at || 0).getTime();
      return dateB - dateA;
    });

    try {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(merged));
    } catch (e) {}

    return merged;
  },

  /**
   * GET PROFILE BY SLUG
   */
  async getProfileBySlug(slug) {
    if (!slug) return null;
    const cleanSlug = String(slug).trim().toLowerCase();
    const all = await this.getProfiles();
    return all.find(p => p.access_slug.toLowerCase() === cleanSlug) || null;
  },

  /**
   * CREATE / SAVE NEW QR ACCESS PROFILE
   */
  async createProfile({
    name,
    type = 'internal_warehouse',
    accessSlug,
    pinCode,
    sessionDurationHours = 0,
    cooldownDurationHours = 6,
    createdBy = 'Admin'
  }) {
    if (!name || !name.trim()) throw new Error('Profile name is required');
    if (!pinCode || !/^\d{6}$/.test(String(pinCode).trim())) {
      throw new Error('PIN must be exactly 6 numeric digits (0-9)');
    }

    const cleanName = name.trim();
    let cleanSlug = (accessSlug || cleanName)
      .toLowerCase()
      .trim()
      .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-')
      .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '');

    if (!cleanSlug) cleanSlug = `gate-${Date.now().toString(36)}`;

    // Ensure unique slug
    const existing = await this.getProfiles();
    if (existing.some(p => p.access_slug === cleanSlug)) {
      cleanSlug = `${cleanSlug}-${Math.floor(100 + Math.random() * 900)}`;
    }

    const newProfile = {
      id: `key_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 9)}`,
      name: cleanName,
      type: type === 'external_customer' ? 'external_customer' : 'internal_warehouse',
      access_slug: cleanSlug,
      pin_code: String(pinCode).trim(),
      session_duration_hours: Math.max(0, parseFloat(sessionDurationHours) || 0),
      cooldown_duration_hours: type === 'internal_warehouse' ? 0 : Math.max(0, parseFloat(cooldownDurationHours) || 0),
      is_active: true,
      created_by: createdBy || 'Admin',
      created_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      updated_at: new Date().toISOString()
    };

    // 1. Try Supabase table
    try {
      await supabase.from('portal_access_keys').insert([newProfile]);
    } catch (e) {}

    // 2. Persist to rma_settings
    const updatedList = [newProfile, ...existing];
    try {
      await supabase.from('rma_settings').upsert({
        key: SETTINGS_KEY,
        value: updatedList,
        updated_at: new Date().toISOString()
      });
    } catch (e) {}

    try {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(updatedList));
    } catch (e) {}

    return newProfile;
  },

  /**
   * UPDATE PROFILE (PIN, Duration, Name, Cooldown, Status)
   */
  async updateProfile(idOrSlug, updates) {
    const existing = await this.getProfiles();
    const targetIdx = existing.findIndex(p => p.id === idOrSlug || p.access_slug === idOrSlug);
    if (targetIdx === -1) throw new Error('Access profile not found');

    const updatedProfile = {
      ...existing[targetIdx],
      ...updates,
      updated_at: new Date().toISOString()
    };

    if (updates.pin_code && !/^\d{6}$/.test(String(updates.pin_code).trim())) {
      throw new Error('PIN must be exactly 6 numeric digits');
    }

    existing[targetIdx] = updatedProfile;

    // 1. Try Supabase table
    try {
      await supabase
        .from('portal_access_keys')
        .update(updatedProfile)
        .eq('access_slug', updatedProfile.access_slug);
    } catch (e) {}

    // 2. Persist to rma_settings
    try {
      await supabase.from('rma_settings').upsert({
        key: SETTINGS_KEY,
        value: existing,
        updated_at: new Date().toISOString()
      });
    } catch (e) {}

    try {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(existing));
    } catch (e) {}

    return updatedProfile;
  },

  /**
   * DELETE PROFILE (Permanently removes QR access profile and records tombstone)
   */
  async deleteProfile(idOrSlug) {
    if (!idOrSlug) return false;
    const existing = await this.getProfiles();
    const target = existing.find(p => p.id === idOrSlug || p.access_slug?.toLowerCase() === String(idOrSlug).toLowerCase());
    if (!target) return false;

    // Record tombstone to prevent resurrection from default profiles
    addDeletedSlug(target.access_slug);

    const filtered = existing.filter(p => p.id !== target.id && p.access_slug?.toLowerCase() !== target.access_slug.toLowerCase());

    // 1. Delete from Supabase dedicated table
    try {
      await supabase.from('portal_access_keys').delete().eq('access_slug', target.access_slug);
    } catch (e) {}

    // 2. Update rma_settings
    try {
      await supabase.from('rma_settings').upsert({
        key: SETTINGS_KEY,
        value: filtered,
        updated_at: new Date().toISOString()
      });
    } catch (e) {}

    // 3. Update localStorage
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(filtered));
    } catch (e) {}

    // 4. If current device session was for this slug, clear it
    const active = this.getActiveSession();
    if (active && active.slug?.toLowerCase() === target.access_slug.toLowerCase()) {
      this.clearSession();
    }

    return true;
  },

  /**
   * VERIFY PIN WITH SERVER-SIDE ANTI-FRAUD COOLDOWN ENGINE & BRUTE-FORCE PROTECTION
   */
  async verifyPin(slug, inputPin) {
    const profile = await this.getProfileBySlug(slug);
    if (!profile) {
      return { success: false, error: 'NOT_FOUND', message: 'QR Access Profile not found.' };
    }

    if (!profile.is_active) {
      return { success: false, error: 'INACTIVE', message: 'This QR Access Code is currently inactive.' };
    }

    // Check rate limit on device
    const attemptKey = `${ATTEMPTS_KEY}${slug}`;
    let attemptsData = { count: 0, lockedUntil: 0 };
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(attemptKey);
      if (raw) attemptsData = JSON.parse(raw);
    } catch (e) {}

    const now = Date.now();
    if (attemptsData.lockedUntil && attemptsData.lockedUntil > now) {
      const secondsLeft = Math.ceil((attemptsData.lockedUntil - now) / 1000);
      return {
        success: false,
        error: 'LOCKED',
        secondsLeft,
        message: `Too many incorrect attempts. Please wait ${secondsLeft}s before retrying.`
      };
    }

    const cleanInput = String(inputPin || '').trim();
    const deviceFingerprint = await getDeviceFingerprint();

    // 1. PRIMARY: Call unbypassable server-side verification endpoint
    try {
      const resp = await fetch('/api/v1/auth/verify-pin', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          slug: profile.access_slug,
          pin: cleanInput,
          deviceFingerprint
        })
      });

      const data = await resp.json().catch(() => ({}));

      // HTTP 429: Active Cooldown Lockout
      if (resp.status === 429 || data.error === 'COOLDOWN_ACTIVE') {
        return {
          success: false,
          error: 'COOLDOWN_ACTIVE',
          message: data.message || 'Return Window Currently Locked',
          cooldownRemainingMinutes: data.cooldownRemainingMinutes || 60,
          unlocksAt: data.unlocksAt,
          sessionExpiresAt: data.sessionExpiresAt,
          profileName: data.profileName || profile.name,
          cooldownDurationHours: data.cooldownDurationHours || profile.cooldown_duration_hours || 6
        };
      }

      // HTTP 200: Successful authentication
      if (resp.ok && data.success && data.session) {
        try { localStorage.removeItem(attemptKey); } catch (e) {}
        try { 
          localStorage.setItem(SESSION_KEY, JSON.stringify(data.session)); 
          if (data.session.cooldownUntil) {
            localStorage.setItem(`rma_last_session_${data.session.slug?.toLowerCase()}`, JSON.stringify(data.session));
          }
        } catch (e) {}
        return { success: true, profile: data.profile || profile, session: data.session };
      }

      // HTTP 401: Invalid PIN
      if (resp.status === 401 || data.error === 'INVALID_PIN') {
        const newCount = (attemptsData.count || 0) + 1;
        let lockedUntil = 0;
        if (newCount >= 5) lockedUntil = now + 30000;
        try {
          localStorage.setItem(attemptKey, JSON.stringify({ count: newCount >= 5 ? 0 : newCount, lockedUntil }));
        } catch (e) {}

        return {
          success: false,
          error: 'INVALID_PIN',
          remainingAttempts: Math.max(0, 5 - newCount),
          isLocked: lockedUntil > 0,
          message: lockedUntil > 0 
            ? 'Too many incorrect attempts. Locked for 30 seconds.'
            : 'Incorrect 6-digit PIN. Please retry.'
        };
      }

      if (data.message && !resp.ok) {
        return { success: false, error: data.error || 'ERROR', message: data.message };
      }
    } catch (netErr) {
      console.warn('API endpoint unreachable; using direct Supabase anti-fraud fallback:', netErr);
    }

    // 2. FALLBACK: Direct Supabase Cooldown Check & PIN verification
    // Checks public.device_intake_sessions directly so cooldowns are NEVER bypassed
    try {
      if (profile.type === 'external_customer' && Number(profile.session_duration_hours) > 0) {
        const { data: dbSessions } = await supabase
          .from('device_intake_sessions')
          .select('*')
          .eq('device_fingerprint', deviceFingerprint)
          .eq('access_slug', profile.access_slug)
          .order('cooldown_until', { ascending: false })
          .limit(1);

        if (dbSessions && dbSessions.length > 0) {
          const s = dbSessions[0];
          const cooldownDate = new Date(s.cooldown_until);
          const expiresDate = new Date(s.session_expires_at);
          const nowDate = new Date();

          if (nowDate >= expiresDate && nowDate < cooldownDate) {
            const diffMs = cooldownDate.getTime() - nowDate.getTime();
            const cooldownRemainingMinutes = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(diffMs / (60 * 1000)));
            return {
              success: false,
              error: 'COOLDOWN_ACTIVE',
              message: 'Return Window Currently Locked: Your previous RMA session has concluded.',
              cooldownRemainingMinutes,
              unlocksAt: s.cooldown_until,
              sessionExpiresAt: s.session_expires_at,
              profileName: profile.name,
              cooldownDurationHours: profile.cooldown_duration_hours || 6
            };
          }
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {}

    // Verify PIN locally
    const cleanExpected = String(profile.pin_code || '').trim();
    if (cleanInput === cleanExpected) {
      try { localStorage.removeItem(attemptKey); } catch (e) {}
      const session = this.createSession(profile);

      // Async record session in Supabase
      if (profile.type === 'external_customer') {
        const durationHours = Number(profile.session_duration_hours || 2);
        const cooldownHours = Number(profile.cooldown_duration_hours !== undefined ? profile.cooldown_duration_hours : 6);
        const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
        const sessionExpiresAt = new Date(Date.now() + (durationHours * 3600 * 1000)).toISOString();
        const cooldownUntil = new Date(new Date(sessionExpiresAt).getTime() + (cooldownHours * 3600 * 1000)).toISOString();

        supabase.from('device_intake_sessions').insert([{
          access_slug: profile.access_slug,
          device_fingerprint: deviceFingerprint,
          ip_address: 'client-direct',
          session_started_at: nowIso,
          session_expires_at: sessionExpiresAt,
          cooldown_until: cooldownUntil,
          status: 'active'
        }]).then(() => {}).catch(() => {});
      }

      return { success: true, profile, session };
    } else {
      const newCount = (attemptsData.count || 0) + 1;
      let lockedUntil = 0;
      if (newCount >= 5) lockedUntil = now + 30000;
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(attemptKey, JSON.stringify({ count: newCount >= 5 ? 0 : newCount, lockedUntil }));
      } catch (e) {}

      return {
        success: false,
        error: 'INVALID_PIN',
        remainingAttempts: Math.max(0, 5 - newCount),
        isLocked: lockedUntil > 0,
        message: lockedUntil > 0 
          ? 'Too many incorrect attempts. Locked for 30 seconds.'
          : 'Incorrect 6-digit PIN. Please retry.'
      };
    }
  },

  /**
   * CHECK DEVICE COOLDOWN STATUS
   * Checks if current device is in active cooldown for a given slug
   */
  async checkDeviceCooldown(slug) {
    if (!slug) return null;
    const cleanSlug = String(slug).trim().toLowerCase();

    // 1. Fast local cache check
    try {
      const cached = localStorage.getItem(`rma_last_session_${cleanSlug}`);
      if (cached) {
        const s = JSON.parse(cached);
        if (s.cooldownUntil && s.expiresAt) {
          const now = Date.now();
          const expTime = new Date(s.expiresAt).getTime();
          const cdTime = new Date(s.cooldownUntil).getTime();
          if (now >= expTime && now < cdTime) {
            const diffMs = cdTime - now;
            return {
              isCooldownActive: true,
              cooldownRemainingMinutes: Math.max(1, Math.ceil(diffMs / (60 * 1000))),
              unlocksAt: s.cooldownUntil,
              sessionExpiresAt: s.expiresAt,
              profileName: s.profileName,
              cooldownDurationHours: s.cooldownDurationHours || 6
            };
          }
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {}

    // 2. Hardware fingerprint & Supabase remote check
    try {
      const deviceFingerprint = await getDeviceFingerprint();

      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from('device_intake_sessions')
        .select('*')
        .eq('access_slug', cleanSlug)
        .eq('device_fingerprint', deviceFingerprint)
        .order('cooldown_until', { ascending: false })
        .limit(1);

      if (!error && Array.isArray(data) && data.length > 0) {
        const s = data[0];
        const now = new Date();
        const cooldownDate = new Date(s.cooldown_until);
        const expiresDate = new Date(s.session_expires_at);

        if (now >= expiresDate && now < cooldownDate) {
          const diffMs = cooldownDate.getTime() - now.getTime();
          return {
            isCooldownActive: true,
            cooldownRemainingMinutes: Math.max(1, Math.ceil(diffMs / (60 * 1000))),
            unlocksAt: s.cooldown_until,
            sessionExpiresAt: s.session_expires_at
          };
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {}
    return null;
  },

  /**
   * ADMIN EMERGENCY RESET / CLEAR COOLDOWNS
   * Instantly unlocks all devices for a given QR profile.
   */
  async emergencyResetCooldowns(slug, profileId = null) {
    const cleanSlug = String(slug || '').trim().toLowerCase();

    // 1. Clear local session cache
    try {
      localStorage.removeItem(`rma_last_session_${cleanSlug}`);
    } catch (e) {}

    // 2. Call server route
    try {
      await fetch('/api/v1/auth/clear-cooldown', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ slug: cleanSlug, profileId })
      });
    } catch (e) {}

    // 3. Direct Supabase delete
    try {
      let query = supabase.from('device_intake_sessions').delete();
      if (cleanSlug) {
        query = query.eq('access_slug', cleanSlug);
      } else if (profileId) {
        query = query.eq('profile_id', profileId);
      }
      await query;
    } catch (e) {}

    return true;
  },

  /**
   * CREATE ENCRYPTED SESSION TOKEN ON DEVICE
   */
  createSession(profile) {
    const now = Date.now();
    const durationHours = Number(profile.session_duration_hours || 0);
    const cooldownHours = Number(profile.cooldown_duration_hours !== undefined ? profile.cooldown_duration_hours : 6);
    const expiresAt = durationHours > 0 
      ? new Date(now + (durationHours * 3600 * 1000)).toISOString() 
      : null; // null = No Expiry (Permanent)

    const cooldownUntil = (durationHours > 0 && cooldownHours > 0 && expiresAt)
      ? new Date(new Date(expiresAt).getTime() + (cooldownHours * 3600 * 1000)).toISOString()
      : null;

    const token = `gate_${profile.access_slug}_${now.toString(36)}_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 8)}`;

    const sessionPayload = {
      token,
      slug: profile.access_slug,
      profileId: profile.id,
      profileName: profile.name,
      type: profile.type,
      durationHours,
      cooldownDurationHours: cooldownHours,
      unlockedAt: new Date(now).toISOString(),
      expiresAt,
      cooldownUntil
    };

    try {
      localStorage.setItem(SESSION_KEY, JSON.stringify(sessionPayload));
      if (cooldownUntil) {
        localStorage.setItem(`rma_last_session_${profile.access_slug.toLowerCase()}`, JSON.stringify(sessionPayload));
      }
    } catch (e) {}

    return sessionPayload;
  },

  /**
   * CHECK IF ACTIVE VALID SESSION EXISTS ON DEVICE
   */
  getActiveSession(targetSlug = null) {
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(SESSION_KEY);
      if (!raw) return null;

      const session = JSON.parse(raw);
      if (!session || !session.token) return null;

      // If specific targetSlug is provided, check matching slug
      if (targetSlug && session.slug?.toLowerCase() !== targetSlug.toLowerCase()) {
        return null;
      }

      // Check expiration for temporary customer sessions
      if (session.expiresAt) {
        const expTime = new Date(session.expiresAt).getTime();
        if (Date.now() >= expTime) {
          // If session expired and cooldown applies, ensure last session cache is preserved
          if (session.cooldownUntil) {
            try {
              localStorage.setItem(`rma_last_session_${session.slug?.toLowerCase()}`, JSON.stringify(session));
            } catch (e) {}
          }
          // Expired -> Clean up active session
          localStorage.removeItem(SESSION_KEY);
          return null;
        }
      }

      return session;
    } catch (e) {
      return null;
    }
  },

  /**
   * CLEAR SESSION (LOGOUT DEVICE FROM GATEKEEPER)
   */
  clearSession(slug = null) {
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(SESSION_KEY);
      if (raw) {
        const session = JSON.parse(raw);
        if (session && session.slug && session.cooldownUntil) {
          localStorage.setItem(`rma_last_session_${session.slug.toLowerCase()}`, JSON.stringify(session));
        }
      }
      localStorage.removeItem(SESSION_KEY);
    } catch (e) {}
  },

  /**
   * TEST MODE ACTIVE CHECK
   */
  isTestModeActive() {
    try {
      return localStorage.getItem('rma_portal_test_mode') === 'true';
    } catch (e) {
      return false;
    }
  }
};

// Cross-tab broadcast channel for instantaneous authentication synchronization
const authChannel = typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.BroadcastChannel 
  ? new BroadcastChannel('rma_auth_bus') 
  : null;

export const authService = {
  getHrApiKey() {
    return localStorage.getItem(HR_API_KEY_STORAGE) || import.meta.env.VITE_HR_API_KEY || '';
  },

  setHrApiKey(key) {
    if (key) localStorage.setItem(HR_API_KEY_STORAGE, key.trim());
    else localStorage.removeItem(HR_API_KEY_STORAGE);
  },

  getCurrentUser() {
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(AUTH_STORAGE_KEY);
      return raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : null;
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  },

  /**
   * Complete, secure logout across all local caches and broadcast to all open tabs
   */
  async logout() {
    try {
      localStorage.removeItem(AUTH_STORAGE_KEY);
      localStorage.removeItem('rma_portal_admin_session');
      localStorage.removeItem('rma_admin_session_v2');
      localStorage.removeItem('rma_quick_auth_admin');
      
      sessionStorage.removeItem(AUTH_STORAGE_KEY);
      sessionStorage.removeItem('rma_portal_admin_session');
      sessionStorage.removeItem('rma_admin_session_v2');
      sessionStorage.removeItem('rma_quick_auth_admin');
      sessionStorage.removeItem('rma_login_pending_email');
      
      // Clear any cached OTPs
      try {
        Object.keys(sessionStorage).forEach(k => {
          if (k.startsWith('otp_')) sessionStorage.removeItem(k);
        });
      } catch (e) {}

      // Broadcast logout across all tabs immediately
      try {
        authChannel?.postMessage({ type: 'LOGOUT', timestamp: Date.now() });
        localStorage.setItem('rma_logout_sync', String(Date.now()));
      } catch (e) {}

      await supabase.auth.signOut({ scope: 'local' }).catch(() => {});
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Supabase auth signOut notice:', e);
    }
  },

  /**
   * Listen for logout or session changes across tabs
   */
  onAuthChange(callback) {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return () => {};
    
    const handleBroadcast = (e) => {
      if (e.data?.type === 'LOGOUT') callback({ type: 'LOGOUT' });
    };

    const handleStorage = (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'rma_logout_sync' || (e.key === AUTH_STORAGE_KEY && !e.newValue)) {
        callback({ type: 'LOGOUT' });
      }
    };

    authChannel?.addEventListener('message', handleBroadcast);
    window.addEventListener('storage', handleStorage);

    return () => {
      authChannel?.removeEventListener('message', handleBroadcast);
      window.removeEventListener('storage', handleStorage);
    };
  },

  /**
   * Fetch employee directory from Supabase admin_users table
   */
  async getEmployees() {
    try {
      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from('admin_users')
        .select('*')
        .order('role', { ascending: true })
        .order('name', { ascending: true });

      if (error || !data || data.length === 0) {
        return DEFAULT_EMPLOYEES;
      }
      return data;
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Error fetching employees from Supabase:', e);
      return DEFAULT_EMPLOYEES;
    }
  },

  /**
   * Sync active employees from Pingcon HR Center API
   * Strictly extracts COMPANY EMAILS from the HR system/sheet, ignoring personal accounts.
   * Endpoint: https://hr-center-pingcon.laravel.cloud/api/v1/employees
   */
  async syncFromHRCenter(apiKey) {
    const key = apiKey || this.getHrApiKey();
    if (!key) {
      throw new Error('HR Center API Key is required. Please obtain your key from the developer tools.');
    }

    try {
      const res = await fetch('https://hr-center-pingcon.laravel.cloud/api/v1/employees?per_page=150', {
        headers: {
          'Authorization': `Bearer ${key.trim()}`,
          'Accept': 'application/json'
        }
      });

      if (!res.ok) {
        throw new Error(`HR Center API returned status ${res.status}: ${res.statusText}`);
      }

      const json = await res.json();
      const hrList = Array.isArray(json) ? json : (json.data || []);

      if (!hrList.length) {
        return { count: 0, message: 'No employees found in HR Center response.' };
      }

      // Upsert into Supabase admin_users with COMPANY EMAIL PRIORITY
      const rows = [];
      for (const emp of hrList) {
        // Look for company email field
        const companyEmail = (
          emp.company_email ||
          emp.companyEmail ||
          emp.company_email_address ||
          emp.work_email ||
          emp.official_email ||
          emp.corporate_email ||
          ''
        ).toLowerCase().trim();

        let chosenEmail = companyEmail;

        // Fallback only if no designated company email, and ensure it is NOT a personal email
        if (!chosenEmail || chosenEmail === 'n/a') {
          const rawEmail = (emp.email || '').toLowerCase().trim();
          if (rawEmail && !rawEmail.includes('@gmail.com') && !rawEmail.includes('@yahoo.com') && !rawEmail.includes('@hotmail.com')) {
            chosenEmail = rawEmail;
          }
        }

        // If this is Danilo Alvaro, enforce finance2@keysysincorporated.com as Super Admin
        const empName = emp.full_name || emp.name || `${emp.first_name || ''} ${emp.last_name || ''}`.trim() || 'Employee';
        const isDanilo = empName.toLowerCase().includes('danilo') && empName.toLowerCase().includes('alvaro');

        if (isDanilo) {
          chosenEmail = 'finance2@keysysincorporated.com';
        }

        if (!chosenEmail || chosenEmail === 'n/a') {
          continue; // Skip employees without a valid company email
        }

        rows.push({
          name: isDanilo ? 'Danilo Alvaro Jr. (Super Admin)' : empName,
          email: chosenEmail,
          role: isDanilo ? 'super_admin' : (emp.role || 'inventory_staff'),
          is_active: emp.status !== 'resigned' && emp.status !== 'inactive' && emp.is_active !== false,
          department: emp.department || emp.department_name || (isDanilo ? 'Finance Systems / IT' : 'General')
        });
      }

      // Upsert rows into Supabase admin_users
      for (const row of rows) {
        await supabase
          .from('admin_users')
          .upsert([row], { onConflict: 'email' });
      }

      this.setHrApiKey(key);
      return { 
        count: rows.length, 
        message: `Successfully synchronized ${rows.length} company employee accounts with official company emails!` 
      };
    } catch (err) {
      throw new Error(`Failed to sync from HR Center API: ${err.message}`);
    }
  },

  /**

  async setEmployeeStatus(id, email, isActive) {

  /**
   * Super Admin action: Add new employee with company email
   */
  async addEmployee({ name, email, role = 'inventory_staff', department = 'General' }) {
    const cleanEmail = email.toLowerCase().trim();
    const row = {
      name: name.trim(),
