--- START FILE: src/services/creditMemoService.js ---
import { supabase } from '../supabaseClient';
import { authService } from './authService';

const CREDIT_MEMOS_STORAGE_KEY = 'rma_portal_credit_memos_v2';

/**
 * Service for managing Finance Credit Memos
 * Persists directly to the dedicated 'credit_memos' table in Supabase
 * with seamless fallback to 'rma_reports' notes and localStorage
 */
export const creditMemoService = {
  /**
   * Generate sequential Credit Memo Number
   * Format: CM-YYYY-XXXX-RAND (e.g. CM-2026-0001-H7D2)
   */
  generateCreditMemoNumber(existingCount = 0) {
    const currentYear = new Date().getFullYear();
    let count = existingCount;
    if (!count) {
      try {
        const raw = localStorage.getItem(CREDIT_MEMOS_STORAGE_KEY);
        if (raw) {
          const list = JSON.parse(raw);
          if (Array.isArray(list)) count = list.length;
        }
      } catch (e) {}
    }
    const seq = String(count + 1).padStart(4, '0');
    const chars = '0123456789ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ';
    let rand = '';
    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
      rand += chars.charAt(Math.floor(Math.random() * chars.length));
    }
    return `CM-${currentYear}-${seq}-${rand}`;
  },

  /**
   * Generate sequential Pull Out Reference (POR)
   * Format: POR-YYYY-XXXX-RAND (e.g. POR-2026-0001-1A4D)
   * Format: POR _ + Current Year + increasing serial number + random unique alphanumeric
   */
  generatePullOutReference(existingCount = 0) {
    const currentYear = new Date().getFullYear();
    let count = existingCount;
    if (!count) {
      try {
        const raw = localStorage.getItem(CREDIT_MEMOS_STORAGE_KEY);
        if (raw) {
          const list = JSON.parse(raw);
          if (Array.isArray(list)) count = list.length;
        }
      } catch (e) {}
    }
    const seq = String(count + 1).padStart(4, '0');
    const chars = '0123456789ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ';
    let rand = '';
    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
      rand += chars.charAt(Math.floor(Math.random() * chars.length));
    }
    return `POR-${currentYear}-${seq}-${rand}`;
  },

  /**
   * Get all Credit Memos from dedicated Supabase 'credit_memos' table,
   * legacy 'rma_reports' notes, and local storage
   */
  async getCreditMemos() {
    const memosMap = new Map();

    // 1. Primary Source: Dedicated Supabase 'credit_memos' table
    try {
      const { data: dbMemos, error } = await supabase
        .from('credit_memos')
        .select('*')
        .order('credit_issued_at', { ascending: false });

      if (!error && Array.isArray(dbMemos)) {
        for (const m of dbMemos) {
          if (m.credit_memo_number) {
            const creditAmt = Number(m.credit_amount ?? m.amount ?? 0);
            const grossAmt = Number(m.amount ?? m.credit_amount ?? 0);
            memosMap.set(m.credit_memo_number, {
              ...m,
              credit_amount: creditAmt,
              amount: grossAmt || creditAmt,
              is_synced_to_db: true
            });
          }
        }
      } else if (error) {
        console.warn('Supabase credit_memos table read note:', error.message || error);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('credit_memos fetch catch:', e);
    }

    // 2. Legacy / Secondary fallback: Supabase rma_reports (checking notes for credit memo payload)
    try {
      const { data: reports, error } = await supabase
        .from('rma_reports')
        .select('*')
        .not('status', 'eq', 'deleted')
        .order('created_at', { ascending: false });

      if (!error && Array.isArray(reports)) {
        for (const r of reports) {
          if (r.notes && typeof r.notes === 'string' && r.notes.includes('credit_memo_number')) {
            try {
              const memoData = JSON.parse(r.notes);
              if (memoData && memoData.credit_memo_number && !memosMap.has(memoData.credit_memo_number)) {
                const creditAmt = Number(memoData.credit_amount ?? memoData.amount ?? 0);
                const grossAmt = Number(memoData.amount ?? memoData.credit_amount ?? 0);
                const combined = {
                  ...memoData,
                  credit_amount: creditAmt,
                  amount: grossAmt || creditAmt,
                  report_id: r.id,
                  rma_number: r.rma_number || memoData.rma_number,
                  barcode: r.barcode || memoData.barcode,
                  product_name: r.name || memoData.product_name,
                  sku: r.code || memoData.sku,
                  supplier_name: r.supplier_name || memoData.supplier_name,
                  company: 'Wholesale Distribution',
                  customer_ae_name: r.ae_name || memoData.customer_ae_name,
                  customer_ae_email: r.ae_email || memoData.customer_ae_email,
                  is_synced_to_db: true
                };
                memosMap.set(memoData.credit_memo_number, combined);
              }
            } catch (err) {}
          }
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Supabase rma_reports memos fallback notice:', e);
    }

    // 3. Merge with local cache for offline/unsynced entries
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(CREDIT_MEMOS_STORAGE_KEY);
      if (raw) {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
        if (Array.isArray(parsed)) {
          parsed.forEach(m => {
            if (m.credit_memo_number && !memosMap.has(m.credit_memo_number)) {
              memosMap.set(m.credit_memo_number, m);
            }
          });
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {}

    const list = Array.from(memosMap.values());
    list.sort((a, b) => new Date(b.credit_issued_at || b.created_at || 0) - new Date(a.credit_issued_at || a.created_at || 0));

    // Update local cache with latest merged list
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(CREDIT_MEMOS_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(list));
    } catch (e) {}

    return list;
  },

  /**
   * Save a newly issued Credit Memo to Supabase 'credit_memos' table
   */
  async createCreditMemo(memoData) {
    const existing = await this.getCreditMemos();
    const cmNumber = memoData.credit_memo_number || this.generateCreditMemoNumber(existing.length);

    const unitPrice = Number((Number(memoData.unit_price) || 0).toFixed(2));
    const qty = Number(memoData.quantity) || 1;
    const grossAmount = Number((Number(memoData.amount) || (qty * unitPrice)).toFixed(2));
    const creditAmount = Number((Number(memoData.credit_amount) || grossAmount).toFixed(2));
    const pullOutRef = memoData.pull_out_ref ? memoData.pull_out_ref.trim() : this.generatePullOutReference(existing.length);
    const pullOutDate = memoData.pull_out_date || new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];

    const newMemo = {
      credit_memo_number: cmNumber,
      rma_number: memoData.rma_number,
      report_id: memoData.report_id ? Number(memoData.report_id) : null,
      barcode: memoData.barcode || 'N/A',
      product_name: memoData.product_name || memoData.name || 'Item',
      sku: memoData.sku || memoData.code || null,
      supplier_name: memoData.supplier_name || memoData.supplierName || 'Savemore',
      company: 'Wholesale Distribution',
      customer_ae_name: memoData.customer_ae_name || memoData.ae_name || 'N/A',
      customer_ae_email: memoData.customer_ae_email || memoData.ae_email || '',
      quantity: qty,
      unit_name: memoData.unit_name || memoData.unit || 'pc',
      unit_price: unitPrice,
      amount: grossAmount,
      credit_amount: creditAmount,
      pull_out_ref: pullOutRef,
      pull_out_date: pullOutDate,
      credit_issued_by: memoData.credit_issued_by || 'Analiza B. Benoza',
      credit_issued_by_email: memoData.credit_issued_by_email || 'analiza@savemore.com',
      credit_issued_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      notes: memoData.notes ? memoData.notes.trim() : '',
      status: 'issued'
    };

    let dbSuccess = false;

    // 1. Primary: Save to dedicated 'credit_memos' table in Supabase
    try {
      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from('credit_memos')
        .upsert([newMemo], { onConflict: 'credit_memo_number' })
        .select();

      if (!error && data && data.length > 0) {
        dbSuccess = true;
        console.log(`[Supabase DB] Credit memo ${cmNumber} inserted into credit_memos table.`);
        if (data[0].id) {
          newMemo.id = data[0].id;
        }
      } else if (error) {
        console.warn(`[Supabase DB] credit_memos table insert notice:`, error.message || error);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('credit_memos insert catch:', e);
    }

    // 2. Also update rma_reports lifecycle stage to 'credit_memo_issued' and store backup in notes
    if (memoData.rma_number || memoData.report_id) {
      try {
        let rmaUpdateQ = supabase
          .from('rma_reports')
          .update({
            notes: JSON.stringify(newMemo),
            status: 'credit_memo_issued'
          });

        if (memoData.rma_number) {
          rmaUpdateQ = rmaUpdateQ.eq('rma_number', memoData.rma_number);
        } else if (memoData.report_id) {
          rmaUpdateQ = rmaUpdateQ.eq('id', memoData.report_id);
        }

        const { error: rmaErr } = await rmaUpdateQ;

        if (!rmaErr && !dbSuccess) {
          dbSuccess = true;
        }
      } catch (e) {
        console.warn('rma_reports status sync notice:', e);
      }
    }

    newMemo.is_synced_to_db = dbSuccess;

    // 3. Save to local storage
    const updatedList = [newMemo, ...existing.filter(m => m.credit_memo_number !== cmNumber)];
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(CREDIT_MEMOS_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(updatedList));
    } catch (e) {}

    return { success: true, memo: newMemo, dbSaved: dbSuccess };
  },

  /**
   * Update an existing Credit Memo in Supabase 'credit_memos' table
   */
  async updateCreditMemo(cmNumber, updates) {
    const existing = await this.getCreditMemos();
    const index = existing.findIndex(m => m.credit_memo_number === cmNumber);
    if (index === -1) throw new Error(`Credit Memo ${cmNumber} not found.`);

    const unitPrice = updates.unit_price !== undefined ? Number(Number(updates.unit_price).toFixed(2)) : existing[index].unit_price;
    const qty = updates.quantity !== undefined ? Number(updates.quantity) : existing[index].quantity;
    const amount = updates.amount !== undefined ? Number(Number(updates.amount).toFixed(2)) : Number((qty * unitPrice).toFixed(2));
    const creditAmount = updates.credit_amount !== undefined ? Number(Number(updates.credit_amount).toFixed(2)) : existing[index].credit_amount;

    const updated = {
      ...existing[index],
      ...updates,
      unit_price: unitPrice,
      quantity: qty,
      amount: amount,
      credit_amount: creditAmount,
      company: 'Wholesale Distribution',
      updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      is_synced_to_db: true
    };

    // 1. Update in dedicated 'credit_memos' table
    try {
      const { error } = await supabase
        .from('credit_memos')
        .update({
          quantity: qty,
          unit_price: unitPrice,
          amount: amount,
          pull_out_ref: updated.pull_out_ref,
          pull_out_date: updated.pull_out_date,
          credit_amount: creditAmount,
          notes: updated.notes || '',
          updated_at: new Date().toISOString()
        })
        .eq('credit_memo_number', cmNumber);

      if (error) {
        console.warn('credit_memos table update notice:', error.message || error);
      } else {
        console.log(`[Supabase DB] Credit memo ${cmNumber} updated in credit_memos table.`);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('credit_memos update catch:', e);
    }

    // 2. Update rma_reports notes backup
    const rma = updated.rma_number;
    if (rma) {
      try {
        await supabase
          .from('rma_reports')
          .update({
            notes: JSON.stringify(updated),
            status: 'credit_memo_issued'
          })
          .eq('rma_number', rma);
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    // 3. Update localStorage
    existing[index] = updated;
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(CREDIT_MEMOS_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(existing));
    } catch (e) {}

    return { success: true, memo: updated };
  },

  /**
   * Delete / Void a Credit Memo
   */
  async deleteCreditMemo(cmNumber, reportId) {
    const existing = await this.getCreditMemos();
    const target = existing.find(m => m.credit_memo_number === cmNumber);
    const filtered = existing.filter(m => m.credit_memo_number !== cmNumber);

    try {
      localStorage.setItem(CREDIT_MEMOS_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(filtered));
    } catch (e) {}

    // 1. Delete from dedicated 'credit_memos' table
    try {
      const { error } = await supabase
        .from('credit_memos')
        .delete()
        .eq('credit_memo_number', cmNumber);

      if (error) {
        console.warn('credit_memos table delete notice:', error.message || error);
      } else {
        console.log(`[Supabase DB] Credit memo ${cmNumber} deleted from credit_memos table.`);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('credit_memos delete catch:', e);
    }

    // 2. Reset rma_reports status and clear notes
    const rma = target?.rma_number;
    if (rma) {
      try {
        await supabase
          .from('rma_reports')
          .update({
            notes: null,
            status: 'pending'
          })
          .eq('rma_number', rma);
      } catch (e) {}
    } else if (reportId) {
      try {
        await supabase
          .from('rma_reports')
          .update({
            notes: null,
            status: 'pending'
          })
          .eq('id', reportId);
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    return { success: true };
  },

  /**
   * Bulk Delete / Void multiple Credit Memos
   */
  async deleteMultipleCreditMemos(memoNumbers = []) {
    if (!memoNumbers || memoNumbers.length === 0) return { success: true };
    const numSet = new Set(memoNumbers);

    const existing = await this.getCreditMemos();
    const targets = existing.filter(m => numSet.has(m.credit_memo_number));
    const filtered = existing.filter(m => !numSet.has(m.credit_memo_number));

    try {
      localStorage.setItem(CREDIT_MEMOS_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(filtered));
    } catch (e) {}

    // 1. Bulk delete from 'credit_memos' table
    try {
      const { error } = await supabase
        .from('credit_memos')
        .delete()
        .in('credit_memo_number', memoNumbers);

      if (error) {
        console.warn('credit_memos bulk delete notice:', error.message || error);
      } else {
        console.log(`[Supabase DB] Bulk deleted ${memoNumbers.length} rows from credit_memos table.`);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('credit_memos bulk delete catch:', e);
    }

    // 2. Reset affected rma_reports
    const targetRmas = targets.map(t => t.rma_number).filter(Boolean);
    if (targetRmas.length > 0) {
      try {
        await supabase
          .from('rma_reports')
          .update({
            notes: null,
            status: 'pending'
          })
          .in('rma_number', targetRmas);
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    return { success: true, deletedCount: targets.length };
  }
};

/**
 * AUTOMATED RMA RETURN NOTIFICATION SERVICE
 * 
 * Senders & Recipients Routing:
 * 1. Pingcon / Bonita Products:
 *    - Sender: finance@pingconmarketing.com
 *    - TO: azgodev@gmail.com
 *    - CC: [Customer AE Company Email, mgan@pingconmarketing.com, marketing@pingconmarketing.com, azgan@pingconmarketing.com, jaezelle.benito@pingconmarketing.com]
 * 
 * 2. A2Z2GO / Keysys Products:
 *    - Sender: finance2@a2z2go.net
 *    - TO: azgodev@gmail.com
 *    - CC: [Customer AE Company Email, mgan@a2z2go.net, marketing@a2z2go.net, azgan@a2z2go.net, jaezelle.benito@pingconmarketing.com]
 */
import { supabase } from '../supabaseClient';
import { authService } from './authService';

const DEFAULT_RECIPIENTS = {
  toEmail: 'azgodev@gmail.com',
  baseCcList: [
    'mgan@pingconmarketing.com',
    'marketing@pingconmarketing.com',
    'azgan@pingconmarketing.com',
    'jaezelle.benito@pingconmarketing.com'
  ]
};

export const notificationService = {
  /**
   * Get configured RMA email recipients (with local storage and corporate defaults)
   */
  getEmailSettings() {
    try {
      if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
        const saved = localStorage.getItem('rma_portal_email_recipients');
        if (saved) {
          const parsed = JSON.parse(saved);
          if (parsed && parsed.toEmail) {
            return {
              toEmail: String(parsed.toEmail).trim(),
              baseCcList: Array.isArray(parsed.baseCcList) ? parsed.baseCcList : DEFAULT_RECIPIENTS.baseCcList
            };
          }
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {}
    return { ...DEFAULT_RECIPIENTS };
  },

  /**
   * Load email recipients from Supabase rma_settings table (if table exists)
   */
  async loadEmailSettingsFromDb() {
    try {
      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from('rma_settings')
        .select('*')
        .eq('key', 'email_recipients')
        .single();

      if (!error && data?.value?.toEmail) {
        const settings = {
          toEmail: String(data.value.toEmail).trim(),
          baseCcList: Array.isArray(data.value.baseCcList) ? data.value.baseCcList : DEFAULT_RECIPIENTS.baseCcList
        };
        if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
          localStorage.setItem('rma_portal_email_recipients', JSON.stringify(settings));
        }
        return settings;
      }
    } catch (e) {
      // Supabase rma_settings table might not be created yet; fallback silently
    }
    return this.getEmailSettings();
  },

  /**
   * Super Admin action: Save updated TO and CC recipients for RMA notifications
   */
  async saveEmailSettings({ toEmail, baseCcList }) {
    const cleanTo = String(toEmail || '').trim();
    if (!cleanTo || !cleanTo.includes('@')) {
      throw new Error('A valid Primary TO recipient email is required.');
    }

    const cleanCcList = Array.isArray(baseCcList)
      ? Array.from(new Set(baseCcList.map(e => String(e).trim()).filter(e => e.includes('@'))))
      : [];

    const newSettings = {
      toEmail: cleanTo,
      baseCcList: cleanCcList
    };

    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      localStorage.setItem('rma_portal_email_recipients', JSON.stringify(newSettings));
      window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('rma-settings-changed', { detail: newSettings }));
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event('storage'));
      try {
        if (window.BroadcastChannel) {
          const ch = new BroadcastChannel('rma_portal_sync_bus');
          ch.postMessage({ type: 'email-settings-updated', settings: newSettings });
        }
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    // Try persisting to Supabase rma_settings table
    try {
      await supabase
        .from('rma_settings')
        .upsert({
          key: 'email_recipients',
          value: newSettings,
          updated_at: new Date().toISOString()
        }, { onConflict: 'key' });
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Notice: rma_settings table not created yet in Supabase. Local storage active.');
    }

    return { success: true, settings: newSettings };
  },

  /**
   * Determine company configuration with user-configurable recipients
   */
  resolveCompanyConfig(report) {
    const settings = this.getEmailSettings();
    return {
      companyName: 'Wholesale RMA Returns',
      senderEmail: 'finance2@keysysincorporated.com',
      senderName: 'Wholesale RMA Finance Portal',
      toEmail: settings.toEmail || DEFAULT_RECIPIENTS.toEmail,
      baseCcList: Array.isArray(settings.baseCcList) && settings.baseCcList.length > 0 
        ? settings.baseCcList 
        : DEFAULT_RECIPIENTS.baseCcList
    };
  },

  /**
   * Build clean, modern HTML email notification body
   */
  generateEmailHtml(report, config, isTestMode = false) {
    const rmaNumber = report.rma_number || 'RMA-PENDING';
    const itemName = report.name || `Unidentified Item (${report.barcode})`;
    const reporter = report.reporter_name || report.reported_by || 'Warehouse Staff';
    const contact = report.reporter_contact || 'N/A';
    const aeName = report.ae_name || 'Unassigned';
    const aeEmail = report.ae_email || '';

  /**
   * Dispatch email notification for a newly submitted RMA report
   */
  async sendRMANotification(report, isTestMode = false) {
    if (!report) return { success: false, error: 'No report data provided' };

    const currentUser = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? authService.getCurrentUser() : null;
    const isSuperAdmin = currentUser?.role === 'super_admin';
    const testActive = Boolean(
      isSuperAdmin && (
        isTestMode || 
        (typeof window !== 'undefined' && localStorage.getItem('rma_portal_test_mode') === 'true')
      )
    );

    try {
      const config = this.resolveCompanyConfig(report);

      // Assemble CC list: base company recipients + Customer AE email
      const ccSet = new Set(config.baseCcList);
      if (report.ae_email && report.ae_email.includes('@')) {
        ccSet.add(report.ae_email.trim());
      }
      const finalCcList = Array.from(ccSet);
      const toEmail = config.toEmail;

      let subject = `[RMA Alert] ${report.rma_number || 'New Return'}: ${report.name || report.barcode} (${report.reason || 'Damaged'})`;

      if (testActive) {
        // Subject email must have "Test - " as the first word
        subject = `Test - [RMA Alert] ${report.rma_number || 'New Return'}: ${report.name || report.barcode} (${report.reason || 'Damaged'})`;
      }

      const htmlBody = this.generateEmailHtml(report, config, testActive);

      const photos = Array.isArray(report.photos) 
        ? report.photos 
        : (typeof report.photos === 'string' ? JSON.parse(report.photos || '[]') : []);

      // Attach proof images so Gmail provides built-in native in-page lightbox viewer
      const attachments = photos.map((p, idx) => ({
        filename: `proof_photo_${idx + 1}.jpg`,
        path: p
      }));

      console.log(`[RMA Email Dispatch] (TestMode: ${testActive}) Sending from "${config.senderEmail}" to "${toEmail}", CC: [${finalCcList.join(', ')}] with ${attachments.length} attachments`);

      const res = await fetch('/api/send-email', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json'
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          from: config.senderEmail,
          fromName: testActive ? `[TEST] ${config.senderName}` : config.senderName,
          to: toEmail,
          cc: finalCcList,
          subject,
          html: htmlBody,
          isTestMode: testActive,
          attachments,
          text: `${testActive ? 'Test - ' : ''}New RMA Return: ${report.rma_number} for ${report.name || report.barcode}. Reason: ${report.reason}. Reported by: ${report.reporter_name || report.reported_by}. Customer AE: ${report.ae_name || 'N/A'}`
        })
      });

      if (!res.ok) {
        const errorText = await res.text();
        console.warn('send-email response was not ok:', res.status, errorText);
        return { success: false, error: errorText };
      }

      const result = await res.json();
      console.log('Email notification dispatch result:', result);
      return result;
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('Non-blocking error dispatching RMA email notification:', err.message);
      return { success: false, error: err.message };
    }
  },

        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },

      });
      if (!res.ok) {
        return { success: false, error: `HTTP ${res.status}: ${await res.text()}` };
      }

--- START FILE: src/services/pinRequestService.js ---
import { supabase } from '../supabaseClient';
import { notificationService } from './notificationService';

const STORAGE_KEY = 'rma_pin_requests_v2';
const SETTINGS_KEY = 'pin_requests_store';

function notifyPinRequestsChanged(record = null) {
  if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('rma-pin-requests-changed', { detail: { record } }));
    try {
      if (window.BroadcastChannel) {
        const ch = new BroadcastChannel('rma_portal_sync_bus');
        ch.postMessage({ type: 'pin-requests-changed', record });
      }
    } catch (e) {}
  }
}

export const pinRequestService = {
  /**
   * GET ALL PIN REQUESTS
   * Queries public.pin_requests table -> fallback to rma_settings -> fallback to localStorage
   */
  async getRequests() {
    let remoteRequests = null;

    // 1. Try dedicated table in Supabase
    try {
      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from('pin_requests')
        .select('*')
        .order('created_at', { ascending: false });

      if (!error && Array.isArray(data)) {
        remoteRequests = data;
      }
    } catch (e) {
      // Table may not exist yet in database
    }

    // 2. Fallback to rma_settings store
    if (remoteRequests === null) {
      try {
        const { data, error } = await supabase
          .from('rma_settings')
          .select('value')
          .eq('key', SETTINGS_KEY)
          .single();

        if (!error && data?.value && Array.isArray(data.value)) {
          remoteRequests = data.value;
        }
      } catch (e) {
        // Settings fallback
      }
    }

    // 3. Fallback to localStorage
    let localRequests = [];
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
      if (raw) {
        localRequests = JSON.parse(raw);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      localRequests = [];
    }

    const finalRequests = remoteRequests !== null ? remoteRequests : localRequests;

    // Keep localStorage in sync
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(finalRequests));
    } catch (e) {}

    return finalRequests;
  },

  /**
   * GET PENDING REQUESTS COUNT (for badges in header)
   */
  async getPendingCount() {
    const requests = await this.getRequests();
    return requests.filter(r => r.status === 'pending').length;
  },

  /**
   * SUBMIT NEW PIN REQUEST
   */
  async createPinRequest({
    accessSlug,
    accessKeyId = null,
    requesterEmail,
    requesterName,
    organizationName = '',
    notes = '',
    isTestMode = false
  }) {
    if (!accessSlug || !requesterEmail || !requesterName) {
      throw new Error('Please provide Access Slug, Email, and Name.');
    }

    const newRecord = {
      id: typeof crypto !== 'undefined' && crypto.randomUUID ? crypto.randomUUID() : `req_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 8)}`,
      access_slug: String(accessSlug).trim().toLowerCase(),
      access_key_id: accessKeyId || null,
      requester_email: String(requesterEmail).trim().toLowerCase(),
      requester_name: String(requesterName).trim(),
      organization_name: String(organizationName || '').trim(),
      notes: String(notes || '').trim(),
      status: 'pending',
      approved_by: null,
      reviewed_at: null,
      created_at: new Date().toISOString()
    };

    let insertedRemote = false;

    // 1. Try dedicated table
    try {
      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from('pin_requests')
        .insert([newRecord])
        .select()
        .single();

      if (!error && data) {
        insertedRemote = true;
      }
    } catch (e) {
      // Table may not exist yet
    }

    // 2. Always update local storage & sync to rma_settings fallback
    const allRequests = await this.getRequests();
    const updatedRequests = [newRecord, ...allRequests.filter(r => r.id !== newRecord.id)];

    try {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(updatedRequests));
    } catch (e) {}

    if (!insertedRemote) {
      try {
        await supabase
          .from('rma_settings')
          .upsert({
            key: SETTINGS_KEY,
            value: updatedRequests,
            updated_at: new Date().toISOString()
          }, { onConflict: 'key' });
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    // 3. Dispatch automated alert email to Admin team (recipients same as RMA reports, strictly EXCLUDING AE email)
    this.sendPinRequestAlertEmail(newRecord, Boolean(isTestMode)).catch(err => {
      console.warn('Non-blocking PIN request email notification error:', err);
    });

    notifyPinRequestsChanged(newRecord);
    return { success: true, data: newRecord };
  },

  /**
   * DISPATCH ALERT EMAIL TO ADMINS ON NEW PIN REQUEST
   * Recipients: Same recipients as RMA reports, strictly EXCLUDING AE email.
   */

  /**

  async approveRequest({

    approvedBy = 'Admin',
    pinCode = '123456',

    accessSlug = 'dock',

    const target = allRequests.find(r => r.id === requestId);
    if (!target) {
      throw new Error('PIN request not found.');

    const reviewedAt = new Date().toISOString();
    const updatedTarget = {
      ...target,
      status: 'approved',
      approved_by: approvedBy,
      reviewed_at: reviewedAt
    };

    // 1. Update in Supabase
    try {
      await supabase
        .from('pin_requests')
        .update({
          status: 'approved',
          approved_by: approvedBy,
          reviewed_at: reviewedAt
        })
        .eq('id', requestId);
    } catch (e) {}

    // 2. Sync to local state
    const updatedList = allRequests.map(r => r.id === requestId ? updatedTarget : r);
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(updatedList));

        .from('rma_settings')

  /**
   * REJECT REQUEST
   */
  async rejectRequest({ requestId, rejectedBy = 'Admin', reason = '' }) {
    const allRequests = await this.getRequests();
    const target = allRequests.find(r => r.id === requestId);
    if (!target) {
      throw new Error('PIN request not found.');
    }

    const reviewedAt = new Date().toISOString();
    const updatedTarget = {
      ...target,
      status: 'rejected',
      approved_by: rejectedBy,
      reviewed_at: reviewedAt,
      notes: reason ? `${target.notes ? `${target.notes} | ` : ''}[Rejection reason: ${reason}]` : target.notes
    };

    try {
      await supabase
        .from('pin_requests')
        .update({
          status: 'rejected',
          approved_by: rejectedBy,
          reviewed_at: reviewedAt,
          notes: updatedTarget.notes
        })
        .eq('id', requestId);
    } catch (e) {}

    const updatedList = allRequests.map(r => r.id === requestId ? updatedTarget : r);
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(updatedList));
    } catch (e) {}

    try {
      await supabase
        .from('rma_settings')
        .upsert({
          key: SETTINGS_KEY,
          value: updatedList,
          updated_at: new Date().toISOString()
        }, { onConflict: 'key' });
    } catch (e) {}

    notifyPinRequestsChanged();
    return { success: true, request: updatedTarget };
  },

  /**
   * BATCH APPROVE REQUESTS
   */
  async approveBatch({ requestIds, approvedBy = 'Admin', getProfilePinFn, isTestMode = false }) {
    const results = [];
    for (const id of requestIds) {
      try {
        const pinInfo = getProfilePinFn ? await getProfilePinFn(id) : { pinCode: '123456', profileName: 'RMA Station', accessSlug: 'dock' };
        const res = await this.approveRequest({
          requestId: id,
          approvedBy,
          pinCode: pinInfo.pinCode,
          profileName: pinInfo.profileName,
          accessSlug: pinInfo.accessSlug,
          isTestMode
        });
        results.push(res);
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Batch approval error for request', id, err);
      }
    }
    notifyPinRequestsChanged();
    return results;
  },

  /**
   * DELETE REQUEST
   */
  async deleteRequest(requestId) {
    try {
      await supabase
        .from('pin_requests')
        .delete()
        .eq('id', requestId);
    } catch (e) {}

    const allRequests = await this.getRequests();
    const updatedList = allRequests.filter(r => r.id !== requestId);

    try {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(updatedList));
    } catch (e) {}

    try {
      await supabase
        .from('rma_settings')
        .upsert({
          key: SETTINGS_KEY,
          value: updatedList,
          updated_at: new Date().toISOString()
        }, { onConflict: 'key' });
    } catch (e) {}

    notifyPinRequestsChanged();
    return { success: true };
  }
};

/**
 * Antigravity Finance & Purchase Orders API v1 Service
 * 
 * Direct integration with Laravel Cloud database containing:
 * - erply_products: 5,793+ live SKU catalog with names, prices, VAT & suppliers
 * - auto_po_supplier_contacts: 610+ supplier directory with terms, emails & contacts
 * - proof_of_delivery_items: 554,000+ line items history
 */

import { supabase } from '../supabaseClient';

const BASE_URL = import.meta.env.VITE_PO_API_URL || 'https://purchase-order-db-production-ff1oho.laravel.cloud/api/v1';
const getApiKey = () => {
  if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
    const storedDanilo = localStorage.getItem('EXTERNAL_API_KEY_DANILO');
    if (storedDanilo && storedDanilo.trim()) return storedDanilo.trim();
    const stored = localStorage.getItem('rma_po_api_key');
    if (stored && stored.trim()) return stored.trim();
  }
  return import.meta.env.VITE_EXTERNAL_API_KEY_DANILO || import.meta.env.VITE_PO_API_KEY || 'pk_live_po_cloud_db_2026_dev_key';
};

let isApiUnauthorized = (() => {
  try {
    return sessionStorage.getItem('rma_po_api_disabled') === 'true';
  } catch (e) {
    return false;
  }
})();

const markUnauthorized = () => {
  isApiUnauthorized = true;
  try {
    sessionStorage.setItem('rma_po_api_disabled', 'true');
  } catch (e) {}
};

const clearUnauthorized = () => {
  isApiUnauthorized = false;
  try {
    sessionStorage.removeItem('rma_po_api_disabled');
  } catch (e) {}
};

let lastCheckTime = 0;

// Routing Group inference
const inferGroup = (name = '', brand = '') => {
  const text = `${name} ${brand}`.toLowerCase();
  if (text.includes('keysys') || text.includes('a2z2go') || text.includes('terminal') || text.includes('pos')) {
    return 'Group 1 (KEYSYS & A2Z2GO)';
  }
  return 'Group 2 (PINGCON & BONITA TISSUE)';
};

// Normalize API item to app standard format
export const normalizeProduct = (item) => {
  if (!item) return null;
  const sku = item.code || item.sku || `SKU-${item.id}`;
  // In coworker's API, ean_code stores the barcode values from the items, and code stores our SKU
  const barcode = item.ean_code || item.code2 || item.barcode || sku;
  const priceWithVat = parseFloat(item.priceWithVat) || parseFloat(item.price) || 0;
  const netPrice = parseFloat(item.price) || (priceWithVat / 1.12);

  return {
    id: String(item.id || sku),
    sku: sku,
    code: sku,
    barcode: barcode,
    ean_code: item.ean_code || null,
    name: item.name || '',
    brand: item.brandName || '',
    brand_name: item.brandName || '',
    supplier: item.supplierName || 'Savemore',
    supplier_name: item.supplierName || 'Savemore',
    unit_price: netPrice,
    price: netPrice,
    price_with_vat: priceWithVat,
    priceWithVat: priceWithVat,
    case_pack: item.unitName ? `Per ${item.unitName}` : '1 pc',
    unit_name: item.unitName || 'pc',
    image_url: item.imageUrl || item.image_url || null, // Strictly real images only, no fake/stock photos
    group: inferGroup(item.name || '', item.brandName || ''),
    requires_serial: Boolean(item.hasSerialNumbers),
    has_serial_numbers: Boolean(item.hasSerialNumbers),
    ae_name: null,
    ae_email: null,
    is_verified: true,
    source: 'erply_api',
    raw_data: item
  };
};

export const purchaseOrdersApi = {
  /**
   * Healthcheck & table access check
  /**
   * Load API key from Supabase cloud so mobile devices automatically get the key without manual re-entry
   */
  async loadApiKeyFromCloud() {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return null;
    const stored = localStorage.getItem('EXTERNAL_API_KEY_DANILO') || localStorage.getItem('rma_po_api_key');
    if (stored && stored.trim() && stored.trim() !== 'pk_live_po_cloud_db_2026_dev_key') {
      return stored.trim();
    }

    try {
      // 1. Primary: Check rma_settings table where Admin stores the key
      const { data: settingData } = await supabase
        .from('rma_settings')
        .select('value')
        .eq('key', 'EXTERNAL_API_KEY_DANILO')
        .maybeSingle();

      if (settingData?.value && typeof settingData.value === 'string' && settingData.value.trim() && settingData.value.trim() !== 'pk_live_po_cloud_db_2026_dev_key') {
        const cloudKey = settingData.value.trim();
        localStorage.setItem('EXTERNAL_API_KEY_DANILO', cloudKey);
        localStorage.setItem('rma_po_api_key', cloudKey);
        clearUnauthorized();
        return cloudKey;
      }

      // 2. Secondary: Check products table __CONFIG_PO_API_KEY__
      const { data } = await supabase
        .from('products')
        .select('code')
        .eq('barcode', '__CONFIG_PO_API_KEY__')
        .maybeSingle();

      if (data?.code && data.code.trim() && data.code.trim() !== 'pk_live_po_cloud_db_2026_dev_key') {
        const cloudKey = data.code.trim();
        localStorage.setItem('EXTERNAL_API_KEY_DANILO', cloudKey);
        localStorage.setItem('rma_po_api_key', cloudKey);
        clearUnauthorized();
        return cloudKey;
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Notice loading cloud API key:', e?.message || e);
    }
    return null;
  },

  /**
   * Set API key and sync to Supabase for all devices (PC, mobile, tablet)
   */
  async setApiKey(key) {
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      if (key && key.trim()) {
        const clean = key.trim();
        localStorage.setItem('EXTERNAL_API_KEY_DANILO', clean);
        localStorage.setItem('rma_po_api_key', clean);
        clearUnauthorized();

        // Sync to cloud so mobile devices have instant access
        try {
          await supabase.from('products').upsert({
            barcode: '__CONFIG_PO_API_KEY__',
            name: 'System Config PO API Key',
            code: clean,
            is_verified: false,
            updated_at: new Date().toISOString()
          }, { onConflict: 'barcode' });

          await supabase.from('rma_settings').upsert({
            key: 'EXTERNAL_API_KEY_DANILO',
            value: clean,
            updated_at: new Date().toISOString()
          }, { onConflict: 'key' });
        } catch (e) {
          console.warn('Cloud API key sync notice:', e);
        }
      } else {
        localStorage.removeItem('EXTERNAL_API_KEY_DANILO');
        localStorage.removeItem('rma_po_api_key');
        clearUnauthorized();
        try {
          await supabase.from('products').delete().eq('barcode', '__CONFIG_PO_API_KEY__');
        } catch (e) {}
      }
    }
  },

  getApiKey() {
    return getApiKey();
  },

  isUnauthorized() {
    return isApiUnauthorized;
  },

  /**
   * Healthcheck & table access check
   */
  async testConnection(force = false) {
    let key = getApiKey();
    if (!key || key === 'pk_live_po_cloud_db_2026_dev_key') {
      const cloudKey = await this.loadApiKeyFromCloud();
      if (cloudKey) key = cloudKey;
    }

    if (isApiUnauthorized && !force) {
      const cloudKey = await this.loadApiKeyFromCloud();
      if (cloudKey) {
        key = cloudKey;
      } else {
        return { connected: false, error: 'Product Catalog API Key is unauthorized (HTTP 401). Update key in Settings.' };
      }
    }

    lastCheckTime = Date.now();

    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${BASE_URL}/tables`, {
        headers: {
          'X-API-Key': key,
          'Accept': 'application/json'
        }
      });
      if (!res.ok) {
        if (res.status === 401) markUnauthorized();
        return { connected: false, error: `HTTP ${res.status}: ${res.statusText}` };
      }
      clearUnauthorized();
      const data = await res.json();
      return { 
        connected: true, 
        tableCount: data.total_tables || 24,
        message: 'Connected to Live Purchase Orders API v1 (Laravel Cloud)'
      };
    } catch (err) {
      return { connected: false, error: err.message };
    }
  },

  /**
   * Fast lookup of a single product by Barcode or SKU code
   * Checks erply_products table (5,793 items)
   */
  async findProductByBarcode(barcodeOrCode) {
    if (!barcodeOrCode) return null;
    const clean = String(barcodeOrCode).trim();
    if (!clean) return null;

    let key = getApiKey();
    if (!key || key === 'pk_live_po_cloud_db_2026_dev_key' || isApiUnauthorized) {
      const cloudKey = await this.loadApiKeyFromCloud();
      if (cloudKey) {
        key = cloudKey;
      } else if (isApiUnauthorized) {
        return null;
      }
    }
    // Backend SQL is case-sensitive. Try exact code variations:
    const codeCandidates = Array.from(new Set([clean, clean.toUpperCase(), clean.toLowerCase()]));

    for (const code of codeCandidates) {
      try {
        // 1. FIRST PRIORITY: Direct equality lookup on ean_code (Manufacturer / Retail Barcode!): ?ean_code=...
        const eanUrl = `${BASE_URL}/data/erply_products?ean_code=${encodeURIComponent(code)}&columns=id,code,code2,ean_code,name,priceWithVat,price,supplierName,brandName,unitName,hasSerialNumbers`;
        const resEan = await fetch(eanUrl, {
          headers: {
            'X-API-Key': key,
            'Accept': 'application/json'
          }
        });

        if (resEan.status === 401) {
          markUnauthorized();
          return null;
        }

        if (resEan.ok) {
          const jsonEan = await resEan.json();
          if (jsonEan.data && jsonEan.data.length > 0) {
            return normalizeProduct(jsonEan.data[0]);
          }
        }

        // 2. SECOND PRIORITY: Direct equality lookup on code2 (Secondary Barcode / UPC): ?code2=...
        const code2Url = `${BASE_URL}/data/erply_products?code2=${encodeURIComponent(code)}&columns=id,code,code2,ean_code,name,priceWithVat,price,supplierName,brandName,unitName,hasSerialNumbers`;
        const res2 = await fetch(code2Url, {
          headers: {
            'X-API-Key': key,
            'Accept': 'application/json'
          }
        });

        if (res2.status === 401) {
          markUnauthorized();
          return null;
        }

        if (res2.ok) {
          const json2 = await res2.json();
          if (json2.data && json2.data.length > 0) {
            return normalizeProduct(json2.data[0]);
          }
        }

        // 3. THIRD PRIORITY: Direct equality lookup on code (Internal SKU): ?code=...
        const directUrl = `${BASE_URL}/data/erply_products?code=${encodeURIComponent(code)}&columns=id,code,code2,ean_code,name,priceWithVat,price,supplierName,brandName,unitName,hasSerialNumbers`;
        const res = await fetch(directUrl, {
          headers: {
            'X-API-Key': key,
            'Accept': 'application/json'
          }
        });

        if (res.status === 401) {
          markUnauthorized();
          return null;
        }

        if (res.ok) {
          const json = await res.json();
          if (json.data && json.data.length > 0) {
            return normalizeProduct(json.data[0]);
          }
        }
      } catch (err) {
        // Quiet catch
      }
    }

    // If not found by direct ean_code, code2, or code equality, it is not in the live database.
    return null;
  },

  /**
   * Real-time search across live products in erply_products
   * Overcomes backend case-sensitivity by testing capitalized and uppercase terms
   */
  async searchProducts(query, limit = 250) {
    if (!query || query.trim().length === 0) return [];
    const trimmed = query.trim();

    let key = getApiKey();
    if (!key || key === 'pk_live_po_cloud_db_2026_dev_key' || isApiUnauthorized) {
      const cloudKey = await this.loadApiKeyFromCloud();
      if (cloudKey) {
        key = cloudKey;
      } else if (isApiUnauthorized) {
        return [];
      }
    }

    // Build variations to handle case-sensitive SQL (e.g., 'tissue' -> 'Tissue', 'TISSUE', 'tissue')
    const capitalized = trimmed.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + trimmed.slice(1);
    const uppercase = trimmed.toUpperCase();
    const lowercase = trimmed.toLowerCase();
    const variations = Array.from(new Set([capitalized, trimmed, uppercase, lowercase]));

    for (const term of variations) {
      try {
        const url = `${BASE_URL}/data/erply_products?search=${encodeURIComponent(term)}&per_page=${limit}&columns=id,code,code2,ean_code,name,priceWithVat,price,supplierName,brandName,unitName,hasSerialNumbers`;
        const res = await fetch(url, {
          headers: {
            'X-API-Key': key,
            'Accept': 'application/json'
          }
        });

        if (res.status === 401) {
          markUnauthorized();
          break; // Stop immediately to avoid 401 spam
        }

        if (res.ok) {
          const json = await res.json();
          if (json.data && Array.isArray(json.data) && json.data.length > 0) {
            const items = json.data.map(normalizeProduct);
            items.totalRecords = json.pagination?.total_records || items.length;
            items.totalPages = json.pagination?.total_pages || 1;
            return items;
          }
        }
      } catch (err) {
        // Quiet catch
      }
    }

    return [];
  },

  /**
   * Fetch supplier directory from auto_po_supplier_contacts (610 records)
   */
  async getSuppliers(limit = 100) {
    try {
      const url = `${BASE_URL}/data/auto_po_supplier_contacts?per_page=${limit}&sort_by=full_company_name&sort_dir=asc`;
      const res = await fetch(url, {
        headers: {
          'X-API-Key': API_KEY,
          'Accept': 'application/json'
        }
      });

      if (res.ok) {
        const json = await res.json();
        if (json.data && Array.isArray(json.data)) {
          return json.data;
        }
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('[PurchaseOrdersAPI] Fetch suppliers error:', err);
    }
    return [];
  }
};

--- START FILE: src/services/supplierClaimService.js ---
import { supabase } from '../supabaseClient';

const CLAIMS_STORAGE_KEY = 'rma_portal_supplier_claims_v2';
const SETTINGS_KEY = 'supplier_claims_store';

export const supplierClaimService = {
  /**
   * GENERATE UNIQUE RTV ID
   * Format: RTV-YYYY-XXXX-RAND (e.g. RTV-2026-0001-HY67)
   * RTV + Current Year + 4-digit increasing sequence + 4-char alphanumeric
   */
  generateRtvId(existingClaims = []) {
    const currentYear = new Date().getFullYear();
    let maxSeq = 0;

    if (Array.isArray(existingClaims)) {
      existingClaims.forEach(c => {
        const num = c.claim_number || c.claimNumber || '';
        const match = String(num).match(/RTV-\d{4}-(\d+)-/i);
        if (match && match[1]) {
          const parsed = parseInt(match[1], 10);
          if (!isNaN(parsed) && parsed > maxSeq) {
            maxSeq = parsed;
          }
        }
      });
    }

    const nextSeq = String(maxSeq + 1).padStart(4, '0');
    const chars = '23456789ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ';
    let rand = '';
    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
      rand += chars.charAt(Math.floor(Math.random() * chars.length));
    }

    return `RTV-${currentYear}-${nextSeq}-${rand}`;
  },

  /**
   * GET ALL SAVED SUPPLIER DEBIT CLAIMS
   * Fetches from:
   * 1. Supabase public.supplier_claims table (if exists)
   * 2. Supabase rma_settings table (key: 'supplier_claims_store')
   * 3. LocalStorage fallback
   */
  async getClaims() {
    let remoteClaims = null;

    // 1. Try dedicated table first
    try {
      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from('supplier_claims')
        .select('*')
        .order('created_at', { ascending: false });

      if (!error && Array.isArray(data)) {
        remoteClaims = data;
      }
    } catch (e) {
      // Table may not exist yet in Postgres
    }

    // 2. If table not found, fetch from rma_settings
    if (!remoteClaims) {
      try {
        const { data, error } = await supabase
          .from('rma_settings')
          .select('value')
          .eq('key', SETTINGS_KEY)
          .single();

        if (!error && data?.value && Array.isArray(data.value)) {
          remoteClaims = data.value;
        }
      } catch (e) {
        console.warn('Could not read supplier_claims_store from rma_settings:', e.message);
      }
    }

    // 3. Fallback to localStorage if offline or first load
    let localClaims = [];
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(CLAIMS_STORAGE_KEY);
      if (raw) {
        localClaims = JSON.parse(raw);
      }
    } catch (e) {}

    // Merge by claim_number
    const claimMap = new Map();
    localClaims.forEach(c => {
      const id = c.claim_number || c.claimNumber;
      if (id) claimMap.set(id, c);
    });
    (remoteClaims || []).forEach(c => {
      const id = c.claim_number || c.claimNumber;
      if (id) claimMap.set(id, c);
    });

    const merged = Array.from(claimMap.values()).sort((a, b) => {
      const dateA = new Date(a.created_at || a.createdAt || 0).getTime();
      const dateB = new Date(b.created_at || b.createdAt || 0).getTime();
      return dateB - dateA;
    });

    // Cache to localStorage
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(CLAIMS_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(merged));
    } catch (e) {}

    return merged;
  },

  /**
   * SAVE NEW SUPPLIER DEBIT CLAIM (RTV)
   * Automatically persists to Supabase (supplier_claims table & rma_settings)
   * and updates linked rma_reports with the RTV identifier and audit trail.
   */
  async saveClaim({
    claimNumber,
    supplierName,
    generatedBy,
    items = [],
    totalQuantity = 0,
    totalClaimAmount = 0
  }) {
    if (!claimNumber) throw new Error('Claim number is required');
    if (!items.length) throw new Error('At least one item is required to save claim');

    const cleanClaimNumber = String(claimNumber).trim();
    const cleanSupplier = String(supplierName || 'Savemore').trim();
    const cleanGeneratedBy = String(generatedBy || 'Warehouse Staff').trim();
    const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();

    const claimRecord = {
      claim_number: cleanClaimNumber,
      claimNumber: cleanClaimNumber,
      supplier_name: cleanSupplier,
      supplierName: cleanSupplier,
      generated_by: cleanGeneratedBy,
      generatedBy: cleanGeneratedBy,
      total_quantity: Number(totalQuantity) || items.length,
      totalQuantity: Number(totalQuantity) || items.length,
      total_claim_amount: Number(totalClaimAmount) || 0,
      totalClaimAmount: Number(totalClaimAmount) || 0,
      created_at: nowIso,
      createdAt: nowIso,
      status: 'generated',
      items: items.map(item => ({
        rma_number: item.rma_number,
        barcode: item.barcode,
        name: item.name,
        code: item.code || item.sku || '',
        quantity: Number(item.quantity) || 1,
        unit_name: item.unit_name || 'pc',
        price: Number(item.price_with_vat || item.price || 0),
        total: (Number(item.quantity) || 1) * Number(item.price_with_vat || item.price || 0),
        reason: item.reason || 'Damaged Box / Crushed Packaging'
      }))
    };

    // 1. Try inserting into public.supplier_claims table
    let savedToTable = false;
    try {
      const { error } = await supabase
        .from('supplier_claims')
        .upsert([
          {
            claim_number: cleanClaimNumber,
            supplier_name: cleanSupplier,
            generated_by: cleanGeneratedBy,
            total_quantity: claimRecord.total_quantity,
            total_claim_amount: claimRecord.total_claim_amount,
            items: claimRecord.items,
            status: 'generated',
            created_at: nowIso
          }
        ], { onConflict: 'claim_number' });

      if (!error) savedToTable = true;
    } catch (e) {
      // Table may not exist yet
    }

    // 2. Persist to rma_settings (key: 'supplier_claims_store') as universal sync
    try {
      const existing = await this.getClaims();
      const updatedList = [claimRecord, ...existing.filter(c => (c.claim_number || c.claimNumber) !== cleanClaimNumber)];
      
      await supabase
        .from('rma_settings')
        .upsert({
          key: SETTINGS_KEY,
          value: updatedList,
          updated_at: nowIso
        });

      localStorage.setItem(CLAIMS_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(updatedList));
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Could not update rma_settings with new claim:', e);
    }

    // 3. Update all linked rma_reports: set disposition to RTV and append to audit_trail & notes
    try {
      for (const item of items) {
        const rmaNum = item.rma_number;
        if (!rmaNum) continue;

        // Fetch current row to append to audit_trail
        const { data: currentRows } = await supabase
          .from('rma_reports')
          .select('id, audit_trail, notes')
          .eq('rma_number', rmaNum);

        const row = currentRows && currentRows[0];
        if (row) {
          const currentAudit = Array.isArray(row.audit_trail) ? row.audit_trail : [];
          const updatedAudit = [
            ...currentAudit,
            {
              action: 'RTV_CLAIM_GENERATED',
              rtv_number: cleanClaimNumber,
              supplier_name: cleanSupplier,
              generated_by: cleanGeneratedBy,
              timestamp: nowIso
            }
          ];

          const existingNotes = row.notes || '';
          const tag = `[RTV: ${cleanClaimNumber}]`;
          const updatedNotes = existingNotes.includes(tag) 
            ? existingNotes 
            : (existingNotes ? `${existingNotes}\n${tag}` : tag);

          await supabase
            .from('rma_reports')
            .update({
              disposition: 'Return to Vendor (RTV)',
              audit_trail: updatedAudit,
              notes: updatedNotes
            })
            .eq('id', row.id);
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Could not update linked rma_reports with RTV info:', e);
    }

    return claimRecord;
  },

  /**
   * DELETE / VOID A SUPPLIER CLAIM
   */
  async deleteClaim(claimNumber) {
    if (!claimNumber) return;

    // Delete from table
    try {
      await supabase
        .from('supplier_claims')
        .delete()
        .eq('claim_number', claimNumber);
    } catch (e) {}

    // Update rma_settings
    try {
      const existing = await this.getClaims();
      const updatedList = existing.filter(c => (c.claim_number || c.claimNumber) !== claimNumber);
      
      await supabase
        .from('rma_settings')
        .upsert({
          key: SETTINGS_KEY,
          value: updatedList,
          updated_at: new Date().toISOString()
        });

      localStorage.setItem(CLAIMS_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(updatedList));
    } catch (e) {}
  }
};

--- START FILE: src/utils/deviceFingerprint.js ---
/**
 * Deterministic Device & Hardware Fingerprinting Engine
 * 
 * Generates an unbypassable, persistent hardware signature from physical machine traits:
 * - Physical Screen Resolution & Color Depth
 * - Hardware Concurrency (CPU Cores) & Physical Memory
 * - System Timezone & Platform
 * - Physical GPU Vendor & Renderer (WebGL Unmasked Hardware Identity)
 * - Canvas 2D Text & Geometry Rendering Pipeline
 * - Web Audio API Oscillator & Dynamics Processing
 * 
 * CRITICAL ANTI-BYPASS PROPERTY:
 * This hardware hash remains IDENTICAL even if the user:
 * 1. Clears localStorage, cookies, and browsing history.
 * 2. Opens an Incognito or Private Browsing window.
 * 3. Switches browsers (Chrome -> Safari, Brave, Firefox, Edge) on the same device.
 */

let cachedFingerprint = null;

// Simple deterministic string hasher (DJB2 / Murmur-inspired) fallback
function fastHash(str) {
  let hash1 = 0xdeadbeef ^ 0;
  let hash2 = 0x41c64e6d ^ 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < str.length; i++) {
    const ch = str.charCodeAt(i);
    hash1 = Math.imul(hash1 ^ ch, 2654435761);
    hash2 = Math.imul(hash2 ^ ch, 1597334677);
  }
  hash1 = Math.imul(hash1 ^ (hash1 >>> 16), 2246822507) ^ Math.imul(hash2 ^ (hash2 >>> 13), 3266489909);
  hash2 = Math.imul(hash2 ^ (hash2 >>> 16), 2246822507) ^ Math.imul(hash1 ^ (hash1 >>> 13), 3266489909);
  return (4294967296 * (2097151 & hash2) + (hash1 >>> 0)).toString(16);
}

// SHA-256 via Web Crypto API with fallback
async function sha256(str) {
  try {
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.crypto && window.crypto.subtle) {
      const msgBuffer = new TextEncoder().encode(str);
      const hashBuffer = await window.crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', msgBuffer);
      const hashArray = Array.from(new Uint8Array(hashBuffer));
      return hashArray.map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    }
  } catch (e) {}
  return fastHash(str);
}

// 1. Physical GPU Hardware Query (WebGL Unmasked)
function getGpuHardware() {
  try {
    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    const gl = canvas.getContext('webgl') || canvas.getContext('experimental-webgl');
    if (!gl) return 'no-webgl';

    const debugInfo = gl.getExtension('WEBGL_debug_renderer_info');
    if (!debugInfo) return 'no-debug-info';

    const vendor = gl.getParameter(debugInfo.UNMASKED_VENDOR_WEBGL) || '';
    const renderer = gl.getParameter(debugInfo.UNMASKED_RENDERER_WEBGL) || '';
    return `${vendor}~${renderer}`;
  } catch (e) {
    return 'gpu-err';
  }
}

// 2. Canvas 2D Rendering Pipeline Characteristics
function getCanvasFingerprint() {
  try {
    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    canvas.width = 240;
    canvas.height = 60;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    if (!ctx) return 'no-2d';

    ctx.textBaseline = 'alphabetic';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#069';
    ctx.fillRect(10, 5, 62, 20);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#f60';
    ctx.font = '11pt no-real-font-123';
    ctx.fillText('Wholesale RMA Gatekeeper \ud83d\udd12', 4, 45);

    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(102, 204, 0, 0.7)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(50, 50, 40, 0, Math.PI * 2, true);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.stroke();

    return canvas.toDataURL();
  } catch (e) {
    return 'canvas-err';
  }
}

// 3. AudioContext Hardware Fingerprint
async function getAudioFingerprint() {
  try {
    const AudioContext = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
    if (!AudioContext) return 'no-audio';

    const context = new AudioContext();
    const sampleRate = context.sampleRate || 44100;
    const oscillator = context.createOscillator();
    const analyser = context.createAnalyser();
    const gain = context.createGain();

    oscillator.type = 'triangle';
    oscillator.frequency.setValueAtTime(10000, context.currentTime);

    gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0, context.currentTime);
    oscillator.connect(analyser);
    analyser.connect(gain);
    gain.connect(context.destination);

    const maxChannels = context.destination.maxChannelCount || 2;
    await context.close().catch(() => {});
    return `sr:${sampleRate}~ch:${maxChannels}`;
  } catch (e) {
    return 'audio-err';
  }
}

/**
 * Returns a high-entropy, cross-browser, cross-session deterministic hardware fingerprint
 */
export async function getDeviceFingerprint() {
  if (cachedFingerprint) return cachedFingerprint;

  if (typeof window === 'undefined') {
    return 'server-device-node';
  }

  try {
    const screenInfo = `${window.screen?.width || 0}x${window.screen?.height || 0}x${window.screen?.colorDepth || 0}x${window.screen?.pixelDepth || 0}`;
    const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
    const cores = navigator.hardwareConcurrency || 4;
    const memory = navigator.deviceMemory || 8;
    const timezone = Intl?.DateTimeFormat?.().resolvedOptions?.().timeZone || 'UTC';
    const gpu = getGpuHardware();
    const canvas = getCanvasFingerprint();
    const audio = await getAudioFingerprint();

    // Combine immutable physical traits
    const rawEntropy = [
      screenInfo,
      `dpr:${dpr}`,
      `cores:${cores}`,
      `mem:${memory}`,
      `tz:${timezone}`,
      `gpu:${gpu}`,
      `audio:${audio}`,
      `canvas:${fastHash(canvas)}`
    ].join('||');

    const hash = await sha256(rawEntropy);
    cachedFingerprint = `dfp_${hash.substring(0, 32)}`;
    return cachedFingerprint;
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('Device fingerprinting fallback notice:', err);
    cachedFingerprint = `dfp_fallback_${Date.now().toString(36)}`;
    return cachedFingerprint;
  }
}

/**
 * Enterprise Accounting & Logistics CSV Exporter
 * Formats financial records with clean headers and UTF-8 BOM for Microsoft Excel & Google Sheets.
 */

function escapeCsvCell(val) {
  if (val === null || val === undefined) return '""';
  const str = String(val).replace(/"/g, '""');
  return `"${str}"`;
}

function downloadCsvBlob(csvContent, filename) {
  // \uFEFF is UTF-8 Byte Order Mark (BOM) so Excel reads formatting and currencies properly
  const blob = new Blob(['\uFEFF' + csvContent], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' });
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement('a');
  a.href = url;
  a.download = filename;
  document.body.appendChild(a);
  a.click();
  setTimeout(() => {
    document.body.removeChild(a);
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  }, 200);
}

    'Defect Reason',
    'Google Drive Folder',
    'Notes'
  ];

  const rows = reports.map((r, index) => {
    const qty = Number(r.quantity || 1);
    const unitPrice = Number(r.price_with_vat || r.price || 0);
    const totalVal = (qty * unitPrice).toFixed(2);
    const dateStr = r.created_at ? new Date(r.created_at).toISOString().slice(0, 10) : '';

    return [
      escapeCsvCell(index + 1),
      escapeCsvCell(r.rma_number),
      escapeCsvCell(dateStr),
      escapeCsvCell(r.store_branch || ''),
      escapeCsvCell(r.invoice_dr_number || ''),
      escapeCsvCell(r.batch_lot_number || ''),
      escapeCsvCell(r.expiry_date || ''),
      escapeCsvCell(r.status || 'pending'),
      escapeCsvCell(r.disposition || 'Pending Triage'),
      escapeCsvCell(r.condition_grade || 'Unassessed'),
      escapeCsvCell(r.warehouse_location || 'DOCK'),
      escapeCsvCell(r.supplier_name || 'Savemore'),
      escapeCsvCell(r.barcode),
      escapeCsvCell(r.code || r.sku || ''),
      escapeCsvCell(r.name),
      escapeCsvCell(qty),
      escapeCsvCell(r.unit_name || 'pc'),
      escapeCsvCell(Number(r.price || 0).toFixed(2)),
      escapeCsvCell(Number(r.price_with_vat || 0).toFixed(2)),
      escapeCsvCell(totalVal),
      escapeCsvCell(r.reporter_name || ''),
      escapeCsvCell(r.reported_by || ''),
      escapeCsvCell(r.inspected_by || ''),
      escapeCsvCell(r.reason || ''),
      escapeCsvCell(r.google_drive_folder_url || ''),
      escapeCsvCell(r.notes || '')
    ].join(',');
  });

  const csv = [headers.join(','), ...rows].join('\r\n');
  const actualFilename = filename || `RMA_Reports_Export_${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}.csv`;
  downloadCsvBlob(csv, actualFilename);
}

/**
 * Bulletproof Isolated Print Engine
 * Renders target HTML element into a dedicated, clean, invisible iframe.
 * Eliminates background page leakage, prevents multi-page overflow (guarantees exactly 1 page),
 * and ensures 100% visual fidelity between the on-screen preview and printed paper / PDF export.
 */

export function printIsolatedElement({
  elementId,
  documentTitle = 'Print Document',
  pageSize = 'portrait', // 'portrait' | '4in 6in' | '3in 3in' | '2in 2in' | 'A4 portrait'
  pageMargin = '0.2in',
  scale = 1.0,
  customStyles = ''
}) {
  if (typeof document === 'undefined') return;

  const sourceEl = typeof elementId === 'string' ? document.getElementById(elementId) : elementId;
  if (!sourceEl) {
    console.error('printIsolatedElement: Target element not found:', elementId);
    return;
  }

  // Clone target element
  const clone = sourceEl.cloneNode(true);

  // Remove existing print iframe if any
  const existingIframe = document.getElementById('app-isolated-print-iframe');
  if (existingIframe) {
    existingIframe.remove();
  }

  // Create clean isolated iframe
  const iframe = document.createElement('iframe');
  iframe.id = 'app-isolated-print-iframe';
  iframe.style.position = 'fixed';
  iframe.style.top = '-9999px';
  iframe.style.left = '-9999px';
  iframe.style.width = '0px';
  iframe.style.height = '0px';
  iframe.style.border = '0';
  iframe.style.visibility = 'hidden';
  document.body.appendChild(iframe);

  // Collect existing stylesheets & fonts from main window and sanitize @page rules
  const stylesheets = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('link[rel="stylesheet"], style'))
    .map(el => {
      let html = el.outerHTML;
      // Strip any conflicting global @page rules from parent styles
      return html.replace(/@page\s*\{[^}]*\}/gi, '');
    })
    .join('\n');

  const iframeDoc = iframe.contentWindow.document;
  iframeDoc.open();
  iframeDoc.write(`
    <!DOCTYPE html>
    <html lang="en">
      <head>
        <meta charset="utf-8" />
        <title>${documentTitle}</title>
        <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
        ${stylesheets}
        <style>
          @page {
            size: ${pageSize} !important;
            margin: 0 !important;
          }
          *, *::before, *::after {
            box-sizing: border-box !important;
            -webkit-print-color-adjust: exact !important;
            print-color-adjust: exact !important;
          }
          html, body {
            margin: 0 !important;
            padding: 0 !important;
            width: 100% !important;
            height: 100% !important;
            background: #ffffff !important;
            color: #000000 !important;
            overflow: hidden !important;
            font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif !important;
          }
          body {
            display: flex !important;
            flex-direction: column !important;
            align-items: center !important;
            justify-content: center !important;
            page-break-before: avoid !important;
            page-break-after: avoid !important;
            page-break-inside: avoid !important;
            break-inside: avoid !important;
          }
          .isolated-print-sheet {
            width: 100% !important;
            height: 100% !important;
            display: flex !important;
            flex-direction: column !important;
            align-items: center !important;
            justify-content: center !important;
            margin: 0 auto !important;
            padding: ${pageMargin} !important;
            box-sizing: border-box !important;
            text-align: center !important;
            page-break-inside: avoid !important;
            break-inside: avoid !important;
            overflow: hidden !important;
          }
          .isolated-print-card {
            margin: 0 auto !important;
            display: flex !important;
            flex-direction: column !important;
            align-items: center !important;
            justify-content: center !important;
            box-shadow: none !important;
            page-break-inside: avoid !important;
            break-inside: avoid !important;
            max-width: 100% !important;
            box-sizing: border-box !important;
            transform-origin: center center !important;
            ${scale !== 1.0 ? `transform: scale(${scale}) !important;` : ''}
          }
          ${customStyles}
        </style>
      </head>
      <body>
        <div class="isolated-print-sheet">
          <div class="isolated-print-card">
            ${clone.outerHTML}
          </div>
        </div>
      </body>
    </html>
  `);
  iframeDoc.close();

  // Trigger print after styles & SVG elements have painted
  const executePrint = () => {
    try {
      iframe.contentWindow.focus();
      iframe.contentWindow.print();
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('Isolated print warning:', err);
    } finally {
      // Clean up iframe after print dialog completes
      setTimeout(() => {
        if (iframe && iframe.parentNode) {
          iframe.parentNode.removeChild(iframe);
        }
      }, 3000);
    }
  };

  // Wait 150ms for layout & SVG render
  setTimeout(executePrint, 150);
}

/**
 * QR Code & Box Sticker Download Utility
 * Client-side high-resolution PNG & SVG generation for mobile and desktop devices.
 */

/**
 * Convert an SVG element to an HTMLImageElement
 */
function svgToImage(svgElement) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    try {
      const xml = new XMLSerializer().serializeToString(svgElement);
      const svgBlob = new Blob([xml], { type: 'image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8' });
      const URL = window.URL || window.webkitURL || window;
      const blobUrl = URL.createObjectURL(svgBlob);
      const img = new Image();
      img.onload = () => {
        resolve({ img, blobUrl });
      };
      img.onerror = (err) => {
        URL.revokeObjectURL(blobUrl);
        reject(err);
      };
      img.src = blobUrl;
    } catch (e) {
      reject(e);
    }
  });
}

/**
 * Trigger file download via a transient anchor element
 */
function triggerDownload(dataUrlOrBlob, filename) {
  const isBlob = dataUrlOrBlob instanceof Blob;
  const url = isBlob ? URL.createObjectURL(dataUrlOrBlob) : dataUrlOrBlob;
  const a = document.createElement('a');
  a.style.display = 'none';
  a.href = url;
  a.download = filename;
  document.body.appendChild(a);
  a.click();
  setTimeout(() => {
    document.body.removeChild(a);
    if (isBlob) URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  }, 200);
}

/**
 * Helper: Draw multi-line wrapped text with strict boundary management (left aligned)
 * Returns the Y coordinate after the last line of text drawn.
 */
function drawWrappedText(ctx, text, x, y, maxWidth, lineHeight, maxLines = 2) {
  if (!text) return y;
  const words = String(text).trim().split(/\s+/);
  let line = '';
  let currentY = y;
  let linesDrawn = 0;

  for (let n = 0; n < words.length; n++) {
    const testLine = line ? `${line} ${words[n]}` : words[n];
    const metrics = ctx.measureText(testLine);
    if (metrics.width > maxWidth && n > 0) {
      linesDrawn++;
      if (linesDrawn >= maxLines) {
        // Last line limit hit: append ellipsis only if more words remain
        let truncatedLine = line;
        while (ctx.measureText(truncatedLine + '...').width > maxWidth && truncatedLine.length > 0) {
          truncatedLine = truncatedLine.slice(0, -1);
        }
        ctx.fillText(truncatedLine + '...', x, currentY);
        return currentY + lineHeight;
      }
      ctx.fillText(line, x, currentY);
      line = words[n];
      currentY += lineHeight;
    } else {
      line = testLine;
    }
  }

  if (line) {
    ctx.fillText(line, x, currentY);
    currentY += lineHeight;
  }

  return currentY;
}

/**
 * Helper: Draw multi-line wrapped text with center alignment
 */
function drawWrappedTextCentered(ctx, text, centerX, y, maxWidth, lineHeight, maxLines = 2) {
  if (!text) return y;
  const words = String(text).trim().split(/\s+/);
  let line = '';
  let currentY = y;
  let linesDrawn = 0;

  for (let n = 0; n < words.length; n++) {
    const testLine = line ? `${line} ${words[n]}` : words[n];
    const metrics = ctx.measureText(testLine);
    if (metrics.width > maxWidth && n > 0) {
      linesDrawn++;
      if (linesDrawn >= maxLines) {
        let truncatedLine = line;
        while (ctx.measureText(truncatedLine + '...').width > maxWidth && truncatedLine.length > 0) {
          truncatedLine = truncatedLine.slice(0, -1);
        }
        ctx.fillText(truncatedLine + '...', centerX, currentY);
        return currentY + lineHeight;
      }
      ctx.fillText(line, centerX, currentY);
      line = words[n];
      currentY += lineHeight;
    } else {
      line = testLine;
    }
  }

  if (line) {
    ctx.fillText(line, centerX, currentY);
    currentY += lineHeight;
  }

  return currentY;
}

/**
 * Download High-Resolution QR Code (PNG)
 * Generates an ultra-crisp card with the QR code and RMA Ticket info.
 */
export async function downloadQrCodePng({
  svgElementOrId,
  rmaNumber = 'RMA-TICKET',
  productName = '',
  barcode = '',
  reporter = '',
  reporterContact = '',
  dateFormatted = '',
  filename
}) {
  const svgEl = typeof svgElementOrId === 'string'
    ? document.getElementById(svgElementOrId)
    : svgElementOrId;

  if (!svgEl) {
    throw new Error('QR SVG element not found in DOM.');
  }

  const { img, blobUrl } = await svgToImage(svgEl);

  try {
    // Canvas dimensions (high-res 1200 x 1420)
    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    const width = 1200;
    const height = 1420;
    canvas.width = width;
    canvas.height = height;

    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    if (!ctx) throw new Error('Could not initialize 2D canvas context.');

    // 1. Clean White Background
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);

    // 2. Subtle outer border with rounded corners
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#0f172a';
    ctx.lineWidth = 12;
    ctx.strokeRect(30, 30, width - 60, height - 60);

    // 3. Header badge
    ctx.fillStyle = '#0f172a';
    ctx.fillRect(30, 30, width - 60, 90);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 32px "Inter", system-ui, sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('WHOLESALE RMA RETURN AUTHORIZATION', width / 2, 90);

    // 4. Draw QR Code centered (high contrast)
    const qrSize = 780;
    const qrX = (width - qrSize) / 2;
    const qrY = 160;

    // White backing box for QR with subtle border
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.fillRect(qrX - 20, qrY - 20, qrSize + 40, qrSize + 40);
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#e2e8f0';
    ctx.lineWidth = 4;
    ctx.strokeRect(qrX - 20, qrY - 20, qrSize + 40, qrSize + 40);

    ctx.drawImage(img, qrX, qrY, qrSize, qrSize);

    // 5. Instruction below QR
    ctx.fillStyle = '#475569';
    ctx.font = 'bold 24px "JetBrains Mono", Consolas, monospace';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('▲ SCAN QR CODE FOR INSTANT WAREHOUSE INTAKE ▲', width / 2, 1000);

    // 6. RMA Ticket Number (Big Monospace)
    ctx.fillStyle = '#0f172a';
    let rmaFontSize = 64;
    ctx.font = `900 ${rmaFontSize}px "JetBrains Mono", Consolas, monospace`;
    while (ctx.measureText(rmaNumber).width > 1050 && rmaFontSize > 34) {
      rmaFontSize -= 2;
      ctx.font = `900 ${rmaFontSize}px "JetBrains Mono", Consolas, monospace`;
    }
    ctx.fillText(rmaNumber, width / 2, 1085);

    // 7. Product & Barcode Subtitle (Wrapped cleanly across up to 2 lines)
    let nextY = 1150;
    if (productName || barcode) {
      ctx.fillStyle = '#1e293b';
      ctx.font = 'bold 36px "Inter", system-ui, sans-serif';
      nextY = drawWrappedTextCentered(ctx, productName || 'Returned Merchandise', width / 2, nextY, 1040, 44, 2);

      if (barcode) {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#64748b';
        ctx.font = 'bold 28px "JetBrains Mono", Consolas, monospace';
        ctx.fillText(`Barcode: ${barcode}`, width / 2, nextY + 10);
        nextY += 45;
      }
      if (reporter || reporterContact || dateFormatted) {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#475569';
        ctx.font = 'bold 24px "Inter", sans-serif';
        const repInfo = reporter ? (reporterContact && reporterContact !== 'N/A' ? `${reporter} (${reporterContact})` : reporter) : '';
        const metaLine = [repInfo, dateFormatted].filter(Boolean).join('  •  ');
        if (metaLine) {
          ctx.fillText(metaLine, width / 2, nextY + 10);
          nextY += 40;
        }
      }

      // Reporter Signature Line
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#334155';
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(width / 2 - 240, nextY + 30);
      ctx.lineTo(width / 2 + 240, nextY + 30);
      ctx.stroke();

      ctx.fillStyle = '#64748b';
      ctx.font = 'bold 20px "Inter", sans-serif';
      ctx.fillText(`Reporter Signature: ${reporter || 'Staff'}`, width / 2, nextY + 60);
    }

    // 8. Footer timestamp / system notice
    ctx.fillStyle = '#94a3b8';
    ctx.font = '500 22px "Inter", system-ui, sans-serif';
    const dateStr = new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-US', { year: 'numeric', month: 'short', day: 'numeric' });
    ctx.fillText(`RMA Portal Verification • Generated ${dateStr}`, width / 2, 1365);

    // Convert to PNG and download
    const finalFilename = filename || `${rmaNumber}-QR.png`;
    canvas.toBlob((blob) => {
      if (blob) {
        triggerDownload(blob, finalFilename);
      } else {
        triggerDownload(canvas.toDataURL('image/png'), finalFilename);
      }
    }, 'image/png');

    return true;
  } finally {
    URL.revokeObjectURL(blobUrl);
  }
}

/**

  sku = '',

  reporter = 'Warehouse Staff',
  reporterContact = '',

}) {
  const svgEl = typeof svgElementOrId === 'string'
    ? document.getElementById(svgElementOrId)
    : svgElementOrId;

    throw new Error('QR SVG element not found in DOM.');
  }

  const { img, blobUrl } = await svgToImage(svgEl);

  try {
    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    const width = 1200;
    const height = 1680;
    canvas.width = width;
    canvas.height = height;

    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    if (!ctx) throw new Error('Could not initialize canvas context.');

    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';

    ctx.strokeRect(40, 40, width - 80, height - 80);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#0f172a';
    ctx.font = '900 38px "Inter", sans-serif';

    ctx.font = 'bold 22px "JetBrains Mono", Consolas, monospace';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('SCAN FOR RMA DETAILS', qrX + qrSize / 2, qrY + qrSize + 29);

    // 5. Middle Left Column: RMA Number, Supplier, and Status
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#64748b';
    ctx.font = 'bold 24px "Inter", sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('RETURN AUTHORIZATION #', 80, 260);

    // Dynamic Font Sizing for RMA Number to strictly prevent overlapping the QR code!
    // Maximum left column width before reaching QR frame is 620px (from x=80 to x=700)
    let rmaFontSize = 54;
    ctx.font = `900 ${rmaFontSize}px "JetBrains Mono", Consolas, monospace`;
    while (ctx.measureText(rmaNumber).width > 610 && rmaFontSize > 26) {
      rmaFontSize -= 2;
      ctx.font = `900 ${rmaFontSize}px "JetBrains Mono", Consolas, monospace`;
    }
    ctx.fillStyle = '#0f172a';
    ctx.fillText(rmaNumber, 80, 335);

    // Dynamic Supplier Tag Pill (measures text width to fit neatly)
    const supplierText = `Supplier: ${supplier || 'Savemore'}`;
    ctx.font = 'bold 26px "Inter", sans-serif';
    const supplierPillWidth = Math.min(Math.max(ctx.measureText(supplierText).width + 50, 280), 610);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#f1f5f9';
    ctx.fillRect(80, 380, supplierPillWidth, 54);
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#cbd5e1';
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.strokeRect(80, 380, supplierPillWidth, 54);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#334155';
    ctx.fillText(supplierText, 105, 417);

    // Verification Status Badge
    ctx.fillStyle = '#eff6ff';

    ctx.strokeStyle = '#bfdbfe';

    ctx.fillStyle = '#1d4ed8';
    ctx.font = 'bold 22px "Inter", sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('STATUS: LOGGED & PENDING', 105, 484);

    // 6. Section 2: Returned Item Details Container Box (Taller & beautifully spaced)
    const boxY = 670;
    const boxH = 760;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#f8fafc';
    ctx.fillRect(80, boxY, width - 160, boxH);
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#cbd5e1';
    ctx.lineWidth = 4;
    ctx.strokeRect(80, boxY, width - 160, boxH);
